new_string:

```ts
/** The first 32 hex characters of sha256(normalizeEmail(email)): an address never reaches a key in clear, and the digest survives the daily IP salt rotation. */
function emailDigest(email: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(normalizeEmail(email)).digest("hex").slice(0, 32);
}

/** `t:<action>:ip:<ipHash>` / `t:<action>:e:<sha256(normalizedEmail) first 32 hex>`; actions "otp" and "reset" are the auth mail caps. */
export function throttleKey(action: ThrottleAction | "otp" | "reset", kind: "ip" | "email", value: string): string {
  if (kind === "ip") return `t:${action}:ip:${value}`;
  return `t:${action}:e:${emailDigest(value)}`;
}
```

```ts
  db: ThrottleDb,
  args: { action: ThrottleAction; ipHash: string; email: string },

): Promise<boolean> {

  const [ipOk, emailOk] = await Promise.all([
    consumeThrottle(db, throttleKey(args.action, "ip", args.ipHash), { limit: limits.ip, windowSec: THROTTLE_WINDOW_SEC }, now),

}
```

new_string:

```ts
/** What `ipHash()` of src/lib/visitor-hash.ts returns: 32 lower-case hex characters. Anything else (a raw address, a bucket text) is refused before a key is built. */
export const IP_HASH_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/;

/** A typed address (per-pro and global e-mail keys) or a verified identity (its user key only: strangers typing the address cannot lock it out). */
export type ThrottleSubject = { kind: "email"; email: string } | { kind: "user"; userId: string };

/** The actions that take a seat: their per-séance IP key needs the séance (THROTTLE_LIMITS[action].perOccurrenceIp is not null for exactly these, pinned by throttle.test.ts). */
export type SeatTakingThrottleAction = "buybook" | "free";

type ActionThrottleBase = {
  professionalId: string;
  /** ipHash(daily salt, ipBuckets(ip).narrow), never an address */
  ipHash: string;
  /** ipHash(daily salt, ipBuckets(ip).wide), null for IPv4 */
  wideIpHash: string | null;
  subject: ThrottleSubject;
};

/**
 * One throttled call. A seat-taking action (buybook, free) must name its séance: its per-séance IP key
 * is part of the limit, so the type refuses the call without it (a forgotten key would silently weaken
 * the limit, S33) and `actionThrottleKeys` throws on it at run time too. The other actions take no séance.
 */
export type ActionThrottleArgs =
  | (ActionThrottleBase & { action: SeatTakingThrottleAction; occurrenceId: string })
  | (ActionThrottleBase & { action: Exclude<ThrottleAction, SeatTakingThrottleAction>; occurrenceId?: string });

/**
 * Pure: every key and limit the action consumes, in this order: the IP key, the /48 key (when there is
 * one), then for a typed address the global e-mail key and the per-pro e-mail key, or for a verified
 * identity its user key, then the per-séance IP key (seat-taking actions) and the per-pro IP key (free
 * registrations). Throws when a seat-taking action has no occurrence id.
 */
export function actionThrottleKeys(args: ActionThrottleArgs): { key: string; limit: number }[] {
  const { action, professionalId } = args;
  const limits = THROTTLE_LIMITS[action];
  if (limits.perOccurrenceIp !== null && !args.occurrenceId) throw new Error(`throttle: occurrenceId required for ${action}`);
  const keys: { key: string; limit: number }[] = [{ key: throttleKey(action, "ip", args.ipHash), limit: limits.ip }];
  if (args.wideIpHash !== null) keys.push({ key: `t:${action}:ip48:${args.wideIpHash}`, limit: limits.ip48 });
  if (args.subject.kind === "email") {
    const digest = emailDigest(args.subject.email);
    keys.push({ key: `t:${action}:e:${digest}`, limit: limits.emailGlobal });
    keys.push({ key: `t:${action}:e:${professionalId}:${digest}`, limit: limits.email });
  } else {
    keys.push({ key: `t:${action}:u:${args.subject.userId}`, limit: limits.email });
  }
  if (limits.perOccurrenceIp !== null) {
    keys.push({ key: `t:${action}:o:${args.occurrenceId}:ip:${args.ipHash}`, limit: limits.perOccurrenceIp });
  }
  if (limits.perProIp !== null) {
    keys.push({ key: `t:${action}:p:${professionalId}:ip:${args.ipHash}`, limit: limits.perProIp });
  }
  return keys;
}

/** Throws (nothing consumed) when ipHash or a non-null wideIpHash fails IP_HASH_RE, or when a seat-taking action has no occurrence id; else consumes every actionThrottleKeys entry in ONE Promise.all (THROTTLE_WINDOW_SEC); false if any is over. */
export async function checkActionThrottle(db: ThrottleDb, args: ActionThrottleArgs, now: Date): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!IP_HASH_RE.test(args.ipHash) || (args.wideIpHash !== null && !IP_HASH_RE.test(args.wideIpHash))) {
    throw new Error("checkActionThrottle: ipHash must be the 32 hex characters of ipHash()");
  }
  // Built before the first write: a forgotten occurrence id throws here, with nothing consumed.
  const keys = actionThrottleKeys(args);
  const results = await Promise.all(
    keys.map(({ key, limit }) => consumeThrottle(db, key, { limit, windowSec: THROTTLE_WINDOW_SEC }, now)),
  );
  return results.every(Boolean);
}
```

The statement `upsertCustomer` runs after this task (exact):

```sql
with u as (
  select id from "user"
  where id = ${input.userId ?? null}::text and email_verified and lower(email) = ${email}
)
insert into customer (id, professional_id, email, name, phone, user_id, link_version, created_at, updated_at)
values (${nanoid()}, ${input.professionalId}, ${email}, ${input.name.trim()}, ${phone}, (select id from u), 1, ${ts(now)}, ${ts(now)})
on conflict (professional_id, email) do update set
  phone = case when customer.phone is null and excluded.user_id is not null then excluded.phone else customer.phone end,
  user_id = coalesce(customer.user_id, excluded.user_id),
  updated_at = excluded.updated_at
returning id
```

(`email = normalizeEmail(input.email)`, `phone = input.phone?.trim() || null`. `excluded.user_id` is `(select id from u)`, so only a verified session of this same address fills a missing phone, SEC-M8; on INSERT the typed phone stays, it is a new row.)

```ts
type TestDb = Parameters<typeof upsertCustomer>[0];

/** A `client` user row, verified or not, for the account-link cases (the caller deletes it with deleteTestUser). */
async function insertUser(db: TestDb, opts: { email: string; verified: boolean }): Promise<string> {
  const id = nanoid();
  await db.insert(user).values({ id, name: "Client test", email: opts.email, emailVerified: opts.verified, role: "client" });
  return id;
}

dbTest("upsertCustomer normalises the e-mail, keeps the typed phone of a new row and never overwrites the name", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const email = testEmail();
  const first = await upsertCustomer(db, {
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    email: `  ${email.toUpperCase()} `,
    name: " Léa ",
    phone: " 06 00 00 00 00 ",
  });
  const again = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Quelqu'un d'autre", phone: "07 11 11 11 11" });
  assert.equal(again.customerId, first.customerId);
  const row = await customerRow(db, first.customerId);
  assert.deepEqual(
    [row.email, row.name, row.phone, row.userId, row.linkVersion],
    [email, "Léa", "06 00 00 00 00", null, 1],
    "a new row keeps its typed phone; nothing typed afterwards replaces the name or the phone",
  );
});

dbTest("upsertCustomer links an account only for a verified user of the same e-mail, on insert (OUT:69, S3)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const users: string[] = [];
  try {
    const email = testEmail("link");
    const holder = await insertUser(db, { email, verified: true });
    const stranger = await insertUser(db, { email: testEmail("stranger"), verified: true });
    const unverifiedEmail = testEmail("unv");
    const unverified = await insertUser(db, { email: unverifiedEmail, verified: false });
    users.push(holder, stranger, unverified);

    // a verified user of the same address, typed with capitals and spaces: linked
    const mine = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: `  ${email.toUpperCase()} `, name: "Léa", userId: holder });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, mine.customerId)).userId, holder);

    // a verified user of ANOTHER address, typed for a new address: not linked
    const typed = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: testEmail("typed"), name: "Inconnu", userId: stranger });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, typed.customerId)).userId, null);

    // an unverified user of the same address: not linked
    const notYet = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: unverifiedEmail, name: "Pas encore", userId: unverified });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, notYet.customerId)).userId, null);

    // a user id that does not exist: no error, no link
    const ghost = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: testEmail("ghost"), name: "Fantôme", userId: nanoid() });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, ghost.customerId)).userId, null);
  } finally {
    for (const id of users) await deleteTestUser(db, id);
  }
});

dbTest("upsertCustomer on an existing row: links the verified same-address user, never another, never replaces a link, never renames (OUT:69, S3)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  const users: string[] = [];
  try {
    const email = testEmail("link");
    const typedEmail = testEmail("typed");
    const unverifiedEmail = testEmail("unv");
    const legacyEmail = testEmail("legacy");
    const holder = await insertUser(db, { email, verified: true });
    const stranger = await insertUser(db, { email: testEmail("stranger"), verified: true });
    const unverified = await insertUser(db, { email: unverifiedEmail, verified: false });
    const legacyHolder = await insertUser(db, { email: legacyEmail, verified: true });
    users.push(holder, stranger, unverified, legacyHolder);

    // rows first typed by anonymous visitors
    const row = async (address: string, name: string) => (await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: address, name })).customerId;
    const mine = await row(email, "Léa");
    const typed = await row(typedEmail, "Marc");
    const notYet = await row(unverifiedEmail, "Zoé");
    const legacy = await row(legacyEmail, "Hugo");
    for (const id of [mine, typed, notYet, legacy]) assert.equal((await customerRow(db, id)).userId, null);

    // the verified user of the same address links the row, and the name stays
    const again = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Autre nom", userId: holder });
    assert.equal(again.customerId, mine);
    const linked = await customerRow(db, mine);
    assert.deepEqual([linked.userId, linked.name], [holder, "Léa"]);

    // a verified user of another address does not link the row; an unverified user of the same address neither
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: typedEmail, name: "Marc", userId: stranger });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, typed)).userId, null);
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: unverifiedEmail, name: "Zoé", userId: unverified });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, notYet)).userId, null);

    // a link that is already there is never replaced, even by a verified user of the very same address
    await db.execute(sql`update customer set user_id = ${stranger} where id = ${legacy}`);
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: legacyEmail, name: "Hugo", userId: legacyHolder });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, legacy)).userId, stranger);
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa", userId: stranger });
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, mine)).userId, holder);

    // the link is per pro: the same address at another pro is another row, unlinked until that user acts there
    const elsewhere = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: other.proId, email, name: "Léa ailleurs" });
    assert.notEqual(elsewhere.customerId, mine);
    assert.equal((await customerRow(db, elsewhere.customerId)).userId, null);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
    for (const id of users) await deleteTestUser(db, id);
  }
});

dbTest("upsertCustomer fills a missing phone only for a verified user of the same address (SEC-M8, S46)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const users: string[] = [];
  try {
    const email = testEmail("phone");
    const holder = await insertUser(db, { email, verified: true });
    const stranger = await insertUser(db, { email: testEmail("stranger"), verified: true });
    const freshEmail = testEmail("fresh");
    const freshHolder = await insertUser(db, { email: freshEmail, verified: true });
    users.push(holder, stranger, freshHolder);
    const phoneOf = async (id: string) => (await customerRow(db, id)).phone;

    const existing = (await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa" })).customerId;
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(existing), null);

    // anonymous input never fills an existing client's empty phone
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa", phone: "06 99 99 99 99" });
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(existing), null);
    // nor does a verified user of ANOTHER address typing this one
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa", phone: "06 88 88 88 88", userId: stranger });
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(existing), null);
    // the verified user of this address without a phone leaves it empty
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa", userId: holder });
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(existing), null);

    // the verified user of this address fills it
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa", phone: " 06 11 22 33 44 ", userId: holder });
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(existing), "06 11 22 33 44");
    // and nobody replaces a phone that is there
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa", phone: "07 00 00 00 00", userId: holder });
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(existing), "06 11 22 33 44");
    await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email, name: "Léa", phone: "07 00 00 00 00" });
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(existing), "06 11 22 33 44");

    // a new row keeps the typed phone, with or without an account
    const fresh = await upsertCustomer(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, email: freshEmail, name: "Marc", phone: "06 55 55 55 55", userId: freshHolder });
    assert.equal(await phoneOf(fresh.customerId), "06 55 55 55 55");
  } finally {
    for (const id of users) await deleteTestUser(db, id);
  }
});
```

```ts
dbTest("recordOrphanPayment counts the payment for the admin card and returns the orphan outcome (the webhook's unresolvable sessions)", async (h) => {
  const key = HEALTH_KEYS.orphanPayments;
  const [saved] = await h.db.select().from(throttle).where(eq(throttle.key, key));
  try {
    const before = (await readHealth(h.db))[key]?.value ?? 0;
    const done = await recordOrphanPayment(h.db, payment(true), new Date());
    assert.deepEqual(done, { ok: true, effects: [], outcome: "orphan", ticketIds: [], bookingConfirmed: false });
    assert.equal((await readHealth(h.db))[key]?.value, before + 1);
    // a payment without a session id (the mock checkout shape) is counted the same way
    await recordOrphanPayment(h.db, { sessionId: null, paymentIntentId: null, livemode: false }, new Date());
    assert.equal((await readHealth(h.db))[key]?.value, before + 2);
  } finally {
    if (saved) {
      await h.db.update(throttle).set({ hits: saved.hits, windowStart: saved.windowStart }).where(eq(throttle.key, key));
    } else {
      await h.db.delete(throttle).where(eq(throttle.key, key));
    }
  }
});
```

```ts
 * Anonymous identity (E1, E3, E4, E9), ONE statement: insert, or on
 * (professional_id, email) fill only the blanks: phone and user_id are
 * COALESCEd, the name is NEVER overwritten by anonymous input. `userId` only
 * when a verified session carries the same e-mail (the caller checks). The
 * caller validated the input (customerInputSchema); a CHECK error throws.
 */
export async function upsertCustomer(
  db: Db,
  input: { professionalId: string; email: string; name: string; phone?: string | null; userId?: string | null },
  now: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<{ customerId: string }> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
    insert into customer (id, professional_id, email, name, phone, user_id, link_version, created_at, updated_at)
    values (${nanoid()}, ${input.professionalId}, ${normalizeEmail(input.email)}, ${input.name.trim()},
      ${input.phone?.trim() || null}, ${input.userId ?? null}, 1, ${ts(now)}, ${ts(now)})
    on conflict (professional_id, email) do update set
      phone = coalesce(customer.phone, excluded.phone),
      user_id = coalesce(customer.user_id, excluded.user_id),
      updated_at = excluded.updated_at
    returning id`);
  return { customerId: res.rows[0].id };
}
```

new_string:

```ts
/**
 * Anonymous identity (E1, E3, E4, E9), ONE statement: insert, or on
 * (professional_id, email) fill only the blanks. The name is NEVER overwritten
 * by anonymous input. `userId` is kept only when that user is verified and
 * carries this e-mail, on insert and on conflict (OUT:69): a typed e-mail never
 * links someone else's account, and anonymous input never fills an existing
 * client's phone (only that verified user does, SEC-M8; a new row keeps its
 * typed phone). The row identifies a customer to attach a booking or a purchase
 * to; it authorises nothing (no wallet, no spend). The caller validated the
 * input (customerInputSchema); a CHECK error throws.
 */
export async function upsertCustomer(
  db: Db,
  input: { professionalId: string; email: string; name: string; phone?: string | null; userId?: string | null },
  now: Date = new Date(),
): Promise<{ customerId: string }> {
  const email = normalizeEmail(input.email);
  const phone = input.phone?.trim() || null;
  const res = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
    with u as (
      select id from "user"
      where id = ${input.userId ?? null}::text and email_verified and lower(email) = ${email}
    )
    insert into customer (id, professional_id, email, name, phone, user_id, link_version, created_at, updated_at)
    values (${nanoid()}, ${input.professionalId}, ${email}, ${input.name.trim()}, ${phone}, (select id from u), 1, ${ts(now)}, ${ts(now)})
    on conflict (professional_id, email) do update set
      phone = case when customer.phone is null and excluded.user_id is not null then excluded.phone else customer.phone end,
      user_id = coalesce(customer.user_id, excluded.user_id),
      updated_at = excluded.updated_at
    returning id`);
  return { customerId: res.rows[0].id };
}
```

```js
// One-off rewrite for Task 4: every bookWithHeldTicket call of the DB tests passes the pro's user as the client user
// (the engine only records it). Only the text of a bookWithHeldTicket(...) call is touched.
const fs = require("fs");
const files = [
  "src/lib/back-office/catalog-actions.db.test.ts",
  "src/lib/back-office/catalog-reads.db.test.ts",
  "src/lib/booking/cancel.db.test.ts",
  "src/lib/booking/delete-user.db.test.ts",
  "src/lib/booking/series-occurrence.db.test.ts",
  "src/lib/booking/time-off.db.test.ts",
  "src/lib/booking/wallet.db.test.ts",
];
const CALL = "bookWithHeldTicket(";
let total = 0;
for (const file of files) {
  const original = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  let text = original;
  let from = 0;
  let count = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const at = text.indexOf(CALL, from);
    if (at < 0) break;
    // the call text runs from its opening parenthesis to the matching one
    let depth = 0;
    let end = at + CALL.length - 1;
    for (; end < text.length; end++) {
      if (text[end] === "(") depth++;
      else if (text[end] === ")" && --depth === 0) break;
    }
    const call = text.slice(at, end + 1);
    const fixed = call.replace("actorUserId: null", "actorUserId: pro.userId");
    if (fixed !== call) count++;
    text = text.slice(0, at) + fixed + text.slice(end + 1);
    from = at + fixed.length;
  }
  if (text !== original) fs.writeFileSync(file, text, "utf8");
  console.log(`${file}: ${count} call(s) rewritten`);
  total += count;
}
console.log(`total ${total}`);
```

```ts
// src/lib/public/identity.ts
export type SessionFacts = {
  userId: string; email: string; name: string; emailVerified: boolean;
  /** = impersonatedBy !== null */
  impersonated: boolean;
  /** the admin's user id while an admin impersonates (session.impersonatedBy), else null: ids-only trace lines (Decision 75, FR:SEC-6) */
  impersonatedBy: string | null;
};
export type SessionLike =
  | { user: { id: string; email: string; name?: string | null; emailVerified?: boolean | null }; session: { impersonatedBy?: string | null } }
  | null
  | undefined;
export function sessionFactsOf(session: SessionLike): SessionFacts | null;
export type VisitorState = "anonymous" | "unverified" | "verified" | "impersonating";
export function visitorState(s: SessionFacts | null): VisitorState;
export type WalletOwner = { professionalId: string; customerId: string; userId: string; email: string };
export type PublicVisitor = {
  state: VisitorState;
  email: string | null; name: string | null;
  isPageOwner: boolean;
  owner: WalletOwner | null;
  guestCustomerId: string | null;
};
export async function resolveVisitor(
  db: Db,
  args: { session: SessionFacts | null; guestToken: string | undefined; key: Buffer },
  pro: { professionalId: string; ownerUserId: string },
): Promise<PublicVisitor>;
export async function linkCustomerUser(db: Db, owner: WalletOwner, now: Date): Promise<void>;
export function upsertUserIdFor(s: SessionFacts | null, email: string): string | null;
export async function customerEmailOf(db: Db, professionalId: string, customerId: string): Promise<string | null>;
export function spaceIdentityOf(visitor: PublicVisitor): SpaceIdentity; // addition of this plan, see Step 8

// src/lib/back-office/guest-access.ts
export async function ownedCustomerId(db: Db, professionalId: string, s: { userId: string; email: string }): Promise<string | null>;
export type SpaceIdentity =
  | { kind: "customer"; customerId: string; via: "session" | "guest" }
  | { kind: "no_record"; email: string }
  | { kind: "unverified"; email: string; guestCustomerId: string | null }
  | { kind: "impersonating" }
  | { kind: "anonymous" };
export type SpaceSession = { userId: string; email: string; emailVerified: boolean; impersonated: boolean };
```

Rules this task enforces (contract § 1 Identity, Decisions 5, 19, 63, 70, 72, 75): a wallet owner is a verified, non-impersonated, FRESH session whose e-mail is the e-mail of a customer of the page's pro that is not linked to another account; the guest cookie is never read for a verified or an impersonating session; a render never writes (`resolveVisitor` is read-only; `linkCustomerUser` runs only in an action core, after its `parseFr` and its throttle, Revision 3.2); `visitor.ts` has no writer and no file under `src` outside the tests names `requireWalletOwner` (Revision 3.3); no `getSession()` (5-minute cookie cache) anywhere in `visitor.ts`.

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import type { SessionFacts } from "../lib/public/identity";
import type { Db } from "./db";

/** 32 random lowercase hex characters: a valid ipHash (IP_HASH_RE), a fresh throttle bucket for every call. */
export function testIpHash(): string {
  return randomBytes(16).toString("hex");
}

/** A `client` user row (verified or not), deleted by the caller with deleteTestUser. */
export async function createTestClientUser(
  db: Db,
  opts: { email: string; name?: string; verified: boolean },
): Promise<{ userId: string }> {
  const schema = await import("../lib/db/schema");
  const userId = nanoid();
  await db.insert(schema.user).values({
    id: userId,
    name: opts.name ?? "Client test",
    email: opts.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
    emailVerified: opts.verified,
    role: "client",
  });
  return { userId };
}

/** The facts of a signed-in client: verified unless `verified: false`; impersonated gives the fixed fake admin id "admin-test". */
export function sessionOf(
  u: { userId: string; email: string; name?: string },
  opts: { verified?: boolean; impersonated?: boolean } = {},
): SessionFacts {
  const impersonated = opts.impersonated === true;
  return {
    userId: u.userId,
    email: u.email,
    name: u.name ?? "Client test",
    emailVerified: opts.verified ?? true,
    impersonated,
    impersonatedBy: impersonated ? "admin-test" : null,
  };
}
```

```ts
const noGuest = { guestToken: undefined, key: KEY } as const;

/** The espace view of a session: verified and not impersonated unless `over` says otherwise. */
const sessionFor = (userId: string, email: string, over: Partial<SpaceSession> = {}): SpaceSession => ({
  userId,
  email,
  emailVerified: true,
  impersonated: false,
  ...over,
});

dbTest("resolveSpaceIdentity: a verified session gives the customer of this pro by e-mail, or no_record", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const email = testEmail("session");
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { email });

  assert.deepEqual(
    await resolveSpaceIdentity(db, pro.proId, { ...noGuest, session: sessionFor("u-session", ` ${email.toUpperCase()}`) }),
    { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "session" },
  );
  const stranger = testEmail("stranger");
  assert.deepEqual(
    await resolveSpaceIdentity(db, pro.proId, { ...noGuest, session: sessionFor("u-stranger", stranger) }),
    { kind: "no_record", email: stranger },

dbTest("resolveSpaceIdentity: a row linked to another account is not the session's: no_record, cookie or not (Decision 5)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const email = testEmail("linked");
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { email });
  const mine = await createTestClientUser(db, { email, verified: true });
  const rival = await createTestClientUser(db, { email: testEmail("rival"), verified: true });
  try {
    const session = sessionFor(mine.userId, email);
    // unlinked row: the verified owner of the address
    assert.deepEqual(await resolveSpaceIdentity(db, pro.proId, { ...noGuest, session }), { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "session" });

    // linked to another user: not hers, and the valid cookie of that customer does not open it for a verified session (L1370)
    await db.update(schema.customer).set({ userId: rival.userId }).where(eq(schema.customer.id, customerId));
    const token = signGuestLink({ customerId, linkVersion: 1 }, KEY);
    assert.deepEqual(await resolveSpaceIdentity(db, pro.proId, { ...noGuest, session }), { kind: "no_record", email });
    assert.deepEqual(await resolveSpaceIdentity(db, pro.proId, { session, guestToken: token, key: KEY }), { kind: "no_record", email });

    // linked to the session user: hers
    await db.update(schema.customer).set({ userId: mine.userId }).where(eq(schema.customer.id, customerId));
    assert.deepEqual(await resolveSpaceIdentity(db, pro.proId, { ...noGuest, session }), { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "session" });
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, mine.userId);
    await deleteTestUser(db, rival.userId);
  }
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The customer of this pro a verified session owns: its e-mail is normalizeEmail(s.email) (customer_pro_email_uq) AND
 * it is not linked to another account (user_id null or the session user's own). The same predicate as getMySpace (spec
 * L1377-1378) and as the wallet owner (Decision 5). The caller has checked that the session is verified, fresh and not
 * impersonated; null when there is no such row.
 */
export async function ownedCustomerId(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  s: { userId: string; email: string },
): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ id: customer.id })
    .from(customer)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(customer.email, normalizeEmail(s.email)),
        or(isNull(customer.userId), eq(customer.userId, s.userId)),
      ),
    );
  return row?.id ?? null;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Who is looking at this pro's espace (spec § 12, Decision 36). A VERIFIED,
 * non-impersonated session wins: its customer at this pro, or no_record. An
 * unverified session counts for nothing (anyone can sign up with someone
 * else's address), and an admin impersonating the pro never reads a client's
 * data through the pro's session. Else the guest cookie, checked against this
 * pro and the customer's current link version. Else anonymous.
 */
export async function resolveSpaceIdentity(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  input: { session: SpaceSession | null; guestToken: string | undefined; key: Buffer },
): Promise<SpaceIdentity> {
  const { session } = input;
  if (session && session.emailVerified && !session.impersonated) {
    const customerId = await customerFromVerifiedEmail(db, professionalId, session.email);
    return customerId ? { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "session" } : { kind: "no_record", email: session.email };
  }
  const customerId = await customerFromGuestCookie(db, professionalId, input.guestToken, input.key);
  return customerId ? { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "guest" } : { kind: "anonymous" };
}
```

with:

```ts
/**
 * Who is looking at this pro's espace (spec § 12, Decision 36). An impersonating admin is `impersonating` (checked
 * first; the cookie is ignored). A VERIFIED session wins: its owned customer at this pro (ownedCustomerId) or
 * no_record, and the cookie is ignored (L1370). An unverified session counts for nothing (anyone can sign up with
 * someone else's address) but is never anonymous: `unverified` carries the cookie's customer, shown read-only next to
 * the confirmation banner. With no session at all: the guest cookie, checked against this pro and the customer's
 * current link version, else anonymous.
 */
export async function resolveSpaceIdentity(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  input: { session: SpaceSession | null; guestToken: string | undefined; key: Buffer },
): Promise<SpaceIdentity> {
  const { session } = input;
  if (session?.impersonated) return { kind: "impersonating" };
  if (session?.emailVerified) {
    const customerId = await ownedCustomerId(db, professionalId, session);
    return customerId ? { kind: "customer", customerId, via: "session" } : { kind: "no_record", email: session.email };
  }
  const guestCustomerId = await customerFromGuestCookie(db, professionalId, input.guestToken, input.key);
  if (session) return { kind: "unverified", email: session.email, guestCustomerId };
  return guestCustomerId ? { kind: "customer", customerId: guestCustomerId, via: "guest" } : { kind: "anonymous" };
}
```

```ts
  assert.equal(visitorState(sessionOf(user, { verified: false, impersonated: true })), "impersonating", "impersonated + unverified is impersonating");
});

test("upsertUserIdFor (S4): the session user only for a verified, non-impersonated session of the SAME address, case and spaces ignored", () => {

  assert.equal(upsertUserIdFor(sessionOf(me), "beatriz@example.com"), "u1");
  assert.equal(upsertUserIdFor(sessionOf(me), "  Beatriz@Example.COM "), "u1");
  assert.equal(upsertUserIdFor(sessionOf({ ...me, email: "Beatriz@Example.com" }), "beatriz@example.com"), "u1", "the session side is normalised too");
});

  assert.equal(upsertUserIdFor(sessionOf(me), "thomas@example.com"), null);
  assert.equal(upsertUserIdFor(sessionOf(me), ""), null);
  assert.equal(upsertUserIdFor(null, "beatriz@example.com"), null);

function visitor(over: Partial<PublicVisitor>): PublicVisitor {
  return { state: "anonymous", email: null, name: null, isPageOwner: false, owner: null, guestCustomerId: null, ...over };
}

test("spaceIdentityOf: the espace identity of a visitor, in the order of the contract (COV-C1)", () => {
  // impersonation first, whatever else the visitor object says
  assert.deepEqual(spaceIdentityOf(visitor({ state: "impersonating", owner: OWNER, guestCustomerId: "c9" })), { kind: "impersonating" });
  // the Owner
  assert.deepEqual(spaceIdentityOf(visitor({ state: "verified", email: OWNER.email, owner: OWNER })), {
    kind: "customer",
    customerId: "c1",
    via: "session",
  });
  // verified without a record: no_record, and a cookie that should not be there is not used (L1370)
  assert.deepEqual(spaceIdentityOf(visitor({ state: "verified", email: "x@example.com", guestCustomerId: "c9" })), {
    kind: "no_record",
    email: "x@example.com",
  });
  // unverified: the banner kind, with or without the cookie's customer, never anonymous
  assert.deepEqual(spaceIdentityOf(visitor({ state: "unverified", email: "x@example.com" })), {
    kind: "unverified",
    email: "x@example.com",
    guestCustomerId: null,
  });
  assert.deepEqual(spaceIdentityOf(visitor({ state: "unverified", email: "x@example.com", guestCustomerId: "c9" })), {
    kind: "unverified",
    email: "x@example.com",
    guestCustomerId: "c9",
  });
  // signed out
  assert.deepEqual(spaceIdentityOf(visitor({ guestCustomerId: "c9" })), { kind: "customer", customerId: "c9", via: "guest" });
  assert.deepEqual(spaceIdentityOf(visitor({})), { kind: "anonymous" });
});
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import { ownedCustomerId } from "@/lib/back-office/guest-access";
import { revokeLinks } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import * as schema from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { guestLinkKey, signGuestLink } from "@/lib/guest-link";
import { createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, testEmail, type Db, type TestPro } from "@/test/db";
import { makeCustomer } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { createTestClientUser, sessionOf } from "@/test/public";

import { customerEmailOf, linkCustomerUser, resolveVisitor, type WalletOwner } from "./identity";

const KEY = guestLinkKey("test-secret");
const noCookie = { guestToken: undefined, key: KEY } as const;
const target = (pro: TestPro) => ({ professionalId: pro.proId, ownerUserId: pro.userId });
const tokenOf = (customerId: string, linkVersion = 1) => signGuestLink({ customerId, linkVersion }, KEY);

/** Client users for the duration of `fn`, deleted after it (the harness only deletes the pro's user). */
async function withClientUsers<T>(
  db: Db,
  specs: { email: string; verified: boolean }[],
  fn: (users: { userId: string; email: string }[]) => Promise<T>,
): Promise<T> {
  const users: { userId: string; email: string }[] = [];
  try {
    for (const spec of specs) {
      const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(db, spec);
      users.push({ userId, email: spec.email });
    }
    return await fn(users);
  } finally {
    for (const u of users) await deleteTestUser(db, u.userId);
  }
}

async function customerRow(db: Db, customerId: string) {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ userId: schema.customer.userId, updatedAt: schema.customer.updatedAt })
    .from(schema.customer)
    .where(eq(schema.customer.id, customerId));
  return row;
}

      // unlinked row; the address matches with case and spaces ignored

      // linked to the session user

      assert.equal(await ownedCustomerId(db, pro.proId, { userId: me.userId, email }), customerId);

      // linked to another user: not hers
      await db.update(schema.customer).set({ userId: rival.userId }).where(eq(schema.customer.id, customerId));
      assert.equal(await ownedCustomerId(db, pro.proId, { userId: me.userId, email }), null);

      // another address at this pro
      assert.equal(await ownedCustomerId(db, pro.proId, { userId: me.userId, email: testEmail("nobody") }), null);

      // another pro's page has no row for this address (S6); its own row for the address is its own
      assert.equal(await ownedCustomerId(db, other.proId, { userId: me.userId, email }), null);
      const theirs = await makeCustomer(db, other, { email });
      assert.equal(await ownedCustomerId(db, other.proId, { userId: me.userId, email }), theirs);

    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
```

Create `src/lib/public/identity.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Visitor identity of the public pages and actions (spec § 12, contract § 3.5). No `server-only`, no env and no
 * process db: the callers pass `db`, the guest key and the session facts they read from the request, so the DB tests
 * run this module as it is (src/server/visitor.ts is the thin wrapper that reads the fresh session and the cookie).
 *
 * Rules: a session counts only when read fresh and not suspended (the wrapper applies actingSession first); an admin
 * impersonating a pro is a visitor with no client identity (no wallet, no cookie); the wallet Owner is a verified
 * session whose e-mail is the e-mail of a customer of THIS pro that is not linked to another account; the guest
 * cookie is read only for a signed-out or an unverified visitor, never for a verified or an impersonating one. A
 * render never writes: linkCustomerUser runs only in an action core, after the core has parsed its input and passed
 * its throttle (bookWithHeldTicketCore), never in a wrapper or a page.
 */
import { and, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import {
  customerFromGuestCookie,
  ownedCustomerId,
  type SpaceIdentity,
} from "@/lib/back-office/guest-access";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { customer } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { normalizeEmail } from "@/lib/tickets";

export type SessionFacts = {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  emailVerified: boolean;
  /** = impersonatedBy !== null */
  impersonated: boolean;
  /** the admin's user id while an admin impersonates (session.impersonatedBy), else null: ids-only trace lines (Decision 75, FR:SEC-6) */
  impersonatedBy: string | null;
};

export type SessionLike =
  | {
      user: { id: string; email: string; name?: string | null; emailVerified?: boolean | null };
      session: { impersonatedBy?: string | null };
    }
  | null
  | undefined;

/**
 * The fields of a (fresh, not suspended: visitor.ts applies actingSession first) Better Auth session P4 relies on;
 * null without a session. Fails closed: any impersonatedBy that is not null or undefined, an empty string included,
 * counts as an impersonation.
 */
export function sessionFactsOf(session: SessionLike): SessionFacts | null {
  if (!session) return null;
  const impersonatedBy = session.session.impersonatedBy ?? null;
  return {
    userId: session.user.id,
    email: session.user.email,
    name: session.user.name ?? "",
    emailVerified: session.user.emailVerified === true,
    impersonated: impersonatedBy !== null,
    impersonatedBy,
  };
}

export type VisitorState = "anonymous" | "unverified" | "verified" | "impersonating";

/** null → anonymous; impersonated → impersonating (checked first); !emailVerified → unverified; else verified. */
export function visitorState(s: SessionFacts | null): VisitorState {
  if (!s) return "anonymous";
  if (s.impersonated) return "impersonating";
  return s.emailVerified ? "verified" : "unverified";
}

export type WalletOwner = { professionalId: string; customerId: string; userId: string; email: string };

export type PublicVisitor = {
  state: VisitorState;
  /** session e-mail and name, only for "unverified" and "verified" */
  email: string | null;
  name: string | null;
  /** the session user owns this pro page (impersonation included) */
  isPageOwner: boolean;
  /** "verified" with a customer of this pro: e-mail = the session e-mail AND (user_id null OR the session user) */
  owner: WalletOwner | null;
  /** the skedul_guest cookie's customer of THIS pro at its current link_version; always null when state is "verified" (L1370) or "impersonating" (SEC-M6, Decision 19) */
  guestCustomerId: string | null;
};

/** Read-only (a render never writes): state, owner (ownedCustomerId of guest-access.ts), guest cookie customer (customerFromGuestCookie, skipped for verified and impersonating), page ownership. */
export async function resolveVisitor(
  db: Db,
  args: { session: SessionFacts | null; guestToken: string | undefined; key: Buffer },
  pro: { professionalId: string; ownerUserId: string },
): Promise<PublicVisitor> {
  const { session } = args;
  const state = visitorState(session);
  let owner: WalletOwner | null = null;
  let guestCustomerId: string | null = null;
  if (session && state === "verified") {
    const customerId = await ownedCustomerId(db, pro.professionalId, session);
    if (customerId) {
      owner = { professionalId: pro.professionalId, customerId, userId: session.userId, email: normalizeEmail(session.email) };
    }
  } else if (state === "anonymous" || state === "unverified") {
    guestCustomerId = await customerFromGuestCookie(db, pro.professionalId, args.guestToken, args.key);
  }
  const identified = session !== null && (state === "verified" || state === "unverified") ? session : null;
  return {
    state,
    email: identified ? identified.email : null,
    name: identified ? identified.name : null,
    isPageOwner: session !== null && session.userId === pro.ownerUserId,
    owner,
    guestCustomerId,
  };
}

/**
 * The Owner's link write (L1345): set customer.user_id to the owner's user when it is still null. The statement
 * names the pro and the customer (a customer of another pro is never touched), keeps a linked row as it is, and,
 * defence in depth, links only a VERIFIED user whose e-mail is the row's own (the caller has checked it).
 */
export async function linkCustomerUser(db: Db, owner: WalletOwner, now: Date): Promise<void> {
  const email = normalizeEmail(owner.email);
  await db
    .update(customer)
    .set({ userId: owner.userId, updatedAt: now })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(customer.id, owner.customerId),
        eq(customer.professionalId, owner.professionalId),
        isNull(customer.userId),
        eq(customer.email, email),
        sql`exists (select 1 from "user" u where u.id = ${owner.userId} and u.email_verified and lower(u.email) = ${email})`,
      ),
    );
}

/** userId for upsertCustomer and the throttle subject: the session user only when verified, not impersonated and normalizeEmail(email) equals the session e-mail; else null (OUT:69, defence in depth with § 3.4). */
export function upsertUserIdFor(s: SessionFacts | null, email: string): string | null {
  if (!s || !s.emailVerified || s.impersonated) return null;
  return normalizeEmail(email) === normalizeEmail(s.email) ? s.userId : null;
}

/** The e-mail of THIS pro's customer (throttle subject of a guest cancel or a release); server-side only, never returned to the browser. */
export async function customerEmailOf(db: Db, professionalId: string, customerId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ email: customer.email })
    .from(customer)
    .where(and(eq(customer.id, customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId)));
  return row?.email ?? null;
}

/**
 * The espace identity of a visitor, in this order: impersonating; the Owner; verified without a record
 * (no_record); unverified (+ the cookie's customer, read-only); the cookie's customer; anonymous. A signed-in
 * visitor, verified or not, never maps to anonymous (COV-C1). Pure twin of resolveSpaceIdentity (guest-access.ts),
 * used by resolveSpaceCustomer in src/server/client-queries.ts.
 */
export function spaceIdentityOf(visitor: PublicVisitor): SpaceIdentity {
  if (visitor.state === "impersonating") return { kind: "impersonating" };
  if (visitor.owner) return { kind: "customer", customerId: visitor.owner.customerId, via: "session" };
  if (visitor.state === "verified") return { kind: "no_record", email: visitor.email ?? "" };
  if (visitor.state === "unverified") {
    return { kind: "unverified", email: visitor.email ?? "", guestCustomerId: visitor.guestCustomerId };
  }
  if (visitor.guestCustomerId) return { kind: "customer", customerId: visitor.guestCustomerId, via: "guest" };
  return { kind: "anonymous" };
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { cookies, headers } from "next/headers";
import { cache } from "react";

import { ADMIN_TZ } from "@/lib/analytics";
import { clientIpFrom, ipBuckets } from "@/lib/client-ip";
import { dayKeyInTz } from "@/lib/datetime";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { GUEST_COOKIE } from "@/lib/guest-link";
import { resolveVisitor, sessionFactsOf, type PublicVisitor, type SessionFacts } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { getFreshSession } from "@/lib/session";
import { actingSession } from "@/lib/suspension";
import { ipHash } from "@/lib/visitor-hash";
import { getDailySalt } from "@/server/analytics-salt";
import { guestKey } from "@/server/guest-key";

/** ipHash(daily salt, bucket) of both ipBuckets(clientIpFrom(await headers())) entries; wideIpHash null when the wide bucket is null. */
export async function visitorIpHashes(now: Date): Promise<{ ipHash: string; wideIpHash: string | null }> {
  const { narrow, wide } = ipBuckets(clientIpFrom(await headers()));
  const salt = await getDailySalt(dayKeyInTz(now, ADMIN_TZ));
  return { ipHash: ipHash(salt, narrow), wideIpHash: wide === null ? null : ipHash(salt, wide) };
}

/**
 * sessionFactsOf(actingSession(await getFreshSession())): never the 5-minute cookie cache (L1321-1324), and a
 * suspended user is no session (FR:SEC-2, as requireProContext).
 */
export async function currentSessionFacts(): Promise<SessionFacts | null> {
  return sessionFactsOf(actingSession(await getFreshSession()));
}

/**
 * cache()d per request on (professionalId, ownerUserId): resolveVisitor with the fresh session, the skedul_guest cookie
 * and the guest key. It only reads. The wallet Owner is its `owner` field; the one write that depends on it (the
 * account link) is made by bookWithHeldTicketCore, after its parseFr and its throttle (contract Revision 3.2).
 */
export const currentPublicVisitor: (professionalId: string, ownerUserId: string) => Promise<PublicVisitor> = cache(
  async (professionalId: string, ownerUserId: string): Promise<PublicVisitor> =>
    resolveVisitor(
      db,
      {
        session: await currentSessionFacts(),
        guestToken: (await cookies()).get(GUEST_COOKIE)?.value,
        key: guestKey(),
      },
      { professionalId, ownerUserId },
    ),
);
```

```ts
}
```

Create `src/lib/payments/checkout.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Checkout gateway and the pure rules around it (spec § 11 E1 and E9, § 14, contract § 3.6). No `server-only`, no
 * env and no Stripe client (the Stripe import is a type): the real gateway lives in src/lib/stripe.ts and the
 * tests, the cores and the mock route use this module as it is.
 *
 * Every Skedul tickets session carries `metadata { purchaseId, app, env }` (and the same on its payment intent) so
 * the webhook handles only sessions of its own app and environment (SEC-I7). Every URL is built from the trusted
 * app URL and ids only: no redirect or next parameter, no address (S16).
 */
import type Stripe from "stripe";

import { CHECKOUT_MINUTES } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type PaymentMode = "mock" | "test" | "live";
export type CheckoutKind = "buybook" | "shop";

export type CheckoutRequest = {
  kind: CheckoutKind;
  purchaseId: string;
  amountCents: number;
  currency: string;
  productName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  successUrl: string;
  cancelUrl: string;
  expiresAt: Date;
  /** APP_ENV of the deployment that creates the session (SEC-I7) */
  env: string;
};

/** The marker every Skedul tickets session carries in its metadata (SEC-I7); the webhook ignores any other session. */
export const SESSION_APP = "skedul-tickets";

export type CheckoutCreated = { sessionId: string; url: string };
export type CheckoutCloseOutcome = "expired" | "already_expired" | "paid" | "processing" | "mock" | "failed";

export interface CheckoutGateway {
  readonly mode: PaymentMode;
  /** Creates the Checkout session (idempotency key checkout:<purchaseId>); throws on any error. */
  create(req: CheckoutRequest): Promise<CheckoutCreated>;
  /** « Libérer ma place » (L1166-1167): retrieve, expire when open. Never throws ("failed"). */
  closeForRelease(sessionId: string): Promise<CheckoutCloseOutcome>;
  /** Best effort expiry of a session the engine refused to attach. Never throws. */
  expire(sessionId: string): Promise<void>;
}

export const MOCK_SESSION_PREFIX = "mock_";

/** `mock_<purchaseId>`: the session id stored for a simulated checkout. */
export function mockSessionId(purchaseId: string): string {
  return `${MOCK_SESSION_PREFIX}${purchaseId}`;
}

/** True for a simulated session id; every Stripe call short-circuits on it (Decision 29). */
export function isMockSession(sessionId: string): boolean {
  return sessionId.startsWith(MOCK_SESSION_PREFIX);
}

/** The app URL without its trailing slashes. */
function baseOf(appUrl: string): string {
  return appUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "");
}

/** `${appUrl}/api/mock-checkout?purchase=<id>` (L815): the only parameter. */
export function mockCheckoutUrl(appUrl: string, purchaseId: string): string {
  return `${baseOf(appUrl)}/api/mock-checkout?purchase=${encodeURIComponent(purchaseId)}`;
}

export type CheckoutTarget = { slug: string; purchaseId: string } & (
  | { kind: "buybook"; occurrenceId: string }
  | { kind: "shop"; offerId: string }
);

/** Path of the cancel page: /{slug}/seance/{o}?paiement=annule&p={id} (L812) or /{slug}/offre/{offerId}?paiement=annule&p={id}. */
export function cancelPathOf(t: CheckoutTarget): string {
  const page =
    t.kind === "buybook"
      ? `seance/${encodeURIComponent(t.occurrenceId)}`
      : `offre/${encodeURIComponent(t.offerId)}`;
  return `/${encodeURIComponent(t.slug)}/${page}?paiement=annule&p=${encodeURIComponent(t.purchaseId)}`;
}

/** success = `${appUrl}/{slug}/merci?p={id}` (L811); cancel = appUrl + cancelPathOf(t). Built from the trusted app URL only. */
export function checkoutUrls(appUrl: string, t: CheckoutTarget): { successUrl: string; cancelUrl: string } {
  const base = baseOf(appUrl);
  return {
    successUrl: `${base}/${encodeURIComponent(t.slug)}/merci?p=${encodeURIComponent(t.purchaseId)}`,
    cancelUrl: `${base}${cancelPathOf(t)}`,
  };
}

/** nowMs + CHECKOUT_MINUTES minutes, computed right before the Stripe call (L808). */
export function buybookCheckoutExpiry(nowMs: number): Date {
  return new Date(nowMs + CHECKOUT_MINUTES * 60_000);
}

/**
 * The Stripe session params (L808, L1103-1104): one line item, `client_reference_id` and the app marker as
 * consistency data, whole-second `expires_at`, French page. A buy + book is card only; a shop purchase uses the
 * methods of the Stripe dashboard.
 */
export function stripeSessionParams(req: CheckoutRequest): Stripe.Checkout.SessionCreateParams {
  const marker = { purchaseId: req.purchaseId, app: SESSION_APP, env: req.env };
  const params: Stripe.Checkout.SessionCreateParams = {
    mode: "payment",
    customer_email: req.customerEmail,
    client_reference_id: req.purchaseId,
    metadata: marker,
    payment_intent_data: { metadata: { ...marker } },
    line_items: [
      {
        quantity: 1,
        price_data: {
          currency: req.currency,
          unit_amount: req.amountCents,
          product_data: { name: req.productName },
        },
      },
    ],
    expires_at: Math.floor(req.expiresAt.getTime() / 1000),
    success_url: req.successUrl,
    cancel_url: req.cancelUrl,
    locale: "fr",
    submit_type: "pay",
  };
  if (req.kind === "buybook") params.payment_method_types = ["card"];
  return params;
}

/**
 * What « Libérer ma place » learns from a retrieved session: open → "open"; expired → "already_expired"; complete
 * and paid → "paid"; anything else, no_payment_required included, → "processing" (never release on doubt, COV-M2).
 */
export function closeOutcomeOf(session: {
  status: string | null;
  payment_status: string | null;
}): "open" | "already_expired" | "paid" | "processing" {
  if (session.status === "open") return "open";
  if (session.status === "expired") return "already_expired";
  if (session.status === "complete" && session.payment_status === "paid") return "paid";
  return "processing";
}

/** "mock" when disabled or without key; "live" for sk_live_ / rk_live_; else "test". The ONE mode rule: src/lib/admin-metrics.ts re-exports it as stripeMode (COV-M8). */
export function paymentModeOf(secretKey: string | undefined, enabled: boolean): PaymentMode {
  if (!enabled || !secretKey) return "mock";
  return /^(sk|rk)_live_/.test(secretKey) ? "live" : "test";
}

/**
 * The simulated checkout is reachable only without Stripe keys AND outside production, by APP_ENV and by
 * VERCEL_ENV (SEC-I5, Decision 27): APP_ENV defaults to development when unset, so a keyless Vercel production
 * would otherwise hand out free tickets.
 */
export function mockCheckoutAllowed(e: { STRIPE_ENABLED: boolean; APP_ENV: string; VERCEL_ENV?: string }): boolean {
  return !e.STRIPE_ENABLED && e.APP_ENV !== "production" && e.VERCEL_ENV !== "production";
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";
import Stripe from "stripe";

import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { logSafeMessage } from "@/lib/log-safe";
import {
  closeOutcomeOf,
  isMockSession,
  mockCheckoutAllowed,
  mockCheckoutUrl,
  mockSessionId,
  paymentModeOf,
  stripeSessionParams,
  type CheckoutGateway,
  type PaymentMode,
} from "@/lib/payments/checkout";

/**
 * Stripe client. `null` when no real key is configured: the app then runs in
 * "mock payment" mode (checkout is simulated locally, see /api/mock-checkout).
 */
export const stripe = env.STRIPE_ENABLED
  ? new Stripe(env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, { typescript: true })
  : null;

/** paymentModeOf(env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, env.STRIPE_ENABLED): "mock", "test" or "live". */
export function paymentMode(): PaymentMode {
  return paymentModeOf(env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, env.STRIPE_ENABLED);
}

/**
 * Whether the simulated checkout may be reached: no Stripe keys AND neither APP_ENV nor VERCEL_ENV says production
 * (the one rule, Decision 27, SEC-I5). Used by the mock route and by publicDeps; no other file reads APP_ENV for payments.
 */
export function mockCheckoutEnabled(): boolean {
  return mockCheckoutAllowed({
    STRIPE_ENABLED: env.STRIPE_ENABLED,
    APP_ENV: env.APP_ENV,
    VERCEL_ENV: env.VERCEL_ENV,
  });
}

/** Stripe request options of « Libérer ma place »: a visitor is waiting, so one short try and one retry. */
const RELEASE_OPTIONS = { timeout: 10_000, maxNetworkRetries: 1 } as const;

function stripeGateway(client: Stripe, mode: PaymentMode): CheckoutGateway {
  return {
    mode,
    async create(req) {
      const session = await client.checkout.sessions.create(stripeSessionParams(req), {
        idempotencyKey: `checkout:${req.purchaseId}`,
      });
      if (!session.url) throw new Error("Stripe returned a Checkout session without a URL");
      return { sessionId: session.id, url: session.url };
    },
    async closeForRelease(sessionId) {
      if (isMockSession(sessionId)) return "mock";
      try {
        const session = await client.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId, undefined, RELEASE_OPTIONS);
        const outcome = closeOutcomeOf(session);
        if (outcome !== "open") return outcome;
        await client.checkout.sessions.expire(sessionId, undefined, RELEASE_OPTIONS);
        return "expired";
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[stripe] close failed: " + logSafeMessage(err));
        return "failed";
      }
    },
    async expire(sessionId) {
      await expireCheckoutSession(sessionId);
    },
  };
}

/** The simulated checkout: no network, the session id is `mock_<purchaseId>` and the URL is the mock route (Decision 29). */
const mockGateway: CheckoutGateway = {
  mode: "mock",
  async create(req) {
    return { sessionId: mockSessionId(req.purchaseId), url: mockCheckoutUrl(env.APP_URL, req.purchaseId) };
  },
  async closeForRelease() {
    return "mock";
  },
  async expire() {
    // a simulated session is never open anywhere: nothing to close
  },
};

/** Stripe when configured, else the mock: create = { sessionId: mockSessionId(id), url: mockCheckoutUrl(env.APP_URL, id) }, closeForRelease = "mock", expire = no-op. */
export const checkoutGateway: CheckoutGateway = stripe ? stripeGateway(stripe, paymentMode()) : mockGateway;

/**
 * Best effort: closes a still-open Checkout session whose seat ended (the
 * pending purchase of a cancelled or released booking), so the client cannot
 * pay for a seat that no longer exists. "mock" for a simulated session id or
 * when Stripe is off; "not_open" when the session is already complete or
 * expired (retrieved first, so Stripe is never asked to expire what is not
 * open); "expired" after sessions.expire; "failed" on any error. Never throws.
 *
 * "not_open" stands for a complete session (possibly paid) as well as an
 * expired one (LED:429): the two best-effort callers count it as « can no longer
 * be paid » and never touch a booking on it. A release decision reads
 * checkoutGateway.closeForRelease instead.
 *
 * `options` are Stripe per-request options applied to both calls. Without them
 * the client defaults apply (80 s timeout, 2 retries), which suits a background
 * effect; the account deletion passes a short timeout and no retry so that a
 * hung Stripe cannot hold it (DELETION_STRIPE_OPTIONS, src/lib/admin-deletion.ts).
 */
export async function expireCheckoutSession(
  checkoutSessionId: string,
  options?: { timeout?: number; maxNetworkRetries?: number },
): Promise<"expired" | "not_open" | "mock" | "failed"> {
  if (isMockSession(checkoutSessionId) || !stripe) return "mock";
  try {
    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(checkoutSessionId, undefined, options);
    if (session.status !== "open") return "not_open";
    await stripe.checkout.sessions.expire(checkoutSessionId, undefined, options);
    return "expired";
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[stripe] expire failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
    return "failed";
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/public/context.ts (pure types)
export type PublicPro = {
  professionalId: string; slug: string; businessName: string; timezone: string; currency: string;
  /** professional.user_id: page-owner detection only, never sent to the browser */
  ownerUserId: string;
  window: BookingWindow;
};
export type PublicDeps = { appUrl: string; checkout: CheckoutGateway; mockAllowed: boolean; /** APP_ENV, stamped on every Checkout session (SEC-I7) */ env: string };
/** Built on the server per action: never from input. guestCustomerId is null for a verified or impersonating session. */
export type ActionVisitor = { session: SessionFacts | null; owner: WalletOwner | null; guestCustomerId: string | null; ipHash: string; wideIpHash: string | null };
export const SLUG_PARAM_RE = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,60}$/;
export function publicProOfRow(row: { id: string; slug: string; businessName: string; timezone: string; currency: string; userId: string; bookingHorizonDays: number; minNoticeMinutes: number; cancelDeadlineHours: number }): PublicPro;
export function splitActionInput(input: unknown): { slug: unknown; rest: unknown };

// src/lib/public/run-action.ts (pure)
export type RunPublicDeps = {
  resolvePro: (slug: string) => Promise<PublicPro | null>;
  visitor: (pro: PublicPro, now: Date) => Promise<ActionVisitor>;
  schedule: (effects: Effect[]) => void;
  revalidate: () => void;
  log: (line: string) => void;
  info: (line: string) => void;
  rethrowIfControlFlow: (err: unknown) => void;
  now: () => Date;
};
export function publicImpersonationLogLine(name: string, session: SessionFacts | null, professionalId: string): string | null;
export async function runPublicActionWith<T extends object>(deps: RunPublicDeps, name: string, slug: unknown, fn: (pro: PublicPro, visitor: ActionVisitor, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>): Promise<PublicResult<T>>;
export type RunClientDeps = Omit<RunPublicDeps, "resolvePro" | "visitor"> & { session: () => Promise<SessionFacts | null> };
export async function runClientActionWith<T extends object>(deps: RunClientDeps, name: string, fn: (session: SessionFacts | null, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>): Promise<PublicResult<T>>;

// src/server/public-context.ts (server-only; not a "use server" file)
export async function resolvePublicPro(slug: string, opts?: { includeSuspended?: boolean }): Promise<{ pro: PublicPro; branding: PublicBranding } | null>;
export function publicDeps(): PublicDeps;
// It only reads (Revision 3.2): the Owner it returns carries what `linkCustomerUser` needs, and the core that links the account does it after its `parseFr` and its throttle.
export async function actionVisitor(pro: PublicPro, now: Date): Promise<ActionVisitor>;
export async function runPublicAction<T extends object>(name: string, slug: unknown, fn: (pro: PublicPro, visitor: ActionVisitor, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>): Promise<PublicResult<T>>;
export async function runClientAction<T extends object>(name: string, fn: (session: SessionFacts | null, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>): Promise<PublicResult<T>>;

// src/test/public.ts (added by this task)
export async function publicProOf(db: Db, pro: TestPro): Promise<PublicPro>;
export function actionVisitorOf(opts?: Partial<ActionVisitor>): ActionVisitor;
export type FakeCheckout = CheckoutGateway & {
  created: CheckoutRequest[]; expired: string[]; closed: string[];
  failCreate: boolean; closeOutcome: CheckoutCloseOutcome;
  onCreate?: (req: CheckoutRequest) => Promise<void>;
};
export function fakeCheckout(mode?: PaymentMode): FakeCheckout;
export function publicDepsOf(checkout: CheckoutGateway, opts?: { mockAllowed?: boolean; appUrl?: string; env?: string }): PublicDeps;
```

Every `"use server"` export of `src/server/public.ts` and `src/server/client.ts` (Tasks 9 to 12, 18, 21) is `const { slug, rest } = splitActionInput(input); return runPublicAction(name, slug, (pro, visitor, now) => core(db, pro, visitor, rest, …, now))`: the core receives `rest` as `unknown` and parses it whole with its strict schema (SEC-M15). The slug is validated here, before any read; the pro is resolved from it on the server; the visitor is built on the server; effects run as `runEffects(effects, "none")` (Decision 74); an action made while an admin impersonates leaves an ids-only trace line (Decision 75).

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S43 (part): `context.test.ts` `splitActionInput` (an extra or missing slug, a non-object, an array: the core's strict schema then refuses, never a partial parse).
- S45: `run-action.test.ts` the slug check, the catch without a leak, effects scheduled on a committing failure, revalidation on success only.
- S49 (part): `public-context.test.ts` both wrappers schedule `runEffects(effects, "none")` and no `runEffects(` call of the file passes `"pro"`.
- S31 (part): `run-action.test.ts` no log line contains `@`, a session id or a personal-link token.
- S51 (part): `run-action.test.ts` the trace line once on a successful impersonated action, never on a refusal, no `@`.

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED, publicFail, publicOk } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { actionVisitorOf, sessionOf } from "@/test/public";

import type { PublicPro } from "./context";
import {
  publicImpersonationLogLine,
  runClientActionWith,
  runPublicActionWith,
  type RunClientDeps,
  type RunPublicDeps,
} from "./run-action";

const PRO: PublicPro = {
  professionalId: "pro_1",
  slug: "altinha-paris",
  businessName: "Altinha Paris",
  timezone: "Europe/Paris",
  currency: "eur",
  ownerUserId: "owner_1",
  window: { bookingHorizonDays: 60, minNoticeMinutes: 60, cancelDeadlineHours: 24 },
};
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-21T10:00:00.000Z");
const SYNC: Effect = { type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: "occ_1" };
const MAIL: Effect = { type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: "b1" };

/** Stands for the errors Next throws for redirect() and notFound(): the wrapper must let them through. */
class ControlFlow extends Error {}

type Spy = {
  /** schedule, info and revalidate, in call order */
  events: string[];
  scheduled: Effect[][];
  logs: string[];
  infos: string[];
  resolved: string[];
  visitorNows: Date[];
  nowCalls: number;
};

function harness(over: Partial<RunPublicDeps> = {}) {
  const spy: Spy = { events: [], scheduled: [], logs: [], infos: [], resolved: [], visitorNows: [], nowCalls: 0 };
  const shared = {
    schedule: (effects: Effect[]) => {
      spy.events.push("schedule");
      spy.scheduled.push(effects);
    },
    revalidate: () => {
      spy.events.push("revalidate");
    },
    log: (line: string) => {
      spy.logs.push(line);
    },
    info: (line: string) => {
      spy.events.push("info");
      spy.infos.push(line);
    },
    rethrowIfControlFlow: (err: unknown) => {
      if (err instanceof ControlFlow) throw err;
    },
    now: () => {
      spy.nowCalls += 1;
      return NOW;
    },
  };
  const deps: RunPublicDeps = {
    ...shared,
    resolvePro: async (slug) => {
      spy.resolved.push(slug);
      return slug === PRO.slug ? PRO : null;
    },
    visitor: async (_pro, now) => {
      spy.visitorNows.push(now);
      return actionVisitorOf();
    },
    ...over,
  };
  const client: RunClientDeps = { ...shared, session: async () => null };
  return { deps, client, spy };
}

const NAME = "startBuyAndBookAction";

    const { deps, spy } = harness();
    let called = false;
    const res = await runPublicActionWith(deps, NAME, slug, async () => {
      called = true;
      return publicOk({});
    });
    assert.deepEqual(res, { ok: false, error: COPY.PAGE_GONE }, JSON.stringify(slug));
    assert.equal(called, false);
    assert.deepEqual(spy.resolved, [], "garbage never reaches the database");
    assert.deepEqual(spy.events, []);
  }
});

test("S45: a success revalidates once, schedules its effects, and hands the browser the result without them", async () => {
  const { deps, spy } = harness();
  const res = await runPublicActionWith<{ bookingId: string }>(deps, NAME, "altinha-paris", async () =>
    publicOk({ bookingId: "b1" }, [MAIL, SYNC]),
  );
  assert.deepEqual(res, { ok: true, bookingId: "b1" });
```

```ts
/**
 * Types and tiny pure helpers shared by every public action (contract § 3.7). No `server-only`, no env, no db: the
 * cores take a `PublicPro`, an `ActionVisitor` and `PublicDeps` that the server wrapper builds from the slug, the
 * fresh session and the request, never from the action input.
 */
import type { BookingWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import type { CheckoutGateway } from "@/lib/payments/checkout";
import type { SessionFacts, WalletOwner } from "@/lib/public/identity";

export type PublicPro = {
  professionalId: string;
  slug: string;
  businessName: string;
  timezone: string;
  currency: string;
  /** professional.user_id: page-owner detection only, never sent to the browser */
  ownerUserId: string;
  window: BookingWindow;
};

export type PublicDeps = {
  appUrl: string;
  checkout: CheckoutGateway;
  mockAllowed: boolean;
  /** APP_ENV, stamped on every Checkout session (SEC-I7) */
  env: string;
};

/** Built on the server per action: never from input. guestCustomerId is null for a verified or impersonating session. */
export type ActionVisitor = {
  session: SessionFacts | null;
  owner: WalletOwner | null;
  guestCustomerId: string | null;
  ipHash: string;
  wideIpHash: string | null;
};

/** The alphabet and length of a pro address (src/lib/slug.ts): the only slugs an action accepts. */
export const SLUG_PARAM_RE = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,60}$/;

/** PublicPro of a professional row: only the fields the cores need, so no Stripe or Google id travels further. */
export function publicProOfRow(row: {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  businessName: string;
  timezone: string;
  currency: string;
  userId: string;
  bookingHorizonDays: number;
  minNoticeMinutes: number;
  cancelDeadlineHours: number;
}): PublicPro {
  return {
    professionalId: row.id,
    slug: row.slug,
    businessName: row.businessName,
    timezone: row.timezone,
    currency: row.currency,
    ownerUserId: row.userId,
    window: {
      bookingHorizonDays: row.bookingHorizonDays,
      minNoticeMinutes: row.minNoticeMinutes,
      cancelDeadlineHours: row.cancelDeadlineHours,
    },
  };
}

/** True for an object literal or a null-prototype object: what a Server Action argument is once decoded. */
function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(value) as unknown;
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null;
}

/**
 * A Server Action input split into its slug and the rest: a plain object gives { slug: input.slug, rest: a copy of
 * the object without slug }; anything else gives { slug: undefined, rest: input } (the wrapper answers PAGE_GONE for
 * the missing slug, and the core's strict schema refuses the rest whole, SEC-M15).
 */
export function splitActionInput(input: unknown): { slug: unknown; rest: unknown } {
  if (!isPlainObject(input)) return { slug: undefined, rest: input };
  const { slug, ...rest } = input;
  return { slug, rest };
}
```

Create `src/lib/public/run-action.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * The tested body of the two wrappers every public write goes through (contract § 3.7, COV-I12). Pure: the real
 * dependencies (the slug lookup, the visitor, after(), revalidatePath, console, unstable_rethrow) are passed in by
 * src/server/public-context.ts, so node:test runs every rule below with fakes.
 *
 * Rules: the slug is checked for shape before any read; an unknown or suspended pro answers PAGE_GONE; ONE `now`
 * serves the visitor and the core; a throw is logged without any address, token or session id and answered with
 * PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED (a Next control-flow error is rethrown); the engine's effects are scheduled after a success AND
 * after a refusal that already committed something (a released seat); the cache is revalidated after a success only;
 * a scheduler or a revalidation that fails after the commit is logged and never turns the committed action into an
 * error (a retry would book twice).
 */
import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { logSafeMessage } from "@/lib/log-safe";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED, withoutPublicEffects, type PublicCoreResult, type PublicResult } from "@/lib/public/result";

import { SLUG_PARAM_RE, type ActionVisitor, type PublicPro } from "./context";
import type { SessionFacts } from "./identity";

export type RunPublicDeps = {
  /** null for an unknown or suspended pro */
  resolvePro: (slug: string) => Promise<PublicPro | null>;
  visitor: (pro: PublicPro, now: Date) => Promise<ActionVisitor>;
  /** after(() => runEffects(effects, "none")): a client-initiated action never spends the pro's mail budget (Decision 74) */
  schedule: (effects: Effect[]) => void;
  /** revalidatePath for each PUBLIC_REVALIDATE target */
  revalidate: () => void;
  /** console.error */
  log: (line: string) => void;
  /** console.info: the impersonation trace */
  info: (line: string) => void;
  /** unstable_rethrow */
  rethrowIfControlFlow: (err: unknown) => void;
  now: () => Date;
};

/** « [public] <name> by admin <impersonatedBy> for pro <professionalId> » (ids only), or null when no admin impersonates (Decision 75, the FR:SEC-6 line of runProAction). */
export function publicImpersonationLogLine(
  name: string,
  session: SessionFacts | null,
  professionalId: string,
): string | null {
  if (!session || !session.impersonated || session.impersonatedBy === null) return null;
  return `[public] ${name} by admin ${session.impersonatedBy} for pro ${professionalId}`;
}

type Followers = Pick<RunPublicDeps, "schedule" | "revalidate" | "log" | "info" | "rethrowIfControlFlow">;

/** Runs one follow-up step of a committed action: a failure is logged (no address) and never propagates. */
function safely(deps: Followers, name: string, step: string, run: () => void): void {
  try {
    run();
  } catch (err) {
    deps.rethrowIfControlFlow(err);
    deps.log(`[public] ${name} ${step} failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
  }
}

/** After the core returned: effects (success or committing refusal), then, on success only, the trace line and the revalidation. */
function settle(deps: Followers, name: string, res: PublicCoreResult<object>, trace: string | null): void {
  if (res.effects.length > 0) safely(deps, name, "schedule", () => deps.schedule(res.effects));
  if (!res.ok) return;
  if (trace !== null) deps.info(trace);
  safely(deps, name, "revalidate", () => deps.revalidate());
}

function unexpected(deps: Followers, name: string, err: unknown): { ok: false; error: string } {
  deps.rethrowIfControlFlow(err);
  deps.log(`[public] ${name} failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
  return { ok: false, error: PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED };
}

/**
 * The wrapper of every public write that belongs to a pro page: slug not a string matching SLUG_PARAM_RE, or
 * resolvePro null → { ok: false, error: COPY.PAGE_GONE } without calling fn; ONE now for visitor and fn; a throw →
 * rethrowIfControlFlow(err), then log(« [public] <name> failed: <logSafeMessage(err)> ») and PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED;
 * effects scheduled on success AND on a failure carrying some; on ok only: info(publicImpersonationLogLine(…)) when
 * not null, then revalidate; returns withoutPublicEffects(res).
 */
export async function runPublicActionWith<T extends object>(
  deps: RunPublicDeps,
  name: string,
  slug: unknown,
  fn: (pro: PublicPro, visitor: ActionVisitor, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>,
): Promise<PublicResult<T>> {
  if (typeof slug !== "string" || !SLUG_PARAM_RE.test(slug)) return { ok: false, error: COPY.PAGE_GONE };
  const now = deps.now();
  let res: PublicCoreResult<T>;
  let trace: string | null;
  try {
    const pro = await deps.resolvePro(slug);
    if (!pro) return { ok: false, error: COPY.PAGE_GONE };
    const visitor = await deps.visitor(pro, now);
    res = await fn(pro, visitor, now);
    trace = publicImpersonationLogLine(name, visitor.session, pro.professionalId);
  } catch (err) {
    return unexpected(deps, name, err);
  }
  settle(deps, name, res, trace);
  return withoutPublicEffects(res);
}

export type RunClientDeps = Omit<RunPublicDeps, "resolvePro" | "visitor"> & {
  /** currentSessionFacts: the fresh session, a suspended user counted as none */
  session: () => Promise<SessionFacts | null>;
};

/** The same rules for the /mon-espace actions (no slug): fn receives the fresh session facts; no impersonation line (every /mon-espace core refuses an impersonated session before any write). */
export async function runClientActionWith<T extends object>(
  deps: RunClientDeps,
  name: string,
  fn: (session: SessionFacts | null, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>,
): Promise<PublicResult<T>> {
  const now = deps.now();
  let res: PublicCoreResult<T>;
  try {
    res = await fn(await deps.session(), now);
  } catch (err) {
    return unexpected(deps, name, err);
  }
  settle(deps, name, res, null);
  return withoutPublicEffects(res);
}
```

```ts
/** The PublicPro of a test pro (reads its row, like resolvePublicPro does). */
export async function publicProOf(db: Db, pro: TestPro): Promise<PublicPro> {
  const schema = await import("../lib/db/schema");
  const { eq } = await import("drizzle-orm");
  const [row] = await db.select().from(schema.professional).where(eq(schema.professional.id, pro.proId));
  if (!row) throw new Error(`publicProOf: professional ${pro.proId} not found`);
  return publicProOfRow(row);
}

/** An ActionVisitor; defaults: no session, no owner, no guest, a fresh testIpHash(), wideIpHash null. */
export function actionVisitorOf(opts: Partial<ActionVisitor> = {}): ActionVisitor {
  return { session: null, owner: null, guestCustomerId: null, ipHash: testIpHash(), wideIpHash: null, ...opts };
}

export type FakeCheckout = CheckoutGateway & {
  created: CheckoutRequest[];
  expired: string[];
  closed: string[];
  failCreate: boolean;
  closeOutcome: CheckoutCloseOutcome;
  /** test hook run inside create, before it answers (e.g. expire the purchase to make the attach fail) */
  onCreate?: (req: CheckoutRequest) => Promise<void>;
};

/**
 * A recording gateway, never the network: create records the request, throws when failCreate, runs onCreate, then
 * returns { sessionId: `cs_test_fake_${purchaseId}`, url: `https://checkout.test/${purchaseId}` }; closeForRelease
 * records the session id and returns closeOutcome (default "expired"); expire records the session id.
 */
export function fakeCheckout(mode: PaymentMode = "test"): FakeCheckout {
  const fake: FakeCheckout = {
    mode,
    created: [],
    expired: [],
    closed: [],
    failCreate: false,
    closeOutcome: "expired",
    async create(req) {
      fake.created.push(req);
      if (fake.failCreate) throw new Error("fake checkout: create failed");
      await fake.onCreate?.(req);
      return { sessionId: `cs_test_fake_${req.purchaseId}`, url: `https://checkout.test/${req.purchaseId}` };
    },
    async closeForRelease(sessionId) {
      fake.closed.push(sessionId);
      return fake.closeOutcome;
    },
    async expire(sessionId) {
      fake.expired.push(sessionId);
    },
  };
  return fake;
}

/** The PublicDeps of a test; defaults: appUrl "https://app.test", env "test", the simulated checkout not allowed. */
export function publicDepsOf(
  checkout: CheckoutGateway,
  opts: { mockAllowed?: boolean; appUrl?: string; env?: string } = {},
): PublicDeps {
  return {
    appUrl: opts.appUrl ?? "https://app.test",
    checkout,
    mockAllowed: opts.mockAllowed ?? false,
    env: opts.env ?? "test",
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Wiring guard for src/server/public-context.ts (contract § 1 Effects, Decisions 3, 74 and 75, S49). The module
 * imports next/cache, next/navigation, next/server and the process db, which the node:test runner cannot load, so
 * the wiring is pinned on the source: the rules themselves are tested in src/lib/public/run-action.test.ts.
 * Pattern of src/server/pro-context.test.ts. Run from the repository root.
 */
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import test from "node:test";

const SOURCE = readFileSync("src/server/public-context.ts", "utf8");
/** The source without comments: a sentence in a doc comment is never counted as a call. */
const CODE = SOURCE.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "").replace(/^\s*\/\/.*$/gm, "");

/** The text of `marker` up to the next top-level doc comment. */
function sectionOf(marker: string): string {
  const start = SOURCE.indexOf(marker);
  assert.notEqual(start, -1, `${marker} is declared`);
  const end = SOURCE.indexOf("\n/**", start);
  return SOURCE.slice(start, end === -1 ? undefined : end);
}
```
