```ts
import "server-only";

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { unstable_rethrow } from "next/navigation";
import { after } from "next/server";

import type { PublicBranding } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { publicProOfRow, type ActionVisitor, type PublicDeps, type PublicPro } from "@/lib/public/context";
import type { SessionFacts } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { PUBLIC_REVALIDATE, type PublicCoreResult, type PublicResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { runClientActionWith, runPublicActionWith } from "@/lib/public/run-action";
import { checkoutGateway, mockCheckoutEnabled } from "@/lib/stripe";
import { runEffects } from "@/server/notify";
import { getPublicProfile } from "@/server/queries";
import { currentPublicVisitor, currentSessionFacts, visitorIpHashes } from "@/server/visitor";

/** getPublicProfile(slug, opts) → { pro: publicProOfRow(row), branding: the PublicBranding fields of the row } (a suspended pro is null unless includeSuspended). */
export async function resolvePublicPro(
  slug: string,
  opts?: { includeSuspended?: boolean },
): Promise<{ pro: PublicPro; branding: PublicBranding } | null> {
  const profile = await getPublicProfile(slug, opts);
  if (!profile) return null;
  const row = profile.pro;
  return {
    pro: publicProOfRow(row),
    branding: {
      businessName: row.businessName,
      headline: row.headline,
      brandColor: row.brandColor,
      bannerUrl: row.bannerUrl,
      headerLayout: row.headerLayout,
      avatarKind: row.avatarKind,
      avatarStyle: row.avatarStyle,
      avatarSeed: row.avatarSeed,
      avatarUrl: row.avatarUrl,
    },
  };
}

/** { appUrl: env.APP_URL, checkout: checkoutGateway, mockAllowed: mockCheckoutEnabled(), env: env.APP_ENV }. */
export function publicDeps(): PublicDeps {
  return {
    appUrl: env.APP_URL,
    checkout: checkoutGateway,
    mockAllowed: mockCheckoutEnabled(),
    env: env.APP_ENV,
  };
}

/**
 * The fresh session facts, the visitor of this pro (owner, guest cookie), both IP hashes (visitorIpHashes). It only
 * reads: the Owner it returns carries what linkCustomerUser needs, and the one core that links the account
 * (bookWithHeldTicketCore) does it after its parseFr and its throttle, never before (contract § 1 Validation).
 */
export async function actionVisitor(pro: PublicPro, now: Date): Promise<ActionVisitor> {
  const [session, visitor, hashes] = await Promise.all([
    currentSessionFacts(),
    currentPublicVisitor(pro.professionalId, pro.ownerUserId),
    visitorIpHashes(now),
  ]);
  return {
    session,
    owner: visitor.owner,
    guestCustomerId: visitor.guestCustomerId,
    ipHash: hashes.ipHash,
    wideIpHash: hashes.wideIpHash,
  };
}

/** Every client-initiated effect run uses the "none" budget: the client gets what they asked for, bounded by the throttle keys, never dropped because a pro's budget is spent (Decision 74). */
function scheduleEffects(effects: Effect[]): void {
  after(() => runEffects(effects, "none"));
}

/** revalidatePath for each PUBLIC_REVALIDATE target: the public pages of every pro and /mon-espace. */
function revalidatePublic(): void {
  for (const target of PUBLIC_REVALIDATE) revalidatePath(target.path, target.type);
}

/**
 * The wrapper of every public write: runPublicActionWith with the real deps (resolvePublicPro, actionVisitor,
 * after(() => runEffects(effects, "none")), revalidatePath, console.error, console.info, unstable_rethrow,
 * () => new Date()). No logic of its own; src/server/public-context.test.ts pins the "none" budget of both wrappers.
 */
export async function runPublicAction<T extends object>(
  name: string,
  slug: unknown,
  fn: (pro: PublicPro, visitor: ActionVisitor, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>,
): Promise<PublicResult<T>> {
  return runPublicActionWith<T>(
    {
      resolvePro: async (slug) => (await resolvePublicPro(slug))?.pro ?? null,
      visitor: (pro, now) => actionVisitor(pro, now),
      schedule: scheduleEffects,
      revalidate: revalidatePublic,
      log: (line) => console.error(line),
      info: (line) => console.info(line),
      rethrowIfControlFlow: unstable_rethrow,
      now: () => new Date(),
    },
    name,
    slug,
    fn,
  );
}

/** The same for the /mon-espace actions (no slug): runClientActionWith with the real deps, fn receives the fresh session facts. */
export async function runClientAction<T extends object>(
  name: string,
  fn: (session: SessionFacts | null, now: Date) => Promise<PublicCoreResult<T>>,
): Promise<PublicResult<T>> {
  return runClientActionWith<T>(
    {
      session: currentSessionFacts,
      schedule: scheduleEffects,
      revalidate: revalidatePublic,
      log: (line) => console.error(line),
      info: (line) => console.info(line),
      rethrowIfControlFlow: unstable_rethrow,
      now: () => new Date(),
    },
    name,
    fn,
  );
}
```

What the new plans read (every read joins through the purchase's or the booking's own `professional_id`, so a row that crosses two pros plans no e-mail):
- `email.purchase_receipt {purchaseId}`: the purchase only when `status = 'paid'`; its customer (same pro), the pro (`business_name`, `timezone`), the type name (`ticket_type`, same pro), `min(ticket.expires_at)` of its tickets; `paidOn = formatDayMonthYear(todayKey(paid_at, tz))`; `expiryText = expiryLabel(expiresAt, tz, now, quantity)`; `amountLabel = formatMoney(amount_cents, currency)`; `bookingLine` = « Un des tickets a servi pour votre inscription à « {title} » ({whenLabel}). » when a `confirmed` booking has `purchase_id = p`, else null; `walletCount` = the purchase's tickets still `available`; `test = !livemode`. One e-mail to the customer.
- `email.late_payment {purchaseId}`: the purchase `paid` AND a booking with `purchase_id = p` that is not `confirmed`; `count` = tickets of the purchase; title and when of that booking's occurrence; `pageUrl = ${appUrl}/{slug}`. One e-mail, else none.
- `email.pro_new_booking {bookingId}`: the booking `confirmed`; recipient = `"user".email` of `professional.user_id`; `planningUrl = ${appUrl}${planningHref({ occurrenceId, startsAt, tz })}`; `coverageLabel = COVERAGE_LABELS[coverage]`. One e-mail to the pro.
- `email.pro_booking_cancelled {bookingId}`: `status = 'cancelled' AND ended_by = 'client'`; `ticketReturned` = `returnedBookingIds`; same recipient and URL. One e-mail to the pro.
- A row that no longer exists, or is not in that state, plans `{ kind: "emails", professionalId: null, emails: [] }` (`noEmail()`).

Rules this task enforces (contract § 1 Effects, Decisions 54, 55, 59, 74, FR:SEC-1): every new plan names the pro whose budget it would spend (`emails(professionalId, …)`); P4 runs these plans with the budget `"none"`, so the pro's own budget is never spent by a client's receipt; no template subject carries a client name or address (the production mock line prints the redacted subject, Decision 59); the pro notices carry no personal link; every value is escaped; no dash; the runner never throws and no log line carries an address.

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S6 (part): `notify-core.db.test.ts` a purchase whose customer or type, or whose booking, belongs to another pro plans no e-mail; the two pro notices of a crossed booking plan none.
- S29 (part): `public-emails.test.ts` no subject contains the customer's name or address (the `mock-log.test.ts` half is P3's, kept green).
- S31 (part): `notify-run.test.ts` no log or warn line contains `@`.
- S49 (part): `notify-run.test.ts` the budget the run was given reaches `mailsToSend`; a cut « pro » plan sends only the mails it kept and warns one line (the source guards of Tasks 7, 13, 14 and 20 are the other halves).

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { mailBudgetLogLine, type EffectBudget } from "@/lib/mail-budget";
import type { EffectPlan, OutgoingEmail } from "@/lib/notify-core";

import { runEffectsWith, type RunEffectsDeps } from "./notify-run";

const MAIL_A: OutgoingEmail = { to: "a@example.com", subject: "Sujet A", html: "<p>A</p>" };
const MAIL_B: OutgoingEmail = { to: "b@example.com", subject: "Sujet B", html: "<p>B</p>" };
const CONFIRMED: Effect = { type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: "b1" };
const RECEIPT: Effect = { type: "email.purchase_receipt", purchaseId: "p1" };
const SYNC: Effect = { type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: "o1" };
const EXPIRE: Effect = { type: "stripe.expire_session", purchaseId: "p1", checkoutSessionId: "cs_test_1" };

function emailsPlan(emails: OutgoingEmail[], professionalId: string | null = "pro_1"): EffectPlan {
  return { kind: "emails", professionalId, emails };
}

type Seen = {
  planned: string[];
  budgets: EffectBudget[];
  sent: string[];
  synced: string[];
  expired: string[];
  logs: string[];
  warns: string[];
};

/** Fake deps: `plans` scripts what planEffect answers per effect type (an Error is thrown). */
function harness(plans: Record<string, EffectPlan | Error>, over: Partial<RunEffectsDeps> = {}) {
  const seen: Seen = { planned: [], budgets: [], sent: [], synced: [], expired: [], logs: [], warns: [] };
  const deps: RunEffectsDeps = {
    plan: async (effect) => {
      seen.planned.push(effect.type);
      const plan = plans[effect.type];
      if (plan instanceof Error) throw plan;
      if (!plan) throw new Error(`no plan scripted for ${effect.type}`);
      return plan;
    },
    mailsToSend: async (plan, budget) => {
      seen.budgets.push(budget);
      return { send: plan.emails, dropped: 0 };
    },
    sendEmail: async (mail) => {
      seen.sent.push(mail.subject);
    },
    syncOccurrence: async (occurrenceId) => {
      seen.synced.push(occurrenceId);
    },
    expireCheckout: async (checkoutSessionId) => {
      seen.expired.push(checkoutSessionId);
    },
    log: (line) => {
      seen.logs.push(line);
    },
    warn: (line) => {
      seen.warns.push(line);
    },
    ...over,
  };
  return { deps, seen };
}

test("duplicates run once and the Google syncs run last, like dedupeEffects says", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness({
    "email.booking_confirmed": emailsPlan([MAIL_A]),
    "email.purchase_receipt": emailsPlan([MAIL_B]),
    "google.sync_occurrence": { kind: "google", occurrenceId: "o1" },
  });
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [SYNC, CONFIRMED, CONFIRMED, RECEIPT, { ...SYNC }], "none");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.planned, ["email.booking_confirmed", "email.purchase_receipt", "google.sync_occurrence"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.sent, ["Sujet A", "Sujet B"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.synced, ["o1"]);
});

test("S49: mailsToSend receives the budget the run was given, \"pro\" and \"none\" alike", async () => {
  for (const budget of ["pro", "none"] as const) {
    const { deps, seen } = harness({ "email.booking_confirmed": emailsPlan([MAIL_A]) });
    await runEffectsWith(deps, [CONFIRMED], budget);
    assert.deepEqual(seen.budgets, [budget]);
    assert.deepEqual(seen.sent, ["Sujet A"]);
  }
});

test("the budget is required: runEffectsWith has no default (tsc proves it, Decision 74)", async () => {
  const { deps } = harness({});
  // @ts-expect-error the third argument is required: a caller must say "pro" or "none"
  await runEffectsWith(deps, []);
});

test("S49: a cut « pro » plan sends only the mails it kept and warns one line with the pro id and the count, no address", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness(
    { "email.booking_confirmed": emailsPlan([MAIL_A, MAIL_B], "pro_1") },
    { mailsToSend: async (plan) => ({ send: plan.emails.slice(0, 1), dropped: 1 }) },
  );
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [CONFIRMED], "pro");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.sent, ["Sujet A"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.warns, [mailBudgetLogLine("pro_1", 1)]);
  assert.equal(seen.warns[0], "[notify] mail budget reached for pro pro_1: 1 e-mail(s) not sent");
  for (const line of seen.warns) assert.equal(line.includes("@"), false);

  const two = harness({ "email.booking_confirmed": emailsPlan([MAIL_A, MAIL_B], "pro_2") }, { mailsToSend: async () => ({ send: [], dropped: 2 }) });
  await runEffectsWith(two.deps, [CONFIRMED], "pro");
  assert.deepEqual(two.seen.sent, []);
  assert.deepEqual(two.seen.warns, ["[notify] mail budget reached for pro pro_2: 2 e-mail(s) not sent"]);
});

test("a plan that names no pro warns nothing, even when mailsToSend dropped its mails", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness(
    { "email.booking_confirmed": emailsPlan([MAIL_A], null) },
    { mailsToSend: async () => ({ send: [], dropped: 1 }) },
  );
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [CONFIRMED], "pro");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.warns, []);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.sent, []);
});

test("a throwing plan is logged without an address and the next effect still runs", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness({
    "email.booking_confirmed": new Error("read failed for beatriz@example.com"),
    "email.purchase_receipt": emailsPlan([MAIL_B]),
  });
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [CONFIRMED, RECEIPT], "none");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.logs, ["[notify] email.booking_confirmed failed: read failed for [email]"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.sent, ["Sujet B"]);
});

test("a throwing send is logged without an address, never thrown, and the next effect still runs", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness(
    {
      "email.booking_confirmed": emailsPlan([MAIL_A]),
      "google.sync_occurrence": { kind: "google", occurrenceId: "o1" },
    },
    {
      sendEmail: async (mail) => {
        throw new Error(`Resend refused ${mail.to}`);
      },
    },
  );
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [CONFIRMED, SYNC], "none");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.logs, ["[notify] email.booking_confirmed failed: Resend refused [email]"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.synced, ["o1"], "the Google sync after the failing e-mail still ran");
});

test("Google and Stripe plans call their dependency with the planned id", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness({
    "google.sync_occurrence": { kind: "google", occurrenceId: "occ_9" },
    "stripe.expire_session": { kind: "stripe", purchaseId: "p1", checkoutSessionId: "cs_test_9" },
  });
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [SYNC, EXPIRE], "none");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.synced, ["occ_9"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.expired, ["cs_test_9"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.logs, []);
});

test("a failing Google sync or Stripe expiry is logged with the effect type and never thrown", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness(
    {
      "google.sync_occurrence": { kind: "google", occurrenceId: "o1" },
      "stripe.expire_session": { kind: "stripe", purchaseId: "p1", checkoutSessionId: "cs_test_1" },
    },
    {
      syncOccurrence: async () => {
        throw new Error("calendar down");
      },
      expireCheckout: async () => {
        throw new Error("no session cs_test_1");
      },
    },
  );
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [SYNC, EXPIRE], "none");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.logs, [
    "[notify] stripe.expire_session failed: no session [session]",
    "[notify] google.sync_occurrence failed: calendar down",
  ]);
});

test("an outer failure is logged as « run failed » and never thrown", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness({});
  const broken = {
    [Symbol.iterator]() {
      throw new Error("iteration failed for beatriz@example.com");
    },
  } as unknown as Effect[];
  await runEffectsWith(deps, broken, "none");
  assert.deepEqual(seen.logs, ["[notify] run failed: iteration failed for [email]"]);
  assert.deepEqual(seen.planned, []);
});

test("S31: whatever fails, no log or warn line carries an address", async () => {
  const { deps, seen } = harness(
    {
      "email.booking_confirmed": new Error("lookup of x@example.com failed"),
      "email.purchase_receipt": emailsPlan([MAIL_A, MAIL_B], "pro_1"),
    },
    {
      mailsToSend: async (plan) => ({ send: plan.emails.slice(0, 1), dropped: 1 }),
      sendEmail: async (mail) => {
        throw new Error(`bounce for ${mail.to}`);
      },
    },
  );
  await runEffectsWith(deps, [CONFIRMED, RECEIPT], "pro");
  assert.ok(seen.logs.length >= 2);
  for (const line of [...seen.logs, ...seen.warns]) assert.equal(line.includes("@"), false, line);
});
```

Create `src/lib/emails/purchase-receipt.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * « Reçu de votre achat »: sent once a purchase is paid (Stripe webhook, mock checkout), as a mail of its own, apart
 * from the booking confirmation (Decision 55). `expiryText` comes from back-office/format.expiryLabel with the number
 * of tickets; `walletCount` is the tickets still in the wallet (the « À l'unité » ticket of a buy + book is already
 * spent, so nothing is said to be in the wallet, COV-M1g). Pure: every value goes through escapeHtml.
 */
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { escapeHtml, layout } from "@/lib/email-layout";
import { COPY, walletLine } from "@/lib/public/messages";

import { mailDetails, mailParagraph, mailPersonalLink, oneLine } from "./parts";

export type PurchaseReceiptArgs = {
  customerName: string;
  businessName: string;
  label: string;
  typeName: string;
  quantity: number;
  walletCount: number;
  amountLabel: string;
  paidOn: string;
  expiryText: string;
  bookingLine: string | null;
  test: boolean;
  personalLinkUrl: string;
};

export function purchaseReceiptEmail(a: PurchaseReceiptArgs): { subject: string; html: string } {
  const rows = [
    { label: "Achat", value: `${a.label} (${plural(a.quantity, "ticket", "tickets")} « ${a.typeName} »)` },
    { label: "Montant", value: a.amountLabel },
    { label: "Payé le", value: a.paidOn },
    { label: "Validité", value: a.expiryText },
  ];
  const wallet = walletLine(a.walletCount);
  const html = layout(
    escapeHtml("Reçu de votre achat"),
    `
    ${mailParagraph(`Bonjour ${a.customerName}, merci pour votre achat chez ${a.businessName}.`)}
    ${mailDetails(rows)}
    ${a.bookingLine ? mailParagraph(a.bookingLine) : ""}
    ${a.test ? mailParagraph(COPY.TEST_PAYMENT_LINE) : ""}
    ${wallet ? mailParagraph(wallet) : ""}
    ${mailPersonalLink(a.personalLinkUrl)}
  `,
  );
  return { subject: oneLine(`Reçu : ${a.label} chez ${a.businessName}`), html };
}
```

Create `src/lib/emails/late-payment.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * « Paiement reçu »: sent when a payment lands after the seat was released (the hold ended, spec L1136-1137): the
 * tickets went to the wallet, the séance is not reserved. The subject is fixed: it names neither the client nor the
 * séance. Pure: every value goes through escapeHtml.
 */
import { formatCount } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { escapeHtml, layout } from "@/lib/email-layout";

import { mailButton, mailParagraph, mailPersonalLink, oneLine } from "./parts";

export type LatePaymentArgs = {
  customerName: string;
  businessName: string;
  title: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  count: number;
  pageUrl: string;
  personalLinkUrl: string;
};

export function latePaymentEmail(a: LatePaymentArgs): { subject: string; html: string } {
  const held =
    a.count > 1
      ? `vos ${formatCount(a.count)} tickets sont dans votre portefeuille.`
      : "votre ticket est dans votre portefeuille.";
  const html = layout(
    escapeHtml("Paiement reçu"),
    `
    ${mailParagraph(`Bonjour ${a.customerName},`)}
    ${mailParagraph(`Paiement reçu, votre place n'était plus réservée : ${held}`)}
    ${mailParagraph(
      `La séance « ${a.title} » (${a.whenLabel}) n'est pas réservée pour vous. Vous pouvez utiliser vos tickets sur une autre séance.`,
    )}
    <p style="margin:16px 0 0">${mailButton(a.pageUrl, `Voir la page de ${a.businessName}`)}</p>
    ${mailPersonalLink(a.personalLinkUrl)}
  `,
  );
  return { subject: oneLine("Paiement reçu : votre place n'était plus réservée"), html };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * « Nouvelle inscription »: the pro's notice when a CLIENT books (a free place, a held ticket, a paid buy + book).
 * It names the client in the body only, never in the subject, and carries no personal link: it goes to the pro's own
 * address with a deep link to the planning (Decision 54).
 */
import { escapeHtml, layout } from "@/lib/email-layout";

import { mailButton, mailDetails, mailParagraph, oneLine } from "./parts";

export type ProNewBookingArgs = {
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  title: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  coverageLabel: string;
  planningUrl: string;
};

export function proNewBookingEmail(a: ProNewBookingArgs): { subject: string; html: string } {
  const html = layout(
    escapeHtml("Nouvelle inscription"),
    `
    ${mailParagraph(`${a.customerName} (${a.customerEmail}) s'est inscrit(e) à « ${a.title} » (${a.whenLabel}).`)}
    ${mailDetails([{ label: "Couverture", value: a.coverageLabel }])}
    <p style="margin:16px 0 0">${mailButton(a.planningUrl, "Voir dans le planning")}</p>
  `,
  );
  return { subject: oneLine(`Nouvelle inscription : ${a.title}`), html };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * « Annulation d'un client »: the pro's notice when a client cancels their own registration. Like the new
 * registration notice, it names the client in the body only and carries no personal link.
 */
import { escapeHtml, layout } from "@/lib/email-layout";

import { mailButton, mailParagraph, oneLine } from "./parts";

export type ProBookingCancelledArgs = {
  customerName: string;
  customerEmail: string;
  title: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  ticketReturned: boolean;
  planningUrl: string;
};

export function proBookingCancelledEmail(a: ProBookingCancelledArgs): { subject: string; html: string } {
  const returned = a.ticketReturned ? mailParagraph("Son ticket lui a été rendu.") : "";
  const html = layout(
    escapeHtml("Annulation d'un client"),
    `
    ${mailParagraph(`${a.customerName} (${a.customerEmail}) a annulé son inscription à « ${a.title} » (${a.whenLabel}).`)}
    ${returned}
    <p style="margin:16px 0 0">${mailButton(a.planningUrl, "Voir dans le planning")}</p>
  `,
  );
  return { subject: oneLine(`Annulation : ${a.title}`), html };
}
```

Create `src/lib/notify-run.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * The executor of post-commit effects (LED:84, FR:SEC-1), pure: the plan reader, the mail budget, the sender, the
 * Google sync and the Stripe expiry come in as `deps`, so node:test runs every rule below with fakes.
 * src/server/notify.ts wires the real ones.
 *
 * Never throws: a failing effect logs « [notify] <type> failed: <message> » (no address, token or session id: only
 * logSafeMessage reaches a log) and the next effect still runs; an outer failure logs « [notify] run failed: … ».
 * `budget` has no default: "pro" (runProAction) spends the pro's e-mail budget, "none" (every P4 caller: client
 * actions, the Stripe webhook, the mock checkout) sends every mail and counts nothing (Decision 74).
 */
import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { mailBudgetLogLine, type EffectBudget } from "@/lib/mail-budget";
import { dedupeEffects, logSafeMessage, type EffectPlan, type OutgoingEmail } from "@/lib/notify-core";

export type RunEffectsDeps = {
  /** planEffect(db, effect, { appUrl, guestKey, now: new Date() }) */
  plan: (effect: Effect) => Promise<EffectPlan>;
  /** mailsToSend(db, plan, budget, new Date()) of src/lib/mail-budget.ts: "pro" spends the pro's budget and may drop the tail of the plan, "none" sends every mail and counts nothing */
  mailsToSend: (
    plan: Extract<EffectPlan, { kind: "emails" }>,
    budget: EffectBudget,
  ) => Promise<{ send: OutgoingEmail[]; dropped: number }>;
  /** notify.ts sendPaced (the Resend pacing stays there) */
  sendEmail: (mail: OutgoingEmail) => Promise<void>;
  syncOccurrence: (occurrenceId: string) => Promise<void>;
  expireCheckout: (checkoutSessionId: string) => Promise<void>;
  /** console.error */
  log: (line: string) => void;
  /** console.warn: the budget line */
  warn: (line: string) => void;
};

async function execute(deps: RunEffectsDeps, plan: EffectPlan, budget: EffectBudget): Promise<void> {
  switch (plan.kind) {
    case "emails": {
      // Final review SEC-1: the mails of a pro's action spend the pro's budget; past it they are dropped, with one line and no address.
      const { send, dropped } = await deps.mailsToSend(plan, budget);
      if (dropped > 0 && plan.professionalId !== null) {
        deps.warn(logSafeMessage({ message: mailBudgetLogLine(plan.professionalId, dropped) }));
      }
      for (const mail of send) await deps.sendEmail(mail);
      return;
    }
    case "google":
      await deps.syncOccurrence(plan.occurrenceId);
      return;
    case "stripe":
      await deps.expireCheckout(plan.checkoutSessionId);
      return;
    default: {
      const unreachable: never = plan;
      throw new Error(`Unhandled plan: ${JSON.stringify(unreachable)}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Runs effects after commit, best effort: duplicates dropped and Google syncs last (dedupeEffects), each effect
 * planned from a fresh read, then executed. An « emails » plan goes through deps.mailsToSend(plan, budget) and, when
 * dropped > 0 and plan.professionalId is not null, warns one line (pro id and count) before sending the rest.
 */
export async function runEffectsWith(deps: RunEffectsDeps, effects: readonly Effect[], budget: EffectBudget): Promise<void> {
  try {
    for (const effect of dedupeEffects(effects)) {
      try {
        await execute(deps, await deps.plan(effect), budget);
      } catch (err) {
        deps.log(`[notify] ${effect.type} failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log(`[notify] run failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
  }
}
```

```ts
/* ───────────────────── P4: receipt, late payment and the pro's notices ───────────────────── */

/** The address of a user (the pro's own account is the recipient of the pro notices). */
async function userEmailOf(db: Db, userId: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.select({ email: user.email }).from(user).where(eq(user.id, userId));
  return row.email;
}

/** E1 as the action does it: the hold and its pending purchase at `holdAt`, then the Checkout session attached. */
async function holdSeat(
  db: Db,
  pro: TestPro,
  args: { occurrence: { id: string; startsAt: Date }; customerId: string; offerId: string; holdAt: Date },
) {
  const hold = must(
    await startBuyAndBook(
      db,
      {
        professionalId: pro.proId,
        occurrenceId: args.occurrence.id,
        customerId: args.customerId,
        seenStartsAt: args.occurrence.startsAt,
        offerId: args.offerId,
      },
      args.holdAt,
    ),
  );
  must(
    await attachCheckoutSession(
      db,
      {
        purchaseId: hold.purchaseId,
        checkoutSessionId: `cs_test_${hold.purchaseId}`,
        checkoutUrl: "https://checkout.example.test/s",
      },
      args.holdAt,
    ),
  );
  return hold;
}

/** The webhook's path: the purchase is fulfilled at `now` (a live payment carries its payment intent, invariant I6). */
function pay(db: Db, purchaseId: string, now: Date, livemode = false) {
  return fulfillPurchase(db, purchaseId, { sessionId: `cs_test_${purchaseId}`, paymentIntentId: `pi_${purchaseId}`, livemode }, now);
}

dbTest("purchase_receipt: « Reçu » of a paid buy + book of « Carnet de 4 »: amount, expiry of the 4 tickets, the booking, 3 tickets left, the test line", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const business = await businessNameOf(db, pro.proId);
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500, validityCount: 3, validityUnit: "month" });
  const { occurrences: [occ] } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha du soir", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  const email = testEmail("receipt");
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email });
  const hold = await holdSeat(db, pro, { occurrence: occ, customerId, offerId, holdAt: now });
  const paid = await pay(db, hold.purchaseId, now);
  assert.equal(paid.outcome, "fulfilled");
  assert.deepEqual(
    paid.effects.map((e) => e.type),
    ["email.purchase_receipt", "email.booking_confirmed", "email.pro_new_booking", "google.sync_occurrence"],
  );

  const mails = emailsOf(await planEffect(db, effectOf(paid.effects, "email.purchase_receipt"), depsAt(now)), pro.proId);
  assert.equal(mails.length, 1);
  const [mail] = mails;
  const expires = ticketExpiry(now, { count: 3, unit: "month" }, pro.tz);
  const when = formatWhen(occ.startsAt, occ.endsAt, pro.tz);
  assert.equal(mail.to, email);
  assert.equal(mail.subject, `Reçu : Carnet de 4 chez ${business}`);
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc(`Bonjour Beatriz Almeida, merci pour votre achat chez ${business}.`)));
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc("Carnet de 4 (4 tickets « Cours collectif »)")), "label, quantity and type");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc(formatMoney(8500, "eur"))), "amount");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc(formatDayMonthYear(todayKey(now, pro.tz)))), "paid on");
  assert.ok(expiryLabel(expires, pro.tz, now, 4).startsWith("valables jusqu'au "), "four tickets: « valables »");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc(expiryLabel(expires, pro.tz, now, 4))), "the expiry of the 4 tickets");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc(`Un des tickets a servi pour votre inscription à « Altinha du soir » (${when}).`)), "booking line");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc("3 tickets sont dans votre portefeuille.")), "the spent ticket is not counted");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc(COPY.TEST_PAYMENT_LINE)), "livemode false: the test line");
  assert.ok(mail.html.includes(linkOf(customerId)), "personal link");
});

dbTest("purchase_receipt: « À l'unité » paid for real: no wallet line (its ticket was spent), no test line, no limit of validity (COV-M1g)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const business = await businessNameOf(db, pro.proId);
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });

});

dbTest("late_payment: a payment that lands after the hold ended mails « Paiement reçu » with the ticket count; the receipt says every ticket is in the wallet", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const business = await businessNameOf(db, pro.proId);
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const { occurrences: [occ] } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha du soir", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  const when = formatWhen(occ.startsAt, occ.endsAt, pro.tz);
  const cases = [
    { quantity: 4, sentence: "vos 4 tickets sont dans votre portefeuille.", wallet: "4 tickets sont dans votre portefeuille." },
    { quantity: 1, sentence: "votre ticket est dans votre portefeuille.", wallet: "1 ticket est dans votre portefeuille." },
  ];
  for (const { quantity, sentence, wallet } of cases) {
    const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, { quantity });
    const email = testEmail("late");
    const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email });
    // the hold started 60 minutes ago: it lapsed at 45, and the seat was released before the payment landed
    const hold = await holdSeat(db, pro, { occurrence: occ, customerId, offerId, holdAt: addMinutes(now, -60) });
    const released = must(await releasePurchase(db, hold.purchaseId, now));
    assert.equal(released.released, true);
    const paid = await pay(db, hold.purchaseId, now);
    assert.deepEqual(paid.effects.map((e) => e.type), ["email.purchase_receipt", "email.late_payment"]);

    const lateMails = emailsOf(await planEffect(db, effectOf(paid.effects, "email.late_payment"), depsAt(now)), pro.proId);
    assert.equal(lateMails.length, 1, `${quantity}`);
    const [mail] = lateMails;
    assert.equal(mail.to, email);
    assert.equal(mail.subject, "Paiement reçu : votre place n'était plus réservée");
    assert.ok(mail.html.includes(esc(`Paiement reçu, votre place n'était plus réservée : ${sentence}`)), sentence);
    assert.ok(
      mail.html.includes(
        esc(`La séance « Altinha du soir » (${when}) n'est pas réservée pour vous. Vous pouvez utiliser vos tickets sur une autre séance.`),
      ),
    );
    assert.ok(mail.html.includes(`href="${APP}/${pro.slug}"`), "the page of the pro");
    assert.ok(mail.html.includes(`>Voir la page de ${esc(business)}</a>`));
    assert.ok(mail.html.includes(linkOf(customerId)), "personal link");

    const [receipt] = emailsOf(await planEffect(db, effectOf(paid.effects, "email.purchase_receipt"), depsAt(now)), pro.proId);
    assert.ok(receipt.html.includes(esc(wallet)), "no ticket was spent: all of them are in the wallet");
    assert.equal(receipt.html.includes("Un des tickets a servi"), false, "no confirmed booking");
  }
});

dbTest("pro_booking_cancelled: the client cancelled; « Son ticket lui a été rendu. » only when a ticket came back; a cancellation by the pro sends no such notice", async ({ db, pro }) => {

  );

  assert.equal(freeMail.to, proEmail);

    freeMail.html.includes(esc(`Thomas Leroy (${email}) a annulé son inscription à « Roda libre » (${formatWhen(free.startsAt, free.endsAt, pro.tz)}).`)),
  );

  assert.equal(freeMail.html.includes("/api/c/"), false);

  const ticketCancel = must(await cancelByClient(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, customerId, bookingId: ticketReg.bookingId, actorUserId: null }, now));
  assert.equal(ticketCancel.ticketReturned, true);
  const [ticketMail] = emailsOf(await planEffect(db, effectOf(ticketCancel.effects, "email.pro_booking_cancelled"), depsAt(now)), pro.proId);
  assert.equal(ticketMail.subject, "Annulation : Altinha du soir");

  );
  must(await cancelBookingsByPro(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: free.id, bookingIds: [proReg.bookingId] }, now));
  assert.deepEqual(
    await planEffect(db, { type: "email.pro_booking_cancelled", bookingId: proReg.bookingId }, depsAt(now)),

dbTest("the receipt, the late payment and the pro notices plan nothing for a purchase or a booking that is not in their state", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const deps = depsAt(now);
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  const { occurrences: [occ] } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha du soir", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: testEmail("state") });
  const hold = await holdSeat(db, pro, { occurrence: occ, customerId, offerId, holdAt: now });

  // a pending purchase with its pending booking: nothing is paid, nothing is confirmed
  const pending: Effect[] = [
    { type: "email.purchase_receipt", purchaseId: hold.purchaseId },
    { type: "email.late_payment", purchaseId: hold.purchaseId },
    { type: "email.pro_new_booking", bookingId: hold.bookingId },
    { type: "email.pro_booking_cancelled", bookingId: hold.bookingId },
  ];
  for (const effect of pending) assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, effect, deps), NONE, effect.type);

  // paid and confirmed: the receipt and the pro's new-booking notice exist, a late payment and a cancellation do not
  const paid = await pay(db, hold.purchaseId, now);
  assert.equal(paid.bookingConfirmed, true);
  assert.equal(emailsOf(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.purchase_receipt", purchaseId: hold.purchaseId }, deps), pro.proId).length, 1);
  assert.equal(emailsOf(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.pro_new_booking", bookingId: hold.bookingId }, deps), pro.proId).length, 1);
  assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.late_payment", purchaseId: hold.purchaseId }, deps), NONE, "the booking was confirmed: nothing was late");
  assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.pro_booking_cancelled", bookingId: hold.bookingId }, deps), NONE, "confirmed, not cancelled");

  // cancelled by the client: no longer a new booking, now a cancellation
  must(await cancelByClient(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, customerId, bookingId: hold.bookingId, actorUserId: null }, now));
  assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.pro_new_booking", bookingId: hold.bookingId }, deps), NONE, "a cancelled booking is not new");
  assert.equal(emailsOf(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.pro_booking_cancelled", bookingId: hold.bookingId }, deps), pro.proId).length, 1);
});

dbTest("S6: a purchase whose customer or type belongs to another pro plans no receipt, and a booking of another pro plans no late payment", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const deps = depsAt(now);
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  const ownEmail = testEmail("own");
  const own = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: ownEmail });
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  const purchases: string[] = [];
  const bookings: string[] = [];
  try {
    const stranger = await makeCustomer(db, other, { name: "Mallory", email: testEmail("mallory") });
    const foreignTypeId = await makeType(db, other, { name: "Type d'un autre" });
    const { occurrences: [foreignOcc] } = await makeEvent(db, other, { title: "Séance d'un autre" });
    // Built by hand on purpose: ticket_purchase.customer_id, ticket_purchase.ticket_type_id and booking.purchase_id have no
    // composite FK to the pro, so only the plans' own joins keep a foreign row out of an e-mail.
    const foreignCustomer = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: stranger, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId, status: "paid" }, now);
    const foreignType = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: own, offerId, ticketTypeId: foreignTypeId, status: "paid" }, now);
    const crossed = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: own, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId, status: "paid" }, now);
    purchases.push(foreignCustomer, foreignType, crossed);
    bookings.push(await rowBooking(db, other, { occurrenceId: foreignOcc.id, customerId: stranger, status: "expired", purchaseId: crossed }, now));

    for (const purchaseId of [foreignCustomer, foreignType]) {
      assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.purchase_receipt", purchaseId }, deps), NONE, purchaseId);
      assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.late_payment", purchaseId }, deps), NONE, purchaseId);
    }
    // the control: the same purchase, own customer and own type, still gets its receipt; its crossed booking gets no late payment
    const [receipt] = emailsOf(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.purchase_receipt", purchaseId: crossed }, deps), pro.proId);
    assert.equal(receipt.to, ownEmail);
    assert.equal(receipt.html.includes("Mallory"), false);
    assert.deepEqual(await planEffect(db, { type: "email.late_payment", purchaseId: crossed }, deps), NONE, "the booking belongs to another pro");
  } finally {
    // The hand-built rows go first: the foreign keys inside the domain are NO ACTION.
    if (bookings.length > 0) await db.delete(booking).where(inArray(booking.id, bookings));
    if (purchases.length > 0) await db.delete(ticketPurchase).where(inArray(ticketPurchase.id, purchases));
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});
```

```ts
/* ───────────── P4 plans: the receipt, the late payment and the pro's two notices ───────────── */

/** The address of the pro's own account (the recipient of the pro notices), or null. */
async function proEmailOf(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ email: user.email })
    .from(professional)
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, professional.userId))
    .where(eq(professional.id, professionalId));
  return row?.email ?? null;
}

/** The séance in the pro's planning, as the pro opens it from a notice (spec L1542-1544). */
function planningUrlOf(b: Pick<BookingFacts, "occurrenceId" | "startsAt" | "tz">, deps: NotifyDeps): string {
  return `${deps.appUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}${planningHref({ occurrenceId: b.occurrenceId, startsAt: b.startsAt, tz: b.tz })}`;
}

/**
 * The receipt of a PAID purchase, to its customer. The customer, the pro and the ticket type are read through the
 * purchase's own professional_id: a purchase that crosses two pros plans nothing. `walletCount` is the purchase's
 * tickets still available (the ticket a buy + book spent is not counted); `expiryText` says « valables » for several.
 */
async function planPurchaseReceipt(db: Db, purchaseId: string, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [p] = await db
    .select({
      purchaseId: ticketPurchase.id,
      professionalId: ticketPurchase.professionalId,
      customerId: customer.id,
      customerName: customer.name,
      customerEmail: customer.email,
      linkVersion: customer.linkVersion,
      businessName: professional.businessName,
      tz: professional.timezone,
      label: ticketPurchase.label,
      typeName: ticketType.name,
      quantity: ticketPurchase.quantity,
      amountCents: ticketPurchase.amountCents,
      currency: ticketPurchase.currency,
      paidAt: ticketPurchase.paidAt,
      livemode: ticketPurchase.livemode,
    })
    .from(ticketPurchase)
    .innerJoin(
      customer,
      and(eq(customer.id, ticketPurchase.customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, ticketPurchase.professionalId)),
    )
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, ticketPurchase.professionalId))
    .innerJoin(
      ticketType,
      and(eq(ticketType.id, ticketPurchase.ticketTypeId), eq(ticketType.professionalId, ticketPurchase.professionalId)),
    )
    .where(and(eq(ticketPurchase.id, purchaseId), eq(ticketPurchase.status, "paid")));
  if (!p || p.paidAt === null) return noEmail();

  const [tickets] = await db
    .select({
      expiresAt: min(ticket.expiresAt),
      available: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${ticket.status} = 'available')`.mapWith(Number),
    })
    .from(ticket)
    .where(and(eq(ticket.purchaseId, p.purchaseId), eq(ticket.professionalId, p.professionalId)));
  const [held] = await readBookings(db, and(eq(booking.purchaseId, p.purchaseId), eq(booking.status, "confirmed")));
  const bookingLine =
    held && held.professionalId === p.professionalId
      ? `Un des tickets a servi pour votre inscription à « ${held.title} » (${whenOf(held)}).`
      : null;

  const mail = purchaseReceiptEmail({
    customerName: p.customerName,
    businessName: p.businessName,
    label: p.label,
    typeName: p.typeName,
    quantity: p.quantity,
    walletCount: tickets?.available ?? 0,
    amountLabel: formatMoney(p.amountCents, p.currency),
    paidOn: formatDayMonthYear(todayKey(p.paidAt, p.tz)),
    expiryText: expiryLabel(tickets?.expiresAt ?? null, p.tz, deps.now, p.quantity),
    bookingLine,
    test: !p.livemode,
    personalLinkUrl: linkOf(p, deps),
  });
  return emails(p.professionalId, [{ to: p.customerEmail, ...mail }]);
}

/**
 * « Paiement reçu » for a PAID purchase whose booking is not confirmed (it ended before the money arrived): the
 * tickets went to the wallet, the séance is not reserved. The booking must belong to the purchase's own pro and
 * customer, else nothing is planned.
 */
async function planLatePayment(db: Db, purchaseId: string, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [p] = await db
    .select({
      professionalId: ticketPurchase.professionalId,
      customerId: ticketPurchase.customerId,
      slug: professional.slug,
    })
    .from(ticketPurchase)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, ticketPurchase.professionalId))
    .where(and(eq(ticketPurchase.id, purchaseId), eq(ticketPurchase.status, "paid")));
  if (!p) return noEmail();
  const [b] = await readBookings(db, and(eq(booking.purchaseId, purchaseId), ne(booking.status, "confirmed")));
  if (!b || b.professionalId !== p.professionalId || b.customerId !== p.customerId) return noEmail();
  const [tickets] = await db
    .select({ n: count() })
    .from(ticket)
    .where(and(eq(ticket.purchaseId, purchaseId), eq(ticket.professionalId, p.professionalId)));
  if (!tickets || tickets.n === 0) return noEmail();

  const mail = latePaymentEmail({
    customerName: b.customerName,
    businessName: b.businessName,
    title: b.title,
    whenLabel: whenOf(b),
    count: tickets.n,
    pageUrl: `${deps.appUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/${p.slug}`,
    personalLinkUrl: linkOf(b, deps),
  });
  return emails(p.professionalId, [{ to: b.customerEmail, ...mail }]);
}

/** « Nouvelle inscription » to the pro's own address, for a CONFIRMED booking. No personal link. */
async function planProNewBooking(db: Db, bookingId: string, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [b] = await readBookings(db, eq(booking.id, bookingId));
  if (!b || b.status !== "confirmed") return noEmail();
  const to = await proEmailOf(db, b.professionalId);
  if (to === null) return noEmail();
  const mail = proNewBookingEmail({
    customerName: b.customerName,
    customerEmail: b.customerEmail,
    title: b.title,
    whenLabel: whenOf(b),
    coverageLabel: COVERAGE_LABELS[b.coverage],
    planningUrl: planningUrlOf(b, deps),
  });
  return emails(b.professionalId, [{ to, ...mail }]);
}

/** « Annulation d'un client » to the pro's own address: the booking is cancelled AND the client ended it. */
async function planProBookingCancelled(db: Db, bookingId: string, deps: NotifyDeps): Promise<EffectPlan> {
  const [b] = await readBookings(db, eq(booking.id, bookingId));
  if (!b || b.status !== "cancelled" || b.endedBy !== "client") return noEmail();
  const to = await proEmailOf(db, b.professionalId);
  if (to === null) return noEmail();
  const returned = await returnedBookingIds(db, b.professionalId, [b.bookingId]);
  const mail = proBookingCancelledEmail({
    customerName: b.customerName,
    customerEmail: b.customerEmail,
    title: b.title,
    whenLabel: whenOf(b),
    ticketReturned: returned.has(b.bookingId),
    planningUrl: planningUrlOf(b, deps),
  });
  return emails(b.professionalId, [{ to, ...mail }]);
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import { syncOccurrence } from "@/lib/calendar-sync";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { sendEmail } from "@/lib/email";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { mailsToSend, type EffectBudget } from "@/lib/mail-budget";
import { planEffect, type OutgoingEmail } from "@/lib/notify-core";
import { runEffectsWith } from "@/lib/notify-run";
import { expireCheckoutSession } from "@/lib/stripe";
import { guestKey } from "@/server/guest-key";

/** Resend allows 2 requests per second by default: with Resend on, e-mails leave one by one, at least 550 ms apart. */
const MAIL_GAP_MS = 550;

/** When the next e-mail may leave (epoch ms). Module level, so it paces every run of this server instance. */
let nextMailAt = 0;

async function sendPaced(mail: OutgoingEmail): Promise<void> {
  if (env.RESEND_ENABLED) {
    // The slot is reserved before the first await: two runs in flight queue behind each other.
    const slot = Math.max(Date.now(), nextMailAt);
    nextMailAt = slot + MAIL_GAP_MS;
    const wait = slot - Date.now();
    if (wait > 0) await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, wait));
  }
  await sendEmail(mail);
}

/**
 * Runs effects after commit, best effort: the tested runEffectsWith (src/lib/notify-run.ts) with the real
 * dependencies. Duplicates dropped and Google syncs last, each effect planned from a fresh read, then executed.
 * Never throws: a failing effect logs « [notify] <type> failed: <message> » (no address, token or session id) and
 * the next one still runs. E-mails leave one by one, paced under Resend's 2 requests per second (sendPaced), so a
 * séance of 100 registrants takes about a minute. Scheduled with after() by runProAction (budget "pro": the pro's
 * e-mail budget, final review SEC-1) and by runPublicAction, runClientAction, the Stripe webhook and the mock
 * checkout (budget "none": the client gets what they asked or paid for, bounded by the throttle keys, Decision 74).
 * `budget` has no default.
 */
export async function runEffects(effects: readonly Effect[], budget: EffectBudget): Promise<void> {
  await runEffectsWith(
    {
      plan: (effect) => planEffect(db, effect, { appUrl: env.APP_URL, guestKey: guestKey(), now: new Date() }),
      mailsToSend: (plan, mailBudget) => mailsToSend(db, plan, mailBudget, new Date()),
      sendEmail: sendPaced,
      syncOccurrence: async (occurrenceId) => {
        await syncOccurrence(occurrenceId);
      },
      expireCheckout: async (checkoutSessionId) => {
        await expireCheckoutSession(checkoutSessionId);
      },
      log: (line) => console.error(line),
      warn: (line) => console.warn(line),
    },
    effects,
    budget,
  );
}
```

```ts
/** The actions that take a seat: their per-séance IP key needs the séance (THROTTLE_LIMITS[action].perOccurrenceIp is not null for exactly these, pinned by throttle.test.ts). */
export type SeatTakingThrottleAction = "buybook" | "free";
type ActionThrottleBase = {
  professionalId: string;
  /** ipHash(daily salt, ipBuckets(ip).narrow), never an address */
  ipHash: string;
  /** ipHash(daily salt, ipBuckets(ip).wide), null for IPv4 */
  wideIpHash: string | null;
  subject: ThrottleSubject;
};
/** A seat-taking action (buybook, free) must name its séance (tsc refuses the call without it, and actionThrottleKeys throws at run time); the other actions take no séance. */

  | (ActionThrottleBase & { action: SeatTakingThrottleAction; occurrenceId: string })
  | (ActionThrottleBase & { action: Exclude<ThrottleAction, SeatTakingThrottleAction>; occurrenceId?: string });
```

`createCheckoutAndAttach` is the one helper this plan adds to the contract's list: steps 10 and 11 of E1 are identical to the checkout branches of E9 (contract § 3.10), so both cores call it instead of carrying two copies of the release-on-failure code. - [ ] **Step 3: Implement the pure part of `src/lib/public/booking-actions.ts`**

Create `src/lib/public/booking-actions.ts` with exactly this content (Step 7 completes it with the database part):

```ts
/**
 * Public bookings and purchases of an event séance (spec § 11 E1, E2, E3) as testable cores. Every core
 * validates the WHOLE input first (parseFr on a strict schema), then refuses in a fixed order (honeypot,
 * payment availability, throttle, seat pressure) BEFORE its first write, then calls the engine with the pro of
 * the page slug (PublicPro), never with anything taken from the input. A core never reads a session or a
 * cookie: the wrapper (src/server/public-context.ts) builds the ActionVisitor. No server-only, no next/*.
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import type { ActionVisitor } from "@/lib/public/context";
import { upsertUserIdFor, type SessionFacts } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { plainNameSchema } from "@/lib/public/plain-name";
import type { ThrottleSubject } from "@/lib/throttle";
import { answersInputSchema, customerInputSchema, idSchema, normalizeEmail, type AnswerInput } from "@/lib/tickets";

/** What the client sends as its identity (parsed by the strict schema below). */
export type IdentityInput = { name: string; email: string; phone?: string };

/** Strict typed identity (SEC-M15, SEC-M9, OUT:91): name plainNameSchema; email z.string().trim().pipe(customerInputSchema.shape.email); phone customerInputSchema.shape.phone; no other key. */
export const identityInputSchema = z
  .object({
    name: plainNameSchema,
    email: z.string().trim().pipe(customerInputSchema.shape.email),
    phone: customerInputSchema.shape.phone,
  })
  .strict();

/** The séance the client saw and its answers: the part every claim on a séance shares. */
export const claimTargetSchema = z.object({
  occurrenceId: idSchema,
  seenStartsAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  answers: answersInputSchema,
});

/** The WHOLE input of each core, `.strict()` (an extra key or a wrong type is refused before anything else, SEC-M15). */
export const buyAndBookInputSchema = claimTargetSchema
  .extend({ offerId: idSchema, identity: identityInputSchema, website: z.unknown().optional() })
  .strict();

export type BuyAndBookInput = {
  occurrenceId: string;
  offerId: string;
  seenStartsAt: string;
  identity: IdentityInput;
  answers: AnswerInput[];
  website?: string;
};

/** The honeypot (L786, L863): filled = anything but undefined or "" (SEC-M15); checked right after the shape parse, before any read or write. */
export function honeypotFilled(website: unknown): boolean {
  return website !== undefined && website !== "";
}

/** The identity to write: an Owner's session e-mail replaces the typed one (the field is read-only for them, L1353); name and phone as parsed (phone "" → null). */
export function identityOf(
  parsed: { name: string; email: string; phone?: string },
  visitor: Pick<ActionVisitor, "owner">,
): { name: string; email: string; phone: string | null } {
  return {
    name: parsed.name,
    email: visitor.owner ? normalizeEmail(visitor.owner.email) : parsed.email,
    phone: parsed.phone ? parsed.phone : null,
  };
}

/** SEC-I6: a verified identity (upsertUserIdFor(session, email) not null) → { kind: "user", userId }; else { kind: "email", email }. */
export function throttleSubjectOf(session: SessionFacts | null, email: string): ThrottleSubject {
  const userId = upsertUserIdFor(session, email);
  return userId === null ? { kind: "email", email } : { kind: "user", userId };
}

/** SEC-I1: live holds one séance may carry before buy + book refuses a typed address: Math.max(3, Math.ceil(capacity / 3)). */
export function holdCeiling(capacity: number): number {
  return Math.max(3, Math.ceil(capacity / 3));
}
```

```ts
/* ───────────────────────── DB cases: startBuyAndBookCore ───────────────────────── */

const EVENT_TITLE = "Altinha débutants";

/** A tickets-mode séance in 3 days (10:00, Paris), one linked type, one « Carnet de 4 » offer at 85 €. `occurrenceCount` > 1 makes a daily series. */
async function setup(h: DbHarness, over: { capacity?: number; occurrenceCount?: number } = {}) {
  const typeId = await makeType(h.db, h.pro, { name: "Altinha" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(h.db, h.pro, typeId, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500 });
  const { eventId, occurrences } = await makeEvent(h.db, h.pro, {
    title: EVENT_TITLE,
    ticketTypeIds: [typeId],
    capacity: over.capacity ?? 12,
    rule:
      over.occurrenceCount === undefined
        ? undefined
        : { freq: "daily", interval: 1, endMode: "count", occurrenceCount: over.occurrenceCount },
  });
  return { typeId, offerId, eventId, occurrences, occ: occurrences[0] };
}
type Setup = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof setup>>;

/** The raw input of a buy + book call, as the browser sends it (the wrapper splits the slug off). */
function buyInput(
  s: Setup,
  over: Record<string, unknown> = {},
  occ: { id: string; startsAt: Date } = s.occ,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    occurrenceId: occ.id,
    offerId: s.offerId,
    seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt.toISOString(),
    identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: testEmail("buy") },
    answers: [],
    ...over,
  };
}

/** One call of the core: the real pro row, a visitor (default anonymous), a fake gateway and ONE `now`. */
async function run(
  h: DbHarness,
  input: unknown,
  opts: { visitor?: ActionVisitor; fake?: FakeCheckout; mockAllowed?: boolean; now?: Date } = {},
) {
  const pro = await publicProOf(h.db, h.pro);
  const visitor = opts.visitor ?? actionVisitorOf();
  const fake = opts.fake ?? fakeCheckout("test");
  const now = opts.now ?? new Date();
  const deps = publicDepsOf(fake, { mockAllowed: opts.mockAllowed ?? false });
  const res = await startBuyAndBookCore(h.db, pro, visitor, input, deps, now);
  return { res, fake, visitor, now };
}

const purchasesOf = (h: DbHarness) =>
  h.db.select().from(ticketPurchase).where(eq(ticketPurchase.professionalId, h.pro.proId));

const bookingsOf = (h: DbHarness, occurrenceId: string) =>
  h.db.select().from(bookingTable).where(eq(bookingTable.occurrenceId, occurrenceId));

async function customerOf(h: DbHarness, email: string) {
  const [row] = await h.db
    .select()
    .from(customerTable)
    .where(and(eq(customerTable.professionalId, h.pro.proId), eq(customerTable.email, normalizeEmail(email))));
  return row;
}

const digestOf = (email: string): string =>
  createHash("sha256").update(normalizeEmail(email)).digest("hex").slice(0, 32);

/** Every throttle row a call with this IP hash or this address would have written. */
function throttleRowsOf(h: DbHarness, ipHash: string, email: string) {
  return h.db
    .select()
    .from(throttle)
    .where(or(like(throttle.key, `%${ipHash}%`), like(throttle.key, `%${digestOf(email)}%`)));
}

/** A verified client user, its customer row at h.pro (linked) and the Owner visitor built from them. Delete the user with deleteTestUser. */
async function ownerVisitor(h: DbHarness, email: string) {
  const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email, name: "Beatriz Almeida", verified: true });
  const customerId = await rowCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { email, userId });
  const owner = { professionalId: h.pro.proId, customerId, userId, email };
  const visitor = actionVisitorOf({
    session: sessionOf({ userId, email, name: "Beatriz Almeida" }, { verified: true }),
    owner,
  });
  return { userId, customerId, owner, visitor };
}

/** `live` live holds and `elapsed` elapsed ones made of raw rows (a pending purchase and its pending booking per customer), seats_taken kept in step (I1). */
async function addRowHolds(h: DbHarness, s: Setup, live: number, now: Date, elapsed = 0): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < live + elapsed; i++) {
    const customerId = await rowCustomer(h.db, h.pro, {}, now);
    const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(
      h.db,
      h.pro,
      { customerId, offerId: s.offerId, ticketTypeId: s.typeId },
      now,
    );
    await rowBooking(
      h.db,
      h.pro,
      {
        occurrenceId: s.occ.id,
        customerId,
        status: "pending",
        coverage: "ticket",
        purchaseId,
        holdExpiresAt: i < live ? addMinutes(now, 45) : addMinutes(now, -5),
      },
      now,
    );
  }
  await h.db.update(occurrenceTable).set({ seatsTaken: live + elapsed }).where(eq(occurrenceTable.id, s.occ.id));
}

dbTest("E1 holds a seat and answers with the Checkout URL of the session the gateway created", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const email = testEmail("buy");
  const now = new Date();
  const input = buyInput(s, {
    identity: { name: " Beatriz Almeida ", email: ` ${email.toUpperCase()} `, phone: "06 12 34 56 78" },
  });
  const { res, fake } = await run(h, input, { now });
  assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
  assert.equal(res.checkoutUrl, `https://checkout.test/${res.purchaseId}`);

  const [purchase] = await h.db.select().from(ticketPurchase).where(eq(ticketPurchase.id, res.purchaseId));
  assert.equal(purchase.status, "pending");
  assert.equal(purchase.checkoutSessionId, `cs_test_fake_${res.purchaseId}`);
  assert.equal(purchase.checkoutUrl, res.checkoutUrl);
  assert.equal(purchase.offerId, s.offerId);
  assert.equal(purchase.amountCents, 8500);
  assert.equal(purchase.quantity, 4);

  const bookings = await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id);
  assert.equal(bookings.length, 1);
  assert.equal(bookings[0].status, "pending");
  assert.equal(bookings[0].purchaseId, res.purchaseId);
  assert.equal(bookings[0].customerId, purchase.customerId);
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 1);

  const row = await customerOf(h, email);
  assert.equal(row?.id, purchase.customerId);
  assert.equal(row?.email, email);
  assert.equal(row?.name, "Beatriz Almeida");
  assert.equal(row?.phone, "06 12 34 56 78");
  assert.equal(row?.userId, null);

  assert.equal(fake.created.length, 1);
  const req = fake.created[0];
  assert.equal(req.kind, "buybook");
  assert.equal(req.purchaseId, res.purchaseId);
  assert.equal(req.amountCents, 8500);
  assert.equal(req.currency, "eur");
  assert.equal(req.productName, `${EVENT_TITLE} · Carnet de 4`);
  assert.equal(req.customerEmail, email);
  assert.equal(req.env, "test");
  assert.ok(req.expiresAt.getTime() >= now.getTime() + 30 * 60_000, "Stripe needs 30 minutes at least");
  assert.equal(req.successUrl, `https://app.test/${h.pro.slug}/merci?p=${res.purchaseId}`);
  assert.equal(
    req.cancelUrl,
    `https://app.test/${h.pro.slug}/seance/${s.occ.id}?paiement=annule&p=${res.purchaseId}`,
  );
  assert.deepEqual(fake.expired, []);
});

dbTest("a gateway failure releases the seat at once and answers CHECKOUT_FAILED", async (h, t) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  t.mock.method(console, "error", (...args: unknown[]) => {
    lines.push(args.map(String).join(" "));
  });
  const fake = fakeCheckout("test");
  const email = testEmail("fail");
  // A Stripe-like failure that quotes the typed address and a session id, as Stripe's validation errors do: the
  // log line must not repeat either (logSafeMessage), which a fixed message could never prove.
  fake.create = async (req) => {
    fake.created.push(req);
    throw new Error(`Invalid email address: ${email} (session cs_test_a1B2c3D4e5F6)`);
  };

  const { res } = await run(h, buyInput(s, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), { fake });
  assert.ok(!res.ok);
  assert.equal(res.error, COPY.CHECKOUT_FAILED);
  assert.equal(res.code, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [{ type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: s.occ.id }]);

  const [purchase] = await purchasesOf(h);
  assert.equal(purchase.status, "expired");
  assert.equal(purchase.checkoutSessionId, null);
  const [held] = await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id);
  assert.equal(held.status, "expired");
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(fake.expired, []);

  assert.equal(lines.length, 1);
  assert.equal(lines[0], "[public] checkout create failed: Invalid email address: [email] (session [session])");
  assert.equal(lines[0].includes("@"), false);
  assert.equal(lines[0].includes(email), false);
  assert.equal(lines[0].includes("cs_test_"), false);
});

});

dbTest("a typed address cannot take a seat on a séance at its hold ceiling; an Owner still can (S33, SEC-I6)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h, { capacity: 6 });
  const now = new Date();
  assert.equal(holdCeiling(6), 3);
  await addRowHolds(h, s, 3, now);

  const email = testEmail("ceiling");
  const typed = await run(h, buyInput(s, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), { now });
  assert.ok(!typed.res.ok);
  assert.equal(typed.res.error, COPY.TOO_MANY_PAYMENTS);
  assert.equal(typed.res.code, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(typed.res.effects, []);
  assert.equal(await customerOf(h, email), undefined);
  assert.equal(typed.fake.created.length, 0);
  assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 3);
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 3);

  const o = await ownerVisitor(h, testEmail("owner"));
  try {
    const owned = await run(h, buyInput(s), { visitor: o.visitor, now });
    assert.ok(owned.res.ok, JSON.stringify(owned.res));
    assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 4);
    assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 4);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, o.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("a verified session that is not yet an Owner here types its own address past the hold ceiling; another address does not (S33, SEC-I6)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h, { capacity: 6 });
  const now = new Date();
  await addRowHolds(h, s, 3, now);
  assert.equal(holdCeiling(6), 3);

  const email = testEmail("verified");
  const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email, name: "Beatriz Almeida", verified: true });
  try {
    // Verified, but no customer row at this pro yet: no Owner. The session alone keys the throttle on her user.
    const visitor = actionVisitorOf({ session: sessionOf({ userId, email, name: "Beatriz Almeida" }, { verified: true }) });
    assert.equal(visitor.owner, null);
    assert.equal(await customerOf(h, email), undefined);

    // Typing ANOTHER address makes her a stranger to that address: the ceiling applies.
    const strangerEmail = testEmail("stranger");
    const other = await run(h, buyInput(s, { identity: { name: "Camille Durand", email: strangerEmail } }), { visitor, now });
    assert.ok(!other.res.ok);
    assert.equal(other.res.error, COPY.TOO_MANY_PAYMENTS);
    assert.equal(other.fake.created.length, 0);
    assert.equal(await customerOf(h, strangerEmail), undefined);
    assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 3);

    // Typing her OWN address: a verified identity cannot be made up by a stranger, so the ceiling is skipped.
    const own = await run(h, buyInput(s, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), { visitor, now });
    assert.ok(own.res.ok, JSON.stringify(own.res));
    assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 4);
    assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 4);
    assert.equal((await customerOf(h, email))?.userId, userId, "her own address is linked to her account");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, userId);
  }
});

dbTest("a typed address never links someone else's account (OUT:69)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const victimEmail = testEmail("victim");
  const otherEmail = testEmail("other");
  const strangerEmail = testEmail("stranger");
  const victim = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email: victimEmail, name: "Victime", verified: true });
  const other = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email: otherEmail, name: "Autre", verified: true });
  try {
    // 1. nobody is signed in and the visitor types the victim's address
    const anonymous = await run(h, buyInput(s, { identity: { name: "Mallory", email: victimEmail } }));
    assert.ok(anonymous.res.ok, JSON.stringify(anonymous.res));
    assert.equal((await customerOf(h, victimEmail))?.userId, null);

    // 2. a verified user signed in as ANOTHER address types a third address: no link either
    const signedIn = actionVisitorOf({
      session: sessionOf({ userId: other.userId, email: otherEmail, name: "Autre" }, { verified: true }),
    });
    const typedStranger = await run(h, buyInput(s, { identity: { name: "Mallory", email: strangerEmail } }), {
      visitor: signedIn,
    });
    assert.ok(typedStranger.res.ok, JSON.stringify(typedStranger.res));
    assert.equal((await customerOf(h, strangerEmail))?.userId, null);

    // 3. the same user typing their own address is linked (the contrast)
    const own = await run(h, buyInput(s, { identity: { name: "Autre", email: otherEmail } }), { visitor: signedIn });
    assert.ok(own.res.ok, JSON.stringify(own.res));
    assert.equal((await customerOf(h, otherEmail))?.userId, other.userId);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, victim.userId);
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("an Owner keeps the engine sentences of her own state", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h, { occurrenceCount: 3 });
  const o = await ownerVisitor(h, testEmail("owner"));
  try {
    const [first, second, third] = s.occurrences;
    const held = await run(h, buyInput(s, {}, first), { visitor: o.visitor });
    assert.ok(held.res.ok, JSON.stringify(held.res));

    const again = await run(h, buyInput(s, {}, first), { visitor: o.visitor });
    assert.ok(!again.res.ok);
    assert.equal(again.res.error, "Vous êtes déjà inscrit(e).");
    assert.equal(again.res.code, "already_booked");

    const secondHold = await run(h, buyInput(s, {}, second), { visitor: o.visitor });
    assert.ok(secondHold.res.ok, JSON.stringify(secondHold.res));

});
```

`new_string` (the same function followed by the new code):

```ts
export function holdCeiling(capacity: number): number {
  return Math.max(3, Math.ceil(capacity / 3));
}

/** A read, not a guard (a race lets one extra hold through, never a stranger's seat): live holds (status 'pending' and hold_expires_at > now) and the capacity of THIS pro's occurrence; null when not this pro's or unknown (the engine then answers not_found). */
export async function seatPressureOf(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  occurrenceId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<{ liveHolds: number; capacity: number } | null> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ capacity: number; live_holds: number }>(sql`
    select o.capacity::int as capacity,
      (select count(*)::int from booking b
        where b.occurrence_id = o.id and b.professional_id = o.professional_id
          and b.status = 'pending' and b.hold_expires_at > ${ts(now)}) as live_holds
    from occurrence o
    where o.id = ${occurrenceId} and o.professional_id = ${professionalId}`);
  const row = res.rows[0];
  return row ? { liveHolds: Number(row.live_holds), capacity: Number(row.capacity) } : null;
}

/** The title of an event séance of this pro (the Checkout product name); null when it is not found. */
async function seanceTitleOf(db: Db, professionalId: string, occurrenceId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ title: event.title })
    .from(occurrence)
    .innerJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId),
        eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(event.professionalId, professionalId),
      ),
    );
  return row?.title ?? null;
}

/**
 * Best effort once a purchase exists (a pending purchase, and its held seat for a buy + book) and a later step THREW:
 * close the Checkout session when Stripe has one, then release the purchase, each in its own try so one failure never
 * hides the other. It never throws: the caller rethrows the ORIGINAL error, which runPublicActionWith answers as
 * PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED. Without this the seat stays held until the hold lapses, and the same typed address then gets
 * COPY.BUYBOOK_NOT_POSSIBLE. The sync effect a release returns is dropped (nothing can run it after a throw): the
 * next calendar sync heals it. Logs carry no address and no session id (logSafeMessage).
 */
async function abandonPurchase(
  db: Db,
  deps: PublicDeps,
  purchaseId: string,
  sessionId: string | null,
  now: Date,
): Promise<void> {
  if (sessionId !== null) {
    try {
      await deps.checkout.expire(sessionId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[public] checkout expire failed: " + logSafeMessage(err));
    }
  }
  try {
    await releasePurchase(db, purchaseId, now);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[public] purchase release failed: " + logSafeMessage(err));
  }
}

/**
 * Steps 10 and 11 of E1 and E9: the Checkout session, then its attachment to the purchase. A throw from the
 * gateway releases the purchase at once (COPY.CHECKOUT_FAILED, L814); a refused attachment (the purchase is no
 * longer pending) expires the session, releases the purchase and answers « stale ». The seat of a buy + book
 * comes back in both cases and its sync effect is returned with the failure. Logs carry no address or session id.
 * Anything else that THROWS here (the attach UPDATE, a release) closes the session that exists and releases the
 * purchase best effort (abandonPurchase), then rethrows.
 */
export async function createCheckoutAndAttach(
  db: Db,
  deps: PublicDeps,
  request: CheckoutRequest,
  context: "buybook" | "shop",
  businessName: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ purchaseId: string; checkoutUrl: string }>> {
  // The session Stripe handed out, until the code below has closed it itself: what a throw must close.
  let openSessionId: string | null = null;
  try {
    let created: CheckoutCreated;
    try {
      created = await deps.checkout.create(request);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[public] checkout create failed: " + logSafeMessage(err));
      const rel = await releasePurchase(db, request.purchaseId, now);
      return publicFail(COPY.CHECKOUT_FAILED, { effects: rel.ok ? rel.effects : [] });
    }
    openSessionId = created.sessionId;
    const attached = await attachCheckoutSession(
      db,
      { purchaseId: request.purchaseId, checkoutSessionId: created.sessionId, checkoutUrl: created.url },
      now,
    );
    if (!attached.ok) {
      openSessionId = null;
      try {
        await deps.checkout.expire(created.sessionId);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[public] checkout expire failed: " + logSafeMessage(err));
      }
      const rel = await releasePurchase(db, request.purchaseId, now);
      return fromEngineClient(fail("stale"), context, { businessName }, rel.ok ? rel.effects : []);
    }
    return publicOk({ purchaseId: request.purchaseId, checkoutUrl: created.url });
  } catch (err) {
    await abandonPurchase(db, deps, request.purchaseId, openSessionId, now);
    throw err;
  }
}

/** E1 (L778-823): shape, honeypot, payment availability, throttle "buybook", seat pressure, upsertCustomer, startBuyAndBook, Checkout session, attachCheckoutSession; a Stripe failure or a refused attach releases the seat at once, and so does a throw once the seat is held (rethrown after the release). */
export async function startBuyAndBookCore(
  db: Db,
  pro: PublicPro,
  visitor: ActionVisitor,
  input: unknown,
  deps: PublicDeps,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ purchaseId: string; checkoutUrl: string }>> {
  // 1. The whole input, strict: a malformed call reads and writes nothing.
  const parsed = parseFr(buyAndBookInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return fromParse(parsed);
  const data = parsed.data;

  // 2. The honeypot: refused before any throttle, read or write.
  if (honeypotFilled(data.website)) return publicFail(COPY.HONEYPOT_REFUSED);

  // 3. The identity to write (an Owner's session address wins) and who is rate limited.
  const vars = { businessName: pro.businessName };
  const identity = identityOf(data.identity, visitor);
  const subject = throttleSubjectOf(visitor.session, identity.email);

  // 4. A simulated payment outside its allowance (Stripe on, or production): nothing is written.
  if (deps.checkout.mode === "mock" && !deps.mockAllowed) return publicFail(COPY.PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE);

  // 5. The throttle, before any write or gateway call (SEC-I1, SEC-I2).
  const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
    db,
    {
      action: "buybook",
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      ipHash: visitor.ipHash,
      wideIpHash: visitor.wideIpHash,
      subject,
      occurrenceId: data.occurrenceId,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!allowed) return publicFail(ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES.throttled, { code: "throttled" });

  // 6. Seat pressure: a typed address costs nothing to make up, so a séance at its hold ceiling refuses it (SEC-I1).
  if (subject.kind === "email") {
    const pressure = await seatPressureOf(db, pro.professionalId, data.occurrenceId, now);
    if (pressure && pressure.liveHolds >= holdCeiling(pressure.capacity)) return publicFail(COPY.TOO_MANY_PAYMENTS);
  }

  // 7. The customer row identifies who the purchase is for; it authorises nothing. The account is linked only
  // for a verified session of this very address (upsertUserIdFor, enforced again in SQL).
  const { customerId } = await upsertCustomer(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      email: identity.email,
      name: identity.name,
      phone: identity.phone,
      userId: subject.kind === "user" ? subject.userId : null,
    },
    now,
  );

  // 8. The engine: seat held, purchase pending. For a typed address the two refusals that depend on another
  // customer's state say the same neutral sentence, without a code (Decision 64).
  const res = await startBuyAndBook(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      occurrenceId: data.occurrenceId,
      customerId,
      offerId: data.offerId,
      seenStartsAt: new Date(data.seenStartsAt),
      answers: data.answers,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) {
    if (subject.kind === "email" && (res.code === "already_booked" || res.code === "too_many_holds")) {
      return publicFail(COPY.BUYBOOK_NOT_POSSIBLE);
    }
    return fromEngineClient(res, "buybook", vars);
  }

  // 9 and 10. The product name shown on the Checkout page, then the request (31 minutes, computed right before the
  // call, L808). The seat is held from here on: a throw before the Checkout session exists releases it (a throw
  // later is createCheckoutAndAttach's to clean up).
  let request: CheckoutRequest;
  try {
    const title = await seanceTitleOf(db, pro.professionalId, data.occurrenceId);
    const productName = title === null ? res.label : `${title} · ${res.label}`;
    request = {
      kind: "buybook",
      purchaseId: res.purchaseId,
      amountCents: res.amountCents,
      currency: res.currency,
      productName,
      customerEmail: identity.email,
      env: deps.env,
      ...checkoutUrls(deps.appUrl, {
        kind: "buybook",
        slug: pro.slug,
        purchaseId: res.purchaseId,
        occurrenceId: data.occurrenceId,
      }),
      expiresAt: buybookCheckoutExpiry(Date.now()),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    await abandonPurchase(db, deps, res.purchaseId, null, now);
    throw err;
  }

  // 11. The Checkout session, then its attachment.
  return createCheckoutAndAttach(db, deps, request, "buybook", pro.businessName, now);
}
```

Create `src/server/public.ts` with exactly this content (Tasks 10 to 12 add the other actions):

```ts
"use server";

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { startBuyAndBookCore, type BuyAndBookInput } from "@/lib/public/booking-actions";
import { splitActionInput } from "@/lib/public/context";
import type { PublicResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { publicDeps, runPublicAction } from "@/server/public-context";

// Public writes (spec § 11). Every export splits the slug off its input, lets runPublicAction resolve the pro
// and the visitor on the server (never from input), and hands the REST of the input, as `unknown`, to a core
// that parses it whole. The wrapper owns the effects (run with the "none" budget) and the revalidation.

/** E1 from the séance page: hold a seat, then the Checkout URL to send the browser to (startBuyAndBookCore). */
export async function startBuyAndBookAction(
  input: { slug: string } & BuyAndBookInput,
): Promise<PublicResult<{ purchaseId: string; checkoutUrl: string }>> {
  const { slug, rest } = splitActionInput(input);
  return runPublicAction("startBuyAndBook", slug, (pro, visitor, now) =>
    startBuyAndBookCore(db, pro, visitor, rest, publicDeps(), now),
  );
}
```
