```ts
registerFree(db: Db, input: { professionalId: string; occurrenceId: string; customerId: string; seenStartsAt: Date; answers?: AnswerInput[]; customerNotes?: string | null }, now?: Date): Promise<EngineResult<{ bookingId: string }>> // effects: email.booking_confirmed, email.pro_new_booking, google.sync_occurrence
bookWithHeldTicket(db: Db, input: { professionalId: string; occurrenceId: string; customerId: string; seenStartsAt: Date; answers?: AnswerInput[]; customerNotes?: string | null; actorUserId: string }, now?: Date): Promise<EngineResult<{ bookingId: string; ticketId: string }>> // same three effects
```

- Produces (exact, added to `src/lib/public/booking-actions.ts`):

```ts
export const freeRegistrationInputSchema; // claimTargetSchema.extend({ identity: identityInputSchema, website: z.unknown().optional() }).strict()
export const heldTicketInputSchema; // claimTargetSchema.strict()
export type FreeRegistrationInput = { occurrenceId: string; seenStartsAt: string; identity: IdentityInput; answers: AnswerInput[]; website?: string };
export type HeldTicketInput = { occurrenceId: string; seenStartsAt: string; answers: AnswerInput[] };
export async function activeBookingIdOf(db: Db, professionalId: string, occurrenceId: string, customerId: string, now: Date): Promise<string | null>;
export async function registerFreeCore(db: Db, pro: PublicPro, visitor: ActionVisitor, input: unknown, now: Date): Promise<PublicCoreResult<object>>;
export async function bookWithHeldTicketCore(db: Db, pro: PublicPro, visitor: ActionVisitor, input: unknown, now: Date): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ bookingId: string }>>;
// src/server/public.ts
export async function registerFreeAction(input: { slug: string } & FreeRegistrationInput): Promise<PublicResult>;
export async function bookWithHeldTicketAction(input: { slug: string } & HeldTicketInput): Promise<PublicResult<{ bookingId: string }>>;
```

`activeBookingIdOf` is server-side only and never returned to the browser: it names the booking whose confirmation is re-sent to its own inbox (Decision 64). It counts a booking as active the way the engine's `activeBookingOf` does (confirmed, or pending with a live hold; a hold that ends exactly now is over, `gt(holdExpiresAt, now)`, which Revision 3.3 pins with its own test). `registerFreeCore` reads it and `seatsLeftOf` together (`Promise.all`, Revision 3.3).

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** S1 (a typed address and a guest cookie never spend tickets), S2 (an unverified or impersonated session never spends), S6 (free and held cross-tenant cases, an Owner of another pro), S19 (free: the 7th request of one address; held: refused after 10 hits, nothing changed), S33 (free: the 3rd registration on one séance from one IP, the 7th at the pro from one IP), S34 (free half: `already_booked` answers as a new address would on this séance, a fresh success or the same « Complet » answer when no seat is left, and the existing booking's confirmation goes to its own inbox only), S43 (malformed input), and the Revision 3.2 rule that no write precedes validation and the throttle (a malformed, refused or throttled held-ticket call links no account; the first accepted one links it). Also covered here, owned by Task 9: the S20 rule applied to E3 (a filled honeypot writes no customer and no throttle row).

```ts
/* ───────────────────────── Task 10: free registration and held ticket ───────────────────────── */

test("the free and held-ticket schemas are strict too", () => {
  const free = {
    occurrenceId: "o1",
    seenStartsAt: "2026-10-25T08:00:00.000Z",
    identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: "beatriz@example.com" },
    answers: [],
  };
  assert.equal(parseFr(freeRegistrationInputSchema, free).ok, true);
  assert.equal(parseFr(freeRegistrationInputSchema, { ...free, offerId: "f1" }).ok, false, "no offer in a free registration");
  assert.equal(parseFr(freeRegistrationInputSchema, { ...free, customerId: "c1" }).ok, false);

  const held = { occurrenceId: "o1", seenStartsAt: "2026-10-25T08:00:00.000Z", answers: [] };
  assert.equal(parseFr(heldTicketInputSchema, held).ok, true);
  for (const extra of [{ identity: free.identity }, { customerId: "c1" }, { userId: "u1" }, { website: "" }]) {
    const res = parseFr(heldTicketInputSchema, { ...held, ...extra });
    assert.equal(res.ok, false, JSON.stringify(extra));
    if (!res.ok) assert.equal(res.error, "Champ inattendu.", JSON.stringify(extra));
  }
});

test("registerFreeCore reads the existing booking and the seats of a typed address together (one round trip, Decision 64 residual)", () => {
  const source = readFileSync("src/lib/public/booking-actions.ts", "utf8");
  const start = source.indexOf("export async function registerFreeCore");
  assert.notEqual(start, -1, "registerFreeCore is declared");
  const end = source.indexOf("\n/**", start);
  const body = source.slice(start, end === -1 ? undefined : end);
  // A fresh address pays only the engine call; the registered one must not also pay two reads in sequence.
  assert.match(
    body,
    /Promise\.all\(\[\s*activeBookingIdOf\([^)]*\),\s*seatsLeftOf\([^)]*\),?\s*\]\)/,
    "the two reads run through Promise.all",
  );
  assert.equal(body.match(/await activeBookingIdOf\(|await seatsLeftOf\(/g), null, "neither read is awaited on its own");
});

/** A free-mode séance (« Roda libre ») in 3 days; `occurrenceCount` > 1 makes a daily series. */
async function setupFree(h: DbHarness, over: { capacity?: number; occurrenceCount?: number } = {}) {
  const { eventId, occurrences } = await makeEvent(h.db, h.pro, {
    title: "Roda libre",
    bookingMode: "free",
    capacity: over.capacity ?? 12,
    rule:
      over.occurrenceCount === undefined
        ? undefined
        : { freq: "daily", interval: 1, endMode: "count", occurrenceCount: over.occurrenceCount },
  });
  return { eventId, occurrences, occ: occurrences[0] };
}

/** The raw input of a free registration or a held-ticket call for `occ`. */
function claimInput(occ: { id: string; startsAt: Date }, over: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { occurrenceId: occ.id, seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt.toISOString(), answers: [], ...over };
}

function freeInput(occ: { id: string; startsAt: Date }, over: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return claimInput(occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: testEmail("free") }, ...over });
}

async function runFree(h: DbHarness, input: unknown, opts: { visitor?: ActionVisitor; now?: Date } = {}) {
  const pro = await publicProOf(h.db, h.pro);
  const visitor = opts.visitor ?? actionVisitorOf();
  const now = opts.now ?? new Date();
  const res = await registerFreeCore(h.db, pro, visitor, input, now);
  return { res, visitor, now };
}

async function runHeld(h: DbHarness, input: unknown, opts: { visitor?: ActionVisitor; now?: Date } = {}) {
  const pro = await publicProOf(h.db, h.pro);
  const visitor = opts.visitor ?? actionVisitorOf();
  const now = opts.now ?? new Date();
  const res = await bookWithHeldTicketCore(h.db, pro, visitor, input, now);
  return { res, visitor, now };
}

dbTest("free registration confirms the booking and plans the confirmation, the pro's notice and the sync", async (h) => {
  const s = await setupFree(h);
  const email = testEmail("free");
  const { res } = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: " Beatriz Almeida ", email, phone: "" } }));
  const browser = withoutPublicEffects(res);
  assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
  assert.deepEqual(browser, { ok: true });

  const [b] = await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id);
  assert.equal(b.status, "confirmed");
  assert.equal(b.coverage, "free");
  assert.equal(b.createdBy, "client");
  assert.equal(b.purchaseId, null);
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [
    { type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: b.id },
    { type: "email.pro_new_booking", bookingId: b.id },
    { type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: s.occ.id },
  ]);
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 1);

  const row = await customerOf(h, email);
  assert.equal(row?.id, b.customerId);
  assert.equal(row?.name, "Beatriz Almeida");
  assert.equal(row?.phone, null);
  assert.equal(row?.userId, null);
});

dbTest("free: the 7th request of one address at this pro is throttled before any write (S19)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setupFree(h);
  const email = testEmail("limit");
  const now = new Date();
  for (let hit = 1; hit <= 6; hit++) {
    const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
      h.db,
      {
        action: "free",
        professionalId: h.pro.proId,
        ipHash: testIpHash(),
        wideIpHash: null,
        subject: { kind: "email", email },
        occurrenceId: s.occ.id,
      },
      now,
    );
    assert.equal(allowed, true, `hit ${hit}`);
  }

  const { res } = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), { now });
  assert.ok(!res.ok);
  assert.equal(res.error, "Trop de demandes. Réessayez dans un moment.");
  assert.equal(res.code, "throttled");
  assert.equal(await customerOf(h, email), undefined);
  assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 0);
});

dbTest("free: the 7th registration at this pro from one IP is throttled, whatever the séance (S33, SEC-I1)", async (h) => {
  // Seven séances of one series: six earlier registrations from this IP, each on ANOTHER séance and with another
  // address (so neither the per-séance IP key nor an e-mail key is over), then the 7th on the first séance.
  const s = await setupFree(h, { occurrenceCount: 7 });
  const visitor = actionVisitorOf();
  const now = new Date();
  for (let hit = 1; hit <= 6; hit++) {
    const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
      h.db,
      {
        action: "free",
        professionalId: h.pro.proId,
        ipHash: visitor.ipHash,
        wideIpHash: null,
        subject: { kind: "email", email: testEmail("earlier") },
        occurrenceId: s.occurrences[hit].id,
      },
      now,
    );
    assert.equal(allowed, true, `hit ${hit}`);
  }

  const email = testEmail("seventh");
  const { res } = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), {
    visitor,
    now,
  });
  assert.ok(!res.ok);
  assert.equal(res.error, "Trop de demandes. Réessayez dans un moment.");
  assert.equal(res.code, "throttled");
  assert.equal(await customerOf(h, email), undefined);
  assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 0);
});

dbTest("free: a typed address already registered gets the success answer and its own confirmation again (S34, Decision 64)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setupFree(h);
  const email = testEmail("again");
  const identity = { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email };

  const first = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity }));
  const firstBrowser = withoutPublicEffects(first.res);
  assert.ok(first.res.ok, JSON.stringify(first.res));
  const [created] = await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id);

  const second = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity }));
  const secondBrowser = withoutPublicEffects(second.res);
  assert.ok(second.res.ok, JSON.stringify(second.res));
  assert.deepEqual(secondBrowser, firstBrowser, "the browser cannot tell a repeat from a fresh registration");
  assert.deepEqual(second.res.effects, [{ type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: created.id }]);
  assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 1);
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 1);
});

dbTest("free: on a full séance a registered address and a fresh one get the same « Complet » answer (S34, Decision 64)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setupFree(h, { capacity: 1 });
  const registered = testEmail("registered");
  const first = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: registered } }));
  assert.ok(first.res.ok, JSON.stringify(first.res));
  const [created] = await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id);

  const again = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: registered } }));
  const fresh = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Camille Durand", email: testEmail("fresh") } }));
  assert.ok(!fresh.res.ok, JSON.stringify(fresh.res));
  assert.equal(fresh.res.error, "Complet : il ne reste plus de place sur cette séance.");
  assert.equal(fresh.res.code, "full");
  assert.ok(!again.res.ok, "the registered address must not learn it is registered: the séance is full for everyone");
  assert.deepEqual(
    withoutPublicEffects(again.res),
    withoutPublicEffects(fresh.res),
    "the browser cannot tell a registered address from a fresh one on a full séance",
  );

  // Only the inbox owner can tell: the confirmation of her EXISTING booking goes to her address again.
  assert.deepEqual(fresh.res.effects, []);
  assert.deepEqual(again.res.effects, [{ type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: created.id }]);
  assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 1);
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 1);
});

dbTest("free: a stale hold the engine would release does not make a registered address look full (S34, Decision 64)", async (h) => {
  // Capacity 2: the registered address holds one seat, a stale hold of another customer still counts in seats_taken
  // until the next engine action releases it. A fresh address would get that seat back (R(o) before SEAT), so the
  // registered one must be answered as a success too: counting the stale hold would make her « Complet » alone.
  const s = await setupFree(h, { capacity: 2 });
  const typeId = await makeType(h.db, h.pro, { name: "Altinha" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(h.db, h.pro, typeId, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500 });
  const now = new Date();
  const registered = testEmail("registered");
  const first = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: registered } }), { now });
  assert.ok(first.res.ok, JSON.stringify(first.res));
  const [created] = await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id);

  const holder = await rowCustomer(h.db, h.pro, {}, now);
  const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(h.db, h.pro, { customerId: holder, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId }, now);
  await rowBooking(
    h.db,
    h.pro,
    {
      occurrenceId: s.occ.id,
      customerId: holder,
      status: "pending",
      coverage: "ticket",
      purchaseId,
      holdExpiresAt: addMinutes(now, -5),
    },
    now,
  );
  await h.db.update(occurrenceTable).set({ seatsTaken: 2 }).where(eq(occurrenceTable.id, s.occ.id));

  const again = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: registered } }), { now });
  assert.ok(again.res.ok, JSON.stringify(again.res));
  assert.deepEqual(again.res.effects, [{ type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: created.id }]);

  const fresh = await runFree(h, freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Camille Durand", email: testEmail("fresh") } }), { now });
  assert.ok(fresh.res.ok, JSON.stringify(fresh.res));
  assert.deepEqual(withoutPublicEffects(again.res), withoutPublicEffects(fresh.res));
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 2, "the stale hold went, the fresh address took its seat");
});

dbTest("free: a malformed input is refused whole, before anything is read or written (S43, SEC-M15)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setupFree(h);
  const email = testEmail("bad");
  const good = freeInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } });
  const visitor = actionVisitorOf();

  const cases: { label: string; input: unknown; error: string }[] = [
    { label: "an extra key", input: { ...good, userId: "u1" }, error: "Champ inattendu." },
    { label: "an offer id (a buy + book field)", input: { ...good, offerId: "f1" }, error: "Champ inattendu." },
    { label: "identity null", input: { ...good, identity: null }, error: "Valeur invalide." },
    { label: "a wrong type", input: { ...good, occurrenceId: 42 }, error: "Ce champ est obligatoire." },
    { label: "answers that are not a list", input: { ...good, answers: {} }, error: "Valeur invalide." },
    { label: "null", input: null, error: "Valeur invalide." },
  ];
  for (const c of cases) {
    const { res } = await runFree(h, c.input, { visitor });
    assert.ok(!res.ok, c.label);
    assert.equal(res.error, c.error, c.label);
    assert.equal(res.code, undefined, c.label);
    assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [], c.label);
  }
  assert.equal(await customerOf(h, email), undefined);
  assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(await throttleRowsOf(h, visitor.ipHash, email), []);
});

dbTest("held: only an Owner spends tickets, never a typed address, a guest cookie, an unverified or an impersonated session (S1, S2)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const email = testEmail("holder");
  const holder = await ownerVisitor(h, email);
  try {
    const [ticketId] = await giveTickets(h.db, h.pro, holder.customerId, s.typeId, 1);
    const user = { userId: holder.userId, email, name: "Beatriz Almeida" };
    const refusals: [string, ActionVisitor][] = [
      ["an anonymous visitor", actionVisitorOf()],
      ["a guest cookie alone", actionVisitorOf({ guestCustomerId: holder.customerId })],
      [
        "an impersonated session of the holder",
        actionVisitorOf({ session: sessionOf(user, { verified: true, impersonated: true }) }),
      ],
      [
        "an unverified session of the holder's address",
        actionVisitorOf({ session: sessionOf(user, { verified: false }) }),
      ],
    ];
    for (const [label, visitor] of refusals) {
      const { res } = await runHeld(h, claimInput(s.occ), { visitor });
      assert.ok(!res.ok, label);
      assert.equal(res.error, COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_TO_SPEND, label);
      assert.equal(res.code, undefined, label);
      assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [], label);
      assert.deepEqual(await throttleRowsOf(h, visitor.ipHash, email), [], `${label}: refused before the throttle`);
    }

    // A typed address has no way in: the held-ticket input carries no identity field at all.
    const typed = await runHeld(h, claimInput(s.occ, { identity: { name: "Mallory", email } }));
    assert.ok(!typed.res.ok);
    assert.equal(typed.res.error, "Champ inattendu.");

    assert.equal((await bookingsOf(h, s.occ.id)).length, 0);
    assert.equal((await getOccurrence(h.db, s.occ.id)).seatsTaken, 0);
    const tickets = await ticketsOf(h.db, holder.customerId);
    assert.deepEqual(
      tickets.map((t) => [t.id, t.status]),
      [[ticketId, "available"]],
    );
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, holder.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("held: an Owner of another pro, or a customer of another pro, spends nothing on this page (S6)", async (h) => {

  try {

    const session = sessionOf({ userId, email, name: "Beatriz Almeida" }, { verified: true });

dbTest("held: after 10 hits on her user key the Owner is throttled and nothing changes (S19, SEC-I2)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h);

          ipHash: testIpHash(),
          wideIpHash: null,

/** Like ownerVisitor, but her customer row is NOT linked to the account yet (user_id null): the state in which the first spend links it. */
async function unlinkedOwnerVisitor(h: DbHarness, email: string) {
  const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email, name: "Beatriz Almeida", verified: true });
  const customerId = await rowCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { email });
  const owner = { professionalId: h.pro.proId, customerId, userId, email };
  const visitor = actionVisitorOf({
    session: sessionOf({ userId, email, name: "Beatriz Almeida" }, { verified: true }),
    owner,
  });
  return { userId, customerId, owner, visitor };
}

/** customer.user_id of one row. */
async function linkedUserOf(h: DbHarness, customerId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await h.db
    .select({ userId: customerTable.userId })
    .from(customerTable)
    .where(eq(customerTable.id, customerId));
  return row.userId;
}

dbTest("activeBookingIdOf counts a pending booking only while its hold is live", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const now = new Date();
  /** A pending booking of its own customer (and its pending purchase) whose hold ends at `holdExpiresAt`. */
  async function pendingBooking(label: string, holdExpiresAt: Date) {
    const customerId = await rowCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { email: testEmail(label) }, now);
    const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(h.db, h.pro, { customerId, offerId: s.offerId, ticketTypeId: s.typeId }, now);
    const bookingId = await rowBooking(
      h.db,
      h.pro,
      { occurrenceId: s.occ.id, customerId, status: "pending", coverage: "ticket", purchaseId, holdExpiresAt },
      now,
    );
    return { customerId, bookingId };
  }
  const live = await pendingBooking("live", addMinutes(now, 45));
  const lapsed = await pendingBooking("lapsed", addMinutes(now, -5));
  const ending = await pendingBooking("ending", now);
  await h.db.update(occurrenceTable).set({ seatsTaken: 3 }).where(eq(occurrenceTable.id, s.occ.id));

  assert.equal(await activeBookingIdOf(h.db, h.pro.proId, s.occ.id, live.customerId, now), live.bookingId);
  assert.equal(
    await activeBookingIdOf(h.db, h.pro.proId, s.occ.id, lapsed.customerId, now),
    null,
    "a hold that lapsed is not an active booking: the seat is the next claim's",
  );
  assert.equal(
    await activeBookingIdOf(h.db, h.pro.proId, s.occ.id, ending.customerId, now),
    null,
    "a hold that ends exactly now is over (strictly later than now counts)",
  );
});
```

```ts
/** Server-side only, never returned to the browser: the id of this customer's active booking on the séance (Decision 64). */
export async function activeBookingIdOf(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  occurrenceId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ id: booking.id })
    .from(booking)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(booking.occurrenceId, occurrenceId),
        eq(booking.customerId, customerId),
        inArray(booking.status, ["pending", "confirmed"]),
        or(eq(booking.status, "confirmed"), gt(booking.holdExpiresAt, now)),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);
  return row?.id ?? null;
}

/**
 * Seats a NEW claim would find on this pro's séance, the way the engine's batch counts them: capacity minus seats_taken,
 * the elapsed pending holds counting as free because R(o) releases them before SEAT. A refused batch rolls back, so after
 * `already_booked` those holds are still in seats_taken. null when this pro has no such séance.
 */
async function seatsLeftOf(db: Db, professionalId: string, occurrenceId: string, now: Date): Promise<number | null> {
  const res = await db.execute<{ seats_left: number }>(sql`
    select (o.capacity - o.seats_taken
      + (select count(*)::int from booking b
          where b.occurrence_id = o.id and b.professional_id = o.professional_id
            and b.status = 'pending' and b.hold_expires_at < ${ts(now)}))::int as seats_left
    from occurrence o
    where o.id = ${occurrenceId} and o.professional_id = ${professionalId}`);
  const row = res.rows[0];
  return row ? Number(row.seats_left) : null;
}

/**
 * E3 (L860-865): shape, honeypot, throttle "free", upsertCustomer, registerFree. For a typed address `already_booked` is
 * answered as a NEW address would be on this séance, a success or « Complet » when no seat is left (Decision 64).
 */
export async function registerFreeCore(
  db: Db,
  pro: PublicPro,
  visitor: ActionVisitor,
  input: unknown,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult<object>> {
  // 1. The whole input, strict: a malformed call reads and writes nothing.
  const parsed = parseFr(freeRegistrationInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return fromParse(parsed);
  const data = parsed.data;

  // 2. The honeypot.
  if (honeypotFilled(data.website)) return publicFail(COPY.HONEYPOT_REFUSED);

  // 3. The identity to write and who is rate limited.
  const identity = identityOf(data.identity, visitor);
  const subject = throttleSubjectOf(visitor.session, identity.email);

  // 4. The throttle, with the séance: the per-séance and per-pro IP keys apply (SEC-I1).
  const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
    db,
    {
      action: "free",
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      ipHash: visitor.ipHash,
      wideIpHash: visitor.wideIpHash,
      subject,
      occurrenceId: data.occurrenceId,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!allowed) return publicFail(ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES.throttled, { code: "throttled" });

  // 5. The customer row identifies who registers; it authorises nothing (same userId rule as E1).
  const { customerId } = await upsertCustomer(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      email: identity.email,
      name: identity.name,
      phone: identity.phone,
      userId: subject.kind === "user" ? subject.userId : null,
    },
    now,
  );

  // 6. The engine. For a typed address an existing registration looks exactly like what a NEW address would get on
  // this séance (Decision 64); only the inbox owner gets the confirmation of the EXISTING booking again.
  const vars = { businessName: pro.businessName };
  const res = await registerFree(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      occurrenceId: data.occurrenceId,
      customerId,
      seenStartsAt: new Date(data.seenStartsAt),
      answers: data.answers,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (res.ok) return publicOk({}, res.effects);
  if (res.code === "already_booked" && subject.kind === "email") {
    // The engine tests « already booked » BEFORE the seat (claims.ts: assertNotBooked, then SEAT), so on a full séance a
    // registered address would pass where a fresh one is told « Complet »: that difference alone would say who attends.
    // The two reads do not depend on each other and run together: one round trip, so the registered address takes no
    // longer than a fresh one would (the Decision 64 timing residual).
    const [existing, left] = await Promise.all([
      activeBookingIdOf(db, pro.professionalId, data.occurrenceId, customerId, now),
      seatsLeftOf(db, pro.professionalId, data.occurrenceId, now),
    ]);
    const effects: Effect[] = existing === null ? [] : [{ type: "email.booking_confirmed", bookingId: existing }];
    if (left !== null && left < 1) return fromEngineClient(fail("full"), "free", vars, effects);
    return publicOk({}, effects);
  }
  return fromEngineClient(res, "free", vars);
}

/**
 * E2 client (L825-858): ONLY for an Owner (OUT:75), never a typed e-mail nor a guest cookie; throttle "held"; then the
 * Owner's account is linked to her customer row (L1345) and bookWithHeldTicket runs with the owner's customer and user.
 * The link is written here, after the parse, the Owner check and the throttle, and not by the wrapper: a malformed or
 * throttled call writes nothing (contract § 1 Validation, Revision 3.2).
 */
export async function bookWithHeldTicketCore(
  db: Db,
  pro: PublicPro,
  visitor: ActionVisitor,
  input: unknown,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ bookingId: string }>> {
  // 1. The whole input, strict: there is no identity field to smuggle an address into.
  const parsed = parseFr(heldTicketInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return fromParse(parsed);
  const data = parsed.data;

  // 2. Only a verified, non-impersonated Owner of THIS pro spends tickets (OUT:75, COV-I11): a guest cookie, an
  // unverified or impersonated session and an Owner of another pro all end here.
  const owner = visitor.owner;
  if (!owner || owner.professionalId !== pro.professionalId) return publicFail(COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_TO_SPEND);

  // 3. The throttle on her user key: the ticket comes back on every cancellation, so the wallet bounds nothing (SEC-I2).
  const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
    db,
    {
      action: "held",
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      ipHash: visitor.ipHash,
      wideIpHash: visitor.wideIpHash,
      subject: { kind: "user", userId: owner.userId },
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!allowed) return publicFail(ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES.throttled, { code: "throttled" });

  // 4. Link her account to her own customer row (L1345), only now: the input is valid and the throttle let her through.
  // linkCustomerUser fills a null user_id of this pro's row for a verified user of the same address, nothing else.
  await linkCustomerUser(db, owner, now);

  // 5. The engine, with the Owner's customer and user, never anything typed.
  const res = await bookWithHeldTicket(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      occurrenceId: data.occurrenceId,
      customerId: owner.customerId,
      seenStartsAt: new Date(data.seenStartsAt),
      answers: data.answers,
      actorUserId: owner.userId,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngineClient(res, "held", { businessName: pro.businessName });
  return publicOk({ bookingId: res.bookingId }, res.effects);
}
```

```ts
/** E3 from the séance page: a free registration with a typed identity (registerFreeCore). */
export async function registerFreeAction(input: { slug: string } & FreeRegistrationInput): Promise<PublicResult> {
  const { slug, rest } = splitActionInput(input);

/** E2 client from the séance page: spend one held ticket, for an Owner of this pro only (bookWithHeldTicketCore). */
export async function bookWithHeldTicketAction(
  input: { slug: string } & HeldTicketInput,
): Promise<PublicResult<{ bookingId: string }>> {
  const { slug, rest } = splitActionInput(input);
  // The one action that spends tickets. The wrapper writes nothing: the core links the Owner's customer row to her
  // account (L1345) after its parseFr and its throttle, and still refuses anyone who is not an Owner of this pro.
  return runPublicAction("bookWithHeldTicket", slug, (pro, visitor, now) =>
    bookWithHeldTicketCore(db, pro, visitor, rest, now),
  );
}
```

```ts
/** A type « Roda libre » and its « Carnet de 4 » offer at 85 €: a Boutique offer, no séance involved. */
async function setup(h: DbHarness) {
  const typeId = await makeType(h.db, h.pro, { name: "Roda libre" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(h.db, h.pro, typeId, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500 });
  return { typeId, offerId };
}
type Setup = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof setup>>;

/** The raw input of a shop call, as the browser sends it (the wrapper splits the slug off). */
function shopInput(s: Pick<Setup, "offerId">, over: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    offerId: s.offerId,
    identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: testEmail("shop") },
    ...over,
  };
}

/** One call of the core: the real pro row, a visitor (default anonymous), a fake gateway and ONE `now`. */
async function run(
  h: DbHarness,
  input: unknown,
  opts: { visitor?: ActionVisitor; fake?: FakeCheckout; mockAllowed?: boolean; now?: Date } = {},
) {
  const pro = await publicProOf(h.db, h.pro);
  const visitor = opts.visitor ?? actionVisitorOf();
  const fake = opts.fake ?? fakeCheckout("test");
  const now = opts.now ?? new Date();
  const deps = publicDepsOf(fake, { mockAllowed: opts.mockAllowed ?? false });
  const res = await startShopPurchaseCore(h.db, pro, visitor, input, deps, now);
  return { res, fake, visitor, now };
}

const purchasesOf = (h: DbHarness) =>
  h.db.select().from(ticketPurchase).where(eq(ticketPurchase.professionalId, h.pro.proId));

const bookingsOfPro = (h: DbHarness) =>
  h.db.select().from(bookingTable).where(eq(bookingTable.professionalId, h.pro.proId));

async function customerOf(h: DbHarness, email: string) {
  const [row] = await h.db
    .select()
    .from(customerTable)
    .where(and(eq(customerTable.professionalId, h.pro.proId), eq(customerTable.email, normalizeEmail(email))));
  return row;
}

const digestOf = (email: string): string =>
  createHash("sha256").update(normalizeEmail(email)).digest("hex").slice(0, 32);

/** Every throttle row a call with this IP hash or this address would have written. */
function throttleRowsOf(h: DbHarness, ipHash: string, email: string) {
  return h.db
    .select()
    .from(throttle)
    .where(or(like(throttle.key, `%${ipHash}%`), like(throttle.key, `%${digestOf(email)}%`)));
}

    `https://app.test/${h.pro.slug}/offre/${s.offerId}?paiement=annule&p=${res.purchaseId}`,
  );
  assert.deepEqual(fake.expired, []);
});

dbTest("shop purchase: a gateway failure expires the purchase and answers CHECKOUT_FAILED", async (h, t) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  t.mock.method(console, "error", (...args: unknown[]) => {
    lines.push(args.map(String).join(" "));
  });
  const fake = fakeCheckout("test");
  const email = testEmail("fail");
  // A gateway failure that quotes the typed address and a session id: the log line must not repeat either
  // (logSafeMessage), which a fixed message could never prove.
  fake.create = async (req) => {
    fake.created.push(req);
    throw new Error(`Invalid email address: ${email} (session cs_test_a1B2c3D4e5F6)`);
  };

  const { res } = await run(h, shopInput(s, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), { fake });
  assert.ok(!res.ok);
  assert.equal(res.error, COPY.CHECKOUT_FAILED);
  assert.equal(res.code, undefined);
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
  const [purchase] = await purchasesOf(h);
  assert.equal(purchase.status, "expired");
  assert.equal(purchase.checkoutSessionId, null);
  assert.deepEqual(fake.expired, []);
  assert.equal(lines.length, 1);
  assert.equal(lines[0], "[public] checkout create failed: Invalid email address: [email] (session [session])");
  assert.equal(lines[0].includes("@"), false);
  assert.equal(lines[0].includes(email), false);
  assert.equal(lines[0].includes("cs_test_"), false);
});

        subject: { kind: "email", email },
      },
      now,
    );
    assert.equal(allowed, true, `hit ${hit}`);
  }

  const { res, fake } = await run(h, shopInput(s, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), { now });
  assert.ok(!res.ok);
  assert.equal(res.error, "Trop de demandes. Réessayez dans un moment.");
  assert.equal(res.code, "throttled");
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
  assert.equal(await customerOf(h, email), undefined);
  assert.equal((await purchasesOf(h)).length, 0);
  assert.equal(fake.created.length, 0);
});

dbTest("shop purchase: strangers typing an address cannot lock out its verified holder (S36, SEC-I6)", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const email = testEmail("holder");
  const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email, name: "Beatriz Almeida", verified: true });
  try {
    const now = new Date();
    for (let hit = 1; hit <= 7; hit++) {
      await checkActionThrottle(
        h.db,
        {
          action: "shop",
          professionalId: h.pro.proId,
          ipHash: testIpHash(),
          wideIpHash: null,
          subject: { kind: "email", email },
        },
        now,
      );
    }

    // A stranger typing the address is over the per-pro address key.
    const stranger = await run(h, shopInput(s, { identity: { name: "Mallory", email } }), { now });
    assert.ok(!stranger.res.ok);
    assert.equal(stranger.res.code, "throttled");
    assert.equal(await customerOf(h, email), undefined);

    // Its verified holder is keyed on her user, not on the address: she still buys, and her account is linked.
    const visitor = actionVisitorOf({
      session: sessionOf({ userId, email, name: "Beatriz Almeida" }, { verified: true }),
    });
    const holder = await run(h, shopInput(s, { identity: { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email } }), { visitor, now });
    assert.ok(holder.res.ok, JSON.stringify(holder.res));
    assert.equal((await customerOf(h, email))?.userId, userId);
    assert.equal((await purchasesOf(h)).length, 1);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, userId);
  }
});

dbTest("shop purchase: an Owner buys as herself, and a typed address never links someone else's account", async (h) => {
  const s = await setup(h);
  const ownerEmail = testEmail("owner");
  const typedEmail = testEmail("typed");
  const victimEmail = testEmail("victim");
  const owner = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email: ownerEmail, name: "Beatriz Almeida", verified: true });
  const victim = await createTestClientUser(h.db, { email: victimEmail, name: "Victime", verified: true });
  try {
    const customerId = await rowCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { email: ownerEmail, userId: owner.userId });
    const visitor = actionVisitorOf({
      session: sessionOf({ userId: owner.userId, email: ownerEmail, name: "Beatriz Almeida" }, { verified: true }),
      owner: { professionalId: h.pro.proId, customerId, userId: owner.userId, email: ownerEmail },
    });

    // The Owner types another address: the session address wins.
    const owned = await run(h, shopInput(s, { identity: { name: "Autre Nom", email: typedEmail } }), { visitor });
    assert.ok(owned.res.ok, JSON.stringify(owned.res));
    const [purchase] = await purchasesOf(h);
    assert.equal(purchase.customerId, customerId);
    assert.equal(await customerOf(h, typedEmail), undefined);
    assert.equal(owned.fake.created[0].customerEmail, ownerEmail);

    // Nobody signed in types the victim's address: the row is created unlinked.
    const anonymous = await run(h, shopInput(s, { identity: { name: "Mallory", email: victimEmail } }));
    assert.ok(anonymous.res.ok, JSON.stringify(anonymous.res));
    assert.equal((await customerOf(h, victimEmail))?.userId, null);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, owner.userId);
    await deleteTestUser(h.db, victim.userId);
  }
});
```

Create `src/lib/public/shop-actions.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Public purchase of a ticket offer from the Boutique (spec § 11 E9): no séance, so no seat and no hold. The
 * core follows the order of E1 (src/lib/public/booking-actions.ts): the whole strict input first, the
 * honeypot, payment availability, the throttle, the customer row, the engine, then the Checkout session and
 * its attachment (createCheckoutAndAttach, shared with E1). No server-only, no next/*.
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import { startPurchase } from "@/lib/booking/fulfillment";
import { upsertCustomer } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { checkoutUrls, type CheckoutRequest } from "@/lib/payments/checkout";
import {
  createCheckoutAndAttach,
  honeypotFilled,
  identityInputSchema,
  identityOf,
  throttleSubjectOf,
  type IdentityInput,
} from "@/lib/public/booking-actions";
import type { ActionVisitor, PublicDeps, PublicPro } from "@/lib/public/context";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { fromEngineClient, fromParse, publicFail, type PublicCoreResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { checkActionThrottle } from "@/lib/throttle";
import { ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES, idSchema } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

export type ShopPurchaseInput = { offerId: string; identity: IdentityInput; website?: string };

/** The WHOLE input, `.strict()` (SEC-M15): z.object({ offerId: idSchema, identity: identityInputSchema, website: z.unknown().optional() }).strict(). */
export const shopPurchaseInputSchema = z
  .object({ offerId: idSchema, identity: identityInputSchema, website: z.unknown().optional() })
  .strict();

/** E9 (L1099-1104): shape, honeypot, payment availability, throttle "shop", upsertCustomer, startPurchase, Checkout (expires_at = the purchase's checkout_expires_at, dashboard payment methods), attachCheckoutSession; a Stripe failure or a refused attach expires the purchase (releasePurchase). */
export async function startShopPurchaseCore(
  db: Db,
  pro: PublicPro,
  visitor: ActionVisitor,
  input: unknown,
  deps: PublicDeps,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ purchaseId: string; checkoutUrl: string }>> {
  // 1. The whole input, strict: a malformed call reads and writes nothing.
  const parsed = parseFr(shopPurchaseInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return fromParse(parsed);
  const data = parsed.data;

  // 2. The honeypot: refused before any throttle, read or write.
  if (honeypotFilled(data.website)) return publicFail(COPY.HONEYPOT_REFUSED);

  // 3. The identity to write (an Owner's session address wins) and who is rate limited.
  const vars = { businessName: pro.businessName };
  const identity = identityOf(data.identity, visitor);
  const subject = throttleSubjectOf(visitor.session, identity.email);

  // 4. A simulated payment outside its allowance (Stripe on, or production): nothing is written.
  if (deps.checkout.mode === "mock" && !deps.mockAllowed) return publicFail(COPY.PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE);

  // 5. The throttle, before any write or gateway call. No séance, so no per-séance or per-pro IP key.
  const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
    db,
    {
      action: "shop",
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      ipHash: visitor.ipHash,
      wideIpHash: visitor.wideIpHash,
      subject,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!allowed) return publicFail(ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES.throttled, { code: "throttled" });

  // 6. The customer row identifies who buys; it authorises nothing. The account is linked only for a verified
  // session of this very address (upsertUserIdFor, enforced again in SQL).
  const { customerId } = await upsertCustomer(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      email: identity.email,
      name: identity.name,
      phone: identity.phone,
      userId: subject.kind === "user" ? subject.userId : null,
    },
    now,
  );

  // 7. The engine: a pending purchase for an offer of THIS pro (its not_found and stale say nothing about
  // another customer, so they reach the browser as they are).
  const res = await startPurchase(db, { professionalId: pro.professionalId, offerId: data.offerId, customerId }, now);
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngineClient(res, "shop", vars);

  // 8 and 9. The Checkout session, expiring with the purchase (24 h), then its attachment.
  const request: CheckoutRequest = {
    kind: "shop",
    purchaseId: res.purchaseId,
    amountCents: res.amountCents,
    currency: res.currency,
    productName: `${res.ticketTypeName} · ${res.label}`,
    customerEmail: identity.email,
    env: deps.env,
    ...checkoutUrls(deps.appUrl, {
      kind: "shop",
      slug: pro.slug,
      purchaseId: res.purchaseId,
      offerId: data.offerId,
    }),
    expiresAt: res.checkoutExpiresAt,
  };
  return createCheckoutAndAttach(db, deps, request, "shop", pro.businessName, now);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/public/purchase-reads.ts
export type PurchaseReference = {
  purchaseId: string;
  /** server-side only: never a viewer identity, never sent to the browser (Decision 71) */
  customerId: string;
  status: PurchaseStatus; processing: boolean; livemode: boolean;
  label: string; quantity: number; amountCents: number; currency: string; ticketTypeName: string;
  offerId: string | null; checkoutSessionId: string | null;
  /** checkout_url while pending AND checkout_expires_at > now (the Stripe session is still open), else null */
  resumeUrl: string | null;
  /** the booking of THIS purchase (booking.purchase_id = purchaseId), whatever its status */
  booking: {
    bookingId: string; occurrenceId: string; status: BookingStatus; holdExpiresAt: Date | null;
    title: string; startsAt: Date; endsAt: Date; location: string | null;
  } | null;
  /** tickets issued for the purchase (0 until paid) */
  ticketCount: number;
};
export async function purchaseByReference(db: Db, professionalId: string, purchaseId: string, now: Date): Promise<PurchaseReference | null>;
// addition of this task (not in § 3.11): the one shape check of a purchase id that comes from a URL or a form
export function isReferenceId(value: unknown): value is string;

// src/lib/public/release-actions.ts
export type AbandonOutcome = "released" | "paid" | "processing" | "already_ended";
export const abandonInputSchema; // z.object({ purchaseId: idSchema }).strict()
export async function abandonCheckoutCore(db: Db, pro: PublicPro, visitor: ActionVisitor, input: unknown, deps: PublicDeps, now: Date): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ outcome: AbandonOutcome }>>;

// src/server/public.ts
export async function abandonCheckoutAction(input: { slug: string; purchaseId: string }): Promise<PublicResult<{ outcome: AbandonOutcome }>>;
```

Design notes (read before coding):
- `purchaseByReference` is the `?p=` capability (spec L1460-1461). It describes THAT purchase and its OWN booking (`booking.purchase_id = purchaseId`, unique), never its customer: `customerId` is for server code only (the abandon core compares it with an Owner), and no field of the result may reach a client component (Decision 71, SEC-C1). Every table is filtered on `professional_id`.
- Deviation noted: the contract types `holdExpiresAt` as `Date | null` without saying when it is null. It is the booking's `hold_expires_at` while the booking is `pending` and `null` otherwise (a confirmed booking keeps its old hold date in the row, which would read as a live hold to a page).
- `abandonCheckoutCore` never fulfils (the webhook is the fulfilment path, L1109-1112) and never returns anything about the purchase's customer: its ok result has exactly the keys `ok` and `outcome`.
- Order of the core (contract § 3.11, each failure returns at once): parse, purchase of THIS pro, Owner's customer, throttle, then the state of the purchase, then Stripe, then `releasePurchase`. The throttle comes before any Stripe call (SEC-I2).

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**

- S7: `release-actions.db.test.ts` (another pro's purchase, another customer's purchase for an Owner: not found, nothing changed), `purchase-reads.db.test.ts` (foreign id: null).

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
```

```ts
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import { attachCheckoutSession, startBuyAndBook } from "@/lib/booking/claims";
import { fulfillPurchase, startPurchase } from "@/lib/booking/fulfillment";
import { releasePurchase } from "@/lib/booking/release";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import * as schema from "@/lib/db/schema";

import { makeCustomer, makeEvent, makeOffer, makeType } from "@/test/fixtures";

/** A 4-ticket offer linked to a fresh event: « Altinha débutants » at « Gymnase Jean Bouin », capacity 12. */
async function catalog(db: Db, pro: TestPro) {
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, {
    quantity: 4,
    priceCents: 8500,
    validityCount: 3,
    validityUnit: "month",
  });
  const {
    eventId,
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha débutants", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  await db.update(schema.event).set({ location: "Gymnase Jean Bouin" }).where(eq(schema.event.id, eventId));
  return { typeId, offerId, occ };
}

type Catalog = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof catalog>>;

/** A buy + book hold the way startBuyAndBookCore leaves it: pending purchase and booking, session attached unless `attach` is false. */
async function hold(db: Db, pro: TestPro, cat: Catalog, customerId: string, now: Date, attach = true) {
  const started = await startBuyAndBook(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.proId,
      occurrenceId: cat.occ.id,
      customerId,
      seenStartsAt: cat.occ.startsAt,
      offerId: cat.offerId,
    },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(started.ok, JSON.stringify(started));
  const sessionId = `cs_test_${nanoid()}`;
  const url = `https://checkout.test/${started.purchaseId}`;
  if (attach) {
    const attached = await attachCheckoutSession(
      db,
      { purchaseId: started.purchaseId, checkoutSessionId: sessionId, checkoutUrl: url },
      now,
    );
    assert.ok(attached.ok, JSON.stringify(attached));
  }
  return { ...started, sessionId, url };
}

dbTest("purchaseByReference: the resume URL is withheld once checkout_expires_at has passed, the hold stays", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const cat = await catalog(db, pro);
  const h = await hold(db, pro, cat, await makeCustomer(db, pro), now);

  const open = await purchaseByReference(db, pro.proId, h.purchaseId, addMinutes(h.checkoutExpiresAt, -1));
  assert.equal(open?.resumeUrl, h.url);

  // The Stripe session closes at checkout_expires_at: from that instant the URL would be dead, so it is not given.
  const atExpiry = await purchaseByReference(db, pro.proId, h.purchaseId, h.checkoutExpiresAt);

  const closed = await purchaseByReference(db, pro.proId, h.purchaseId, addMinutes(h.checkoutExpiresAt, 1));

  assert.equal(closed?.status, "pending");
  assert.equal(closed?.booking?.status, "pending");
  assert.ok(closed?.booking?.holdExpiresAt, "the 45-minute hold outlives the 31-minute session");
});

  assert.equal(ofFirst?.status, "expired");
  assert.equal(ofFirst?.resumeUrl, null);

  const ofSecond = await purchaseByReference(db, pro.proId, second.purchaseId, addMinutes(now, 1));
  assert.equal(ofSecond?.booking?.bookingId, second.bookingId);
  assert.equal(ofSecond?.booking?.status, "pending");
  assert.equal(ofSecond?.resumeUrl, second.url);
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `src/lib/public/purchase-reads.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * The ?p= purchase reference (spec L1460-1461, contract Decision 71). A
 * purchase id in a URL is a capability for THAT purchase and its OWN booking
 * on THAT pro's pages, nothing more: the customer of a purchase came from an
 * e-mail typed on a public form (upsertCustomer), so a reference never stands
 * for its customer (no wallet, no other booking, no other purchase's resume
 * URL). No `server-only`, no env, no process db: pages and cores pass `db`.
 */
import { and, count, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, event, occurrence, ticket, ticketPurchase, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { idSchema, type BookingStatus, type PurchaseStatus } from "@/lib/tickets";

export type PurchaseReference = {
  purchaseId: string;
  /** server-side only: never a viewer identity, never sent to the browser (Decision 71) */
  customerId: string;
  status: PurchaseStatus;
  processing: boolean;
  livemode: boolean;
  label: string;
  quantity: number;
  amountCents: number;
  currency: string;
  ticketTypeName: string;
  offerId: string | null;
  checkoutSessionId: string | null;
  /** checkout_url while pending AND checkout_expires_at > now (the Stripe session is still open), else null */
  resumeUrl: string | null;
  /** the booking of THIS purchase (booking.purchase_id = purchaseId), whatever its status */
  booking: {
    bookingId: string;
    occurrenceId: string;
    status: BookingStatus;
    /** the live hold of a pending booking; null once it is confirmed, cancelled or expired */
    holdExpiresAt: Date | null;
    title: string;
    startsAt: Date;
    endsAt: Date;
    location: string | null;
  } | null;
  /** tickets issued for the purchase (0 until paid) */
  ticketCount: number;
};

/** The nanoid alphabet: idSchema bounds the length, this bounds the characters (`$` without the m flag only matches at the very end). */
const REFERENCE_ID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/;

/** True for a string of 1 to 64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]: the only shape a ?p= value or a mock `purchase` parameter may have before any query is built. */
export function isReferenceId(value: unknown): value is string {
  return typeof value === "string" && idSchema.safeParse(value).success && REFERENCE_ID_RE.test(value);
}

/** The purchase of THIS pro named by a ?p= reference; null for a malformed id (idSchema, [A-Za-z0-9_-]), an unknown one or another pro's (L1461). It describes that purchase and its own booking only. */
export async function purchaseByReference(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  purchaseId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PurchaseReference | null> {
  if (!isReferenceId(purchaseId)) return null;

  const [p] = await db
    .select({
      purchaseId: ticketPurchase.id,
      customerId: ticketPurchase.customerId,
      status: ticketPurchase.status,
      processingAt: ticketPurchase.processingAt,
      livemode: ticketPurchase.livemode,
      label: ticketPurchase.label,
      quantity: ticketPurchase.quantity,
      amountCents: ticketPurchase.amountCents,
      currency: ticketPurchase.currency,
      ticketTypeName: ticketType.name,
      offerId: ticketPurchase.offerId,
      checkoutSessionId: ticketPurchase.checkoutSessionId,
      checkoutUrl: ticketPurchase.checkoutUrl,
      checkoutExpiresAt: ticketPurchase.checkoutExpiresAt,
    })
    .from(ticketPurchase)
    .innerJoin(
      ticketType,
      and(eq(ticketType.id, ticketPurchase.ticketTypeId), eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId)),
    )
    .where(and(eq(ticketPurchase.id, purchaseId), eq(ticketPurchase.professionalId, professionalId)));
  if (!p) return null;

  const [rows, issued] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        bookingId: booking.id,
        occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId,
        status: booking.status,
        holdExpiresAt: booking.holdExpiresAt,
        title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name}, '')`,
        startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
        endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
        location: sql<string | null>`coalesce(${occurrence.locationOverride}, ${event.location})`,
      })
      .from(booking)
      .innerJoin(occurrence, and(eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId)))
      .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
      .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
      .where(and(eq(booking.purchaseId, purchaseId), eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId))),
    db
      .select({ n: count() })
      .from(ticket)
      .where(and(eq(ticket.purchaseId, purchaseId), eq(ticket.professionalId, professionalId))),
  ]);
  const b = rows[0];

  const sessionOpen =
    p.status === "pending" && p.checkoutUrl !== null && p.checkoutExpiresAt.getTime() > now.getTime();
  return {
    purchaseId: p.purchaseId,
    customerId: p.customerId,
    status: p.status,
    processing: p.processingAt !== null,
    livemode: p.livemode,
    label: p.label,
    quantity: p.quantity,
    amountCents: p.amountCents,
    currency: p.currency,
    ticketTypeName: p.ticketTypeName,
    offerId: p.offerId,
    checkoutSessionId: p.checkoutSessionId,
    resumeUrl: sessionOpen ? p.checkoutUrl : null,
    booking: b
      ? {
          bookingId: b.bookingId,
          occurrenceId: b.occurrenceId,
          status: b.status,
          holdExpiresAt: b.status === "pending" ? b.holdExpiresAt : null,
          title: b.title,
          startsAt: b.startsAt,
          endsAt: b.endsAt,
          location: b.location && b.location.trim() !== "" ? b.location : null,
        }
      : null,
    ticketCount: issued[0]?.n ?? 0,
  };
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import { attachCheckoutSession, startBuyAndBook } from "@/lib/booking/claims";
import { fulfillPurchase } from "@/lib/booking/fulfillment";
import { releasePurchase } from "@/lib/booking/release";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";

import { mockSessionId } from "@/lib/payments/checkout";
import type { ActionVisitor } from "@/lib/public/context";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { abandonCheckoutCore, abandonInputSchema } from "@/lib/public/release-actions";
import { withoutPublicEffects } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { actionThrottleKeys, hitThrottle } from "@/lib/throttle";
import { ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES, THROTTLE_WINDOW_SEC } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, testEmail, type TestPro } from "@/test/db";
import { getBooking, getOccurrence, makeCustomer, makeEvent, makeOffer, makeType } from "@/test/fixtures";
import {
  actionVisitorOf,
  createTestClientUser,
  fakeCheckout,
  publicDepsOf,
  publicProOf,
  sessionOf,
  testIpHash,
  type FakeCheckout,
} from "@/test/public";
import { rowBooking, rowCustomer, rowEvent, rowOffer, rowPurchase, rowSeance, rowType } from "@/test/rows";

type Held = {
  purchaseId: string;
  bookingId: string;
  occurrenceId: string;
  customerId: string;
  email: string;
  /** the session id attached to the purchase, null when none */
  sessionId: string | null;
};

/** A buy + book hold the way startBuyAndBookCore leaves it (pending purchase and booking, one seat taken); `session` picks what is attached. */
async function heldSeat(db: Db, pro: TestPro, session: "stripe" | "mock" | "none" = "stripe"): Promise<Held> {
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(db, pro, typeId, {
    quantity: 4,
    priceCents: 8500,
    validityCount: 3,
    validityUnit: "month",
  });
  const {
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  const email = testEmail("abandon");
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { email });
  const started = await startBuyAndBook(db, {
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    occurrenceId: occ.id,
    customerId,
    seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt,
    offerId,
  });
  assert.ok(started.ok, JSON.stringify(started));
  const sessionId =
    session === "none" ? null : session === "mock" ? mockSessionId(started.purchaseId) : `cs_test_${nanoid()}`;
  if (sessionId !== null) {
    const attached = await attachCheckoutSession(db, {
      purchaseId: started.purchaseId,
      checkoutSessionId: sessionId,
      checkoutUrl: `https://checkout.test/${started.purchaseId}`,
    });
    assert.ok(attached.ok, JSON.stringify(attached));
  }
  return { purchaseId: started.purchaseId, bookingId: started.bookingId, occurrenceId: occ.id, customerId, email, sessionId };
}

/** The core as the wrapper calls it: the PublicPro read from the pro's row, a visitor built from `visitor`, one fresh `now`. */
async function abandon(db: Db, pro: TestPro, visitor: Partial<ActionVisitor>, input: unknown, fake: FakeCheckout) {
  return abandonCheckoutCore(db, await publicProOf(db, pro), actionVisitorOf(visitor), input, publicDepsOf(fake), new Date());
}

type Res = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof abandon>>;

function assertNotFound(res: Res): void {
  assert.ok(!res.ok, "refused");
  assert.equal(res.code, "not_found");
  assert.equal(res.error, "Paiement introuvable : rafraîchissez la page.");
  assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
}

async function purchaseStatus(db: Db, purchaseId: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ status: schema.ticketPurchase.status })
    .from(schema.ticketPurchase)
    .where(eq(schema.ticketPurchase.id, purchaseId));
  return row.status;
}

/** Nothing was released: the booking is still pending, its seat is taken, the purchase is pending. */
async function assertStillHeld(db: Db, held: Held, label: string): Promise<void> {
  assert.equal((await getBooking(db, held.bookingId)).status, "pending", `${label}: booking`);
  assert.equal((await getOccurrence(db, held.occurrenceId)).seatsTaken, 1, `${label}: seat`);
  assert.equal(await purchaseStatus(db, held.purchaseId), "pending", `${label}: purchase`);
}

/** Uses up the per-pro and the global e-mail keys of `release` for a typed address, the way 30 strangers typing it would. */
async function exhaustEmailKeys(db: Db, pro: TestPro, email: string): Promise<void> {
  const keys = actionThrottleKeys({
    action: "release",
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    ipHash: testIpHash(),
    wideIpHash: null,
    subject: { kind: "email", email },
  }).filter((k) => k.key.includes(":e:"));
  assert.equal(keys.length, 2, "the global and the per-pro e-mail keys");
  for (const { key, limit } of keys) await hitThrottle(db, key, limit, THROTTLE_WINDOW_SEC, new Date());
}

dbTest("E11 abandon: a closed, already closed or simulated session releases the hold, frees the seat and re-syncs Google", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  for (const [closeOutcome, session] of [
    ["expired", "stripe"],
    ["already_expired", "stripe"],
    ["mock", "mock"],
  ] as const) {
    const held = await heldSeat(db, pro, session);
    const fake = fakeCheckout();
    fake.closeOutcome = closeOutcome;

    const res = await abandon(db, pro, {}, { purchaseId: held.purchaseId }, fake);
    assert.ok(res.ok, `${closeOutcome}: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
    assert.equal(res.outcome, "released", closeOutcome);
    assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [{ type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: held.occurrenceId }], closeOutcome);
    assert.deepEqual(fake.closed, [held.sessionId], `${closeOutcome}: the purchase's own session was asked`);
    assert.equal((await getBooking(db, held.bookingId)).status, "expired", closeOutcome);

});

    await exhaustEmailKeys(db, pro, held.email);
    const fake = fakeCheckout();

    const stranger = await abandon(db, pro, {}, { purchaseId: held.purchaseId }, fake);
    assert.ok(!stranger.ok);

    const holder = {
      session: sessionOf({ userId: client.userId, email: held.email }, { verified: true }),
      owner: { professionalId: pro.proId, customerId: held.customerId, userId: client.userId, email: held.email },
    };
    const res = await abandon(db, pro, holder, { purchaseId: held.purchaseId }, fake);
    assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
    assert.equal(res.outcome, "released");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, client.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("E11 abandon: a malformed input is refused whole, in French, before anything is read or written (S43)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const held = await heldSeat(db, pro);
  const fake = fakeCheckout();
  const cases: [unknown, string][] = [
    [null, "Valeur invalide."],
    ["x", "Valeur invalide."],
    [[], "Valeur invalide."],
    [{}, "Ce champ est obligatoire."],
    [{ purchaseId: 5 }, "Ce champ est obligatoire."],
    [{ purchaseId: ["a"] }, "Ce champ est obligatoire."],
    [{ purchaseId: "" }, "Ce champ est obligatoire."],
    [{ purchaseId: "a".repeat(65) }, "64 caractères au maximum."],
    [{ purchaseId: held.purchaseId, extra: true }, "Champ inattendu."],
    // This schema has no identity and no honeypot: both keys of the other public forms are unexpected here.
    [{ purchaseId: held.purchaseId, identity: null }, "Champ inattendu."],
    [{ purchaseId: held.purchaseId, website: ["x"] }, "Champ inattendu."],
    [{ purchaseId: held.purchaseId, website: "x" }, "Champ inattendu."],
  ];
  for (const [input, error] of cases) {
    const res = await abandon(db, pro, {}, input, fake);
    assert.ok(!res.ok, JSON.stringify(input));
    assert.equal(res.error, error, JSON.stringify(input));
    assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
  }
  assert.deepEqual(fake.closed, []);
  await assertStillHeld(db, held, "malformed");

  // The schema itself: strict, one key.
  assert.equal(abandonInputSchema.safeParse({ purchaseId: held.purchaseId }).success, true);
  assert.equal(abandonInputSchema.safeParse({ purchaseId: held.purchaseId, slug: "x" }).success, false);

  // A well-formed id that names nothing is the same not found as a foreign one.
  assertNotFound(await abandon(db, pro, {}, { purchaseId: nanoid() }, fake));
  assertNotFound(await abandon(db, pro, {}, { purchaseId: "../x" }, fake));
});
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Create `src/lib/public/release-actions.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * E11 « Libérer ma place » (spec L1163-1168, contract Decisions 32, 33, 71).
 * From the payment return page a client gives a held seat back. The purchase
 * id comes from the input and nowhere else, is checked against the slug's pro
 * by purchaseByReference and, when an Owner is signed in, against the
 * Owner's customer (OUT:74, the precondition of releasePurchase). The core
 * never fulfils (the webhook is the fulfilment path) and never releases what
 * may be paid: it asks Stripe first and releases nothing it cannot prove
 * unpaid. No `server-only`, no env, no process db.
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import { releasePurchase } from "@/lib/booking/release";
import type { Effect } from "@/lib/booking/types";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { throttleSubjectOf } from "@/lib/public/booking-actions";
import type { ActionVisitor, PublicDeps, PublicPro } from "@/lib/public/context";
import { customerEmailOf } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { purchaseByReference } from "@/lib/public/purchase-reads";
import { fromEngineClient, fromParse, publicFail, publicOk, type PublicCoreResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { checkActionThrottle } from "@/lib/throttle";
import { ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES, idSchema } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

export type AbandonOutcome = "released" | "paid" | "processing" | "already_ended";

/** z.object({ purchaseId: idSchema }).strict() (SEC-M15). */
export const abandonInputSchema = z.object({ purchaseId: idSchema }).strict();

const outcome = (o: AbandonOutcome, effects: Effect[] = []) => publicOk<{ outcome: AbandonOutcome }>({ outcome: o }, effects);

/** E11 « Libérer ma place » (L1163-1168, OUT:74). */
export async function abandonCheckoutCore(
  db: Db,
  pro: PublicPro,
  visitor: ActionVisitor,
  input: unknown,
  deps: PublicDeps,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ outcome: AbandonOutcome }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(abandonInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return fromParse(parsed);

  const vars = { businessName: pro.businessName };
  const notFound = () => fromEngineClient({ ok: false, code: "not_found" }, "release", vars);

  const ref = await purchaseByReference(db, pro.professionalId, parsed.data.purchaseId, now);
  if (!ref) return notFound();
  // A signed-in Owner can only release what is hers; a reference of another customer is ignored (OUT:74).
  if (visitor.owner && ref.customerId !== visitor.owner.customerId) return notFound();

  const email = await customerEmailOf(db, pro.professionalId, ref.customerId);
  if (email === null) return notFound();
  const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
    db,
    {
      action: "release",
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      ipHash: visitor.ipHash,
      wideIpHash: visitor.wideIpHash,
      subject: throttleSubjectOf(visitor.session, email),
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!allowed) return publicFail(ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES.throttled, { code: "throttled" });

  if (ref.status === "paid") return outcome("paid");
  if (ref.status === "expired") return outcome("already_ended");
  // A pending purchase whose booking is confirmed has nothing left to give back (SEC-C1).
  if (ref.booking?.status === "confirmed") return outcome("already_ended");

  if (ref.checkoutSessionId !== null) {
    const closed = await deps.checkout.closeForRelease(ref.checkoutSessionId);
    if (closed === "paid") return outcome("paid");
    if (closed === "processing") return outcome("processing");
    if (closed === "failed") return publicFail(COPY.RELEASE_CHECK_FAILED);
    // "expired" | "already_expired" | "mock": the session can no longer be paid.
  } else if (ref.processing) {
    return outcome("processing");
  }

  const res = await releasePurchase(db, ref.purchaseId, now);
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngineClient(res, "release", vars);
  return outcome(res.released ? "released" : "already_ended", res.effects);
}
```

```ts
/** E11 from the payment return page: give a held seat back (abandonCheckoutCore); the purchase id is scoped to the page's pro. */
export async function abandonCheckoutAction(input: {
  slug: string;
  purchaseId: string;
}): Promise<PublicResult<{ outcome: AbandonOutcome }>> {
  const { slug, rest } = splitActionInput(input);
  return runPublicAction("abandonCheckout", slug, (pro, visitor, now) =>
    abandonCheckoutCore(db, pro, visitor, rest, publicDeps(), now),
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/payments/webhook-core.ts (DB; no server-only, no Stripe SDK value import)
export type CheckoutSessionLike = {
  id: string;
  mode?: string | null;
  metadata?: Record<string, string> | null;
  client_reference_id?: string | null;
  payment_status?: string | null;
  payment_intent?: string | { id: string } | null;
  amount_total?: number | null;
  currency?: string | null;
};
export type StripeEventLike = { id: string; type: string; livemode: boolean; data: { object: unknown } };
export type WebhookHandled = "fulfilled" | "duplicate" | "orphan" | "processing" | "released" | "ignored";
export type WebhookOutcome = { handled: WebhookHandled; effects: Effect[] };
/** The deployment the handler runs in (SEC-I7, SEC-M1): env = APP_ENV, mode = paymentMode(). */
export type WebhookOptions = { env: string; mode: PaymentMode };
export const HANDLED_EVENTS: readonly [
  "checkout.session.completed", "checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded",
  "checkout.session.async_payment_failed", "checkout.session.expired",
];
export function paymentIntentIdOf(pi: CheckoutSessionLike["payment_intent"]): string | null;
export function sessionOrigin(session: CheckoutSessionLike, opts: WebhookOptions): "own" | "other_env" | "foreign";
export type SessionPurchase = { kind: "found"; purchaseId: string } | { kind: "none" } | { kind: "mismatch" };
export async function purchaseOfSession(db: Db, session: CheckoutSessionLike): Promise<SessionPurchase>;
export type VerifiedWebhook = { ok: true; event: StripeEventLike } | { ok: false; reason: "missing_signature" | "bad_signature" };
export function verifyWebhook(payload: string, signature: string | null, verify: (payload: string, signature: string) => StripeEventLike): VerifiedWebhook;
export async function handleStripeEvent(db: Db, event: StripeEventLike, now: Date, opts: WebhookOptions): Promise<WebhookOutcome>;

// src/app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export async function POST(request: Request): Promise<Response>;
```

Design notes (read before coding):
- Rules of `handleStripeEvent`, in this order (contract § 3.12; every `ignored` and `orphan` answers 200): 1 type outside `HANDLED_EVENTS` or `data.object` without a string `id`: ignored; 2 `event.livemode !== (opts.mode === "live")`: ignored with a warn (a live key behind a test webhook secret, or the reverse, issues nothing); 3 `sessionOrigin`: `foreign` ignored without a log, `other_env` ignored with a warn; 4 facts and `purchaseOfSession`, `mismatch` ignored with a warn; 5 `completed` + `paid` and `async_payment_succeeded` fulfil (no purchase: orphan; amount or currency off: orphan; a duplicate whose stored payment intent or session differs: orphan); 6 `completed` + `no_payment_required` ignored with a warn, `unpaid` marks processing; 7 `async_payment_failed` and `expired` release the purchase's OWN session only.
- Only a paid session of OUR app and OUR environment can be an orphan. A session without our marker (SaaS billing, Payment Links, another deployment on the same Stripe account) is never an orphan to refund (SEC-I7).
- Deviation noted: on a `duplicate` outcome the stored payment intent and session are re-read AFTER the engine answered (the contract says « the stored »), so two identical concurrent deliveries (one wins, one gets `duplicate`) never read as a second payment.
- Deviation noted: `releasePurchase` failing with a code other than `not_found` is thrown (the route answers 500 and Stripe retries); the contract only names `not_found`.
- The raw `err` is never logged (LED:87): the route logs `logSafeMessage(err)`. The only log line that keeps Stripe ids is the engine's orphan warning (spec L1116: the owner refunds it by hand); every other line below carries no id, address or code.
- The effects are the client's due (receipt, confirmation, late-payment notice, the pro's notice): `runEffects(effects, "none")`, never the pro's mail budget (Decision 74).

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S11: `webhook-core.test.ts` (`verifyWebhook` missing and bad, the real Stripe verifier offline on a re-serialised body, one changed byte, another secret, a stale timestamp).
- S12: `webhook-core.db.test.ts` (the same `completed` event twice: tickets once, effects once).
- S13: `webhook-core.db.test.ts` (`expired` of a session that is not the purchase's: nothing changes).
- S14: `webhook-core.db.test.ts` (an expanded payment intent stored by id; a live payment satisfies I6).
- S37: `webhook-core.db.test.ts` and `webhook-core.test.ts` (no marker, another environment, another mode: ignored, counter unchanged).
- S39: `webhook-core.db.test.ts` (one cent off, another currency, livemode mismatch, a second payment intent, `no_payment_required`).
- S31 (webhook part) and S49: `webhook-core.test.ts` route guard (`runEffects(effects, "none")`, no raw `err` passed to `console.*`) and `webhook-core.db.test.ts` (log lines of ignored events carry no id or address).
- S6: `webhook-core.db.test.ts` (an event settles only the purchase of its own session and pro).
