// src/lib/auth-messages.ts
/** The neutral answer to every code request (spec L1247): it never says whether the address has an account. */
export const CODE_SENT: string; // "Si l'adresse est valide, un code a été envoyé."
/** A suspended account cannot open a session (Better Auth admin plugin, code BANNED_USER). */
export const ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: string; // oauthErrorMessage("BANNED_USER") ?? GENERIC_ERROR
export function verifyCodeFailure(error: AuthClientError): string; // + { code: "BANNED_USER" } -> ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, after 429, 5xx and TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS, before the WRONG_CODE fallback
```

Behaviour produced by `buildAuthOptions` (no signature change): `POST /email-otp/send-verification-otp` with `type: "email-verification"` mails a code only when the request carries a session whose e-mail is the address of the request; every other request gets `{ success: true }` before anything is read or counted. A sign-in no longer writes any `customer` row.

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S21 (OUT:129): `auth.db.test.ts` → an `email-verification` request without a session, and with the session of another address, mails nothing and leaves the address's counter row absent; with its own session it mails and counts.

- S22 (part): `auth-messages.test.ts` → `sendCodeFailure` is `null` for a 200 and a 400 answer.

/** The context of a code request made by a browser whose session e-mail is `sessionEmail` (null: no session cookie at all). */
function otpCtx(body: Record<string, unknown>, sessionEmail: string | null): HookCtx {
  return {
    path: OTP_SEND_PATH,
    body,
    // getSessionFromCtx returns ctx.context.session as it is; without one it reads the cookie and resolves to null.
    context: sessionEmail === null ? {} : { session: { session: { id: "s1" }, user: { id: "u1", email: sessionEmail } } },
  };
}

test("a confirmation code is mailed and counted only for the address of the signed-in session (OUT:129)", async () => {
  // Its own session, however the address is spelled: the request goes on, the counter is the only query (no account lookup).
  const own = stubDb([{ hits: 1 }]);
  assert.equal(
    await runBefore(build(own.db).options, otpCtx({ email: "Lea@Example.com", type: "email-verification" }, "lea@example.com")),
    undefined,
  );
  assert.equal(own.queries.length, 1);
  assert.ok(own.queries[0].params.includes(otpThrottleKey("lea@example.com")));

  // Its own session past the hourly cap: the usual answer, no new code.
  const capped = stubDb([{ hits: 6 }]);
  assert.deepEqual(
    await runBefore(build(capped.db).options, otpCtx({ email: "lea@example.com", type: "email-verification" }, "lea@example.com")),
    { success: true },
  );
  assert.equal(capped.queries.length, 1);

  // The session of another address, and no session at all: the usual answer before anything is read or counted.
  for (const sessionEmail of ["someone@else.com", null]) {
    const stranger = stubDb([{ found: true, hits: 1 }]);
    const answer = await runBefore(
      build(stranger.db).options,
      otpCtx({ email: "lea@example.com", type: "email-verification" }, sessionEmail),
    );
    assert.deepEqual(answer, { success: true }, String(sessionEmail));
    assert.equal(stranger.queries.length, 0, `${sessionEmail}: no lookup, no counter`);
  }
});

test("OUT:129 a confirmation code is mailed only to the address of the signed-in session, every other request is answered alike", OPTS, async () => {
  const db = await getTestDb();
  const t = makeTestAuth(db);
  const email = testEmail("evown");
  const other = testEmail("evother");
  const confirmationMails = (to: string) =>
    t.mails.filter((m) => m.to === to && m.subject.endsWith("est votre code de confirmation Skedul"));
  const ask = (call: BrowserCall, typed: string) =>
    call("/email-otp/send-verification-otp", { email: typed, type: "email-verification" });
  try {
    // Two password sign-ups: unverified accounts, each signed in, each with the one code mail of the sign-up.
    const own = await signUp(t, email);
    const stranger = await signUp(t, other);
    assert.equal(confirmationMails(email).length, 1, "the sign-up code");
    assert.equal(confirmationMails(other).length, 1);

    // No session, and the session of another address: the usual answer, no mail, no counter row.
    const anonymous = await ask(browser(t), email);
    const crossed = await ask(stranger, email);
    for (const answer of [anonymous, crossed]) {
      assert.equal(answer.status, 200);
      assert.deepEqual(answer.json, { success: true });
    }
    // An address nobody registered gets the very same answer: nothing tells the two apart.
    const unknown = await ask(browser(t), testEmail("evnobody"));
    assert.equal(unknown.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(unknown.json, anonymous.json);
    assert.equal(confirmationMails(email).length, 1, "no new mail");
    assert.equal(await throttleHits(db, otpThrottleKey(email)), null, "the address's counter is untouched");

    // Its own session: one more mail (the same code, resend strategy « reuse »), one hit; the spelling does not matter.
    const sent = await ask(own, email);
    assert.equal(sent.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(sent.json, { success: true });
    assert.equal(confirmationMails(email).length, 2);
    assert.equal(await throttleHits(db, otpThrottleKey(email)), 1);
    assert.equal((await ask(own, mixedCase(email))).status, 200);
    assert.equal(confirmationMails(email).length, 3);
    assert.equal(await throttleHits(db, otpThrottleKey(email)), 2);
    assert.equal(confirmationMails(other).length, 1, "the other account got nothing");
  } finally {
    await deleteUsersByEmail(db, [email, other]);
  }
});

- [ ] **Step 8a: The reset link is never logged by a production build (controller ruling, plan review W5)**

`src/lib/auth.ts` sets `logResetLink: !env.RESEND_ENABLED`, so a production build without Resend (a preview deployment) prints a live single-use reset token through `console.info("   reset link: …")` in `sendResetPassword` (`src/lib/auth-options.ts`). That breaks the § 1 rule « Logs never print … a token ». The fix is the rule `mockMailLog` applies since P3 `e73b7bf`: the link is logged only outside a production build.

  - Task 2: `COPY` from `@/lib/public/messages`, keys `CODE_INTRO` « Recevez un code par email pour accéder à vos tickets et à vos réservations. », `CODE_NAME_HELP` « Utilisé si c'est votre première connexion. », `PLAIN_NAME` « Prénom et nom : n'indiquez que votre nom. », `PASSWORD_LINK` « J'ai un mot de passe », `PENDING_SEND` « Envoi… », `PENDING_VERIFY` « Vérification… »; `isPlainName(name: string): boolean` from `@/lib/public/plain-name` (false for a link or a domain name, an address and a phone number of 5 digits or more, spaced or not).
  - Task 5: `export type VisitorState = "anonymous" | "unverified" | "verified" | "impersonating"` from `@/lib/public/identity` (type import only: nothing of that DB module is loaded).
  - Task 16: `CODE_SENT`, `SEND_FAILED`, `VERIFY_FAILED`, `sendCodeFailure(error: AuthClientError): string | null`, `verifyCodeFailure(error: AuthClientError): string` from `@/lib/auth-messages`.
  - Existing: `safeNextPath(value: unknown): string | null` (`@/lib/safe-next`: a plain same-site path, query and hash kept, else `null`); `BOUNDS.name` = 80 (`@/lib/tickets-vocab`); `customerInputSchema` (`@/lib/tickets`: `email: z.email().max(254).transform(normalizeEmail)`); `parseFr` (`@/lib/zod-fr`); `authClient`, `signIn` from `@/lib/auth-client` (`authClient.emailOtp.sendVerificationOtp({ email, type })`, `authClient.signIn.emailOtp({ email, otp, name? })`, `authClient.getSession({ query: { disableCookieCache: true } })`, `signIn.social({ provider: "google", callbackURL, newUserCallbackURL, errorCallbackURL })`); `Dialog` (`@/components/ui/dialog`: `{ open, onClose, title, labelledBy?, describedBy?, returnFocusTo?, children }`); `FormField` (`@/components/dashboard/form-field`: `{ label, htmlFor, help?, error?, optional?, children }`, wires `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` into its one child); `useRefusalFocus()` (`@/components/dashboard/use-refusal-focus`: `{ root, errorBox, refused }`); `GoogleLogo` (`@/components/auth/google-logo`); `Button`, `Input`.
- Produces (exact):

```ts

/** Digits only, at most CODE_LENGTH. */
export function codeInputValue(raw: string): string;
export function isCompleteCode(code: string): boolean;
/** The page to come back to: the path of safeNextPath(path) with its query and hash dropped (SEC-M7: a `p` never travels into /sign-in, the OAuth state or Google), else "/mon-espace". */

"/onboarding" (L1397), sign-in -> /sign-in[?next=] (the page re-resolves the entry: /mon-espace for a non-pro), never "/onboarding"; errorCallbackURL /sign-up[?next=] or /sign-in[?next=] by mode. */

Invariant (every later task that mounts these): a caller renders `EmailCodeForm`, `OtpDialog` and `ClientSignInChoices` only when `canOfferCodeSignIn(visitor.state)`; its `returnTo` is built by the page from its own route params (no query string) and goes through `returnPathOf`.

Design notes (read before coding):
- Security (risk 7, SEC-M7, L1247): a code sign-in on an unverified address purges that account's password and sessions, so a signed-in visitor never sees this form (the callers check `canOfferCodeSignIn`). The send answer is `CODE_SENT` unless `sendCodeFailure` gives a text (429, 5xx): never a different sentence per address. The address field is never prefilled (Decision 7: a planted personal-link cookie must not steer the visitor onto another identity). `returnTo` never carries a query: `googleCallbacks` and `passwordSignInHref` run `returnPathOf` themselves, so even a careless caller cannot leak a `p` into Google's state.
- `router.refresh()` appears once, after the Better Auth client calls, and only after a fresh `getSession` (the 5-minute cookie cache would otherwise keep the page `anonymous`, L1314-1315). No Server Action is called here, so the Next 16 « push + refresh after an action » hang does not apply.
- UI rule (user rule): before writing the JSX of Step 5, invoke the `design-taste-frontend` skill. The three components sit in existing surfaces (`Dialog`, the `/mon-espace` card, the espace card): apply the skill as a consistency and mobile check on the current system (`FormField`, `Button`, `Input`, `wrap-anywhere`, `text-zinc-600`), not as a redesign.
- Regions: the status (`role="status"`) and alert (`role="alert"`) regions are mounted from the first render and only their content changes; the failure box takes the focus (`useRefusalFocus`).

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S22 (EmailCodeForm half): `code-sign-in-guards.test.ts` → the form imports `CODE_SENT`, answers with it unless `sendCodeFailure` gives a text, and uses `verifyCodeFailure` for a refused code.
- S23: `sign-in-flow.test.ts` → `returnPathOf` refuses `//evil.example`, `https://evil.example`, `/\evil` (→ `/mon-espace`) and drops the query and hash; `googleCallbacks` and `passwordSignInHref` never carry a `p`; `authFormGoogleCallbacks` ignores a foreign `next`.
- S38 (half): `sign-in-flow.test.ts` → `canOfferCodeSignIn` is true for `anonymous` only (the page-level browser half is Task 22).

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `src/lib/public/sign-in-flow.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * Pure helpers of the code sign-in forms (spec L1247-1249, L1314-1315, risk 7).
 * No database, no env, no next: the three components and the tests share them.
 * Every path that leaves for /sign-in or for Google goes through returnPathOf,
 * so a purchase reference (?p=) or any other query never travels into the
 * OAuth state or a callback URL (SEC-M7).
 */
import type { VisitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { isPlainName } from "@/lib/public/plain-name";
import { safeNextPath } from "@/lib/safe-next";
import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export const CODE_LENGTH = 6;

/** Where a sign-in goes when the page to come back to is missing or not a plain path of the site. */
const FALLBACK_PATH = "/mon-espace";

/** Digits only, at most CODE_LENGTH. */
export function codeInputValue(raw: string): string {
  return raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, CODE_LENGTH);
}

/** True for exactly CODE_LENGTH digits. */
export function isCompleteCode(code: string): boolean {
  return code.length === CODE_LENGTH && /^\d+$/.test(code);
}

/** The page to come back to: the path of safeNextPath(path) with its query and hash dropped (SEC-M7: a `p` never travels into /sign-in, the OAuth state or Google), else "/mon-espace". */
export function returnPathOf(path: string): string {
  const safe = safeNextPath(path);
  if (safe === null) return FALLBACK_PATH;
  return safe.split(/[?#]/, 1)[0];
}

type GoogleCallbacks = { callbackURL: string; newUserCallbackURL: string; errorCallbackURL: string };

/** Google sign-in from a public page (never the pro onboarding, L76): callbackURL and newUserCallbackURL = returnTo; errorCallbackURL = /sign-in?next=<returnTo> (its account_not_linked handler). `returnTo` goes through returnPathOf again, so the result never carries a query. */
export function googleCallbacks(returnTo: string): GoogleCallbacks {
  const to = returnPathOf(returnTo);
  return { callbackURL: to, newUserCallbackURL: to, errorCallbackURL: `/sign-in?next=${encodeURIComponent(to)}` };
}

/** AuthForm's Google callbacks (COV-I3): callbackURL /sign-in[?next=]; newUserCallbackURL: sign-up -> next ?? "/onboarding" (L1397), sign-in -> /sign-in[?next=] (the page re-resolves the entry: /mon-espace for a non-pro), never "/onboarding"; errorCallbackURL /sign-up[?next=] or /sign-in[?next=] by mode. A `next` that is not a plain path of the site counts as none. */
export function authFormGoogleCallbacks(mode: "sign-in" | "sign-up", next: string | null): GoogleCallbacks {
  const safe = safeNextPath(next);
  const query = safe === null ? "" : `?next=${encodeURIComponent(safe)}`;
  return {
    callbackURL: `/sign-in${query}`,
    newUserCallbackURL: mode === "sign-up" ? (safe ?? "/onboarding") : `/sign-in${query}`,
    errorCallbackURL: `/${mode}${query}`,
  };
}

/** « J'ai un mot de passe »: /sign-in?next=<returnTo>. */
export function passwordSignInHref(returnTo: string): string {
  return `/sign-in?next=${encodeURIComponent(returnPathOf(returnTo))}`;
}

/** The name sent with a first code sign-in (L1249): trimmed, at most BOUNDS.name characters, undefined when empty or not isPlainName. */
export function nameToSend(name: string): string | undefined {
  let cut = name.trim().slice(0, BOUNDS.name);
  // A cut inside a surrogate pair would leave half an emoji: drop that half.
  const last = cut.charCodeAt(cut.length - 1);
  if (last >= 0xd800 && last <= 0xdbff) cut = cut.slice(0, -1);
  cut = cut.trim();
  if (cut === "" || !isPlainName(cut)) return undefined;
  return cut;
}

/** Risk 7 (L1816, COV-C1): the sign-in-by-code form is offered to an anonymous visitor only; never to a signed-in one, verified or not, nor while impersonating. */
export function canOfferCodeSignIn(state: VisitorState): boolean {
  return state === "anonymous";
}
```

"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { useRefusalFocus } from "@/components/dashboard/use-refusal-focus";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import { CODE_SENT, SEND_FAILED, VERIFY_FAILED, sendCodeFailure, verifyCodeFailure } from "@/lib/auth-messages";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { isPlainName } from "@/lib/public/plain-name";
import { codeInputValue, isCompleteCode, nameToSend } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";
import { customerInputSchema } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

/** The e-mail rule of the engine's customer input: the same address check as everywhere else, in French. */
const emailOnly = customerInputSchema.pick({ email: true });
const CODE_FORMAT = "Saisissez les 6 chiffres du code.";

/**
 * Sign in by e-mail code (spec L1247-1249, L1314-1315): the address (and an optional name), then the 6-digit code.
 * Mount it only for an anonymous visitor (canOfferCodeSignIn, risk 7). The answer to « Recevoir un code » is always
 * the neutral CODE_SENT unless the send was rate limited or failed (it never says whether the address has an
 * account), and the address is never prefilled (Decision 7). After a good code the session is read once without the
 * cookie cache, then the page re-renders as signed in. `idPrefix` makes the field ids unique when two forms share a page.
 */
export function EmailCodeForm({
  idPrefix,
  askName = false,
  onSignedIn,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  askName?: boolean;
  onSignedIn?: () => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { root, errorBox, refused } = useRefusalFocus();
  const emailInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const codeInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = useState<"email" | "code">("email");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  /** The normalized address the code was sent to: the typed field may change after « Modifier l'adresse ». */
  const [address, setAddress] = useState("");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [emailError, setEmailError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [codeError, setCodeError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [verifying, setVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  /** Bumped when the step changes or a code is re-sent: the effect below puts the focus in the field that now matters. */
  const [stepFocus, setStepFocus] = useState(0);
  const busy = sending || verifying || done;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (stepFocus === 0) return;
    (step === "code" ? codeInput : emailInput).current?.focus();
  }, [stepFocus, step]);

  /** Sends a sign-in code to `target`; true when the answer is the neutral one. */
  async function sendCode(target: string): Promise<boolean> {
    setSending(true);
    setError(null);
    setStatus(null);
    try {
      const res = await authClient.emailOtp.sendVerificationOtp({ email: target, type: "sign-in" });
      const failure = sendCodeFailure(res.error);
      if (failure) {
        setError(failure);
        refused();
        return false;
      }
      setStatus(CODE_SENT);
      return true;
    } catch {
      setError(SEND_FAILED);
      refused();
      return false;
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  }

  async function onSend(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    setEmailError(null);
    setNameError(null);
    const parsed = parseFr(emailOnly, { email: email.trim() });
    const plain = !askName || isPlainName(name.trim());
    if (!parsed.ok) setEmailError(parsed.fieldErrors.email ?? parsed.error);
    if (!plain) setNameError(COPY.PLAIN_NAME);
    if (!parsed.ok || !plain) {
      refused();
      return;
    }
    if (await sendCode(parsed.data.email)) {
      setAddress(parsed.data.email);
      setCode("");
      setCodeError(null);
      setStep("code");
      setStepFocus((n) => n + 1);
    }
  }

  async function onVerify(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    setError(null);
    if (!isCompleteCode(code)) {
      setCodeError(CODE_FORMAT);
      refused();
      return;
    }
    setCodeError(null);
    setVerifying(true);
    try {
      const res = await authClient.signIn.emailOtp({ email: address, otp: code, name: askName ? nameToSend(name) : undefined });
      if (res.error) {
        setError(verifyCodeFailure(res.error));
        refused();
        return;
      }
      // The session cookie cache (5 minutes) still says « signed out »: read the session once without it, then the page re-renders as signed in.
      try {
        await authClient.getSession({ query: { disableCookieCache: true } });
      } catch {
        // A network failure here only delays what the page shows until the cache expires.
      }
      setDone(true);
      onSignedIn?.();
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      setError(VERIFY_FAILED);
      refused();
    } finally {
      setVerifying(false);
    }
  }

  async function resend() {
    if (busy) return;
    if (await sendCode(address)) {
      setCode("");
      setCodeError(null);
      setStepFocus((n) => n + 1);
    }
  }

  function editAddress() {
    if (busy) return;
    setStep("email");
    setCode("");
    setCodeError(null);
    setError(null);
    setStatus(null);
    setStepFocus((n) => n + 1);
  }

  return (
    <form ref={root} onSubmit={step === "email" ? onSend : onVerify} noValidate className="space-y-4">
      {step === "email" ? (
        <>
          <FormField label="Email" htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-email`} error={emailError}>
            <Input
              id={`${idPrefix}-email`}
              name="email"
              ref={emailInput}
              type="email"
              inputMode="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setEmail(e.target.value);
                setEmailError(null);
              }}
            />
          </FormField>
          {askName && (
            <FormField
              label="Votre nom"
              htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-name`}
              optional
              help={COPY.CODE_NAME_HELP}
              error={nameError}
            >
              <Input
                id={`${idPrefix}-name`}
                name="name"
                autoComplete="name"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setName(e.target.value);
                  setNameError(null);
                }}
              />
            </FormField>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{`Saisissez le code à 6 chiffres envoyé à ${address}.`}</p>
          <FormField
            label="Code reçu par email"
            htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-code`}
            help="6 chiffres, valable 5 minutes."
            error={codeError}
          >
            <Input
              id={`${idPrefix}-code`}
              name="otp"
              ref={codeInput}
              inputMode="numeric"
              autoComplete="one-time-code"
              value={code}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setCode(codeInputValue(e.target.value));
                setCodeError(null);
                setError(null);
              }}
              className="text-center text-lg tracking-[0.4em]"
            />
          </FormField>
        </>
      )}

      {/* Both regions are mounted from the first render: a live region inserted together with its text is not reliably announced. */}
      <div role="status" className="text-sm text-green-700">
        {status && <p>{status}</p>}
      </div>
      <div role="alert">
        {error && (
          <p
            ref={errorBox}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-rose-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {step === "email" ? (
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full sm:w-auto" disabled={busy}>
          {sending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
          {sending ? COPY.PENDING_SEND : "Recevoir un code"}
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center">
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full sm:w-auto" disabled={busy || !isCompleteCode(code)}>
            {verifying && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
            {verifying ? COPY.PENDING_VERIFY : "Valider le code"}
          </Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" className="w-full sm:w-auto" onClick={resend} disabled={busy}>
            {sending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
            Renvoyer le code
          </Button>
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" className="w-full sm:w-auto" onClick={editAddress} disabled={busy}>
            {"Modifier l'adresse"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { GoogleLogo } from "@/components/auth/google-logo";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { signIn } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { googleCallbacks, passwordSignInHref, returnPathOf } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";

const GOOGLE_FAILED = "La connexion avec Google a échoué. Réessayez.";

/**
 * The two other ways in, under the code form: « Continuer avec Google » (only when a Google OAuth client is configured)
 * and « J'ai un mot de passe » (the sign-in page, which brings the visitor back here). Mount it only for an anonymous
 * visitor (canOfferCodeSignIn, risk 7). `returnTo` is the page's own path; it goes through returnPathOf so a query
 * (a purchase reference, a payment flag) never reaches Google or the sign-in page (SEC-M7).
 */
export function ClientSignInChoices({ returnTo, googleEnabled }: { returnTo: string; googleEnabled: boolean }) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const back = returnPathOf(returnTo);

  // Back from Google with the browser's Back button restores this page from the back/forward cache with the spinner still on.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onPageShow = (e: PageTransitionEvent) => {
      if (e.persisted) setLoading(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", onPageShow);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pageshow", onPageShow);
  }, []);

  async function onGoogle() {
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Better Auth redirects the browser to Google; the callbacks bring a client back to this page, never to the pro onboarding.
      const result = await signIn.social({ provider: "google", ...googleCallbacks(back) });
      if (result.error) {
        setError(GOOGLE_FAILED);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    } catch {
      setError(GOOGLE_FAILED);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-zinc-600">
        <span aria-hidden className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" />
        ou
        <span aria-hidden className="h-px flex-1 bg-border" />
      </div>
      <div role="alert">
        {error && <p className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-rose-700">{error}</p>}
      </div>
      {googleEnabled && (
        <Button type="button" variant="secondary" className="w-full" onClick={onGoogle} disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden /> : <GoogleLogo className="size-4" />}
          {COPY.GOOGLE}
        </Button>
      )}
      <Button asChild variant="ghost" className="w-full">
        <Link href={passwordSignInHref(back)}>{COPY.PASSWORD_LINK}</Link>
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useId } from "react";

import { ClientSignInChoices } from "@/components/auth/client-sign-in-choices";
import { EmailCodeForm } from "@/components/auth/email-code-form";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";

const FIELD_PREFIX = "otp-dialog";

/**
 * « J'ai déjà des tickets »: the code sign-in in a dialog (spec L1357, L1368-1369). Mount it only for an anonymous
 * visitor (canOfferCodeSignIn, risk 7). The address field is empty and never locked: a personal-link cookie can be
 * planted by someone else, so it never names who signs in (Decision 7). On success the form closes the dialog and
 * refreshes the page; the opener stays on the page, so the dialog gives the focus back to it on its own. Full width
 * below 640 px, with stacked buttons (COV-M13).
 */
export function OtpDialog({
  open,
  onClose,
  returnTo,
  googleEnabled,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  returnTo: string;
  googleEnabled: boolean;
}) {
  const introId = useId();

  // The panel takes the focus when the dialog opens; the person came to type an address, so the field takes it next
  // (this effect runs after the dialog's own, the form being its child).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) document.getElementById(`${FIELD_PREFIX}-email`)?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} title="Retrouver mes tickets" describedBy={introId}>
      <p id={introId} className="text-sm text-zinc-600">
        {COPY.CODE_INTRO}
      </p>
      <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">
        <EmailCodeForm idPrefix={FIELD_PREFIX} askName onSignedIn={onClose} />
        <ClientSignInChoices returnTo={returnTo} googleEnabled={googleEnabled} />
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// src/lib/public/my-space.ts
export const MY_SPACE_MAX_PROS = 20;
export type MySpaceCard = { slug: string; businessName: string; space: CustomerSpace };
/** The customer rows of a verified session (L1377-1378): user_id = the user, or the verified address with user_id NULL; a row linked to another user never matches (Decision 5). */
export function myCustomerRows(s: { userId: string; email: string }): SQL;
/** L1377-1378: customer rows WHERE user_id = uid OR (email = normalizeEmail(verified e-mail) AND user_id IS NULL), of pros whose user is not suspended; one card per pro, by business name (Intl.Collator fr), at most MY_SPACE_MAX_PROS; space = getCustomerSpace of that row. */
export async function getMySpace(db: Db, s: { userId: string; email: string }, now: Date): Promise<MySpaceCard[]>;

// src/lib/public/client-actions.ts
/** z.object({ name: plainNameSchema }).strict() (SEC-M9, SEC-M15): this name reaches the pro's mails through the customer rows. */
export const myNameInputSchema: z.ZodObject<{ name: z.ZodString }, z.core.$strict>;
/** « Modifier mon nom » (L1384): a verified, non-impersonated session only; parseFr(myNameInputSchema, input); ONE db.batch = UPDATE "user" SET name WHERE id = uid + UPDATE customer SET name WHERE user_id = uid. */
export async function updateMyNameCore(db: Db, s: SessionFacts | null, input: unknown, now: Date): Promise<PublicCoreResult>;
/** « Déconnecter mes liens » (L1371): verified, non-impersonated; ONE statement: link_version + 1 on every row of the getMySpace predicate; returns their number. */
export async function revokeMyLinksCore(db: Db, s: SessionFacts | null, now: Date): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ customers: number }>>;

// src/server/client.ts ("use server")
export async function updateMyNameAction(input: { name: string }): Promise<PublicResult>; // runClientAction
export async function revokeMyLinksAction(): Promise<PublicResult<{ customers: number }>>; // runClientAction

// src/server/client-queries.ts (server-only)
/** The cards of /mon-espace for a verified session; the page checks the visitor state first. */
export function getMySpacePage(s: { userId: string; email: string }): Promise<MySpaceCard[]>;
```

Design notes (read before coding):
- Tenancy and identity: no id comes from the browser. `updateMyNameAction` takes `{ name }` only and `revokeMyLinksAction` takes nothing; the user id and the e-mail come from the fresh session that `runClientAction` reads (`actingSession(getFreshSession())`, never the 5-minute cookie cache). Both cores refuse anything but a `verified` state (`COPY.SIGNED_IN_ONLY`) BEFORE parsing the input: a stranger's malformed input and a valid one get the same answer, and nothing is read for them.
- The row predicate is the one of L1377-1378 and Decision 5: `user_id = uid`, or the verified address with `user_id IS NULL`. A row linked to ANOTHER user never matches, whatever its address. `getMySpace` and `revokeMyLinksCore` share it through `myCustomerRows`, so the cards a client sees and the links she can cut are the same rows.
- `getMySpace` hides pros whose user is suspended (a lapsed ban counts as lifted: `userNotSuspended`). `revokeMyLinksCore` deliberately does NOT filter on suspension: a link of a suspended pro is dead today (the personal-link route answers 404), and must stay dead if the pro comes back.
- « Modifier mon nom » renames `user.name` and the rows with `user_id = uid` (Decision 16): those rows are proven hers. A same-address row that nothing links to her (`user_id` NULL) is never renamed: anonymous input never overwrites a name and neither does a session over an unproven row.
- The name goes through `plainNameSchema` (SEC-M9): it reaches the pros' mails through the customer rows, so a link, a domain name, an address or a phone number (spaced or not) is refused.

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S27: `client-actions.db.test.ts` → unverified, impersonated and absent sessions get `COPY.SIGNED_IN_ONLY` and change nothing; the rename and the revocation touch the user's own rows only (the rows of another user, the unlinked same-address row and another pro's other client are untouched).
- S28: `my-space.db.test.ts` → a row linked to another user is excluded, a suspended pro is excluded (a lapsed ban is not), the unlinked row of the verified address is included.
- S44 (client half): `client-actions.db.test.ts` → « appelez le 0612345678 », « appelez le 06 12 34 56 78 », « www.exemple.fr », « voir bit.ly/x » and an address in the name answer `COPY.PLAIN_NAME` in `fieldErrors.name`.
- S43 (this task's cores): `client-actions.db.test.ts` → an extra key, a wrong type, `null`, a string and an array are refused whole with the French parse error, nothing written.
- Review focus 1 (guard): `src/server/client.test.ts` → no export takes an identity, every export goes through `runClientAction` / `runPublicAction`, no cached session read.

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import * as schema from "@/lib/db/schema";

import { createTestClientUser } from "@/test/public";

function rename(db: Db, pro: TestPro, businessName: string) {
  return db.update(schema.professional).set({ businessName }).where(eq(schema.professional.id, pro.proId));
}

/** `count` pros, each with a customer row of `email` linked to `userId`, in three multi-row inserts; returns the pros' user ids for the cleanup. */
async function manyPros(db: Db, count: number, email: string, userId: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const pros = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => {
    const tag = nanoid(10).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "x");
    return { i, tag, userId: nanoid(), proId: nanoid() };
  });
  await db.insert(schema.user).values(
    pros.map((p) => ({ id: p.userId, name: `Pro ${p.tag}`, email: `pro-${p.tag}@skedul.test`, emailVerified: true, role: "pro" as const })),
  );
  await db.insert(schema.professional).values(
    pros.map((p) => ({
      id: p.proId,
      userId: p.userId,
      slug: `t-${p.tag}`,
      businessName: `Pro ${String(p.i).padStart(2, "0")}`,
      timezone: "Europe/Paris",
      currency: "eur",
    })),
  );
  await db.insert(schema.customer).values(pros.map((p) => ({ id: nanoid(), professionalId: p.proId, userId, email, name: "Beatriz" })));
  return pros.map((p) => p.userId);
}

      db.update(schema.user).set({ banned, banExpires }).where(eq(schema.user.id, second.userId));

    assert.deepEqual(await slugs(), [pro.slug, second.slug], "nobody suspended");

    assert.deepEqual(await slugs(), [pro.slug], "suspended until later");
    await ban(true, new Date(Date.now() - 3_600_000));
    assert.deepEqual(await slugs(), [pro.slug, second.slug], "the ban ended an hour ago: lifted");

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `src/lib/public/my-space.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * « Mon espace » (spec L1377-1378): the cards of /mon-espace, one per pro, for a verified, non-impersonated session
 * (the page checks the visitor state before calling it). No `server-only`, no env, no process db: the caller passes
 * `db` and the session's user id and e-mail.
 *
 * The rows are the session user's: the customers linked to the user, plus the unlinked rows of the verified address
 * (a client who never signed in before was recorded by e-mail only). A row linked to ANOTHER user never matches,
 * whatever its address (Decision 5), and a pro whose user is suspended is offline. Every statement of
 * getCustomerSpace filters professional_id AND customer_id, so a card holds that customer's data and nothing else.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";

import { getCustomerSpace, type CustomerSpace } from "@/lib/back-office/customer-space";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { customer, professional, user } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { userNotSuspended } from "@/lib/suspension";
import { normalizeEmail } from "@/lib/tickets";

export const MY_SPACE_MAX_PROS = 20;

export type MySpaceCard = { slug: string; businessName: string; space: CustomerSpace };

/** The customer rows of a verified session (L1377-1378): user_id = the user, or the verified address with user_id NULL; a row linked to another user never matches (Decision 5). */
export function myCustomerRows(s: { userId: string; email: string }): SQL {
  return sql`(${customer.userId} = ${s.userId} or (${customer.email} = ${normalizeEmail(s.email)} and ${customer.userId} is null))`;
}

/** L1377-1378: customer rows WHERE user_id = uid OR (email = normalizeEmail(verified e-mail) AND user_id IS NULL), of pros whose user is not suspended; one card per pro, by business name (Intl.Collator fr), at most MY_SPACE_MAX_PROS; space = getCustomerSpace of that row. */
export async function getMySpace(db: Db, s: { userId: string; email: string }, now: Date): Promise<MySpaceCard[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      customerId: customer.id,
      professionalId: customer.professionalId,
      linked: sql<boolean>`(${customer.userId} is not null)`,
      slug: professional.slug,
      businessName: professional.businessName,
    })
    .from(customer)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, customer.professionalId))
    .innerJoin(user, eq(user.id, professional.userId))
    .where(and(myCustomerRows(s), userNotSuspended()))
    .orderBy(asc(customer.id));

  // One card per pro. A client whose address changed can match twice at one pro: the row linked to her wins.
  const byPro = new Map<string, (typeof rows)[number]>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const kept = byPro.get(row.professionalId);
    if (!kept || (row.linked && !kept.linked)) byPro.set(row.professionalId, row);
  }

  const collator = new Intl.Collator("fr");
  const picked = [...byPro.values()]
    .sort((a, b) => collator.compare(a.businessName, b.businessName) || collator.compare(a.slug, b.slug))
    .slice(0, MY_SPACE_MAX_PROS);

  const cards = await Promise.all(
    picked.map(async (row) => {
      const space = await getCustomerSpace(db, row.professionalId, row.customerId, now);
      return space ? { slug: row.slug, businessName: row.businessName, space } : null;
    }),
  );
  return cards.filter((card): card is MySpaceCard => card !== null);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement `src/lib/public/client-actions.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * The client's own account actions of /mon-espace (spec L1371, L1384, Decisions 16 and 17): « Modifier mon nom » and
 * « Déconnecter mes liens ». These are the cores that src/server/client.ts wraps: a verified, non-impersonated, FRESH
 * session only, checked before anything is parsed or read (a stranger learns nothing), and the session's own rows
 * only. No `server-only`, no env, no process db: the wrapper passes `db`, the session facts and `now`.
 */
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";

import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { customer, user } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { visitorState, type SessionFacts } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { myCustomerRows } from "@/lib/public/my-space";
import { plainNameSchema } from "@/lib/public/plain-name";
import { fromParse, publicFail, publicOk, type PublicCoreResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

/** z.object({ name: plainNameSchema }).strict() (SEC-M9, SEC-M15): this name reaches the pro's mails through the customer rows. */
export const myNameInputSchema = z.object({ name: plainNameSchema }).strict();

/** « Modifier mon nom » (L1384): a verified, non-impersonated session only; parseFr(myNameInputSchema, input); ONE db.batch = UPDATE "user" SET name WHERE id = uid + UPDATE customer SET name WHERE user_id = uid. */
export async function updateMyNameCore(db: Db, s: SessionFacts | null, input: unknown, now: Date): Promise<PublicCoreResult> {
  if (s === null || visitorState(s) !== "verified") return publicFail(COPY.SIGNED_IN_ONLY);
  const parsed = parseFr(myNameInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return fromParse(parsed);
  const { name } = parsed.data;
  // One batch, one transaction: the account and its linked rows change together or not at all.
  await db.batch([
    db.update(user).set({ name, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(user.id, s.userId)),
    db.update(customer).set({ name, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(customer.userId, s.userId)),
  ]);
  return publicOk({});
}

/** « Déconnecter mes liens » (L1371): verified, non-impersonated; ONE statement: link_version + 1 on every row of the getMySpace predicate; returns their number. */
export async function revokeMyLinksCore(
  db: Db,
  s: SessionFacts | null,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult<{ customers: number }>> {
  if (s === null || visitorState(s) !== "verified") return publicFail(COPY.SIGNED_IN_ONLY);
  // No suspension filter, unlike the cards: a link of a suspended pro is dead today and must stay dead if the pro comes back.
  const rows = await db
    .update(customer)
    .set({ linkVersion: sql`${customer.linkVersion} + 1`, updatedAt: now })
    .where(myCustomerRows(s))
    .returning({ id: customer.id });
  return publicOk({ customers: rows.length });
}
```

/**
 * Wiring guard for src/server/client.ts, the "use server" file of the client actions. It imports the action plumbing
 * (next/cache, next/server), which the node:test runner cannot load, so the wiring is pinned on the source; the
 * decisions themselves have their own tests (client-actions.db.test.ts, run-action.test.ts). Tasks 21 and 21a add

 */
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import test from "node:test";

const SOURCE = readFileSync("src/server/client.ts", "utf8");

/** Every `export async function`: its name, its parameter list and its body (up to the next export). */
function exportedActions(): { name: string; params: string; body: string }[] {
  const starts = [...SOURCE.matchAll(/^export async function (\w+)\(([^)]*)\)/gm)];
  return starts.map((m, i) => ({
    name: m[1],
    params: m[2],
    body: SOURCE.slice(m.index, starts[i + 1]?.index ?? SOURCE.length),
  }));
}

Design notes (read before coding):
- Identity: the page reads `currentSessionFacts()` only (never the 5-minute cookie cache, never `getSession()`), so a ban or a revoked session shows at once. Signed out it shows the code form, never a redirect to `/sign-in` (L1376). Only `canOfferCodeSignIn(state)` (anonymous) mounts `EmailCodeForm` and `ClientSignInChoices`: an unverified visitor gets the « Confirmez votre adresse » banner (a code sign-in would purge the password, risk 7) and an impersonating admin gets `COPY.IMPERSONATING`. No client component receives a customer id, a booking id or any other client's data: `MySpaceView` is a server component and only `initialName` crosses to a client leaf.
- Rendering and caching: the page is dynamic through its session read (no `unstable_cache`, no `revalidate`, no segment config); it is `noindex`, untracked (P3 reserved the segment) and carries no query parameter. The Server Actions revalidate `/mon-espace` (`PUBLIC_REVALIDATE`), so the leaves never call `router.refresh()` after an action.
- Sign-out ends with `window.location.replace("/mon-espace")`: a full navigation that drops the router cache, so Back cannot show the signed-in space again (SEC-M12).
- Wallet notes: at this commit `CustomerSpace.wallet[]` carries `archived` only, so a card shows the archived-type note like `CustomerSpaceView` does. The « orphan » note (`COPY.ORPHAN_TYPE`) needs the `typeClass` that Task 21 adds to the type and is first rendered by Task 22 in `customer-space.tsx`: the Task 22 commit must add the same line to the wallet list of `ProCard` in `src/components/public/my-space.tsx` (`{w.typeClass === "orphan" && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{COPY.ORPHAN_TYPE}</p>}`), so the `/mon-espace` cards and the espace never disagree about a ticket nobody accepts.
- UI rule (user rule): before writing the JSX of Step 3, invoke the `design-taste-frontend` skill. The page keeps the existing system (the `Card` family, `INLINE_LINK_CLASS` for a link inside a sentence, `wrap-anywhere` on every user-supplied text, `lucide-react`); apply the skill as a consistency, AA and mobile check, not as a redesign. Cards stack; the buttons of the account section are full width below 640 px.
- SWC whitespace bug: any JSX text with an apostrophe or an entity is written as a JS string (`{"Retour à l'accueil"}`), on one line.

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** none of its own; the source guard pins the fresh-session read, the anonymous-only mounting and the full-navigation sign-out, and the browser check re-runs S22 and S23 end to end (a neutral answer to the code request, the `?next=` of « J'ai un mot de passe » without a query).

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";

import { ClientSignInChoices } from "@/components/auth/client-sign-in-choices";
import { EmailCodeForm } from "@/components/auth/email-code-form";
import { VerifyEmailBanner } from "@/components/dashboard/verify-email-banner";
import { MySpaceView } from "@/components/public/my-space";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { visitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { canOfferCodeSignIn } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";
import { getMySpacePage } from "@/server/client-queries";
import { currentSessionFacts } from "@/server/visitor";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Mon espace", robots: { index: false } };

/**
 * « Mon espace » (spec L1376-1391): the client's own space across every pro. The visitor comes from the FRESH session
 * (never the 5-minute cookie cache). Signed out: the code form, never a redirect. Signed in but unverified: the
 * confirmation banner, never the code form (a code sign-in would purge the password, risk 7). Impersonating: a
 * sentence (an admin never reads a client's data through a pro's session). Verified: one card per pro. Rendered per
 * request (it reads the session), never indexed, never counted in the page-view stats.
 */
export default async function MySpacePage() {
  const session = await currentSessionFacts();
  const state = visitorState(session);
  const cards =
    state === "verified" && session ? await getMySpacePage({ userId: session.userId, email: session.email }) : [];

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-2xl space-y-6 px-5 py-10">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Mon espace client</h1>

      {canOfferCodeSignIn(state) && (
        <Card className="space-y-5 p-6">
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Accédez à vos réservations et à vos tickets chez tous vos professionnels.</p>
          <EmailCodeForm idPrefix="my-space" askName />
          <ClientSignInChoices returnTo="/mon-espace" googleEnabled={env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED} />
        </Card>
      )}

      {state === "unverified" && session && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <VerifyEmailBanner email={session.email} verified={false} />
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_FIRST}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {state === "impersonating" && (
        <Card className="p-6">
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.IMPERSONATING}</p>
        </Card>
      )}

      {state === "verified" && session && <MySpaceView name={session.name} email={session.email} cards={cards} />}

      <div>
        <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm">
          <Link href="/">{"Retour à l'accueil"}</Link>
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { CalendarCheck, MapPin } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { ClientSignOutButton } from "@/components/public/client-sign-out-button";
import { MyNameForm } from "@/components/public/my-name-form";
import { RevokeMyLinksButton } from "@/components/public/revoke-my-links-button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { INLINE_LINK_CLASS } from "@/components/ui/link-class";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import type { MySpaceCard } from "@/lib/public/my-space";
import { boutiqueHref } from "@/lib/public-anchors";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * « Mon espace »: one card per pro (its next inscriptions, its tickets, a link to the pro's own space), then the
 * account section. A server component: the leaves below are the only client code, and only the name crosses to them.
 * Every text of a pro or of the client (business name, titles, places, names) can be long and unbroken, hence
 * `wrap-anywhere` and `min-w-0`. Cards stack.
 */
export function MySpaceView({ name, email, cards }: { name: string; email: string; cards: MySpaceCard[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <p className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight wrap-anywhere">{name.trim() === "" ? "Bonjour" : `Bonjour ${name}`}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{email}</p>
      </div>

      {cards.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState icon={CalendarCheck} title={COPY.NO_RESERVATION} />
      ) : (
        cards.map((card) => <ProCard key={card.slug} card={card} />)
      )}

      <section aria-labelledby="my-account">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <h2 id="my-account" className="text-base font-semibold leading-tight">
              Mon compte
            </h2>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-5">
            <MyNameForm initialName={name} />
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-start">
              <RevokeMyLinksButton />
              <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
                <Link href="/onboarding">{COPY.CREATE_PAGE}</Link>
              </Button>
              <ClientSignOutButton />
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The card of one pro: next inscriptions, tickets, and the way into the pro's own space. */
function ProCard({ card }: { card: MySpaceCard }) {
  const { slug, businessName, space } = card;
  const headingId = `my-space-${slug}`;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <h2 id={headingId} className="text-base font-semibold leading-tight wrap-anywhere">
            {businessName}
          </h2>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Vos prochaines inscriptions</h3>
            {space.upcoming.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.NO_UPCOMING}</p>
                <Link href={`/${slug}`} className={cn(INLINE_LINK_CLASS, "text-sm wrap-anywhere")}>
                  {`Voir la page de ${businessName}`}
                </Link>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {space.upcoming.map((b) => (
                  <li key={b.bookingId} className="space-y-1 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <p className="min-w-0 font-medium wrap-anywhere">{b.title}</p>
                      <Badge variant="neutral">{b.coverageLabel}</Badge>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{b.whenLabel}</p>
                    {b.location && (
                      <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-600">
                        <MapPin className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                        <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{b.location}</span>
                      </p>
                    )}
                    {b.cancelText && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600">{b.cancelText}</p>}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">Vos tickets</h3>
            {space.wallet.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.NO_TICKET}</p>
                <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
                  <Link href={boutiqueHref(slug)}>{COPY.SEE_SHOP}</Link>
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {space.wallet.map((w) => (
                  <li key={w.ticketTypeId} className="space-y-1 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                    <p className="flex items-start gap-2 font-medium">
                      <span
                        className="mt-1.5 size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: w.color }}
                        aria-hidden
                      />
                      <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{`${w.usable} × ${w.name}`}</span>
                    </p>
                    {w.expiries.map((text) => (
                      <p key={text} className="text-sm text-zinc-600">
                        {text}
                      </p>
                    ))}
                    {w.archived && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{`Ce type n'est plus proposé par ${businessName}.`}</p>
                    )}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>

          <Link href={`/${slug}/espace`} className={cn(INLINE_LINK_CLASS, "inline-block text-sm wrap-anywhere")}>
            {`Ouvrir l'espace chez ${businessName}`}
          </Link>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </section>
  );
}

Create `src/components/public/my-name-form.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { startTransition, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { z } from "zod";

import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { SavedStatus } from "@/components/dashboard/saved-status";
import { useRefusalFocus } from "@/components/dashboard/use-refusal-focus";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { plainNameSchema } from "@/lib/public/plain-name";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED, type PublicResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";
import { updateMyNameAction } from "@/server/client";

/** The browser-side twin of the core's rule (src/lib/public/client-actions.ts): the same plain name, the same French texts. */
const nameOnly = z.object({ name: plainNameSchema });

/**
 * « Votre nom » (spec L1384): renames the account and every row linked to it. The field is filled from the name the
 * server rendered; a refused name names the field under its input and takes the focus, a failed call lands in the
 * error box, which sits in an always-mounted alert region (a live region inserted together with its text is not
 * reliably announced) and takes the focus. The « Enregistré » line sits in an always-mounted status region and goes
 * away with the next edit, so a second save is announced again. No router refresh: the action revalidates this page.
 */
export function MyNameForm({ initialName }: { initialName: string }) {
  const { root, errorBox, refused } = useRefusalFocus();
  const [name, setName] = useState(initialName);
  const [fieldError, setFieldError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [saving, startSave] = useTransition();

  function save(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    setSaved(false);
    setError(null);
    const parsed = parseFr(nameOnly, { name });
    if (!parsed.ok) {
      setFieldError(parsed.fieldErrors.name ?? parsed.error);
      refused();
      return;
    }
    setFieldError(null);
    startSave(async () => {
      let res: PublicResult;
      try {
        res = await updateMyNameAction({ name: parsed.data.name });
      } catch {
        res = { ok: false, error: PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED };
      }
      // After an await the updates leave the transition: wrapped again, they commit together with the new props.
      startTransition(() => {
        if (!res.ok) {
          const field = res.fieldErrors?.name ?? null;
          setFieldError(field);
          setError(field === null ? res.error : null);
          refused();
          return;
        }
        setName(parsed.data.name);
        setSaved(true);
      });
    });
  }

  return (
    <form ref={root} onSubmit={save} noValidate className="space-y-3">
      <FormField label="Votre nom" htmlFor="my-name" error={fieldError}>
        <Input
          id="my-name"
          name="name"
          autoComplete="name"
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setName(e.target.value);
            setFieldError(null);
            setError(null);
            setSaved(false);
          }}
        />
      </FormField>
      <div role="alert">
        {error && (
          <p
            ref={errorBox}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-rose-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={saving}>
          {saving && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
          {saving ? COPY.PENDING_SAVE : "Enregistrer"}
        </Button>
        <SavedStatus saved={saved} message={COPY.SAVED} />
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

Create `src/components/public/revoke-my-links-button.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { startTransition, useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { ConfirmCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED, type PublicResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { revokeMyLinksAction } from "@/server/client";

const REVOKE_COPY: ConfirmCopy = {
  title: "Déconnecter vos liens personnels ?",
  body: "Les liens reçus par email cessent de fonctionner. Les prochains emails contiendront un nouveau lien.",
  confirm: "Déconnecter mes liens",
};

/**
 * « Déconnecter mes liens » (spec L1371, L1384): every personal link of her rows stops working, and the next e-mails
 * carry a new one. A destructive gesture: the dialog states what happens first (its own focus trap and focus
 * restore keep the keyboard inside, then bring it back to this button, which stays on the page). The success line
 * sits in a status region that is always mounted.
 */
export function RevokeMyLinksButton() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startRevoke] = useTransition();

  function openDialog() {
    setError(null);
    setDone(false);
    setOpen(true);
  }

  function confirm() {
    startRevoke(async () => {
      let res: PublicResult<{ customers: number }>;
      try {
        res = await revokeMyLinksAction();
      } catch {
        res = { ok: false, error: PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED };
      }
      startTransition(() => {
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        setOpen(false);
        setDone(true);
      });
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" className="w-full sm:w-auto" onClick={openDialog}>
        {COPY.REVOKE_MY_LINKS}
      </Button>
      <div role="status" className="text-sm text-green-700">
        {done && <p>{COPY.LINKS_REVOKED}</p>}
      </div>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={open}
        copy={REVOKE_COPY}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={confirm}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

Create `src/components/public/client-sign-out-button.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Loader2, LogOut } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { signOut } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import { GENERIC_ERROR } from "@/lib/auth-messages";

/**
 * « Se déconnecter » on /mon-espace. After the sign-out the page is reloaded with a full navigation that REPLACES
 * the history entry (SEC-M12): never a router refresh, which would keep the router cache of the signed-in space, and
 * Back never shows it again. A failed sign-out says so and stays on the page, still signed in.
 */
export function ClientSignOutButton() {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function out() {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await signOut();
      if (res.error) {
        setError(GENERIC_ERROR);
        setPending(false);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      setError(GENERIC_ERROR);
      setPending(false);
      return;
    }
    window.location.replace("/mon-espace");
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full sm:w-auto" onClick={out} disabled={pending}>
        {pending ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden /> : <LogOut aria-hidden />}
        Se déconnecter
      </Button>
      <div role="alert">{error && <p className="text-sm text-rose-700">{error}</p>}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

Replace the whole content of `src/lib/entry.ts` (Write) with:

```ts
/** Where an admin lands after signing in: the admin area or their own dashboard. */
export type EntryChoice = "admin" | "client";

/** Remembers an admin's choice on this device; survives sign-out on purpose. */
export const ENTRY_COOKIE = "skedul_entry";
export const ENTRY_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 365; // 1 year, in seconds

export const ENTRY_LABELS: Record<EntryChoice, string> = {
  admin: "Dashboard Admin",
  client: "Dashboard Client",
};

export function parseEntryChoice(
  value: string | null | undefined,
): EntryChoice | null {
  return value === "admin" || value === "client" ? value : null;
}

export function entryPath(choice: EntryChoice): "/admin" | "/dashboard" {
  return choice === "admin" ? "/admin" : "/dashboard";
}

/**
 * Destination right after sign-in (L1394-1395), or "choose" to show the chooser: an admin chooses (or gets the
 * remembered choice); anyone else goes to the pro back-office when they own a page, else to their client space.
 * Only the sign-up funnel lands on the pro onboarding (L1397).
 */
export function resolveEntry(input: {
  isAdmin: boolean;
  hasProfessional: boolean;
  remembered: EntryChoice | null;
}): "/admin" | "/dashboard" | "/mon-espace" | "choose" {
  if (!input.isAdmin) return input.hasProfessional ? "/dashboard" : "/mon-espace";
  return input.remembered ? entryPath(input.remembered) : "choose";
}
```

Replace the whole content of `src/server/entry.ts` (Write) with:

```ts
"use server";

import { cookies } from "next/headers";

import { getAdminUser } from "@/lib/admin";
import {
  ENTRY_COOKIE,
  ENTRY_COOKIE_MAX_AGE,
  entryPath,
  parseEntryChoice,
  resolveEntry,
  type EntryChoice,
} from "@/lib/entry";
import { getCurrentProfessional } from "@/lib/session";

export type PostSignIn = { kind: "redirect"; to: string } | { kind: "choose" };

/** Where a signed-in user goes next: admins without a remembered choice must choose, a user without a pro page lands on their client space. */
export async function resolvePostSignIn(): Promise<PostSignIn> {
  const [admin, pro, store] = await Promise.all([getAdminUser(), getCurrentProfessional(), cookies()]);
  const target = resolveEntry({
    isAdmin: admin !== null,
    hasProfessional: pro !== null,
    remembered: parseEntryChoice(store.get(ENTRY_COOKIE)?.value),
  });
  return target === "choose"
    ? { kind: "choose" }
    : { kind: "redirect", to: target };
}

/** Records an admin's choice (optionally remembered on this device) and returns the path. */
export async function chooseEntry(
  choice: EntryChoice,
  remember: boolean,
): Promise<string> {
  const valid = parseEntryChoice(choice);
  if (!valid || !(await getAdminUser())) {
    // Not an admin: nothing to choose, the pro back-office when they own a page, else their client space.
    return (await getCurrentProfessional()) ? "/dashboard" : "/mon-espace";
  }
  if (remember) {
    (await cookies()).set(ENTRY_COOKIE, valid, {
      httpOnly: true,
      sameSite: "lax",
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === "production",
      maxAge: ENTRY_COOKIE_MAX_AGE,
      path: "/",
    });
  }
  return entryPath(valid);
}

export async function forgetEntryChoice(): Promise<void> {
  (await cookies()).delete(ENTRY_COOKIE);
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

import { AuthForm } from "@/components/auth/auth-form";
import { DemoQuickLogin } from "@/components/auth/demo-quick-login";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { INLINE_LINK_CLASS } from "@/components/ui/link-class";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { oauthErrorMessage } from "@/lib/oauth-errors";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { safeNextPath } from "@/lib/safe-next";
import { getCurrentUser } from "@/lib/session";
import { resolvePostSignIn } from "@/server/entry";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Connexion" };

export default async function SignInPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string | string[]; next?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  const { error, next: rawNext } = await searchParams;
  // Google found an existing email/password account: offer to link it.
  if (error === "account_not_linked") redirect("/link-google");
  const next = safeNextPath(rawNext);

  // Already signed in: go back where the user was headed, else the usual
  // routing (admins may choose, a user without a pro page lands on /mon-espace).
  let showChooser = false;
  if (await getCurrentUser()) {
    if (next) redirect(next);
    const target = await resolvePostSignIn();
    if (target.kind === "redirect") redirect(target.to);
    showChooser = true;
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="text-xl">Bon retour 👋</CardTitle>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Connectez-vous pour accéder à votre espace.
        </p>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <AuthForm
          mode="sign-in"
          next={next}
          initialChooser={showChooser}
          googleEnabled={env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED}
          initialError={oauthErrorMessage(typeof error === "string" ? error : null)}
        />
        <p className="mt-5 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Vous êtes client ?{" "}
          <Link href="/mon-espace" className={INLINE_LINK_CLASS}>
            {COPY.CLIENT_SPACE_LINK}
          </Link>
        </p>
        {env.APP_ENV !== "production" && <DemoQuickLogin />}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

// src/lib/back-office/client-actions.ts
/** « Rechercher »: parseFr(z.object({ q: z.string().trim().max(100), filter: z.enum(CLIENT_FILTERS) }).strict(), input) first, then listClients for ctx.professionalId; a failed parse is { ok: false, error } and nothing is read. */
export async function searchClientsCore(db: Db, ctx: ProCtx, input: unknown, now: Date): Promise<ActionResult<{ rows: ClientListRow[] }>>;
// src/server/pro-clients.ts ("use server")
export async function searchClientsAction(input: { q: string; filter: ClientFilter }): Promise<ActionResult<{ rows: ClientListRow[] }>>;
// src/lib/back-office/client-filters.ts
/** /dashboard/clients or /dashboard/clients?filter=… : the filter only, never a search term. */
export function clientsHref(filter: ClientFilter): string;
// src/components/dashboard/client-search.tsx ("use client")
export function ClientSearch(props: {
  filter: ClientFilter;
  /** the rows of the filter, read by the page */
  initialRows: ClientListRow[];
  /** counts[filter]: the number of clients in the filter, whatever the search */
  total: number;
  /** CLIENT_LIST_LIMIT, passed by the page so that this client component imports nothing from client-reads.ts at run time */
  limit: number;
  /** the filter chips, rendered by the page (a server component) between the form and the results */
  children: React.ReactNode;
}): React.JSX.Element;
```

Create `src/components/dashboard/client-search.test.ts` (Write):

```ts
/**
 * Wiring guards for the client search (Decision 73, FR:UI-13): the pro's search terms are client names and e-mails,
 * so they never reach a URL, the browser history or the platform request log. The component imports a Server Action
 * and the page imports the database, which the node:test runner cannot load: what they must keep is pinned on their
 * source. Run from the repository root.
 */
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import test from "node:test";

const source = (path: string): string => readFileSync(path, "utf8");

test("the client search keeps the typed term in component state and sends it through a Server Action, never through the URL", () => {
  const search = source("src/components/dashboard/client-search.tsx");
  assert.match(search, /^"use client";/, "a client leaf");
  assert.match(search, /callOrFail\(\(\) => searchClientsAction\(\{ q, filter \}\)\)/, "the call cannot throw into React");
  assert.doesNotMatch(search, /\bname="q"/, "no field named q: nothing to serialise");
  assert.doesNotMatch(search, /<form[^>]*\baction=/, "no GET form to /dashboard/clients");
  for (const forbidden of [/useSearchParams/, /useRouter/, /\brouter\./, /window\.location/, /\bhistory\./, /encodeURIComponent/]) {
    assert.doesNotMatch(search, forbidden, `the component never builds or navigates to a URL carrying the term (${forbidden})`);
  }
  assert.match(search, /maxLength=\{100\}/, "the limit of the schema");
  assert.match(search, /autoComplete="off"/, "the browser does not remember client names");
  assert.match(search, /<div role="status">/, "an always-mounted status region for the empty text and the capped line");
});

test("/dashboard/clients reads ?filter= only: no q in its search params, the chips link without a term", () => {
  const page = source("src/app/dashboard/clients/page.tsx");
  assert.doesNotMatch(page, /params\.q\b/, "the page never reads a search term");
  assert.doesNotMatch(page, /\bq\?\s*:/, "the type of searchParams has no q");
  assert.match(page, /getClientsPage\(ctx\.professionalId, \{ q: "", filter \}\)/);
  assert.match(page, /<ClientSearch key=\{filter\}/, "a filter change remounts the search, so no term follows a chip");
  assert.match(page, /href: clientsHref\(f\),/);
});

test("searchClientsAction is a read: runProQuery (fresh session, no revalidation, no effect)", () => {
  const actions = source("src/server/pro-clients.ts");
  const at = actions.indexOf("export async function searchClientsAction");
  assert.notEqual(at, -1, "exported");
  // The body ends at the first « } » alone on its line: the « }): » closing the parameter type is not it.
  const rest = actions.slice(at);
  const end = rest.search(/\n\}\r?\n/);
  const body = end === -1 ? rest : rest.slice(0, end);
  assert.match(body, /runProQuery\("searchClients", \(ctx, now\) => searchClientsCore\(db, ctx, input, now\)\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(body, /runProAction/);
});
```

```ts
/** The rows of a successful search; a failed one fails the assertion with its text. */
function searchRows(res: ActionResult<{ rows: ClientListRow[] }>): ClientListRow[] {
  assert.equal(res.ok, true, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res.ok ? res.rows : [];
}

/** The French refusal of a failed search. */
function searchRefusal(res: ActionResult<{ rows: ClientListRow[] }>): string {
  assert.equal(res.ok, false, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res.ok ? "" : res.error;
}

dbTest("searchClientsCore: finds a client by an accented name and by e-mail, inside the filter, with the term trimmed", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  const eloise = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Éloïse Marques", email: "eloise.marques@skedul.test" });
  const bruno = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Bruno Pereira", email: "bruno.pereira@skedul.test" });
  const type = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, eloise, type, 2);

  const ids = async (input: unknown) => searchRows(await searchClientsCore(db, ctx, input, now)).map((r) => r.id);
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "Éloïse", filter: "tous" }), [eloise], "an accented name, typed as stored");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "  marques  ", filter: "tous" }), [eloise], "the term is trimmed and the case ignored");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "BRUNO.PEREIRA@skedul", filter: "tous" }), [bruno], "an e-mail, case ignored");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "", filter: "tous" }), [bruno, eloise], "no term: every listed client, in French name order");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "marques", filter: "tickets" }), [eloise], "inside the filter: she holds tickets");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "pereira", filter: "tickets" }), [], "inside the filter: he holds none");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "Eloise.Marques@", filter: "tickets" }), [eloise], "an e-mail inside the filter, case ignored");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "bruno.pereira@", filter: "tickets" }), [], "an e-mail outside the filter");
  assert.deepEqual(await ids({ q: "zzz", filter: "tous" }), []);

  // A thin wrapper of the read the page uses: the same rows.
  const direct = await listClients(db, pro.proId, now, { q: "marques", filter: "tickets" });
  assert.deepEqual(searchRows(await searchClientsCore(db, ctx, { q: "marques", filter: "tickets" }, now)), direct.rows);
});

dbTest("searchClientsCore: a malformed input is refused whole, in French, before anything is read", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const ctx = proCtx(pro);
  const now = new Date();
  // A database that fails on any use: every refusal below must come from the parse, before the first read.
  const noDb = new Proxy({}, {
    get() {
      throw new Error("the database was used");
    },
  }) as unknown as Db;
  const refused = async (input: unknown) => searchRefusal(await searchClientsCore(noDb, ctx, input, now));
  assert.equal(await refused({ q: "", filter: "tous", extra: 1 }), "Champ inattendu.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ q: "a".repeat(101), filter: "tous" }), "Recherche : 100 caractères au maximum.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ q: "", filter: "nope" }), "Choix invalide.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ q: "" }), "Choix invalide.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ q: 5, filter: "tous" }), "Recherche : ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ q: ["x"], filter: "tous" }), "Recherche : ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ filter: "tous" }), "Recherche : ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(await refused(null), "Valeur invalide.");
  assert.equal(await refused("tous"), "Valeur invalide.");
  // 100 characters after trimming is fine.
  searchRows(await searchClientsCore(db, ctx, { q: ` ${"a".repeat(100)} `, filter: "tous" }, now));
});

`src/lib/back-office/client-filters.ts` (Edit). old_string:

```ts
/** /dashboard/clients?filter=…&q=… (empty parts omitted). */
export function clientsHref(filter: ClientFilter, q: string): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (filter !== "tous") parts.push(`filter=${filter}`);
  const query = q.trim();
  if (query !== "") parts.push(`q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
  return parts.length === 0 ? "/dashboard/clients" : `/dashboard/clients?${parts.join("&")}`;
}
```
new_string:

```ts
/**
 * /dashboard/clients or /dashboard/clients?filter=… : the filter only. The pro's search term (a client's name or
 * e-mail) is never part of a URL: it would reach the address bar, the history and the platform request log
 * (Decision 73, FR:UI-13). The search runs through searchClientsAction and lives in component state.
 */
export function clientsHref(filter: ClientFilter): string {
  return filter === "tous" ? "/dashboard/clients" : `/dashboard/clients?filter=${filter}`;

The core, before `revokeLinksCore`. old_string:

/** « Déconnecter ses liens »: link_version + 1. */

```ts
/**
 * « Rechercher » on /dashboard/clients (Decision 73, FR:UI-13): the term never travels in a URL, so the search is a
 * read behind a Server Action. parseFr of the strict input first (nothing is read for a malformed one), then
 * listClients for THIS pro (ctx.professionalId, never input) with the filter and the term. The counts stay the
 * page's: listClients counts every client whatever `q`.
 */
export async function searchClientsCore(
  db: Db,
  ctx: ProCtx,
  input: unknown,
  now: Date,
): Promise<ActionResult<{ rows: ClientListRow[] }>> {
  const parsed = parseFr(searchClientsSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return actionFail(parsed.error);
  const { rows } = await listClients(db, ctx.professionalId, now, parsed.data);
  return { ok: true, rows };
}

/** « Déconnecter ses liens »: link_version + 1. */
```

 */
export async function searchClientsAction(input: {
  q: string;
  filter: ClientFilter;
