Create `src/components/dashboard/client-search.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { ClientList } from "@/components/dashboard/client-list";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { clientsHref, type ClientFilter } from "@/lib/back-office/client-filters";
import type { ClientListRow } from "@/lib/back-office/client-reads";
import { formatCount } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { callOrFail } from "@/lib/pro-messages";
import { searchClientsAction } from "@/server/pro-clients";

/**
 * The « Rechercher » form and the client list of /dashboard/clients (Decision 73, FR:UI-13). The typed term lives in
 * component state only: it is sent to searchClientsAction and never put in a URL, so a client's name or e-mail does
 * not reach the address bar, the history or the platform request log. The page renders this component with
 * `key={filter}`, so a filter chip (a link to ?filter=…) starts a fresh search. An empty term shows the rows of the
 * filter again. The empty text and the capped line live in an always-mounted `role="status"` region.
 */
export function ClientSearch({
  filter,
  initialRows,
  total,
  limit,
  children,
}: {
  filter: ClientFilter;
  initialRows: ClientListRow[];
  total: number;
  limit: number;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [term, setTerm] = useState("");
  const [found, setFound] = useState<{ q: string; rows: ClientListRow[] } | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const rows = found ? found.rows : initialRows;
  const searched = found ? found.q : "";
  // The read stops at `limit` rows while the search and the counts see every client.
  const capped = rows.length >= limit && (searched !== "" || total > rows.length);
  const emptyText = searched !== "" ? `Aucun client ne correspond à « ${searched} ».` : "Aucun client dans ce filtre.";

  function submit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    const q = term.trim();
    setError(null);
    if (q === "") {
      setFound(null);
      return;
    }
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await callOrFail(() => searchClientsAction({ q, filter }));
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      setFound({ q, rows: res.rows });
    });
  }

  /** « Voir tous les clients » inside the unfiltered list: forget the search and give the focus back to the field. */
  function showAll() {
    setTerm("");
    setFound(null);
    setError(null);
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-5 space-y-3">
        <form role="search" onSubmit={submit} className="flex max-w-md items-end gap-2">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <FormField label="Rechercher" htmlFor="client-search">
              <Input
                ref={inputRef}
                id="client-search"
                type="search"
                value={term}
                onChange={(e) => setTerm(e.target.value)}
                maxLength={100}
                autoComplete="off"
              />
            </FormField>
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" disabled={pending}>
            {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" />}
            Rechercher
          </Button>
        </form>
        <FormError message={error} />
        {children}
      </div>

      {rows.length > 0 && <ClientList rows={rows} />}
      <div role="status">
        {rows.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="flex flex-col items-center gap-4 px-6 py-10 text-center">
            <p className="max-w-full text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{emptyText}</p>
            {filter === "tous" ? (
              <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={showAll}>
                Voir tous les clients
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
                <Link href={clientsHref("tous")}>Voir tous les clients</Link>
              </Button>
            )}
          </Card>
        ) : capped ? (
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-zinc-600">
            {`Les ${formatCount(limit)} premiers clients sont affichés. Précisez la recherche pour trouver les autres.`}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

Replace the whole content of `src/app/dashboard/clients/page.tsx` (Write) with:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { Users } from "lucide-react";

import { FilterChips } from "@/components/admin/filter-chips";
import { ClientSearch } from "@/components/dashboard/client-search";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { NewClientButton } from "@/components/dashboard/new-client-button";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/dashboard/page-header";
import {
  CLIENT_FILTERS,
  CLIENT_FILTER_LABELS,
  clientsHref,
  parseClientFilter,
} from "@/lib/back-office/client-filters";
import { CLIENT_LIST_LIMIT } from "@/lib/back-office/client-reads";
import { formatCount } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { getClientsPage } from "@/server/client-queries";
import { requireProContext } from "@/server/pro-context";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Clients" };

const DESCRIPTION = "Les personnes qui réservent chez vous et leurs tickets.";

export default async function ClientsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ filter?: string | string[] }>;
}) {
  const ctx = await requireProContext();
  const params = await searchParams;
  const filter = parseClientFilter(params.filter);
  // The search term never travels in the URL (Decision 73): the page lists the filter, ClientSearch searches it.
  const { rows, counts } = await getClientsPage(ctx.professionalId, { q: "", filter });

  if (counts.tous === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        <PageHeader title="Clients" description={DESCRIPTION} />
        <EmptyState
          icon={Users}
          title="Vos clients apparaîtront ici"
          description="Ils sont créés à leur première réservation ou à leur premier achat. Vous pouvez aussi en ajouter un."
          action={<NewClientButton />}
        />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Clients" description={DESCRIPTION} action={<NewClientButton />} />
      <ClientSearch key={filter} filter={filter} initialRows={rows} total={counts[filter]} limit={CLIENT_LIST_LIMIT}>
        <FilterChips
          label="Filtrer"
          active={filter}
          scrollable
          options={CLIENT_FILTERS.map((f) => ({
            value: f,
            label: `${CLIENT_FILTER_LABELS[f]} (${formatCount(counts[f])})`,
            href: clientsHref(f),
          }))}
        />
      </ClientSearch>
    </>
  );
}
```

The page keeps the P3 behaviour except for the search: the first-client empty state, the chips and their counts, the capped line (now inside `ClientSearch`), the title. A bookmarked `?q=` is ignored.

S10: `spaceActorOf` of a verified session without a record plus a valid cookie is `null`. S42 (the `spaceActorOf` half): an impersonating session plus a valid cookie is `null`. S19 (the cancel half): after 10 hits on the actor's `cancel` key in the hour the core answers `throttled` and the booking is unchanged (for the Owner's user key and for the guest's e-mail keys). S6 (cross-tenant): another customer's booking and another pro's booking get the not-found wording, and nothing changes; `spendableSeances` never mixes two pros. S43: the malformed-input cases (an extra key, a wrong type, `null`) are refused whole before any read.

```ts
dbTest("getCustomerSpace: a locked rendez-vous says who can still cancel it, and the wallet carries each type's class (LED:438, COV-I2)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  await db.update(schema.professional).set({ businessName: BUSINESS }).where(eq(schema.professional.id, pro.proId));
  const customerId = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  // A paid RDV in 5 hours with the default 24 h deadline: locked.
  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier" });
  const rdv = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, { startsAt: addMinutes(now, 5 * 60) });
  const bRdv = await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: rdv, customerId, status: "confirmed", coverage: "guest" });

  const linked = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours lié" });
  const orphan = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours orphelin" });
  const paidRdv = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Rendez-vous payant", rdvEnabled: true, rdvDurationMin: 60 });
  const old = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Ancien stage" });
  await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha", ticketTypeIds: [linked] }, now);
  for (const typeId of [linked, orphan, paidRdv, old]) await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 1);
  const archived = await setTicketTypeArchived(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, ticketTypeId: old, archived: true });
  assert.ok(archived.ok, JSON.stringify(archived));

  const space = await getCustomerSpace(db, pro.proId, customerId, now);
  assert.ok(space);
  const locked = space.upcoming.find((u) => u.bookingId === bRdv);
  assert.equal(locked?.coverage, "guest");
  assert.equal(locked?.cancellable, false);
  assert.equal(locked?.cancelText, "Seul(e) Altinha Test peut annuler maintenant.");
  assert.deepEqual(
    Object.fromEntries(space.wallet.map((w) => [w.name, w.typeClass])),
    {
      "Cours lié": "ok", // accepted by an upcoming tickets-mode event
      "Cours orphelin": "orphan", // no upcoming event accepts it and it is not a paid RDV type
      "Rendez-vous payant": "ok", // a paid RDV type needs no event
      "Ancien stage": "archived",
    },
  );
});
```

```ts
dbTest("spendableSeances: a lapsed hold of someone else frees the seat shown, a live hold of this customer excludes the séance", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);
  const me = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  await rowTicket(db, pro, { customerId: me, ticketTypeId: typeId });
  const stranger = await rowCustomer(db, pro);

  // One seat, held by someone else whose hold ran out 5 minutes ago and was not swept yet: the seat is shown free.
  const lapsedEvent = await rowEvent(db, pro, { capacity: 1 });
  await rowLink(db, pro, lapsedEvent, typeId);
  const lapsed = await rowSeance(db, pro, lapsedEvent, { startsAt: addDaysMs(now, 3), capacity: 1, seatsTaken: 1 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: lapsed,
    customerId: stranger,
    status: "pending",
    purchaseId: await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: stranger, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId }),
    holdExpiresAt: addMinutes(now, -5),
  });

  // Seats left, but this customer already holds one of them (a live hold): never offered twice.
  const heldEvent = await rowEvent(db, pro, { capacity: 5 });
  await rowLink(db, pro, heldEvent, typeId);
  const held = await rowSeance(db, pro, heldEvent, { startsAt: addDaysMs(now, 4), capacity: 5, seatsTaken: 1 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: held,
    customerId: me,
    status: "pending",
    purchaseId: await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId: me, offerId, ticketTypeId: typeId }),
    holdExpiresAt: addMinutes(now, 30),
  });

  const list = await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, me, now);
  assert.deepEqual(
    list.map((s) => s.occurrenceId),
    [lapsed],
  );
});

dbTest("spendableSeances: ticketTypeName is the type spent first, and a ticket that expires before the séance does not count", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const soon = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Carnet court" });
  const later = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Carnet long" });
  const never = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Sans limite" });
  const tooShort = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Expire avant la séance" });
  const {
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { ticketTypeIds: [soon, later, never, tooShort] }, now);

  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, never, 1);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, later, 1, { expiresAt: addDaysMs(now, 30) });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, soon, 1, { expiresAt: addDaysMs(now, 10) });
  // Soonest of all, but it ends a day before the séance (3 days ahead): not eligible, so not the one spent.
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, tooShort, 1, { expiresAt: addDaysMs(now, 1) });

  const [first] = await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, customerId, now);
  assert.equal(first?.occurrenceId, occ.id);
  assert.equal(first?.ticketTypeName, "Carnet court", "consumption order: soonest expiry first, no expiry last");

  const shortOnly = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, shortOnly, tooShort, 1, { expiresAt: addDaysMs(now, 1) });
  assert.deepEqual(await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, shortOnly, now), [], "a ticket that is not valid at the séance opens nothing");
});

dbTest("spendableSeances: at most `limit` séances (8 by default) and none beyond SPENDABLE_DAYS, even when the pro sells that far ahead", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  assert.equal(SPENDABLE_MAX, 8);
  assert.equal(SPENDABLE_DAYS, 60);
  await db.update(schema.professional).set({ bookingHorizonDays: 365 }).where(eq(schema.professional.id, pro.proId));
  const typeId = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, pro);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, customerId, typeId, 1);

  // A daily series of 10 séances from day 3, one séance 10 days inside the window, one 10 days beyond it.
  await makeEvent(
    db,
    pro,
    {
      ticketTypeIds: [typeId],
      rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 3, now), freq: "daily", interval: 1, endMode: "count", occurrenceCount: 10 },
    },
    now,
  );
  const inside = await makeEvent(
    db,
    pro,
    { title: "Inside", ticketTypeIds: [typeId], rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, SPENDABLE_DAYS - 10, now) } },
    now,
  );
  const beyond = await makeEvent(
    db,
    pro,
    { title: "Beyond", ticketTypeIds: [typeId], rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, SPENDABLE_DAYS + 10, now) } },
    now,
  );

  const all = await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, customerId, now, 50);
  assert.equal(all.length, 11, "10 of the series and the one inside the window");
  assert.ok(all.some((s) => s.occurrenceId === inside.occurrences[0].id));
  assert.ok(!all.some((s) => s.occurrenceId === beyond.occurrences[0].id), "bookable online, but beyond the 60 days of the espace");

  const byDefault = await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, customerId, now);
  assert.equal(byDefault.length, SPENDABLE_MAX);
  assert.deepEqual(
    byDefault.map((s) => s.occurrenceId),
    all.slice(0, SPENDABLE_MAX).map((s) => s.occurrenceId),
  );
  assert.equal((await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, customerId, now, 2)).length, 2);
  assert.equal((await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, customerId, now, 0)).length, 1, "a limit below 1 reads as 1");
});

dbTest("spendableSeances: another pro's customer, tickets and séances never mix with this pro's", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const mine = await eligibleFor(db, pro, now);
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const theirs = await eligibleFor(db, other, now);
    assert.deepEqual((await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, mine.customerId, now)).map((s) => s.occurrenceId), [mine.occurrenceId]);
    assert.deepEqual((await spendableSeances(db, other.proId, theirs.customerId, now)).map((s) => s.occurrenceId), [theirs.occurrenceId]);
    assert.deepEqual(await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, theirs.customerId, now), [], "their customer at my pro");
    assert.deepEqual(await spendableSeances(db, other.proId, mine.customerId, now), [], "my customer at their pro");
    assert.deepEqual(await spendableSeances(db, pro.proId, "unknown-customer", now), []);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import { bookWithHeldTicket } from "@/lib/booking/claims";
import { revokeLinks } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import * as schema from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { guestLinkKey, signGuestLink } from "@/lib/guest-link";
import { resolveVisitor } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { cancelMyBookingCore, spaceActorOf } from "@/lib/public/space-actions";
import { checkActionThrottle, type ThrottleSubject } from "@/lib/throttle";
import { ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, testEmail, type TestPro } from "@/test/db";
import { getBooking, giveTickets, makeCustomer, makeEvent, makeType, ticketsOf } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { actionVisitorOf, createTestClientUser, publicProOf, sessionOf, testIpHash } from "@/test/public";

const KEY = guestLinkKey("test-secret");

/* ───────────────────────── spaceActorOf (pure) ───────────────────────── */

const OWNER = { professionalId: "p1", customerId: "c-owner", userId: "u1", email: "beatriz@example.com" };

test("spaceActorOf: the Owner acts through the session, a cookie of another customer is ignored (L1370)", () => {
  const session = sessionOf({ userId: "u1", email: "beatriz@example.com" });
  const expected = { customerId: "c-owner", actorUserId: "u1", via: "session" };
  assert.deepEqual(spaceActorOf({ session, owner: OWNER, guestCustomerId: "c-cookie" }), expected);
  assert.deepEqual(spaceActorOf({ session, owner: OWNER, guestCustomerId: null }), expected);
});

test("spaceActorOf: a verified session without a record at this pro acts as nobody, a valid cookie included (S10)", () => {
  const session = sessionOf({ userId: "u2", email: "nobody@example.com" });
  assert.equal(spaceActorOf({ session, owner: null, guestCustomerId: "c-cookie" }), null);
});

test("spaceActorOf: an impersonating session acts as nobody, a valid cookie or an owner included (SEC-M6, Decision 19, S42)", () => {
  const session = sessionOf({ userId: "u1", email: "beatriz@example.com" }, { impersonated: true });
  assert.equal(spaceActorOf({ session, owner: null, guestCustomerId: "c-cookie" }), null);
  assert.equal(spaceActorOf({ session, owner: OWNER, guestCustomerId: null }), null);
});

test("spaceActorOf: an unverified or a signed-out visitor acts through the cookie customer, read and cancel only", () => {
  const unverified = sessionOf({ userId: "u3", email: "new@example.com" }, { verified: false });
  const guest = { customerId: "c-cookie", actorUserId: null, via: "guest" };
  assert.deepEqual(spaceActorOf({ session: unverified, owner: null, guestCustomerId: "c-cookie" }), guest);
  assert.deepEqual(spaceActorOf({ session: null, owner: null, guestCustomerId: "c-cookie" }), guest);
  assert.equal(spaceActorOf({ session: null, owner: null, guestCustomerId: null }), null);
  assert.equal(spaceActorOf({ session: unverified, owner: null, guestCustomerId: null }), null);
});

/* ───────────────────────── cancelMyBookingCore ───────────────────────── */

type Seat = { customerId: string; bookingId: string; occurrenceId: string; email: string };

/** A customer of `p` with a confirmed booking on a séance 3 days ahead, paid with a held ticket (bookWithHeldTicket). */
async function seatedBooking(db: Db, p: TestPro, opts: { now: Date; email?: string; actorUserId?: string }): Promise<Seat> {
  const email = opts.email ?? testEmail("seat");
  const typeId = await makeType(db, p, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const {
    occurrences: [occ],
  } = await makeEvent(db, p, { ticketTypeIds: [typeId] }, opts.now);
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(db, p, { email });
  await giveTickets(db, p, customerId, typeId, 1);
  const res = await bookWithHeldTicket(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: p.proId,
      occurrenceId: occ.id,
      customerId,
      seenStartsAt: occ.startsAt,
      actorUserId: opts.actorUserId ?? p.userId,
    },
    opts.now,
  );
  assert.equal(res.ok, true, JSON.stringify(res));
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("unreachable");
  return { customerId, bookingId: res.bookingId, occurrenceId: occ.id, email };
}

/** The error and code of a refused core result, with a failed assertion when it was not refused. */
function refusalOf(res: { ok: boolean; error?: string; code?: string }): { error: string | undefined; code: string | undefined } {
  assert.equal(res.ok, false, JSON.stringify(res));
  return { error: res.error, code: res.code };
}

dbTest("cancelMyBookingCore: the Owner cancels before the deadline: cancelled by the client, the ticket comes back, three effects", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const email = testEmail("owner");
  const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(db, { email, verified: true });
  try {
    const seat = await seatedBooking(db, pro, { now, email, actorUserId: userId });
    assert.deepEqual((await ticketsOf(db, seat.customerId)).map((t) => t.status), ["booked"]);
    const visitor = actionVisitorOf({
      session: sessionOf({ userId, email }),
      owner: { professionalId: pro.proId, customerId: seat.customerId, userId, email },
    });
    const publicPro = await publicProOf(db, pro);

    const res = await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, visitor, { bookingId: seat.bookingId }, now);
    assert.equal(res.ok, true, JSON.stringify(res));
    assert.deepEqual(res.effects, [
      { type: "email.booking_cancelled", bookingId: seat.bookingId, by: "client" },
      { type: "email.pro_booking_cancelled", bookingId: seat.bookingId },
      { type: "google.sync_occurrence", occurrenceId: seat.occurrenceId },
    ]);
    const booking = await getBooking(db, seat.bookingId);
    assert.equal(booking.status, "cancelled");
    assert.equal(booking.endedBy, "client");
    assert.deepEqual((await ticketsOf(db, seat.customerId)).map((t) => t.status), ["available"], "the ticket is given back");

    // A second submit finds nothing left to cancel and gives nothing back twice.
    const again = await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, visitor, { bookingId: seat.bookingId }, now);
    assert.equal(refusalOf(again).code, "too_late_or_done");
    assert.deepEqual(again.effects, []);
    assert.equal((await ticketsOf(db, seat.customerId)).length, 1);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, userId);
  }
});

dbTest("cancelMyBookingCore: after the deadline only the pro can cancel: the locked sentence, nothing changes", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const seat = await seatedBooking(db, pro, { now });
  // 240 hours of deadline against a séance 72 hours away: past the deadline, never changed, never moved.
  await db.update(schema.professional).set({ cancelDeadlineHours: 240 }).where(eq(schema.professional.id, pro.proId));
  const publicPro = await publicProOf(db, pro);

  const res = await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, actionVisitorOf({ guestCustomerId: seat.customerId }), { bookingId: seat.bookingId }, now);

});

dbTest("cancelMyBookingCore: another customer's booking and another pro's booking get the not-found wording and stay as they were", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const mineEmail = testEmail("mine");
  const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(db, { email: mineEmail, verified: true });
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const mine = await seatedBooking(db, pro, { now, email: mineEmail });
    const sibling = await seatedBooking(db, pro, { now });
    const theirs = await seatedBooking(db, other, { now });
    const publicPro = await publicProOf(db, pro);
    const owner = actionVisitorOf({
      session: sessionOf({ userId, email: mineEmail }),
      owner: { professionalId: pro.proId, customerId: mine.customerId, userId, email: mineEmail },
    });
    const notFound = { error: "Inscription introuvable : rafraîchissez la page.", code: "not_found" };

    // The Owner of one customer cannot cancel the booking of another customer of the same pro.
    assert.deepEqual(refusalOf(await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, owner, { bookingId: sibling.bookingId }, now)), notFound);
    // Nor a booking of another pro, whoever asks: the Owner, or a cookie customer of that other pro.
    assert.deepEqual(refusalOf(await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, owner, { bookingId: theirs.bookingId }, now)), notFound);
    const foreignCookie = actionVisitorOf({ guestCustomerId: theirs.customerId });
    assert.deepEqual(refusalOf(await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, foreignCookie, { bookingId: theirs.bookingId }, now)), notFound);
    assert.deepEqual(refusalOf(await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, actionVisitorOf({ guestCustomerId: "unknown" }), { bookingId: mine.bookingId }, now)), notFound);
    assert.deepEqual(refusalOf(await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, owner, { bookingId: "unknown-booking" }, now)), notFound);

    for (const id of [mine.bookingId, sibling.bookingId, theirs.bookingId]) {
      assert.equal((await getBooking(db, id)).status, "confirmed");
    }
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
    await deleteTestUser(db, userId);
  }
});

dbTest("cancelMyBookingCore: a revoked personal link cancels nothing, the new one works (S9)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const seat = await seatedBooking(db, pro, { now });
  const publicPro = await publicProOf(db, pro);
  const cookieVisitor = async (token: string) => {
    const visitor = await resolveVisitor(db, { session: null, guestToken: token, key: KEY }, { professionalId: pro.proId, ownerUserId: pro.userId });
    return { guestCustomerId: visitor.guestCustomerId, visitor: actionVisitorOf({ owner: visitor.owner, guestCustomerId: visitor.guestCustomerId }) };
  };

  const oldToken = signGuestLink({ customerId: seat.customerId, linkVersion: 1 }, KEY);
  assert.equal((await cookieVisitor(oldToken)).guestCustomerId, seat.customerId, "the link works until it is revoked");

  const revoked = await revokeLinks(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, customerId: seat.customerId });
  assert.equal(revoked.ok, true, JSON.stringify(revoked));
  const stale = await cookieVisitor(oldToken);
  assert.equal(stale.guestCustomerId, null, "the old cookie resolves to nobody");
  const refused = await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, stale.visitor, { bookingId: seat.bookingId }, now);
  assert.equal(refusalOf(refused).code, "not_found");
  assert.equal((await getBooking(db, seat.bookingId)).status, "confirmed");

  const fresh = await cookieVisitor(signGuestLink({ customerId: seat.customerId, linkVersion: 2 }, KEY));
  assert.equal(fresh.guestCustomerId, seat.customerId);
  const ok = await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, fresh.visitor, { bookingId: seat.bookingId }, now);
  assert.equal(ok.ok, true, JSON.stringify(ok));
});

dbTest("cancelMyBookingCore: after 10 hits on the actor's cancel key in the hour the core answers throttled and the booking is unchanged (S19)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const email = testEmail("throttled");
  const { userId } = await createTestClientUser(db, { email, verified: true });
  try {
    const publicPro = await publicProOf(db, pro);
    const throttled = { error: ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES.throttled, code: "throttled" };
    /** The 10 hits the hour allows, on fresh IP buckets so only the subject's keys fill up. */
    const burn = async (subject: ThrottleSubject) => {
      for (let hit = 1; hit <= 10; hit += 1) {
        const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
          db,
          { action: "cancel", professionalId: pro.proId, ipHash: testIpHash(), wideIpHash: null, subject },
          now,
        );
        assert.equal(allowed, true, `hit ${hit} of 10 is allowed`);
      }
    };

    // The Owner is keyed on the user id.
    const owned = await seatedBooking(db, pro, { now, email, actorUserId: userId });
    await burn({ kind: "user", userId });
    const owner = actionVisitorOf({
      session: sessionOf({ userId, email }),
      owner: { professionalId: pro.proId, customerId: owned.customerId, userId, email },
    });
    const res = await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, owner, { bookingId: owned.bookingId }, now);
    assert.deepEqual(refusalOf(res), throttled);
    assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
    assert.equal((await getBooking(db, owned.bookingId)).status, "confirmed");

    // The guest cookie customer is keyed on the customer's own address, never on the cookie.
    const guestSeat = await seatedBooking(db, pro, { now });
    await burn({ kind: "email", email: guestSeat.email });
    const guest = actionVisitorOf({ guestCustomerId: guestSeat.customerId });
    assert.deepEqual(refusalOf(await cancelMyBookingCore(db, publicPro, guest, { bookingId: guestSeat.bookingId }, now)), throttled);
    assert.equal((await getBooking(db, guestSeat.bookingId)).status, "confirmed");
    assert.deepEqual((await ticketsOf(db, guestSeat.customerId)).map((t) => t.status), ["booked"]);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, userId);
  }
});

dbTest("cancelMyBookingCore: a malformed input is refused whole, in French, before anything is read (S43)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const publicPro = await publicProOf(db, pro);
  // A database that fails on any use: every refusal below must come from the parse, before the first read.
  const noDb = new Proxy({}, {
    get() {
      throw new Error("the database was used");
    },
  }) as unknown as Db;
  const visitor = actionVisitorOf({ guestCustomerId: "c-cookie" });
  const refused = async (input: unknown): Promise<string | undefined> => {
    const res = await cancelMyBookingCore(noDb, publicPro, visitor, input, now);
    assert.deepEqual(res.effects, []);
    return refusalOf(res).error;
  };
  assert.equal(await refused({ bookingId: "b1", extra: 1 }), "Champ inattendu.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ bookingId: "b1", website: ["x"] }), "Champ inattendu.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ bookingId: "b1", slug: "another-page" }), "Champ inattendu.", "the slug is split off by the wrapper, never read here");
  assert.equal(await refused({ bookingId: 5 }), "Ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ bookingId: "" }), "Ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(await refused({}), "Ce champ est obligatoire.");
  assert.equal(await refused({ bookingId: "x".repeat(65) }), "64 caractères au maximum.");
  assert.equal(await refused(null), "Valeur invalide.");
  assert.equal(await refused("b1"), "Valeur invalide.");
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Implement the espace read**

Replace the whole content of `src/lib/back-office/customer-space.ts` (Write) with:

```ts
/**
 * Espace of one customer at one pro (spec § 12, Q22): what is booked, whether it can still be cancelled online, and
 * what is left in the wallet. P3 showed it read-only; P4 adds the cancel and spend actions on top of this read. No
 * `server-only`, no env, no process db.
 *
 * Every statement filters `professional_id` AND `customer_id`: the id of the customer comes from a link or a
 * session, so it is only a claim until this read has checked that the customer is this pro's.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, gt, inArray, isNull, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { formatWhen, formatWhenShort } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { groupWallet, type WalletTicketRow, type WalletTypeRow } from "@/lib/back-office/wallet-view";
import { loadTypeFacts } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import { clientCanCancel, clientCancelDeadline } from "@/lib/cancellation";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, customer, event, occurrence, professional, ticket, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { cancelLockedText } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { COVERAGE_LABELS, type BookingCoverage } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { classifyTypes, type TypeClass } from "@/lib/wallet-rules";

export type CustomerSpace = {
  /** the pro's business name: the locked cancellation sentence and the archived-type note name it */
  businessName: string;
  customer: { id: string; name: string; email: string };
  upcoming: {
    bookingId: string;
    title: string;
    whenLabel: string;
    location: string | null;
    coverage: BookingCoverage;
    coverageLabel: string;
    /** cancelTextOf(…) !== null: clientCanCancel allows it now (before the deadline, or after a pro change or a move) */
    cancellable: boolean;
    /** cancelTextOf(…) when cancellable (its séance or rendez-vous wording kept), else « Seul(e) {pro} peut annuler maintenant. » (L921) */
    cancelText: string;
  }[];
  wallet: {
    ticketTypeId: string;
    name: string;
    color: string;
    archived: boolean;
    /** orphan = no upcoming event accepts the type and it is not a paid RDV type; archived; else ok (the rules of the client list alerts) */
    typeClass: TypeClass;
    usable: number;
    expiries: string[];
  }[];
};

/**
 * The online cancellation hint of one booking; null when the client can no longer cancel online (getCustomerSpace then
 * gives the locked sentence). A rendez-vous is called a rendez-vous, a séance a séance.
 */
export function cancelTextOf(
  b: { startsAt: Date; bookingCreatedAt: Date; changedAt: Date | null; movedAt: Date | null },
  deadlineHours: number,
  now: Date,
  tz: string,
  kind: "seance" | "rdv",
): string | null {
  const check = clientCanCancel({
    startsAt: b.startsAt,
    now,
    deadlineHours,
    bookingCreatedAt: b.bookingCreatedAt,
    occurrenceChangedAt: b.changedAt,
    movedAt: b.movedAt,
  });
  if (!check.allowed) return null;
  if (check.reason === "before_deadline") {
    return `Annulation en ligne possible jusqu'au ${formatWhenShort(clientCancelDeadline(b.startsAt, deadlineHours), tz)}.`;
  }
  return `Annulation en ligne possible jusqu'au début ${kind === "rdv" ? "du rendez-vous" : "de la séance"}.`;
}

/**
 * Confirmed bookings on scheduled future occurrences (soonest first) and the
 * usable tickets by type with their expiries and type class; null when the
 * customer is not this pro's. A pending booking (a seat hold, live or lapsed) is
 * not a booking yet, so only `confirmed` rows are read. Dates are formatted in
 * the PRO's time zone.
 */
export async function getCustomerSpace(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<CustomerSpace | null> {
  const [owner] = await db
    .select({
      id: customer.id,
      name: customer.name,
      email: customer.email,
      tz: professional.timezone,
      businessName: professional.businessName,
      cancelHours: professional.cancelDeadlineHours,
    })
    .from(customer)
    .innerJoin(professional, eq(professional.id, customer.professionalId))
    .where(and(eq(customer.id, customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId)));
  if (!owner) return null;

  const [bookings, tickets, typeFacts] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        bookingId: booking.id,
        coverage: booking.coverage,
        bookingCreatedAt: booking.createdAt,
        movedAt: booking.movedAt,
        startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
        endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
        changedAt: occurrence.changedAt,
        eventId: occurrence.eventId,
        title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name})`,
        location: sql<string | null>`coalesce(${occurrence.locationOverride}, ${event.location})`,
        cancelHours: sql<number | null>`coalesce(${event.cancelDeadlineHours}, ${ticketType.rdvCancelDeadlineHours})`,
      })
      .from(booking)
      .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
      .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
      .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
      .where(
        and(
          eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(booking.customerId, customerId),
          eq(booking.status, "confirmed"),
          eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(occurrence.status, "scheduled"),
          gt(occurrence.startsAt, now),
        ),
      )
      .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(booking.id)),
    db
      .select({
        id: ticket.id,
        ticketTypeId: ticket.ticketTypeId,
        status: ticket.status,
        expiresAt: ticket.expiresAt,
        purchaseId: ticket.purchaseId,
        closedReason: ticket.closedReason,
        closedNote: ticket.closedNote,
        statusChangedAt: ticket.statusChangedAt,
        createdAt: ticket.createdAt,
      })
      .from(ticket)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(ticket.professionalId, professionalId),
          eq(ticket.customerId, customerId),
          eq(ticket.status, "available"),
          or(isNull(ticket.expiresAt), gt(ticket.expiresAt, now)),
        ),
      ),
    // The same type facts as the client list alerts (an rdv_free type is not RDV-enabled there): no second rule.
    loadTypeFacts(db, professionalId, now),
  ]);
  const classes = classifyTypes(typeFacts);

  const typeIds = [...new Set(tickets.map((t) => t.ticketTypeId))];
  const typeRows =
    typeIds.length === 0
      ? []
      : await db
          .select({ id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, color: ticketType.color, archivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt })
          .from(ticketType)
          .where(and(eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId), inArray(ticketType.id, typeIds)))
          .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.createdAt), asc(ticketType.id));
  // Archived types are passed too: a client still holds their tickets (flagged "archived").
  const types: WalletTypeRow[] = typeRows.map((t) => ({
    id: t.id,
    name: t.name,
    color: t.color,
    archived: t.archivedAt !== null,
  }));
  const walletRows: WalletTicketRow[] = tickets.map((t) => ({ ...t, bookingStartsAt: null }));

  return {
    businessName: owner.businessName,
    customer: { id: owner.id, name: owner.name, email: owner.email },
    upcoming: bookings.map((b) => {
      const hint = cancelTextOf(b, b.cancelHours ?? owner.cancelHours, now, owner.tz, b.eventId === null ? "rdv" : "seance");
      return {
        bookingId: b.bookingId,
        title: b.title,
        whenLabel: formatWhen(b.startsAt, b.endsAt, owner.tz),
        location: b.location && b.location.trim() !== "" ? b.location : null,
        coverage: b.coverage,
        coverageLabel: COVERAGE_LABELS[b.coverage],
        cancellable: hint !== null,
        cancelText: hint ?? cancelLockedText(owner.businessName),
      };
    }),
    wallet: groupWallet(walletRows, types, classes, now, owner.tz).map((g) => ({
      ticketTypeId: g.ticketTypeId,
      name: g.name,
      color: g.color,
      archived: g.archived,
      typeClass: classes.get(g.ticketTypeId) ?? (g.archived ? "archived" : "ok"),
      usable: g.usableCount,
      expiries: g.expirySummary,
    })),
  };
}
```

Everything of `getCustomerSpace` except four additions is the P3 code as it stands at `1954782` (`git diff` shows exactly these: `businessName` in the owner select, the `loadTypeFacts` read in the `Promise.all`, `coverage` / `cancellable` / `cancelText` in `upcoming`, `typeClass` in `wallet`, and the real `classes` passed to `groupWallet` instead of `new Map()`).

- [ ] **Step 7: Implement `spendableSeances`**

Create `src/lib/public/spendable.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * « Utiliser vos tickets » (spec L1386-1387, Decision 18): the séances a wallet owner can book right now with a ticket
 * they already hold. One read of the rule the engine asserts when the booking is made (bookWithHeldTicket: ONLINE_OK,
 * the free seat, no booking of this customer yet, an ELIGIBLE ticket), so a listed séance is one the engine accepts. Every
 * table is reached through this pro's `professional_id` and this customer's id: another pro's customer or tickets find
 * nothing. No `server-only`, no env, no process db: the espace page passes `db`.
 */
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { formatWhen } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { ELIGIBLE } from "@/lib/booking/eligibility";
import { ts, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";

/** The most séances « Utiliser vos tickets » lists. */
export const SPENDABLE_MAX = 8;
/** The horizon of the list, in days from now (the pro's own horizon may be shorter, never longer here). */
export const SPENDABLE_DAYS = 60;

export type SpendableSeance = {
  occurrenceId: string;
  title: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  /** ISO instant, the `seenStartsAt` to post with the booking */
  startsAt: string;
  /** the type that would be spent first (consumption order) */
  ticketTypeName: string;
  /** the event has questions: the espace links to the séance page instead of booking in place */
  needsAnswers: boolean;
};

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
/** A caller never reads more than this many rows, whatever it asks for. */
const HARD_LIMIT = 50;

type Row = {
  occurrence_id: string;
  title: string;
  starts_at: string;
  ends_at: string;
  tz: string;
  ticket_type_name: string;
  needs_answers: boolean;
};

/**
 * Public tickets-mode séances of the next SPENDABLE_DAYS open online now (scheduled, not private, not archived, the
 * notice and the local-date horizon with the event's overrides, no overlapping time off: the ONLINE_OK twin of
 * src/lib/booking/claims.ts), a SHOWN seat free (capacity minus seats taken plus the elapsed holds not yet released:
 * seatsShown, holds.ts), no active booking of this customer (confirmed, or a live hold), and an ELIGIBLE ticket of
 * theirs (valid at the séance, accepted by the event, type not archived). Soonest first, at most `limit` (default
 * SPENDABLE_MAX, never above 50, never below 1). `ticketTypeName` is the type spent first (soonest expiry, no expiry
 * last, oldest, id: the order of pickTicket) and `needsAnswers` says whether the event has questions.
 */
export async function spendableSeances(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
  limit: number = SPENDABLE_MAX,
): Promise<SpendableSeance[]> {
  const cap = Number.isFinite(limit) ? Math.max(1, Math.min(Math.trunc(limit), HARD_LIMIT)) : SPENDABLE_MAX;
  const until = new Date(now.getTime() + SPENDABLE_DAYS * DAY_MS);
  const res = await db.execute<Row>(sql`
    select o.id as occurrence_id, e.title, o.starts_at, o.ends_at, p.timezone as tz,
      (select tt.name from ticket t join ticket_type tt on tt.id = t.ticket_type_id
        where t.customer_id = ${customerId} and t.professional_id = o.professional_id and ${ELIGIBLE}
        order by t.expires_at asc nulls last, t.created_at, t.id
        limit 1) as ticket_type_name,
      exists (select 1 from question q where q.event_id = e.id) as needs_answers
    from occurrence o
    join event e on e.id = o.event_id
    join professional p on p.id = o.professional_id
    where o.professional_id = ${professionalId}
      and exists (select 1 from customer c where c.id = ${customerId} and c.professional_id = o.professional_id)
      and o.status = 'scheduled' and e.booking_mode = 'tickets' and not e.is_private and e.archived_at is null
      and o.starts_at >= ${ts(now)} + make_interval(mins => coalesce(e.min_notice_minutes, p.min_notice_minutes))
      and o.starts_at < ${ts(until)}
      and (o.starts_at at time zone p.timezone)::date
          <= (${ts(now)} at time zone p.timezone)::date + coalesce(e.booking_horizon_days, p.booking_horizon_days)
      and not exists (select 1 from time_off toff where toff.professional_id = o.professional_id
                      and toff.start_at < o.ends_at and toff.end_at > o.starts_at)
      and o.capacity - o.seats_taken
          + (select count(*)::int from booking h
             where h.occurrence_id = o.id and h.status = 'pending' and h.hold_expires_at < ${ts(now)}) > 0
      and not exists (select 1 from booking b
                      where b.occurrence_id = o.id and b.customer_id = ${customerId}
                        and (b.status = 'confirmed' or (b.status = 'pending' and b.hold_expires_at >= ${ts(now)})))
      and exists (select 1 from ticket t join ticket_type tt on tt.id = t.ticket_type_id
                  where t.customer_id = ${customerId} and t.professional_id = o.professional_id and ${ELIGIBLE})
    order by o.starts_at, o.id
    limit ${cap}::int`);
  return res.rows.map((r) => {
    const startsAt = new Date(r.starts_at);
    const endsAt = new Date(r.ends_at);
    return {
      occurrenceId: r.occurrence_id,
      title: r.title,
      whenLabel: formatWhen(startsAt, endsAt, r.tz),
      startsAt: startsAt.toISOString(),
      ticketTypeName: r.ticket_type_name,
      needsAnswers: r.needs_answers === true,
    };
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Implement the cancel core**

Create `src/lib/public/space-actions.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The cancel core of the client espace (spec E5, L904-924) and the rule that says who acts there. A public core: it
 * parses the WHOLE input first, takes the identity from the server-built visitor (never from the input), spends a
 * `cancel` throttle hit before the engine call, then cancelByClient with the pro of the page. No `server-only`, no env,
 * no process db: src/server/client.ts is the thin wrapper.
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import { cancelByClient } from "@/lib/booking/cancel";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import type { ActionVisitor, PublicPro } from "@/lib/public/context";
import { customerEmailOf, visitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { fromEngineClient, fromParse, publicFail, publicOk, type PublicCoreResult } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { checkActionThrottle, type ThrottleSubject } from "@/lib/throttle";
import { ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES, idSchema } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

/** Who acts in the espace: the Owner through the session (a user id to record), or a cookie customer (no user). */
export type SpaceActor = { customerId: string; actorUserId: string | null; via: "session" | "guest" };

/**
 * Who acts in this pro's espace, in this order: an impersonating session is nobody (the cookie is ignored too,
 * SEC-M6, Decision 19); the Owner; a verified session WITHOUT a record here is nobody (the cookie is ignored, L1370);
 * else the guest cookie customer (L1368, read and cancel only: the cookie can be planted, so it never spends).
 */
export function spaceActorOf(visitor: Pick<ActionVisitor, "session" | "owner" | "guestCustomerId">): SpaceActor | null {
  const state = visitorState(visitor.session);
  if (state === "impersonating") return null;
  if (visitor.owner) return { customerId: visitor.owner.customerId, actorUserId: visitor.owner.userId, via: "session" };
  if (state === "verified") return null;
  if (visitor.guestCustomerId) return { customerId: visitor.guestCustomerId, actorUserId: null, via: "guest" };
  return null;
}

/** The only field of a cancellation; strict, so a smuggled key (customerId, professionalId, slug) is refused whole (SEC-M15). */
export const cancelMyInputSchema = z.object({ bookingId: idSchema }).strict();

/**
 * E5, « Annuler » in the espace: parse; the actor (nobody → the not-found wording); the throttle subject (the Owner's
 * user id, or the cookie customer's own address: never the cookie, never a typed address); `checkActionThrottle`
 * `cancel` BEFORE the engine call (refused → `throttled`, nothing changes, SEC-I2); cancelByClient for the pro of the
 * page and the actor's customer, so a booking of another customer or of another pro is `not_found`.
 */
export async function cancelMyBookingCore(
  db: Db,
  pro: PublicPro,
  visitor: ActionVisitor,
  input: unknown,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicCoreResult> {
  const parsed = parseFr(cancelMyInputSchema, input);
  if (!parsed.ok) return fromParse(parsed);
  const vars = { businessName: pro.businessName };
  const notFound = () => fromEngineClient({ ok: false, code: "not_found" }, "cancel", vars);

  const actor = spaceActorOf(visitor);
  if (!actor) return notFound();

  let subject: ThrottleSubject;
  if (actor.via === "session" && actor.actorUserId !== null) {
    subject = { kind: "user", userId: actor.actorUserId };
  } else {
    const email = await customerEmailOf(db, pro.professionalId, actor.customerId);
    if (email === null) return notFound();
    subject = { kind: "email", email };
  }
  const allowed = await checkActionThrottle(
    db,
    { action: "cancel", professionalId: pro.professionalId, ipHash: visitor.ipHash, wideIpHash: visitor.wideIpHash, subject },
    now,
  );
  if (!allowed) return publicFail(ENGINE_ERROR_MESSAGES.throttled, { code: "throttled" });

  const res = await cancelByClient(
    db,
    {
      professionalId: pro.professionalId,
      customerId: actor.customerId,
      bookingId: parsed.data.bookingId,
      actorUserId: actor.actorUserId,
    },
    now,
  );
  if (!res.ok) return fromEngineClient(res, "cancel", vars);
  return publicOk({}, res.effects);
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/back-office/guest-access.ts
export type GuestCustomerRow = { customerId: string; linkVersion: number; slug: string; businessName: string; proSuspended: boolean };
export type GuestLinkDecision =
  | { kind: "not_found" }
  | { kind: "stale"; slug: string; businessName: string }
  | { kind: "ok"; slug: string; customerId: string; businessName: string };
// src/lib/back-office/guest-link-page.ts (pure)

/** The response headers of that page (added to the contract's declarations so the policy is testable). */
export const GUEST_LINK_PAGE_HEADERS: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
// src/app/api/c/[token]/route.ts
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";
export async function GET(request: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ token: string }> }): Promise<Response>;
export async function POST(request: Request, ctx: { params: Promise<{ token: string }> }): Promise<Response>;
// src/server/client.ts ("use server")
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S41 (SEC-I4, Decision 68): `guest-link-page.test.ts` (no script, one POST form, everything escaped) and the source guards of `guest-access.test.ts` (the GET sets no cookie; the POST checks the origin before reading anything and sets the cookie on the `ok` branch only); the curl checks of Step 11 (GET without `Set-Cookie`, POST without `Origin` gives 403).
- S52 (FR:SEC-7, P3 Task 41 ruling): `guest-access.test.ts` (the route and `client.ts` build the cookie with `guestCookieOptions` and spell no attribute; the GET and stale branches set none); Step 11 (no `Set-Cookie` on GET or on a stale link).

Design notes (read before coding):
- Why a confirmation page. P3 set the `skedul_guest` cookie on the GET of `/api/c/<token>`. A cross-site navigation, a mail scanner or a forwarded link could then plant an identity in a browser that never clicked (login CSRF, LED:438, SEC-I4). Now the GET only decides and shows « Ouvrir mon espace chez {businessName} » with one POST form; the same-origin POST re-checks the link (MAC, customer row, `SLUG_SHAPE`, current `link_version`) and only then sets the cookie. The token is a credential: it is never logged, and the GET page posts to its own path.
- The page's `Referrer-Policy` is `strict-origin`, not the contract's `no-referrer`. The policy of the document that holds a form also decides the `Origin` header of its POST: with `no-referrer`, browsers send `Origin: null` on that same-origin POST (Fetch spec, "append a request Origin header"), which `sameOrigin` must refuse, so the contract's own browser check (click « Ouvrir mon espace ») would answer 403. `strict-origin` sends only the origin as `Referer` (the token never leaves the page in a `Referer`) and keeps `Origin` intact. `GUEST_LINK_PAGE_HEADERS` pins it in a pure test with this reason.
- In dev the route compares `Origin` with `env.APP_URL`; `.env.development.local` of the worktree sets `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` / `BETTER_AUTH_URL` to `http://localhost:3102`, the port of the `skedul-tickets` server. The `.env.local` value (`:3000`) is for `next build` only.
- A stale link is not an error page: GET and POST both answer 303 to `/{slug}/espace?lien=invalide` and touch no cookie (P3 Task 41 ruling: the cookie is scoped to `/{slug}`, the route cannot tell whose it would delete).
- `forgetGuestLinkAction` reads nothing but the slug (checked by `runPublicAction`: `SLUG_PARAM_RE`, an unknown or suspended pro gives `COPY.PAGE_GONE`); an extra key changes nothing. The cookie is cleared with the very attributes that set it (`guestCookieOptions(pro.slug, production)`, path included) plus `maxAge: 0`, so the browser drops that cookie and no other.
- The guest note « Vous consultez l'espace de … avec un lien personnel. » and the « Ce n'est pas moi » button are rendered by the espace page and `ForgetGuestLinkButton`, which Task 22 creates; contract § 7 lists them in this task's browser check, but nothing in this task renders them. Step 11 checks the page and the cookie; Task 22's browser check exercises the button end to end.

```ts
const ROUTE = "src/app/api/c/[token]/route.ts";

/** The text of `export async function <name>(` up to the next doc comment or export, so a neighbouring handler's comment never leaks in. */
function handlerOf(source: string, name: string): string {
  const start = source.indexOf(`export async function ${name}(`);
  assert.notEqual(start, -1, `${name} is exported`);
  const rest = source.slice(start + 1);
  const end = rest.search(/\n(?:\/\*\*|export )/);
  return end === -1 ? source.slice(start) : source.slice(start, start + 1 + end);
}

test("the personal-link GET only decides and shows the confirmation page: no cookie, no write (Decision 68, S41, S52)", () => {
  const get = handlerOf(readFileSync(ROUTE, "utf8"), "GET");
  assert.doesNotMatch(get, /cookies\.set|Set-Cookie|GUEST_COOKIE/i, "a GET never plants an identity");
  assert.match(get, /guestLinkPageHtml\(\{ businessName: decision\.businessName, actionPath: `\/api\/c\/\$\{encodeURIComponent\(token\)\}` \}\)/);
  assert.match(get, /headers: GUEST_LINK_PAGE_HEADERS/);
  assert.match(get, /decision\.kind === "stale"/, "a stale link redirects and touches no cookie");
});

test("the personal-link POST checks the origin first, re-checks the link, and sets the cookie on the ok branch only (S41)", () => {
  const route = readFileSync(ROUTE, "utf8");
  const post = handlerOf(route, "POST");
  const origin = post.indexOf('sameOrigin(request.headers.get("origin"), env.APP_URL)');
  const resolve = post.indexOf("resolveGuestLink(");
  const notFound = post.indexOf('decision.kind === "not_found"');
  const stale = post.indexOf('decision.kind === "stale"');
  const set = post.indexOf("cookies.set(");
  assert.ok(origin !== -1 && origin < resolve, "the same-origin check comes before the link is read");
  assert.match(post.slice(origin, resolve), /forbidden\(\)/, "a foreign or missing Origin is refused with 403");
  assert.ok(resolve < notFound && notFound < stale && stale < set, "not found, then stale, then the cookie");
  assert.equal((route.match(/cookies\.set\(/g) ?? []).length, 1, "the route writes one cookie, in the POST");
});

test("« Ce n'est pas moi » clears the cookie with the attributes of guestCookieOptions and writes nothing to the database (S52)", () => {
  const client = readFileSync("src/server/client.ts", "utf8");
  const action = handlerOf(client, "forgetGuestLinkAction");
  assert.match(action, /runPublicAction\(/);
  assert.match(action, /\(await cookies\(\)\)\.set\(GUEST_COOKIE, "", \{ \.\.\.guestCookieOptions\(pro\.slug, process\.env\.NODE_ENV === "production"\), maxAge: 0 \}\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(client, /httpOnly|sameSite/, "no attribute is spelled out in client.ts");
  assert.doesNotMatch(action, /\bdb\b/, "no database access");
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create `src/lib/back-office/guest-link-page.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * The page a valid personal link answers on GET (Decision 68, SEC-I4): « Ouvrir mon espace chez {businessName} » with
 * one POST form. Pure and script-free. A mail scanner, a prefetch or a cross-site navigation that merely opens the
 * link plants nothing; only a same-origin click on the button does, because the route sets the cookie on the POST.
 * Every value is escaped and the page links nowhere. French, vouvoiement, no dash.
 */
import { escapeHtml } from "@/lib/email-layout";

/**
 * The response headers of that page. The referrer policy is `strict-origin`, not `no-referrer`: the policy of the
 * document that holds a form also decides the `Origin` header of its POST, and `no-referrer` makes browsers send
 * `Origin: null` on that same-origin POST, which the route's same-origin check must refuse. `strict-origin` sends
 * only the origin as `Referer` (the token, which is in this page's path, never leaves it) and keeps `Origin` intact.
 * The CSP allows the inline style and nothing else: no script, no image, no framing, forms to this site only.
 */
export const GUEST_LINK_PAGE_HEADERS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  "Cache-Control": "no-store",
  "Referrer-Policy": "strict-origin",
  "Content-Security-Policy": "default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'",
  "X-Frame-Options": "DENY",
  "X-Robots-Tag": "noindex",
};

/** One centred column of at most 28rem; the button is full width below 640 px. The violet is the accent text colour of the site (7:1 on white). */
const STYLE = [
  "*{box-sizing:border-box}",
  "body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#fafafa;color:#18181b;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}",
  "main{width:100%;max-width:28rem;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 1rem;text-align:center}",
  ".card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e7e7ee;border-radius:1rem;padding:1.5rem;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}",
  "h1{font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 .75rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}",
  "p{margin:0 0 1.25rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}",
  ".hint{font-size:.875rem;color:#52525b;margin:1rem 0 0}",
  "button{font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;border:0;border-radius:.75rem;background:#4c3ed9;color:#fff;padding:.75rem 1.5rem;min-height:2.75rem}",
  "button:hover{background:#4033b8}",
  "button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8b7cf6;outline-offset:2px}",
  "@media (max-width:640px){button{width:100%}}",
].join("");

/** The page a valid personal link answers on GET: no script, every value escaped, one POST form to `actionPath`. */
export function guestLinkPageHtml(a: { businessName: string; actionPath: string }): string {
  const name = escapeHtml(a.businessName);
  const action = escapeHtml(a.actionPath);
  return [
    "<!doctype html>",
    '<html lang="fr">',
    "<head>",
    '<meta charset="utf-8">',
    '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">',
    '<meta name="robots" content="noindex">',
    "<title>Ouvrir mon espace</title>",
    `<style>${STYLE}</style>`,
    "</head>",
    "<body>",
    "<main>",
    '<div class="card">',
    `<h1>Ouvrir mon espace chez ${name}</h1>`,
    `<p>Ce lien personnel donne accès à vos réservations et à vos tickets chez ${name}.</p>`,
    `<form method="post" action="${action}">`,
    '<button type="submit">Ouvrir mon espace</button>',
    "</form>",
    "</div>",
    '<p class="hint">Vous n\'attendiez pas ce lien ? Fermez simplement cette page.</p>',
    "</main>",
    "</body>",
    "</html>",
  ].join("\n");
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Rewrite the route**

Replace the whole content of `src/app/api/c/[token]/route.ts` (Write) with:

```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

import { guestCookieOptions, resolveGuestLink } from "@/lib/back-office/guest-access";
import { GUEST_LINK_PAGE_HEADERS, guestLinkPageHtml } from "@/lib/back-office/guest-link-page";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { GUEST_COOKIE } from "@/lib/guest-link";
import { sameOrigin } from "@/lib/same-origin";
import { guestKey } from "@/server/guest-key";

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

const NO_STORE = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } as const;

/** The same answer for a bad MAC, an unknown customer and a suspended pro: nothing to learn from it. */
function notFound(): Response {
  return new Response("Not found", { status: 404, headers: NO_STORE });
}

/** A POST that did not come from this site's own page: nothing is read and nothing is set. */
function forbidden(): Response {
  return new Response("Forbidden", { status: 403, headers: NO_STORE });
}

/** The 303 of both methods (the P3 shape). It carries no cookie; the one handler that sets one does it on the result. */
function seeOther(request: Request, path: string): NextResponse {
  const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(path, request.url), 303);
  res.headers.set("Cache-Control", "no-store");
  return res;
}

/**
 * Personal link of a client e-mail (spec § 12, Decision 68): a valid link only shows the confirmation page, whose
 * button POSTs back here. Nothing is written and no cookie is set, so a mail scanner, a prefetch or a cross-site
 * navigation cannot plant an identity. A revoked link says so (303 to ?lien=invalide, Q21) and touches no cookie: the
 * cookie is scoped to /<slug>, so the browser never sends it here, this route could not tell whose it would delete,
 * and anyone could wipe a victim's valid cookie by making them open a revoked link. The redirect target is the slug of
 * the customer's own pro, read from the database; the token is a credential and is never logged.
 */
export async function GET(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ token: string }> }): Promise<Response> {
  const { token } = await params;

  const decision = await resolveGuestLink(db, token, guestKey());
  if (decision.kind === "not_found") return notFound();
  if (decision.kind === "stale") return seeOther(request, `/${decision.slug}/espace?lien=invalide`);

  return new Response(
    guestLinkPageHtml({ businessName: decision.businessName, actionPath: `/api/c/${encodeURIComponent(token)}` }),
    { status: 200, headers: GUEST_LINK_PAGE_HEADERS },
  );
}

/**
 * The click on the confirmation page. Route handlers get no automatic origin check, so the Origin header is compared
 * with the site's own origin before anything is read; the link is then resolved again (MAC, customer row, address
 * segment, current link version) and only an `ok` decision sets the skedul_guest cookie and sends the client to their
 * espace (303). A stale link and an unknown one behave as on GET.
 */
export async function POST(request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ token: string }> }): Promise<Response> {
  if (!sameOrigin(request.headers.get("origin"), env.APP_URL)) return forbidden();

  const { token } = await params;
  const decision = await resolveGuestLink(db, token, guestKey());
  if (decision.kind === "not_found") return notFound();
  if (decision.kind === "stale") return seeOther(request, `/${decision.slug}/espace?lien=invalide`);

  const res = seeOther(request, `/${decision.slug}/espace`);
  res.cookies.set(GUEST_COOKIE, token, guestCookieOptions(decision.slug, process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"));
  return res;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * « Ce n'est pas moi » (Task 21a, Decision 63): clears the personal-link cookie of this pro's path. The attributes come
 * from guestCookieOptions (FR:SEC-7), path included, so the browser drops the very cookie the link set; nothing else is
 * read and nothing is written to the database. Only the slug of the input is used (runPublicAction checks it).
 */
export async function forgetGuestLinkAction(input: { slug: string }): Promise<PublicResult> {
  const { slug } = splitActionInput(input);
  return runPublicAction("forgetGuestLink", slug, async (pro) => {
    (await cookies()).set(GUEST_COOKIE, "", { ...guestCookieOptions(pro.slug, process.env.NODE_ENV === "production"), maxAge: 0 });
    return publicOk({});
  });
}
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S38 (part, with Tasks 5 and 17): a signed-in unverified visitor never gets the code sign-in form. Pinned by `espace-ui.test.ts` (the form sits behind `canOfferCodeSignIn(visitorState)` and after every other identity branch) and by the browser check (the unverified account sees the banner, no « Email » field).

Design notes (read before coding):
- Load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing the JSX (project rule). Everything here sits inside `PublicShell` and keeps the existing card system, `lucide-react` icons and `INLINE_LINK_CLASS`; muted text is `text-zinc-600`, the brand never colours text, no `text-primary` for text. Every text of the pro or of the client (titles, names, places, e-mail) gets `wrap-anywhere` and `min-w-0`.
- Identity (contract § 1, § 9 rows 1 and 2): the page reads the visitor only through `resolveSpaceCustomer(pro)` (the request's `currentPublicVisitor`, fresh session, suspended user = no session) and passes strings to client leaves, never a customer id, a user id or a row. Spending is the Owner's (`visitorState === "verified"` with a record): an anonymous visitor holding only the personal-link cookie gets the sign-in dialog with an EMPTY address (Decision 7, the cookie can be planted by someone else), an unverified one gets a disabled button described by `COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_TO_SPEND`, an impersonating admin gets no control at all. `spendControlOf` enforces it even when `canSpend` is wrong: « book » needs `canSpend` AND `visitorState === "verified"`.
- A success removes the control that was clicked (the booking leaves « Vos prochaines inscriptions », the séance leaves « Utiliser vos tickets »): the action revalidates the page, so the row, its component and its state are gone before a line written inside it could be read. Hence `SpaceStatusProvider`: one client component above the cards owns the always-mounted `role="status"` line, the leaves announce into it, and the focus goes to the « Vos prochaines inscriptions » heading (`id="espace-upcoming"`, `tabIndex={-1}`), the one heading that is always rendered (the « Utiliser vos tickets » card disappears with its last séance, so it cannot be the target). The cancel dialog hands the focus there through `returnFocusTo`, which `Dialog` calls whether the dialog closes or unmounts with its row (WCAG 2.4.3, P3 `5c69d89`). Its callback (stable, `useCallback`, the P3 `event-delete-card.tsx` pattern) answers the heading once « Annuler l'inscription » was clicked (a flag set BEFORE the action is awaited, so it already holds if the revalidated page unmounts the row before the answer is read; a refusal clears it), and `null` otherwise, so « Retour », Escape or « Fermer » give the focus back to the « Annuler » button that opened the dialog (`restoreTarget` falls back to the opener). The spend button, which has no dialog, focuses the heading itself.
- `CustomerSpaceView` renders client leaves that import Server Actions (`server-only`, the process db), so node:test cannot load it. Its P3 markup tests (`renderToStaticMarkup`) become source pins in the P3 pattern of `final-review-ui.test.ts`; the decisions the leaves apply live in `space-view.ts` and are tested as values. Task 21 changes the `CustomerSpace` type (`businessName`, `coverage`, `cancellable`, `typeClass`): whether or not it patched the `space()` factory of this test file to keep `tsc` green, Step 1 replaces the file whole.
- The page keeps the branches Task 5 added (impersonating, unverified) and adds the code form, the guest note and the spend section. An unverified visitor with a personal-link cookie sees the read-only space of that customer (guest note, cancel allowed, spend disabled) under the banner; `COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_FIRST` is shown only when no space is rendered, never above reservations that are shown (G1b, contract § 3.23). The `VerifyEmailBanner` is rendered ONCE, outside the identity switch, as the first child of `PublicShell` (`shell` below), for every signed-in non-impersonated visitor (`bannerOfIdentity`: unverified, an Owner, a verified session without a record), with `verified` from the visitor state: the dashboard layout pattern. That keeps it mounted when a code is accepted and `router.refresh()` flips the identity, so « Adresse confirmée. » is announced and takes the focus (WCAG 2.4.3); a banner inside the unverified branch would be unmounted by the flip. The page builds no `PublicPro` (contract § 5 mentions `publicProOfRow(profile.pro)`): it needs ids and strings only, and `getSpaceProfile` is already the one read of the pro.

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `src/lib/public/space-view.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * The pure rules and the fixed copy of the client espace actions (Task 22): what each spend button does for a visitor
 * state, the confirmation text of a cancellation, and which visitor state an espace identity stands for. Pure, so the
 * decisions are tested as values; the client leaves (cancel-booking-button.tsx, spend-seance-button.tsx) and the page
 * only apply them. French, vouvoiement, no dash.
 */
import type { ConfirmCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import type { SpaceIdentity } from "@/lib/back-office/guest-access";
import type { VisitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import type { BookingCoverage } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

/** DOM id of the « Vos prochaines inscriptions » heading: the focus lands there when a success removes the control that held it (WCAG 2.4.3). */
export const UPCOMING_HEADING_ID = "espace-upcoming";
export const UPCOMING_TITLE = "Vos prochaines inscriptions";
export const SPEND_TITLE = "Utiliser vos tickets";
export const SPEND_LABEL = "Réserver avec 1 ticket";
/** A séance with questions is booked on its own page, where they are asked. */
export const SPEND_LINK_LABEL = "Réserver";
export const SPEND_DONE = "Réservation confirmée.";
export const CANCEL_LABEL = "Annuler";

/** The confirmation of « Annuler » (COV-M12): the ticket comes back for a ticket booking, the pro is told, the client gets a confirmation e-mail. */
export function cancelBookingCopy(coverage: BookingCoverage, businessName: string): ConfirmCopy {
  const told = `${businessName} est prévenu par email. Vous recevez un email de confirmation.`;
  return {
    title: "Annuler votre inscription ?",
    body: coverage === "ticket" ? `Votre ticket vous est rendu et ${told}` : told,
    confirm: "Annuler l'inscription",
  };
}

/** The accessible name of a row's « Annuler »: starts with the visible label (WCAG 2.5.3) and says which booking. */
export function cancelButtonName(title: string, whenLabel: string): string {
  return `${CANCEL_LABEL} : ${title}, ${whenLabel}`;
}

/**
 * The visitor state an espace identity stands for. The personal-link cookie alone is « anonymous » (it spends nothing:
 * it proves nothing about who holds the browser); a signed-in visitor is never anonymous (COV-C1).
 */
export function visitorStateOfIdentity(identity: SpaceIdentity): VisitorState {
  switch (identity.kind) {
    case "impersonating":
      return "impersonating";
    case "unverified":
      return "unverified";
    case "no_record":
      return "verified";
    case "customer":
      return identity.via === "session" ? "verified" : "anonymous";
    case "anonymous":
      return "anonymous";
  }
}

/** Only the Owner spends tickets: a verified session with a record at this pro (OUT:75). The cookie, an unverified or an impersonated session never do. */
export function canSpendIn(identity: SpaceIdentity): boolean {
  return identity.kind === "customer" && identity.via === "session";
}

/**
 * The e-mail confirmation banner of the espace (the dashboard layout pattern): every signed-in, non-impersonated
 * visitor gets it, with `verified` read from the visitor state, so the client component stays mounted when a code is
 * accepted and the identity flips: « Adresse confirmée. » is then announced and takes the focus (WCAG 2.4.3). The
 * personal-link cookie alone is not a sign-in (no banner) and an impersonating admin must not verify the client's
 * address. `shownEmail` is the e-mail of the customer shown, which for an Owner is her session address.
 */
export function bannerOfIdentity(
  identity: SpaceIdentity,
  shownEmail: string | null,
): { email: string; verified: boolean } | null {
  switch (identity.kind) {
    case "unverified":
      return { email: identity.email, verified: false };
    case "no_record":
      return { email: identity.email, verified: true };
    case "customer":
      return identity.via === "session" && shownEmail !== null ? { email: shownEmail, verified: true } : null;
    case "impersonating":
    case "anonymous":
      return null;
  }
}

export type SpendControl = "none" | "link" | "book" | "signin" | "disabled";

/**
 * What a « spend » row offers: nothing while an admin impersonates; a link to the séance page when it asks questions
 * (the espace posts no answers); the one-click booking to a verified Owner only (`canSpend` AND a verified state, so a
 * wrong prop cannot enable it for anyone else); the sign-in dialog to an anonymous visitor holding a personal link
 * (the code proves the address, Decision 7); a disabled, described button to an unverified one.
 */
export function spendControlOf(a: { needsAnswers: boolean; canSpend: boolean; visitorState: VisitorState }): SpendControl {
  if (a.visitorState === "impersonating") return "none";
  if (a.needsAnswers) return "link";
  if (a.canSpend && a.visitorState === "verified") return "book";
  if (a.visitorState === "anonymous") return "signin";
  if (a.visitorState === "unverified") return "disabled";
  return "none";
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";

import { UPCOMING_HEADING_ID } from "@/lib/public/space-view";

type SpaceStatus = { message: string | null; announce: (message: string | null) => void };

const NO_STATUS: SpaceStatus = { message: null, announce: () => {} };
const SpaceStatusContext = createContext<SpaceStatus>(NO_STATUS);

/**
 * Owns the success line of the espace. A success removes the control that was clicked (the booking or the séance
 * leaves its list when the action revalidates the page), so a line written inside that row would vanish with it:
 * the leaves announce here instead, above the cards, in a region that is never unmounted.
 */
export function SpaceStatusProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const value = useMemo<SpaceStatus>(() => ({ message, announce: setMessage }), [message]);
  return <SpaceStatusContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SpaceStatusContext.Provider>;
}

/** The status line: always mounted (a live region inserted together with its text is not reliably announced), visible only with a message. */
export function SpaceStatusLine() {
  const { message } = useContext(SpaceStatusContext);
  return (
    <p
      role="status"
      className={
        message
          ? "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-green-700"
          : "sr-only"
      }
    >
      {message && <CheckCircle2 className="size-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />}
      {message}
    </p>
  );
}

/** `announce(message)` shows a success line; `announce(null)` clears it (called when the next action starts). */
export function useSpaceStatus(): (message: string | null) => void {
  return useContext(SpaceStatusContext).announce;
}

/** The « Vos prochaines inscriptions » heading, the focus target after a success; a stable function so Dialog may call it when it closes. */
export function upcomingHeading(): HTMLElement | null {
  return document.getElementById(UPCOMING_HEADING_ID);
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { upcomingHeading, useSpaceStatus } from "@/components/public/space-status";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { callOrFail } from "@/lib/pro-messages";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { CANCEL_LABEL, cancelBookingCopy, cancelButtonName } from "@/lib/public/space-view";
import type { BookingCoverage } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";
import { cancelMyBookingAction } from "@/server/client";

/**
 * « Annuler » on one upcoming inscription (E5). The confirmation states the consequences (the ticket comes back for a
 * ticket booking, the pro is told, the client gets an e-mail). A success is announced in the shared status line and the
 * focus goes to the section heading: the row, and this component with it, is gone once the page revalidates, and
 * Dialog calls `returnFocusTo` when it closes or unmounts. A refusal (« Seul(e) … peut annuler maintenant. », a booking
 * that changed, the throttle) stays in the dialog. Closed without cancelling (« Retour », Escape, « Fermer »), the
 * dialog gives the focus back to this button.
 */
export function CancelBookingButton({
  slug,
  bookingId,
  title,
  whenLabel,
  coverage,
  businessName,
}: {
  slug: string;
  bookingId: string;
  title: string;
  whenLabel: string;
  coverage: BookingCoverage;
  businessName: string;
}) {
  const announce = useSpaceStatus();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  // Set when « Annuler l'inscription » is clicked, BEFORE the answer is awaited: on success the revalidated page may
  // unmount this row (and the dialog with it) before the code after the await runs. Read by Dialog when it closes:
  // the heading after a cancellation, else null, so the dialog gives the focus back to « Annuler » (its opener).
  const leaving = useRef(false);
  const focusAfterClose = useCallback(() => (leaving.current ? upcomingHeading() : null), []);

  function submit() {
    setError(null);
    leaving.current = true;
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await callOrFail(() => cancelMyBookingAction({ slug, bookingId }));
      if (!res.ok) {
        leaving.current = false;
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      announce(COPY.CANCELLED_OK);
      setOpen(false);
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="secondary"
        size="sm"
        aria-label={cancelButtonName(title, whenLabel)}
        onClick={() => {
          leaving.current = false;
          setError(null);
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        {CANCEL_LABEL}
      </Button>
      <ConfirmDialog
        open={open}
        copy={cancelBookingCopy(coverage, businessName)}
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        onConfirm={submit}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        returnFocusTo={focusAfterClose}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```
