```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { OtpDialog } from "@/components/auth/otp-dialog";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { upcomingHeading, useSpaceStatus } from "@/components/public/space-status";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { callOrFail } from "@/lib/pro-messages";
import type { VisitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { canOfferCodeSignIn } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";
import { SPEND_DONE, SPEND_LABEL, SPEND_LINK_LABEL, spendControlOf } from "@/lib/public/space-view";
import type { SpendableSeance } from "@/lib/public/spendable";
import { bookWithHeldTicketAction } from "@/server/public";

/**
 * One row of « Utiliser vos tickets » (L1386-1387). What it offers is decided by spendControlOf: a link to the séance
 * page when the event asks questions; « Réserver avec 1 ticket » for the Owner, posted with the ISO start the server
 * rendered and no answers; for an anonymous visitor holding only a personal link the same label opens the sign-in
 * dialog with an EMPTY address (Decision 7: the cookie can be planted by someone else, the code proves the address);
 * a disabled button described by « Confirmez votre email pour utiliser vos tickets. » for an unverified one; nothing
 * while an admin impersonates. A success is announced in the shared status line and the focus goes to the section
 * heading (this row leaves the list when the page revalidates).
 */
export function SpendSeanceButton({
  slug,
  seance,
  canSpend,
  visitorState,
  googleEnabled,
  returnTo,
}: {
  slug: string;
  seance: SpendableSeance;
  canSpend: boolean;
  visitorState: VisitorState;
  googleEnabled: boolean;
  returnTo: string;
}) {
  const announce = useSpaceStatus();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [signInOpen, setSignInOpen] = useState(false);
  const hintId = useId();
  const control = spendControlOf({ needsAnswers: seance.needsAnswers, canSpend, visitorState });

  function book() {
    setError(null);
    announce(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await callOrFail(() => bookWithHeldTicketAction({ slug, occurrenceId: seance.occurrenceId, seenStartsAt: seance.startsAt, answers: [] }));
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      announce(SPEND_DONE);
      upcomingHeading()?.focus();
    });
  }

  if (control === "none") return null;
  if (control === "link") {
    return (
      <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
        <Link href={`/${slug}/seance/${seance.occurrenceId}`}>{SPEND_LINK_LABEL}</Link>
      </Button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1.5 sm:items-end">
      {control === "disabled" ? (
        <>
          <Button type="button" size="sm" disabled aria-describedby={hintId}>
            {SPEND_LABEL}
          </Button>
          <p id={hintId} className="text-xs text-zinc-600 sm:text-right">
            {COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_TO_SPEND}
          </p>
        </>
      ) : (
        <Button type="button" size="sm" disabled={pending} onClick={control === "book" ? book : () => setSignInOpen(true)}>
          {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
          {pending ? COPY.PENDING_BOOK : SPEND_LABEL}
        </Button>
      )}
      <FormError message={error} />
      {control === "signin" && canOfferCodeSignIn(visitorState) && (
        <OtpDialog open={signInOpen} onClose={() => setSignInOpen(false)} returnTo={returnTo} googleEnabled={googleEnabled} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { signOut } from "@/lib/auth-client";
import { REQUEST_FAILED } from "@/lib/pro-messages";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { returnPathOf } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";

/**
 * « Utiliser une autre adresse » (L1390): signs the current account out, then reloads `path` in full. The full
 * navigation drops the router cache, so Back never shows the previous account's space (SEC-M12); a soft refresh of
 * the page would keep it. `path` is built by the page from its own route params and still goes through returnPathOf.
 */
export function OtherAddressButton({ path }: { path: string }) {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function leave() {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await signOut();
      if (res.error) {
        setError(REQUEST_FAILED);
        setPending(false);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      setError(REQUEST_FAILED);
      setPending(false);
      return;
    }
    window.location.replace(returnPathOf(path));
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Button type="button" variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={leave} disabled={pending}>
        {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
        {COPY.OTHER_ADDRESS}
      </Button>
      <FormError message={error} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

Create `src/components/public/forget-guest-link-button.tsx`:

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { callOrFail } from "@/lib/pro-messages";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { forgetGuestLinkAction } from "@/server/client";

/**
 * « Ce n'est pas moi » (Decision 63, SEC-I4): clears the personal-link cookie of this pro's path through the action,
 * then reloads the espace in full, where the anonymous visitor finds the code form. Not destructive (no data is lost,
 * the link in the e-mail still works), so there is no confirmation.
 */
export function ForgetGuestLinkButton({ slug }: { slug: string }) {
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  function forget() {
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await callOrFail(() => forgetGuestLinkAction({ slug }));
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(res.error);
        return;
      }
      window.location.replace(`/${slug}/espace`);
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={forget} disabled={pending}>
        {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
        {COPY.NOT_ME}
      </Button>
      <FormError message={error} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";

import { SpaceStatusLine, SpaceStatusProvider } from "@/components/public/space-status";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { CustomerSpace } from "@/lib/back-office/customer-space";
import type { VisitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { SPEND_TITLE, UPCOMING_HEADING_ID, UPCOMING_TITLE } from "@/lib/public/space-view";
import type { SpendableSeance } from "@/lib/public/spendable";
import { boutiqueHref } from "@/lib/public-anchors";

/** What the « Utiliser vos tickets » section needs besides the space itself. Strings and booleans only. `canSpend` is canSpendIn(identity): the Owner only. */
export type SpaceSpend = {
  seances: SpendableSeance[];
  canSpend: boolean;
  visitorState: VisitorState;
  googleEnabled: boolean;
  returnTo: string;
};

/**
 * The espace of one customer (spec § 12): upcoming inscriptions with « Annuler » while the deadline allows, the wallet
 * with the notes on archived and orphan types, and « Utiliser vos tickets ». Every text of the client or of the pro
 * (name, e-mail, titles, places) can be long and unbroken, hence `wrap-anywhere` and `min-w-0`. The success line of
 * the actions lives in one shared region above the cards (SpaceStatusProvider): a booking or a séance leaves its list
 * when an action revalidates the page, so a line written in its row would vanish with it.
 */
export function CustomerSpaceView({
  businessName,
  slug,
  space,
  spend,
}: {
  businessName: string;
  slug: string;
  space: CustomerSpace;
  spend?: SpaceSpend;
}) {
  return (
    <SpaceStatusProvider>
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight wrap-anywhere">{`Bonjour ${space.customer.name}`}</h2>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{space.customer.email}</p>
        </div>

        <SpaceStatusLine />

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle
              id={UPCOMING_HEADING_ID}
              tabIndex={-1}
              className="w-fit rounded focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              {UPCOMING_TITLE}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {space.upcoming.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.NO_UPCOMING}</p>
                <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm" className="h-auto min-h-8 max-w-full whitespace-normal py-1.5 wrap-anywhere">
                  <Link href={`/${slug}`}>{`Voir la page de ${businessName}`}</Link>
                </Button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {space.upcoming.map((b) => (
                  <li key={b.bookingId} className="space-y-1 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <p className="min-w-0 font-medium wrap-anywhere">{b.title}</p>
                      <Badge variant="neutral">{b.coverageLabel}</Badge>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{b.whenLabel}</p>
                    {b.location && (
                      <p className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-600">
                        <MapPin className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                        <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{b.location}</span>
                      </p>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">

                      {b.cancellable && (

                          slug={slug}
                          bookingId={b.bookingId}
                          title={b.title}
                          whenLabel={b.whenLabel}
                          coverage={b.coverage}
                          businessName={businessName}
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Vos tickets</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {space.wallet.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.NO_TICKET}</p>
                <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">

            ) : (
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {space.wallet.map((w) => (
                  <li key={w.ticketTypeId} className="space-y-1 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                    <p className="flex items-start gap-2 font-medium">
                      <span
                        className="mt-1.5 size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: w.color }}

                      />
                      <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{`${w.usable} × ${w.name}`}</span>
                    </p>
                    {w.expiries.map((text) => (
                      <p key={text} className="text-sm text-zinc-600">
                        {text}
                      </p>
                    ))}
                    {w.archived && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{`Ce type n'est plus proposé par ${businessName}.`}</p>
                    )}
                    {w.typeClass === "orphan" && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{COPY.ORPHAN_TYPE}</p>}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {spend && spend.seances.length > 0 && (
          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{SPEND_TITLE}</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {spend.seances.map((s) => (
                  <li
                    key={s.occurrenceId}
                    className="flex flex-col gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
                      <p className="font-medium wrap-anywhere">{s.title}</p>
                      <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{s.whenLabel}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{`1 ticket « ${s.ticketTypeName} »`}</p>
                    </div>
                    <SpendSeanceButton
                      slug={slug}
                      seance={s}
                      canSpend={spend.canSpend}
                      visitorState={spend.visitorState}
                      googleEnabled={spend.googleEnabled}
                      returnTo={spend.returnTo}
                    />
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </SpaceStatusProvider>
  );
}
```

Replace the whole content (Write) with:

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { ClientSignInChoices } from "@/components/auth/client-sign-in-choices";
import { EmailCodeForm } from "@/components/auth/email-code-form";
import { FormError } from "@/components/dashboard/form-error";
import { VerifyEmailBanner } from "@/components/dashboard/verify-email-banner";
import { CustomerSpaceView } from "@/components/public/customer-space";
import { ForgetGuestLinkButton } from "@/components/public/forget-guest-link-button";
import { OtherAddressButton } from "@/components/public/other-address-button";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { COPY, guestNote, noRecordText } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { canOfferCodeSignIn } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";
import { bannerOfIdentity, canSpendIn, visitorStateOfIdentity } from "@/lib/public/space-view";
import {
  getCustomerSpacePage,
  getSpaceProfile,
  getSpendableSeances,
  resolveSpaceCustomer,
} from "@/server/client-queries";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Mon espace", robots: { index: false } };

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ lien?: string }>;
};

/**
 * The client espace of one pro (spec § 12, Q22). Identity comes only from the request's visitor (resolveSpaceCustomer:
 * fresh session, suspended user = no session, personal-link cookie checked against this pro and its current version):
 * an impersonating admin sees a notice; the Owner and the personal link's customer see their space; a verified session
 * without a record sees « Aucun ticket … » and can use another address; an unverified one sees the link's customer
 * read-only, or « Confirmez votre adresse pour voir vos réservations. » when there is none, never the code form; only
 * an anonymous visitor is offered the code form. Every signed-in, non-impersonated visitor gets the confirmation
 * banner, rendered once in the shell so that it stays mounted when a code is accepted. Never indexed, never counted in the page-view stats (isTrackedPath), rendered per request. Client leaves get
 * strings and booleans, never an id of a row.
 */
export default async function EspacePage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const { lien } = await searchParams;

  // An unknown or suspended pro is offline. layout.tsx already answered the 404 before the loading boundary; the page
  // keeps its own check because it needs `pro` and a layout cannot hand props down (the two render in parallel).
  const profile = await getSpaceProfile(slug);
  if (!profile) notFound();
  const { pro } = profile;

  const identity = await resolveSpaceCustomer(pro);
  const visitorState = visitorStateOfIdentity(identity);
  const returnTo = `/${pro.slug}/espace`;

  // The customer whose space is shown: the Owner's or the personal link's. An unverified session shows the link's
  // customer read-only under the banner (COV-C1).
  const shownCustomerId =
    identity.kind === "customer"
      ? identity.customerId
      : identity.kind === "unverified"
        ? identity.guestCustomerId
        : null;
  const [space, spendable] = await Promise.all([
    shownCustomerId ? getCustomerSpacePage(pro.id, shownCustomerId) : Promise.resolve(null),
    shownCustomerId ? getSpendableSeances(pro.id, shownCustomerId) : Promise.resolve([]),
  ]);

  // The confirmation banner sits in ONE place of the tree, the first child of the shell, whatever the branch below:
  // it stays mounted when a code is accepted and the identity flips, so « Adresse confirmée. » is announced and takes
  // the focus (WCAG 2.4.3, the dashboard layout pattern). `verified` comes from the visitor state.
  const banner = bannerOfIdentity(identity, space?.customer.email ?? null);
  const shell = (children: React.ReactNode) => (
    <PublicShell branding={pro} backHref={`/${slug}`}>
      {banner && <VerifyEmailBanner email={banner.email} verified={banner.verified} />}
      {children}
    </PublicShell>
  );

  if (identity.kind === "impersonating") {
    return shell(
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="py-8">
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.IMPERSONATING}</p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>,
    );
  }

  if (identity.kind === "no_record") {
    return shell(
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 py-8">
          <p className="text-sm wrap-anywhere">{noRecordText(pro.businessName, identity.email)}</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-2">
            <OtherAddressButton path={returnTo} />
            <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
              <Link href={`/${slug}`}>{`Voir la page de ${pro.businessName}`}</Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>,
    );
  }

  if (space) {
    const viaLink = identity.kind === "unverified" || (identity.kind === "customer" && identity.via === "guest");
    return shell(
      <>
        {viaLink && (
          <div
            role="note"
            className="mb-6 flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-muted/50 px-4 py-3 text-sm sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
          >
            <p className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{guestNote(space.customer.email)}</p>
            <ForgetGuestLinkButton slug={pro.slug} />
          </div>
        )}
        <CustomerSpaceView
          businessName={pro.businessName}
          slug={slug}
          space={space}
          spend={{ seances: spendable, canSpend: canSpendIn(identity), visitorState, googleEnabled: env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED, returnTo }}
        />
      </>,
    );
  }

  // Unverified and no space to show: the banner is above (in the shell), and the sentence says why nothing else is shown.
  if (identity.kind === "unverified") {
    return shell(<p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_FIRST}</p>);
  }

  // Left: an anonymous visitor, or a customer whose row vanished between the identity read and the space read.
  if (identity.kind !== "anonymous") notFound();

  return shell(
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {lien === "invalide" && <FormError message="Ce lien n'est plus valide." />}
      {canOfferCodeSignIn(visitorState) && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>Accéder à mon espace</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{`Recevez un code par email pour voir vos réservations chez ${pro.businessName}.`}</p>
            <EmailCodeForm idPrefix="espace-code" />
            <ClientSignInChoices returnTo={returnTo} googleEnabled={env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED} />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>,
  );
}
```

Additions (not in § 3.20; each is used by a later task of this group, and is the reason it is declared here):
- `planning-reads.ts`: `PUBLIC_SEANCE_LIMIT` (300), `effectiveLocation(override, eventLocation): string | null` and `acceptedTypesOf(db, professionalId, eventIds): Promise<Map<string, { id; name; color }[]>>` (Task 24 reuses the last two for the séance page).
- `planning-view.ts`: `planningEmptyState({ slug, view, tz, shown, nextStart, anyStart }): { empty: "week" | "all" | null; nextWeekHref: string | null }` (the empty-state decision of `/[slug]`, kept pure so it is tested in both zones, Task 25a).
- `boutique-reads.ts`: `acceptedByTitles(db, professionalId, ticketTypeIds): Promise<Map<string, string[]>>` (the « Utilisable pour » titles, shared with the offer page, Task 24).
- `public-queries.ts`: `getPublicPageProfile(slug)`, the request-memoized `getPublicProfile` (Task 25a: `generateMetadata` and the page read the pro once, and the page keeps the pro's presentation text, which `resolvePublicPro` does not return).

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** S6 (tenancy): one cross-tenant case in `planning-reads.db.test.ts` (another pro's séances, time off and types never reach this pro's list, and the reverse) and in `boutique-reads.db.test.ts` (another pro's types, offers and events are never listed, and `acceptedByTitles` filters the pro on the events AND the links).

**Design notes (read before coding):**
- A read here never writes and never trusts input: the pro comes from the slug (`resolvePublicPro` / `getPublicPageProfile`), every statement filters `professional_id` (on the event row too, in the join), and `listPublicSeances` takes `now` as a parameter (one clock per request).
- The filter of L490-496 is written once (`publicFilter`) and shared by the list and by `nextPublicSeanceStart`, so the « next séance » link can never point to a séance the list hides. The horizon is a LOCAL date (`(starts_at at time zone tz)::date <= (now at time zone tz)::date + coalesce(event horizon, pro horizon)`), never a UTC date: the LA test pins it. The minimum notice never hides a séance (the page shows it « Réservations fermées »).
- An empty scheduled séance under a time off is hidden with the contract's predicate `seats_taken = 0`. The pro-side planning (`hiddenByTimeOff`, P3) measures emptiness on the LIVE seats, so a séance kept only by a lapsed hold under a time off is hidden there and listed (closed online) here until the nightly sweep releases the hold: harmless, and the contract's exact SQL wins.
- Drizzle's one-table trap: a correlated subquery written with interpolated drizzle columns inside a one-table select renders them unqualified. The time-off `exists` is raw SQL naming `occurrence.…` literally, inside a two-table select, and the elapsed holds are a grouped read (`elapsedHoldsOf`).
- `acceptedTypes` and the badges exist for tickets-mode séances only. `acceptedByTitles` follows the pro's own « Accepté par » rule (`readAcceptedBy` of `catalog-reads.ts`): the latest non-archived segment of each series, in tickets mode, so a stale link on a free event is not advertised; the privacy test is on the OUTER query (a series whose latest segment is private does not fall back to an older public one).
- `planning-view.ts` is pure and client-safe: `PublicSeance` is a type import (erased), so no database module is loaded with it. It imports `dayLongLabel` and `weekTitle` from `@/lib/back-office/planning-view` (they live there; the contract's import list does not name that module).
- UI copy has no dash; labels come from `./messages` (Task 2), never retyped here.

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";

import { addDays, instantAt, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";

import { PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS, seatsLeftLabel } from "./messages";
import type { PublicSeance } from "./planning-reads";
import {
  groupByDay,
  parsePlanningParams,
  planningEmptyState,
  planningNav,
  seanceState,
  stateLabel,
  toPublicSeanceVM,
  type PublicSeanceState,
} from "./planning-view";

const PARIS = "Europe/Paris";
const LA = "America/Los_Angeles";
const NO_DASH = new RegExp(`[${String.fromCharCode(0x2013)}${String.fromCharCode(0x2014)}]`);
const WINDOW = { bookingHorizonDays: 60, minNoticeMinutes: 60, cancelDeadlineHours: 24 };
const TYPE = { id: "t1", name: "Cours collectif", color: "#22c55e" };

/** One DST day per zone and per change: the spring gap and the autumn repeat. */
const ZONES: { tz: string; spring: DateKey; autumn: DateKey }[] = [
  { tz: PARIS, spring: "2026-03-29", autumn: "2026-10-25" },
  { tz: LA, spring: "2026-03-08", autumn: "2026-11-01" },
];

const at = (day: DateKey, minute: number, tz: string): Date => instantAt(day, minute, tz);

/** A séance of 60 minutes starting at `minute` of `day` (wall clock in tz), open to tickets by default. */
function seance(tz: string, day: DateKey, minute: number, over: Partial<PublicSeance> = {}): PublicSeance {
  const startsAt = at(day, minute, tz);
  return {
    occurrenceId: "o1",
    eventId: "e1",
    title: "Altinha débutants",
    color: "#6366f1",
    startsAt,
    endsAt: new Date(startsAt.getTime() + 60 * 60_000),
    location: null,
    status: "scheduled",
    bookingMode: "tickets",
    capacity: 12,
    seatsLeft: 12,
    acceptedTypes: [TYPE],
    window: WINDOW,
    underTimeOff: false,
    ...over,
  };
}

const stateOf = (s: PublicSeance, now: Date, tz: string): PublicSeanceState => seanceState(s, now, tz);

test("seanceState: open, free, full and the three states a séance cannot be booked in", () => {
  for (const { tz, spring, autumn } of ZONES) {
    for (const day of [spring, autumn]) {
      const now = at(addDays(day, -1), 8 * 60, tz);
      const label = `${tz} ${day}`;
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(seance(tz, day, 19 * 60), now, tz), { kind: "open", seatsLeft: 12 }, label);
      assert.deepEqual(
        stateOf(seance(tz, day, 19 * 60, { bookingMode: "free", acceptedTypes: [], seatsLeft: 5 }), now, tz),
        { kind: "free", seatsLeft: 5 },
        `${label}: a free séance needs no accepted type`,
      );
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(seance(tz, day, 19 * 60, { seatsLeft: 0 }), now, tz), { kind: "full" }, label);
      assert.deepEqual(
        stateOf(seance(tz, day, 19 * 60, { bookingMode: "none", seatsLeft: 0 }), now, tz),
        { kind: "onsite" },
        label,
      );
    }
  }
});

test("seanceState: past and ongoing are read against the end, cancelled wins over both", () => {
  for (const { tz, spring, autumn } of ZONES) {
    for (const day of [spring, autumn]) {
      const s = seance(tz, day, 19 * 60);
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(s, at(day, 19 * 60 + 30, tz), tz), { kind: "ongoing" }, `${tz} ${day} during`);
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(s, s.startsAt, tz), { kind: "ongoing" }, "it has started at its start");
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(s, s.endsAt, tz), { kind: "past" }, "it is over at its end");
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(s, at(day, 21 * 60, tz), tz), { kind: "past" }, `${tz} ${day} after`);
      const cancelled = seance(tz, day, 19 * 60, { status: "cancelled" });
      for (const now of [at(addDays(day, -1), 8 * 60, tz), at(day, 19 * 60 + 30, tz), at(day, 21 * 60, tz)]) {
        assert.deepEqual(stateOf(cancelled, now, tz), { kind: "cancelled" }, "cancelled comes first");
      }
    }
  }
});

test("seanceState: the horizon is a local date, the notice an elapsed time", () => {
  for (const { tz, spring, autumn } of ZONES) {
    for (const day of [spring, autumn]) {
      const now = at(addDays(day, -1), 8 * 60, tz);
      const label = `${tz} ${day}`;
      // today = day - 1, horizon 2 days: the last bookable local date is day + 1.
      const near: Partial<PublicSeance> = { window: { ...WINDOW, bookingHorizonDays: 2 } };
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(seance(tz, addDays(day, 1), 23 * 60 + 30, near), now, tz), { kind: "open", seatsLeft: 12 }, label);
      assert.deepEqual(stateOf(seance(tz, addDays(day, 2), 0, near), now, tz), { kind: "notYet" }, `${label}: one minute past the last date`);
      // 7 hours before the start with a 10 hour notice: closed.
      const late = at(day, 12 * 60, tz);
      assert.deepEqual(
        stateOf(seance(tz, day, 19 * 60, { window: { ...WINDOW, minNoticeMinutes: 10 * 60 } }), late, tz),
        { kind: "closed" },
        label,
      );
    }
  }
});

test("seanceState: closed for a time off or a tickets séance nobody accepts, and the precedence of the states", () => {
  const { tz, spring: day } = ZONES[0];
  const now = at(addDays(day, -1), 8 * 60, tz);
  const base = seance(tz, day, 19 * 60);
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf({ ...base, underTimeOff: true }, now, tz), { kind: "closed" });
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf({ ...base, acceptedTypes: [] }, now, tz), { kind: "closed" });
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf({ ...base, bookingMode: "free", acceptedTypes: [], underTimeOff: true }, now, tz), { kind: "closed" });
  // closed before full
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf({ ...base, underTimeOff: true, seatsLeft: 0 }, now, tz), { kind: "closed" });
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf({ ...base, acceptedTypes: [], seatsLeft: 0 }, now, tz), { kind: "closed" });
  // onsite before notYet and closed
  const far = seance(tz, addDays(day, 90), 19 * 60, { bookingMode: "none", underTimeOff: true });
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf(far, now, tz), { kind: "onsite" });
  // notYet before closed
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf({ ...far, bookingMode: "tickets", acceptedTypes: [] }, now, tz), { kind: "notYet" });
  // past before onsite
  assert.deepEqual(stateOf({ ...base, bookingMode: "none" }, at(day, 21 * 60, tz), tz), { kind: "past" });
});

test("toPublicSeanceVM: state text, seats text, muted and the accessible name per state", () => {

  const cancelled = row({ status: "cancelled" });
  assert.deepEqual([cancelled.stateText, cancelled.seatsText, cancelled.muted], ["Annulée", null, true]);
  assert.equal(cancelled.ariaLabel, "Altinha débutants, lundi 12 octobre 19:00 à 20:00, Annulée");

  const free = row({ bookingMode: "free", acceptedTypes: [], seatsLeft: 5 });
  assert.deepEqual([free.stateText, free.seatsText, free.muted, free.badges], ["Inscription libre", "5 places restantes", false, []]);
  assert.equal(free.ariaLabel, "Altinha débutants, lundi 12 octobre 19:00 à 20:00, Inscription libre");

  const one = row({ seatsLeft: 1 });
  assert.equal(one.seatsText, "1 place restante");

  const full = row({ seatsLeft: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual([full.stateText, full.seatsText, full.muted], ["Complet", null, true]);
  const closed = row({ underTimeOff: true });
  assert.deepEqual([closed.stateText, closed.muted], ["Réservations fermées", true]);
  const onsite = row({ bookingMode: "none", acceptedTypes: [] });
  assert.deepEqual([onsite.stateText, onsite.muted], ["Sur place", false]);

  const ongoing = toPublicSeanceVM(seance(PARIS, "2026-10-12", 19 * 60), "altinha-paris", at("2026-10-12", 19 * 60 + 10, PARIS), PARIS);
  assert.deepEqual([ongoing.stateText, ongoing.muted], ["En cours", false]);
  const past = toPublicSeanceVM(seance(PARIS, "2026-10-12", 19 * 60), "altinha-paris", at("2026-10-12", 21 * 60, PARIS), PARIS);
  assert.deepEqual([past.stateText, past.muted], ["Terminée", true]);
  const notYet = toPublicSeanceVM(seance(PARIS, "2026-12-30", 19 * 60), "altinha-paris", now, PARIS);
  assert.deepEqual([notYet.stateText, notYet.muted], ["Réservations pas encore ouvertes", false]);

  for (const vm of [cancelled, free, one, full, closed, onsite, ongoing, past, notYet]) {

    assert.ok(vm.ariaLabel.startsWith("Altinha débutants, "), vm.ariaLabel);
  }
});

  const vms = [make("a", "2026-10-13", 10 * 60), make("b", "2026-10-13", 19 * 60), make("c", "2026-10-15", 19 * 60), make("out", "2026-10-26", 19 * 60)];
  const days = groupByDay(vms, week);

  assert.deepEqual(days.map((d) => d.dayKey), week);
  assert.deepEqual(days.map((d) => d.label), [

    "mercredi 14 octobre",
    "jeudi 15 octobre",
    "vendredi 16 octobre",
    "samedi 17 octobre",
    "dimanche 18 octobre",
  ]);
  assert.deepEqual(days.map((d) => d.seances.map((s) => s.occurrenceId)), [[], ["a", "b"], [], ["c"], [], [], []]);
  assert.deepEqual(groupByDay([], week).map((d) => d.seances.length), [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
  assert.deepEqual(groupByDay(vms, []), []);
});

});
```

```ts
/**
 * Pure view model of the public planning (spec L1440-1443, Decisions 9, 10, 46, 47). Everything the `/[slug]` page
 * draws from `listPublicSeances`: the state of a séance, its row, the days of a week and the week navigation. Every
 * function takes the pro's time zone explicitly (never the host zone), no output contains an em or en dash, and
 * nothing here imports the database: `PublicSeance` is a type import only, so a client component may load the module.
 */
import { formatTimeRange } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { dayLongLabel, weekTitle } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-view";
import { onlineBookability } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import { addDays, compareKeys, mondayOf, parseKey, todayKey, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

import { PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS, seatsLeftLabel } from "./messages";
import type { PublicSeance } from "./planning-reads";

export type PublicSeanceState =
  | { kind: "cancelled" }
  | { kind: "past" }
  | { kind: "ongoing" }
  | { kind: "onsite" }
  | { kind: "notYet" }
  | { kind: "closed" }
  | { kind: "full" }
  | { kind: "free"; seatsLeft: number }
  | { kind: "open"; seatsLeft: number };

/**
 * Precedence (exact): cancelled; then startsAt <= now -> past (endsAt <= now) or ongoing; mode none -> onsite;
 * onlineBookability reason horizon -> notYet; reason notice, underTimeOff, or tickets mode without an accepted type
 * -> closed; seatsLeft 0 -> full; mode free -> free; else open.
 */
export function seanceState(
  s: Pick<PublicSeance, "status" | "startsAt" | "endsAt" | "bookingMode" | "seatsLeft" | "acceptedTypes" | "window" | "underTimeOff">,
  now: Date,
  tz: string,
): PublicSeanceState {
  if (s.status === "cancelled") return { kind: "cancelled" };
  if (s.startsAt.getTime() <= now.getTime()) {
    return s.endsAt.getTime() <= now.getTime() ? { kind: "past" } : { kind: "ongoing" };
  }
  if (s.bookingMode === "none") return { kind: "onsite" };
  const online = onlineBookability({ startsAt: s.startsAt, now, tz, window: s.window });
  if (!online.ok && online.reason === "horizon") return { kind: "notYet" };
  // Past cannot happen here (startsAt > now): any other refusal is the minimum notice.
  if (!online.ok || s.underTimeOff || (s.bookingMode === "tickets" && s.acceptedTypes.length === 0)) {
    return { kind: "closed" };
  }
  if (s.seatsLeft <= 0) return { kind: "full" };
  return s.bookingMode === "free" ? { kind: "free", seatsLeft: s.seatsLeft } : { kind: "open", seatsLeft: s.seatsLeft };
}

/** PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS of the state; null for open. */
export function stateLabel(state: PublicSeanceState): string | null {
  return state.kind === "open" ? null : PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS[state.kind];
}

export type PublicSeanceVM = {
  occurrenceId: string;
  href: string;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  dayKey: DateKey;
  /** formatTimeRange: « 19:00 à 20:00 » */
  timeLabel: string;
  location: string | null;
  stateText: string | null;
  /** seatsLeftLabel for open / free */
  seatsText: string | null;
  /** cancelled, past, closed, full */
  muted: boolean;
  badges: { name: string; color: string }[];
  /** COV-M12: « {title}, {dayLabel} {timeLabel}, {stateText ?? seatsText} » (the row link's accessible name) */
  ariaLabel: string;
};

/** The row of one séance (href = /{slug}/seance/{id}); dates are read in tz. */
export function toPublicSeanceVM(s: PublicSeance, slug: string, now: Date, tz: string): PublicSeanceVM {
  const state = seanceState(s, now, tz);
  const dayKey = todayKey(s.startsAt, tz);
  const timeLabel = formatTimeRange(s.startsAt, s.endsAt, tz);
  const stateText = stateLabel(state);
  const seatsText = state.kind === "open" || state.kind === "free" ? seatsLeftLabel(state.seatsLeft) : null;
  const tail = stateText ?? seatsText;
  const head = `${s.title}, ${dayLongLabel(dayKey)} ${timeLabel}`;
  return {
    occurrenceId: s.occurrenceId,
    href: `/${slug}/seance/${s.occurrenceId}`,
    title: s.title,
    color: s.color,
    dayKey,
    timeLabel,
    location: s.location,
    stateText,
    seatsText,
    muted: state.kind === "cancelled" || state.kind === "past" || state.kind === "closed" || state.kind === "full",
    badges: s.acceptedTypes.map((t) => ({ name: t.name, color: t.color })),
    ariaLabel: tail === null ? head : `${head}, ${tail}`,
  };
}

export type PublicDay = { dayKey: DateKey; label: string; seances: PublicSeanceVM[] };

/** One entry per day of `days`, in that order, empty days kept; label = dayLongLabel (« lundi 12 octobre »). */
export function groupByDay(vms: readonly PublicSeanceVM[], days: readonly DateKey[]): PublicDay[] {
  return days.map((dayKey) => ({
    dayKey,
    label: dayLongLabel(dayKey),
    seances: vms.filter((vm) => vm.dayKey === dayKey),
  }));
}

export type PlanningView = "liste" | "semaine";

const WEEK_YEARS = { min: 2000, max: 2100 } as const;

function firstOf(value: string | string[] | undefined): string | undefined {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value[0] : value;
}

/** A well-formed date key between 2000 and 2100, else undefined (the page then shows this week). */
function validWeek(value: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (value === undefined || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return undefined;
  try {
    const { y } = parseKey(value);
    return y >= WEEK_YEARS.min && y <= WEEK_YEARS.max ? value : undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

/** ?semaine= (a DateKey, else undefined) and ?vue= ("semaine", else "liste"); a repeated parameter counts by its first value. */
export function parsePlanningParams(sp: { semaine?: string | string[]; vue?: string | string[] }): {
  semaine: string | undefined;
  view: PlanningView;
} {
  return { semaine: validWeek(firstOf(sp.semaine)), view: firstOf(sp.vue) === "semaine" ? "semaine" : "liste" };
}

export type PlanningNav = {
  weekKey: DateKey;
  title: string;
  prevHref: string | null;
  nextHref: string | null;
  listHref: string;
  weekHref: string;
};

/** /{slug}?semaine=<Monday>[&vue=semaine]: the only query a public week carries (no personal data). */
function publicWeekHref(slug: string, monday: DateKey, view: PlanningView): string {
  return `/${slug}?semaine=${monday}${view === "semaine" ? "&vue=semaine" : ""}`;
}

/**
 * Week navigation by local date (L1440): `weekKey` is read as the Monday of its week; prev is null on the current week
 * (or before); next is null when the next week starts past todayKey + BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.max (nothing can be
 * listed there); title = weekTitle(days); the hrefs keep the chosen view.
 */
export function planningNav(a: { slug: string; weekKey: DateKey; view: PlanningView; todayKey: DateKey }): PlanningNav {
  const monday = mondayOf(a.weekKey);
  const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(monday, i));
  const prev = addDays(monday, -7);
  const next = addDays(monday, 7);
  const lastListable = addDays(a.todayKey, BOUNDS.bookingHorizonDays.max);
  return {
    weekKey: monday,
    title: weekTitle(days),
    prevHref: compareKeys(monday, mondayOf(a.todayKey)) > 0 ? publicWeekHref(a.slug, prev, a.view) : null,
    nextHref: compareKeys(next, lastListable) <= 0 ? publicWeekHref(a.slug, next, a.view) : null,
    listHref: publicWeekHref(a.slug, monday, "liste"),
    weekHref: publicWeekHref(a.slug, monday, "semaine"),
  };
}

/**
 * The empty state of the shown week. `shown` = the séances the week lists (cancelled ones included); `nextStart` = the
 * first séance after the week (nextPublicSeanceStart); `anyStart` = the first séance ahead at all, read only when the
 * week is empty and nothing follows it. null while the week lists a séance; "week" when the week is empty but another
 * one has a séance (nextWeekHref points to the next one when it follows); "all" when no séance is ahead at all.
 */
export function planningEmptyState(a: {
  slug: string;
  view: PlanningView;
  tz: string;
  shown: number;
  nextStart: Date | null;
  anyStart: Date | null;
}): { empty: "week" | "all" | null; nextWeekHref: string | null } {
  if (a.shown > 0) return { empty: null, nextWeekHref: null };
  if (a.nextStart !== null) {
    return { empty: "week", nextWeekHref: publicWeekHref(a.slug, mondayOf(todayKey(a.nextStart, a.tz)), a.view) };
  }
  return { empty: a.anyStart === null ? "all" : "week", nextWeekHref: null };
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import { cancelOccurrence } from "@/lib/booking/cancel";
import { setTicketTypeArchived } from "@/lib/booking/catalog";
import { instantAt, type DateKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { event, occurrence, timeOff } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { addMinutes, createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, type TestPro } from "@/test/db";
import { dayIn, makeEvent, makeType } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { rowBooking, rowCustomer, rowEvent, rowLink, rowOffer, rowPurchase, rowSeance, rowType } from "@/test/rows";

import { effectiveLocation, listPublicSeances, nextPublicSeanceStart } from "./planning-reads";

const WINDOW = { bookingHorizonDays: 60, minNoticeMinutes: 60, cancelDeadlineHours: 24 };
const LA = "America/Los_Angeles";

/** The PublicPro fields the reads need, with the pro's default booking settings. */
const proOf = (pro: TestPro) => ({ professionalId: pro.proId, timezone: pro.tz, window: WINDOW });

/** From yesterday to 120 local days ahead: wide enough for every séance of these tests. */
const wide = (pro: TestPro, now: Date) => ({
  start: addMinutes(now, -24 * 60),
  end: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 120, now), 0, pro.tz),
});

/** A séance of `eventId` at `minute` (wall clock) of the local day `days` ahead; its series date is that day. */
function seanceAt(
  db: Db,
  pro: TestPro,
  eventId: string,
  now: Date,
  days: number,
  over: { minute?: number; capacity?: number; seatsTaken?: number; status?: "scheduled" | "cancelled" } = {},
): Promise<string> {
  const day: DateKey = dayIn(pro, days, now);
  const { minute, ...row } = over;
  return rowSeance(db, pro, eventId, { startsAt: instantAt(day, minute ?? 600, pro.tz), seriesDate: day, ...row }, now);
}

/** A pending booking (ticket coverage) backed by a pending purchase, as « buy + book » leaves it until the client pays. */
async function pendingHold(
  db: Db,
  pro: TestPro,
  args: { occurrenceId: string; typeId: string; offerId: string; holdExpiresAt: Date },
): Promise<void> {
  const customerId = await rowCustomer(db, pro);
  const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(db, pro, { customerId, offerId: args.offerId, ticketTypeId: args.typeId });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, {
    occurrenceId: args.occurrenceId,
    customerId,
    status: "pending",
    coverage: "ticket",
    purchaseId,
    holdExpiresAt: args.holdExpiresAt,
  });
}

});

dbTest("listPublicSeances: the horizon follows the pro's zone, not UTC", async ({ db }) => {
  const la = await createTestPro(db, { tz: LA });
  try {
    const now = new Date();
    const eventId = await rowEvent(db, la, {}, now);
    // 23:30 on the last local day is already the next day in UTC; 00:30 on the day after is still the same UTC day.
    const lastDay = await seanceAt(db, la, eventId, now, 60, { minute: 23 * 60 + 30 });
    const nextDay = await seanceAt(db, la, eventId, now, 61, { minute: 30 });
    const got = await listPublicSeances(db, proOf(la), wide(la, now), now);
    assert.deepEqual(got.map((s) => s.occurrenceId), [lastDay]);
    assert.notEqual(nextDay, lastDay);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, la.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("listPublicSeances: an empty séance under a time off is hidden, a booked or a cancelled one stays", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const eventId = await rowEvent(db, pro, {}, now);
  const empty = await seanceAt(db, pro, eventId, now, 4);
  const booked = await seanceAt(db, pro, eventId, now, 5, { seatsTaken: 1 });
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: booked, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro), status: "confirmed" }, now);
  const cancelled = await seanceAt(db, pro, eventId, now, 6, { status: "cancelled" });
  const after = await seanceAt(db, pro, eventId, now, 8);
  await db.insert(timeOff).values({
    id: nanoid(),
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    startAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 4, now), 0, pro.tz),
    endAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 8, now), 0, pro.tz),
    allDay: true,
    reason: "Vacances",
  });

  const hidden = await listPublicSeances(db, proOf(pro), wide(pro, now), now);
  assert.deepEqual(
    hidden.map((s) => [s.occurrenceId, s.underTimeOff]),
    [
      [booked, true],
      [cancelled, true],
      [after, false],
    ],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(pro), now, now), hidden[0].startsAt, "the hidden séance is not the next one");

  // Removing the time off brings the hidden séance back.
  await db.delete(timeOff).where(eq(timeOff.professionalId, pro.proId));
  const back = await listPublicSeances(db, proOf(pro), wide(pro, now), now);
  assert.deepEqual(
    back.map((s) => [s.occurrenceId, s.underTimeOff]),
    [
      [empty, false],
      [booked, false],
      [cancelled, false],
      [after, false],
    ],
  );
});

dbTest("listPublicSeances: a time off overlaps by one minute or not at all", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const eventId = await rowEvent(db, pro, {}, now);
  const apart = await seanceAt(db, pro, eventId, now, 4); // 10:00 to 11:00
  const cut = await seanceAt(db, pro, eventId, now, 9);
  const day4 = (minute: number) => instantAt(dayIn(pro, 4, now), minute, pro.tz);
  const day9 = (minute: number) => instantAt(dayIn(pro, 9, now), minute, pro.tz);
  await db.insert(timeOff).values([
    { id: nanoid(), professionalId: pro.proId, startAt: day4(540), endAt: day4(600), allDay: false, reason: "avant" },
    { id: nanoid(), professionalId: pro.proId, startAt: day4(660), endAt: day4(720), allDay: false, reason: "après" },
    { id: nanoid(), professionalId: pro.proId, startAt: day9(659), endAt: day9(720), allDay: false, reason: "chevauche" },
  ]);
  const got = await listPublicSeances(db, proOf(pro), wide(pro, now), now);
  assert.deepEqual(
    got.map((s) => [s.occurrenceId, s.underTimeOff]),
    [[apart, false]],
    "touching bounds do not overlap; the séance cut by a minute is empty and hidden",
  );
  assert.equal(got.some((s) => s.occurrenceId === cut), false);
});

  assert.deepEqual(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(pro), now, now), await startOf(visible), "private, archived and hidden séances are skipped");
  assert.deepEqual(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(pro), await startOf(visible), now), await startOf(visible), "at or after");
  assert.deepEqual(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(pro), addMinutes(await startOf(visible), 1), now), await startOf(cancelled), "a cancelled séance is shown, so it counts");
  assert.equal(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(pro), addMinutes(await startOf(cancelled), 1), now), null, "beyond the horizon is not listed");
  assert.equal(new Set([hiddenByPrivate, hiddenByArchive, hiddenByTimeOff, beyond, visible, cancelled]).size, 6);

  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    assert.equal(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(other), now, now), null, "another pro has no séance");
    await makeEvent(db, other, { title: "Chez l'autre" }, now);
    assert.ok(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(other), now, now));
    assert.deepEqual(await nextPublicSeanceStart(db, proOf(pro), now, now), await startOf(visible), "and mine is unchanged");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

  const now = new Date();

  const mine = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha débutants", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] }, now);
  const other = await createTestPro(db);

      allDay: true,
      reason: null,

    const got = await listPublicSeances(db, proOf(pro), wide(pro, now), now);

      [mine.occurrences[0].id, false, [typeId]],

    // Their own empty séance is hidden by their own time off; nothing of mine is.

    await db.delete(timeOff).where(eq(timeOff.professionalId, other.proId));

    assert.deepEqual(theirs.map((s) => [s.title, s.acceptedTypes.map((t) => t.id)]), [["Chez l'autre", [theirType]]]);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);

});
```

```ts
/**
 * The public planning read (spec L490-496, L1440-1443): the séances a visitor may see on `/[slug]`. Testable core:
 * takes `db`, imports neither server-only, next/* nor the db index. Every statement filters `professional_id`, and the
 * pro comes from the slug on the server (resolvePublicPro), never from input. Reads return `Date`s: the pages turn them
 * into ISO strings or labels before any client prop (planning-view.ts).
 */
import { and, asc, eq, gt, gte, inArray, isNotNull, isNull, lt, sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";

import { elapsedHoldsOf } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-reads";
import { effectiveWindow, type BookingWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import { seatsShown } from "@/lib/booking/holds";
import { ts, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { event, eventTicketType, occurrence, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { BookingMode, OccurrenceStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

/** What one call lists at most (a week of a busy pro holds far fewer). */
export const PUBLIC_SEANCE_LIMIT = 300;

export type PublicSeance = {
  occurrenceId: string;
  eventId: string;
  title: string;
  color: string;
  startsAt: Date;
  endsAt: Date;
  /** the effective place: coalesce(o.location_override, e.location), "" -> null (L1441, as customer-space.ts) */
  location: string | null;
  status: OccurrenceStatus;
  bookingMode: BookingMode;
  /** the séance row's capacity (overrides included) */
  capacity: number;
  /** seatsShown({ capacity, seatsTaken, elapsedHolds }) */
  seatsLeft: number;
  /** non-archived linked types, by position; [] unless bookingMode is "tickets" (badges only for tickets mode) */
  acceptedTypes: { id: string; name: string; color: string }[];
  /** effectiveWindow(pro, event overrides) */
  window: BookingWindow;
  /** a time off overlaps (the séance is then closed online) */
  underTimeOff: boolean;
};

type PlanningPro = { professionalId: string; timezone: string; window: BookingWindow };

/** The effective place of a séance: its own, else the event's; an empty or blank place is no place. */
export function effectiveLocation(override: string | null, eventLocation: string | null): string | null {
  const place = override ?? eventLocation;
  return place !== null && place.trim() !== "" ? place : null;
}

/** A time off of the pro overlaps the séance: literal table names, no interpolated column (drizzle's one-table trap). */
const UNDER_TIME_OFF = sql`exists (select 1 from time_off t where t.professional_id = occurrence.professional_id
  and t.start_at < occurrence.ends_at and t.end_at > occurrence.starts_at)`;

/**
 * The filter listPublicSeances and nextPublicSeanceStart share (L490-496): séances of this pro's non-private,
 * non-archived events that start after `now`, scheduled or cancelled, whose local date is within the effective horizon,
 * except an empty scheduled séance under a time off (a booked one stays, closed online). The event row must be the
 * pro's own as well (defence in depth).
 */
function publicFilter(pro: PlanningPro, now: Date): SQL | undefined {
  return and(
    eq(occurrence.professionalId, pro.professionalId),
    eq(event.professionalId, pro.professionalId),
    isNotNull(occurrence.eventId),
    gt(occurrence.startsAt, now),
    inArray(occurrence.status, ["scheduled", "cancelled"]),
    eq(event.isPrivate, false),
    isNull(event.archivedAt),
    sql`(occurrence.starts_at at time zone ${pro.timezone}::text)::date
      <= (${ts(now)} at time zone ${pro.timezone}::text)::date + coalesce(event.booking_horizon_days, ${pro.window.bookingHorizonDays}::int)`,
    sql`not (occurrence.status = 'scheduled' and occurrence.seats_taken = 0 and ${UNDER_TIME_OFF})`,
  );
}

/**
 * The non-archived types linked to these events, per event, by position. Used for the badges of a tickets-mode séance
 * and for the « no accepted type » closure. Every statement filters the pro on both tables.
 */
export async function acceptedTypesOf(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  eventIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<Map<string, { id: string; name: string; color: string }[]>> {
  const byEvent = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; color: string }[]>();
  if (eventIds.length === 0) return byEvent;
  const rows = await db
    .select({ eventId: eventTicketType.eventId, id: ticketType.id, name: ticketType.name, color: ticketType.color })
    .from(eventTicketType)
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, eventTicketType.ticketTypeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(eventTicketType.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId),
        isNull(ticketType.archivedAt),
        inArray(eventTicketType.eventId, [...eventIds]),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(ticketType.position), asc(ticketType.name), asc(ticketType.id));
  for (const r of rows) {
    const list = byEvent.get(r.eventId) ?? [];
    list.push({ id: r.id, name: r.name, color: r.color });
    byEvent.set(r.eventId, list);
  }
  return byEvent;
}

/**
 * L490-496: séances of [start, end) of this pro (by starts_at), starts_at > now, of a non-private non-archived event,
 * scheduled or cancelled, local date <= today + effective horizon, EXCEPT empty scheduled séances under a time off;
 * by starts_at, id; at most PUBLIC_SEANCE_LIMIT. A lapsed hold is a free seat (a grouped read, not a correlated
 * subquery). Never writes.
 */
export async function listPublicSeances(
  db: Db,
  pro: PlanningPro,
  range: { start: Date; end: Date },
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicSeance[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      occurrenceId: occurrence.id,
      eventId: event.id,
      title: event.title,
      color: event.color,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      locationOverride: occurrence.locationOverride,
      eventLocation: event.location,
      status: occurrence.status,
      bookingMode: event.bookingMode,
      capacity: occurrence.capacity,
      seatsTaken: occurrence.seatsTaken,
      eventHorizonDays: event.bookingHorizonDays,
      eventNoticeMinutes: event.minNoticeMinutes,
      eventCancelHours: event.cancelDeadlineHours,
      underTimeOff: sql<boolean>`${UNDER_TIME_OFF}`,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .innerJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .where(and(publicFilter(pro, now), gte(occurrence.startsAt, range.start), lt(occurrence.startsAt, range.end)))
    .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(occurrence.id))
    .limit(PUBLIC_SEANCE_LIMIT);
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];

  const ticketsEventIds = [...new Set(rows.filter((r) => r.bookingMode === "tickets").map((r) => r.eventId))];
  const [elapsed, types] = await Promise.all([
    elapsedHoldsOf(db, pro.professionalId, rows.map((r) => r.occurrenceId), now),
    acceptedTypesOf(db, pro.professionalId, ticketsEventIds),
  ]);
  return rows.map(
    (r): PublicSeance => ({
      occurrenceId: r.occurrenceId,
      eventId: r.eventId,
      title: r.title,
      color: r.color,
      startsAt: r.startsAt,
      endsAt: r.endsAt,
      location: effectiveLocation(r.locationOverride, r.eventLocation),
      status: r.status,
      bookingMode: r.bookingMode,
      capacity: r.capacity,
      seatsLeft: seatsShown({
        capacity: r.capacity,
        seatsTaken: r.seatsTaken,
        elapsedHolds: elapsed.get(r.occurrenceId) ?? 0,
      }),
      acceptedTypes: r.bookingMode === "tickets" ? (types.get(r.eventId) ?? []) : [],
      window: effectiveWindow(pro.window, {
        bookingHorizonDays: r.eventHorizonDays,
        minNoticeMinutes: r.eventNoticeMinutes,
        cancelDeadlineHours: r.eventCancelHours,
      }),
      underTimeOff: r.underTimeOff,
    }),
  );
}

/** The start of the first séance listPublicSeances would show at or after `after`; null when none. */
export async function nextPublicSeanceStart(db: Db, pro: PlanningPro, after: Date, now: Date): Promise<Date | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({ startsAt: occurrence.startsAt })
    .from(occurrence)
    .innerJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .where(and(publicFilter(pro, now), gte(occurrence.startsAt, after)))
    .orderBy(asc(occurrence.startsAt), asc(occurrence.id))
    .limit(1);
  return row?.startsAt ?? null;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The Boutique read (spec L616-619, L1443, E9): what a visitor can buy on `/[slug]`, by ticket type. Testable core:
 * takes `db`, imports neither server-only, next/* nor the db index. Every statement filters `professional_id` on the
 * offer AND on its type; the pro comes from the slug on the server, never from input.
 */
import { and, asc, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { textArray, type Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { ticketOffer, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { offerLabel, validityLabel } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

export type BoutiqueOffer = {
  offerId: string;
  /** offerLabel(): the pro's label, « À l'unité » or « Carnet de N » */
  label: string;
  quantity: number;
  priceCents: number;
  /** validityLabel(): « 3 mois », « 30 jours »; null without validity */
  validityText: string | null;
};

export type BoutiqueType = {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  name: string;
  description: string | null;
  color: string;
  offers: BoutiqueOffer[];
  /** the titles of the public events that accept this type, in French alphabetical order */
  acceptedBy: string[];
};

const TITLE_COLLATOR = new Intl.Collator("fr", { sensitivity: "base" });

/**
 * « Utilisable pour »: per type, the distinct titles of the pro's public events that accept it. Same rule as the
 * pro's own « Accepté par » (catalog-reads): the latest non-archived segment of each series, in tickets mode (only a
 * tickets-mode event accepts tickets, a stale link on a free event does not count), and a private event is left out
 * of the public line (its title is not public). The privacy test is on the OUTER query: a series whose latest segment
 * is private does not fall back to an older public segment. Types with no such event are absent from the map.
 */
export async function acceptedByTitles(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  ticketTypeIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {
  const byType = new Map<string, string[]>();
  if (ticketTypeIds.length === 0) return byType;
  const res = await db.execute<{ ticket_type_id: string; title: string }>(sql`
    select l.ticket_type_id, e.title
    from (
      select distinct on (coalesce(series_root_id, id)) id, title, is_private, booking_mode
      from event
      where professional_id = ${professionalId} and archived_at is null
      order by coalesce(series_root_id, id), start_date desc, created_at desc, id desc
    ) e
    join event_ticket_type l on l.event_id = e.id
    where l.professional_id = ${professionalId} and e.booking_mode = 'tickets' and not e.is_private
      and l.ticket_type_id = any(${textArray(ticketTypeIds)})`);
  for (const r of res.rows) {
    const list = byType.get(r.ticket_type_id) ?? [];
    if (!list.includes(r.title)) list.push(r.title);
    byType.set(r.ticket_type_id, list);
  }
  for (const list of byType.values()) list.sort((a, b) => TITLE_COLLATOR.compare(a, b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
  return byType;
}

/**
 * L616-619, L1443: non-archived, non-rdv_free types with at least one active non-archived offer; offers by position,
 * created_at, id; acceptedBy = distinct titles of non-private non-archived events linking the type (acceptedByTitles,
 * fr collation). Types by position, created_at, id.
 */
export async function listBoutique(db: Db, professionalId: string): Promise<BoutiqueType[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      ticketTypeId: ticketType.id,
      name: ticketType.name,
      description: ticketType.description,
      color: ticketType.color,
      offerId: ticketOffer.id,
      label: ticketOffer.label,
      quantity: ticketOffer.quantity,
      priceCents: ticketOffer.priceCents,
      validityCount: ticketOffer.validityCount,
      validityUnit: ticketOffer.validityUnit,
    })
    .from(ticketOffer)
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, ticketOffer.ticketTypeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticketOffer.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(ticketOffer.isActive, true),
        isNull(ticketOffer.archivedAt),
        isNull(ticketType.archivedAt),
        eq(ticketType.rdvFree, false),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(
      asc(ticketType.position),
      asc(ticketType.createdAt),
      asc(ticketType.id),
      asc(ticketOffer.position),
      asc(ticketOffer.createdAt),
      asc(ticketOffer.id),
    );
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];

  const types = new Map<string, BoutiqueType>();
  for (const r of rows) {
    let type = types.get(r.ticketTypeId);
    if (!type) {
      type = { ticketTypeId: r.ticketTypeId, name: r.name, description: r.description, color: r.color, offers: [], acceptedBy: [] };
      types.set(r.ticketTypeId, type);
    }
    type.offers.push({
      offerId: r.offerId,
      label: offerLabel({ label: r.label, quantity: r.quantity }),
      quantity: r.quantity,
      priceCents: r.priceCents,
      validityText: validityLabel(r.validityCount, r.validityUnit),
    });
  }
  const accepted = await acceptedByTitles(db, professionalId, [...types.keys()]);
  for (const type of types.values()) type.acceptedBy = accepted.get(type.ticketTypeId) ?? [];
  return [...types.values()];
}
```

```ts
import "server-only";

import { cache } from "react";

import { minGeneratedUntil, needsHorizon } from "@/lib/booking/occurrences";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { listBoutique, type BoutiqueType } from "@/lib/public/boutique-reads";
import type { PublicPro } from "@/lib/public/context";
import { listPublicSeances, nextPublicSeanceStart, type PublicSeance } from "@/lib/public/planning-reads";
import { getPublicProfile } from "@/server/queries";

/*
 * Server-side readers of the public pages: thin wrappers that bind the db and the clock to the testable cores in
 * src/lib/public (planning, boutique, séance, offer, purchase reference). The pro always comes from the page slug
 * (resolvePublicPro or getPublicPageProfile), never from input; every client prop is built by the page from picked
 * fields.
 */

/**
 * The pro of the public page `/[slug]` with its presentation text (null for an unknown or suspended pro), memoized for
 * ONE request only (React `cache`, nothing shared between requests): generateMetadata and the page read the database
 * once. Public data only, no client data.
 */
export const getPublicPageProfile = cache((slug: string) => getPublicProfile(slug));

/** The séances of [start, end) the public page lists for this pro (see listPublicSeances). */
export function getPlanningPage(pro: PublicPro, range: { start: Date; end: Date }): Promise<PublicSeance[]> {
  return listPublicSeances(db, pro, range, new Date());
}

/** The start of the first séance the planning shows at or after `after`; null when none. */
export function getNextSeanceStart(pro: PublicPro, after: Date): Promise<Date | null> {
  return nextPublicSeanceStart(db, pro, after, new Date());
}

/** The Boutique of the pro: offers on sale by ticket type. */
export function getBoutiquePage(professionalId: string): Promise<BoutiqueType[]> {
  return listBoutique(db, professionalId);
}

/** True when an active series is generated less far ahead than a render tolerates (the page then schedules ensureHorizon in after()). */
export async function getHorizonNeed(pro: Pick<PublicPro, "professionalId" | "timezone">): Promise<boolean> {
  const now = new Date();
  return needsHorizon(await minGeneratedUntil(db, pro.professionalId, now), now, pro.timezone);
}
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):**
- S6 (tenancy): a cross-tenant case in `seance-reads.db.test.ts` (another pro's séance, customer, RDV; `livePendingHoldsOf` with another pro's id) and in `offer-reads.db.test.ts` (another pro's offer in both directions).
- S7 (`?p=` scoped to the Owner's customer, OUT:74): `visibility.test.ts` → `referenceForPage` is null for an Owner when the reference is another customer's.
- S10 (a verified session wins over the cookie, L1370): `visibility.test.ts` → a verified session without a record and an impersonating admin ignore a planted cookie in `seanceViewerOf`.
- S24 (no wallet or resume URL from a typed e-mail, a reference's customer or a cookie): `visibility.test.ts` → `seanceViewerOf` has no typed-e-mail input and returns no customer for a reference; `seance-reads.db.test.ts` → guest facts carry no URL.
- S25 (a private séance): `visibility.test.ts` → the `canSeePrivateSeance` matrix and `seancePageMode` private → closed.
- S32 (a `?p=` reference never exposes its customer): `visibility.test.ts` → `ReferenceView` has no `customerId` key; `seance-reads.db.test.ts` → the SEC-C1 scenario (an attacker's purchase on the victim's row, the victim's later hold on the same séance).
- S35 (a guest cookie never hides a form nor receives a purchase id, a Checkout URL or a wallet): `visibility.test.ts` → the guest never yields `booked`; `seance-reads.db.test.ts` → guest facts carry the status only.
- S36 (strangers cannot pin the Owner's holds): `seance-reads.db.test.ts` → `livePendingHoldsOf` lists the holds started with her address.

**Design notes (read before coding):**
- SEC-C1 and Decision 71 run through the whole task: the customer of a purchase came from an e-mail somebody typed, so a `?p=` reference is a capability for THAT purchase and its own booking and nothing else. `referenceForPage` compares the customer once (against the Owner) and drops it; `seanceViewerOf` returns `{ kind: "reference" }` for it, and the page calls `seanceVisitorFacts` only for `{ kind: "customer" }` (an Owner or a guest cookie), never with a reference's customer.
- `seanceVisitorFacts` first checks that the customer AND the séance belong to the pro (`activeBookingOf` and `usableTickets` take no professional id), then reads. For a guest cookie it fills the booking status only: `purchaseId` and `resumeUrl` stay null, `usable` and `ended` stay null (Decision 63). `bookingId` and `coverage` are filled for a guest because the contract's type requires them; the page must never pass either to a client component for a guest.
- A pending booking whose hold has lapsed is an ended one even before the sweep (Decision 31: seats shown use `hold_expires_at < now`): `ended` reports it as « expired », so the page does not depend on the nightly job.
- `usable` is computed for an Owner whatever her booking state (« what a spend would use right now »); N = usable tickets at `now` of the type the engine spends first (consumption order, Decision 45) minus one, never below 0.
- `getPublicSeance` returns every status, private and archived included: the page decides what to show (`canSeePrivateSeance`, `seancePageMode`). `acceptedTypes` and `offers` exist for tickets mode only. An id from the URL that is not an id (`idSchema`) is null without a read.
- `seancePageMode` follows Decision 9 literally: booked, then cancelled, then archived and private as closed, then every other state, then the mode's form. `PageBooking.via` has no `"guest"`: the page passes `booked: null` for a guest, and shows `COPY.GUEST_BOOKING_EXISTS` above the form instead (Task 26).
- How the pieces meet on the séance page (Tasks 26 to 28, contract § 3.21): `ref = paiement === "annule" && p ? await getPurchaseReference(pro.professionalId, p) : null`; `refView = referenceForPage(ref, { kind: "seance", occurrenceId }, visitor.owner)`; `viewer = seanceViewerOf({ visitor, reference: refView })`; `facts = viewer?.kind === "customer" ? await getSeanceVisitorFacts(pro.professionalId, occurrenceId, viewer) : null`.

```ts
  const guest: PublicVisitor = { ...ANONYMOUS, guestCustomerId: "c-cookie" };
  const expected: SeanceViewer = { kind: "customer", customerId: "c-cookie", source: "guest" };
  assert.deepEqual(seanceViewerOf({ visitor: guest, reference: null }), expected);
  assert.deepEqual(seanceViewerOf({ visitor: guest, reference: view() }), expected, "the cookie wins over a reference");
  const unverified: PublicVisitor = { ...guest, state: "unverified", email: "u@example.com", name: "U" };
  assert.deepEqual(seanceViewerOf({ visitor: unverified, reference: null }), expected);
});

test("seanceViewerOf: a reference alone is a reference, never a customer", () => {
  const alone = seanceViewerOf({ visitor: ANONYMOUS, reference: view() });
  assert.deepEqual(alone, { kind: "reference", reference: view() });
  assert.ok(alone && alone.kind === "reference");
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(alone).sort(), ["kind", "reference"], "no customer id next to a reference");
  assert.equal(seanceViewerOf({ visitor: ANONYMOUS, reference: null }), null);
  const unverified: PublicVisitor = { ...ANONYMOUS, state: "unverified", email: "u@example.com", name: "U" };
  assert.deepEqual(seanceViewerOf({ visitor: unverified, reference: view() }), { kind: "reference", reference: view() });
});

test("seanceViewerOf: an impossible owner on an impersonating visitor is not a customer", () => {
  const odd: PublicVisitor = { ...ANONYMOUS, state: "impersonating", owner: OWNER };
  assert.equal(seanceViewerOf({ visitor: odd, reference: null }), null);
});

test("canSeePrivateSeance: the page owner, a customer with an active booking, a reference whose booking is on it", () => {
  const owner: SeanceViewer = { kind: "customer", customerId: "c1", source: "owner" };
  const guest: SeanceViewer = { kind: "customer", customerId: "c2", source: "guest" };
  const byRef: SeanceViewer = { kind: "reference", reference: view() };
  const byShop: SeanceViewer = { kind: "reference", reference: view({ kind: "shop", booking: null }) };
  const none = { isPageOwner: false, customerHasActiveBooking: false };

  assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, isPageOwner: true, viewer: null }), true);
  assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, isPageOwner: true, viewer: guest }), true);
  assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, viewer: null }), false);
  assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, viewer: null, customerHasActiveBooking: true }), false);
  for (const viewer of [owner, guest]) {
    assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, viewer }), false, `${viewer.kind} without a booking`);
    assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, viewer, customerHasActiveBooking: true }), true, `${viewer.kind} with a booking`);
  }
  assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, viewer: byRef }), true);
  assert.equal(canSeePrivateSeance({ ...none, viewer: byShop }), false);
});

const OPEN: PublicSeanceState = { kind: "open", seatsLeft: 5 };
const FREE: PublicSeanceState = { kind: "free", seatsLeft: 5 };
const base = { state: OPEN, archived: false, isPrivate: false, booked: null, mode: "tickets" as const, canSpend: false, coveringOffers: 2 };

test("seancePageMode: the mode's form for an open or free séance", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode(base), { kind: "tickets", canSpend: false, coveringOffers: 2 });
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, canSpend: true, coveringOffers: 0 }), { kind: "tickets", canSpend: true, coveringOffers: 0 });
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, state: FREE, mode: "free" }), { kind: "free" });
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, mode: "none" }), { kind: "state", state: { kind: "onsite" } });
});

test("seancePageMode: every other state is shown as it is", () => {
  const states: PublicSeanceState[] = [
    { kind: "past" },
    { kind: "ongoing" },
    { kind: "onsite" },
    { kind: "notYet" },
    { kind: "closed" },
    { kind: "full" },
    { kind: "cancelled" },
  ];
  for (const state of states) assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, state }), { kind: "state", state });
});

test("seancePageMode: archived and private are closed, a cancelled séance stays cancelled", () => {
  const closed = { kind: "state", state: { kind: "closed" } };
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, archived: true }), closed);
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, isPrivate: true }), closed);
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, isPrivate: true, state: FREE, mode: "free" }), closed);
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, archived: true, state: { kind: "full" } }), closed);
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, archived: true, isPrivate: true, state: { kind: "cancelled" } }), {
    kind: "state",
    state: { kind: "cancelled" },
  });
});

test("seancePageMode: the Owner's or the reference's booking comes first", () => {
  const confirmed: PageBooking = { status: "confirmed", via: "owner" };
  const pending: PageBooking = { status: "pending", via: "reference" };
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, booked: confirmed }), { kind: "booked", status: "confirmed", via: "owner" });
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, booked: pending, state: { kind: "full" } }), { kind: "booked", status: "pending", via: "reference" });
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, booked: confirmed, isPrivate: true, archived: true }), {
    kind: "booked",
    status: "confirmed",
    via: "owner",
  });
});

test("seancePageMode: a guest cookie's booking is never a PageBooking, so it never hides the form", () => {
  // The page passes booked: null for a guest viewer (PageBooking has no "guest" via): the form stays.
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, booked: null }), { kind: "tickets", canSpend: false, coveringOffers: 2 });
  assert.deepEqual(seancePageMode({ ...base, booked: null, state: FREE, mode: "free" }), { kind: "free" });
});

test("no module string carries a dash", () => {
  const strings = JSON.stringify([seancePageMode(base), referenceForPage(ref(), SEANCE, null)]);
  assert.equal(NO_DASH.test(strings), false);
});
```
