```ts
/**
 * Who sees what on a séance or an offer page (spec L1445-1455, Decisions 9, 21, 63, 71). Pure: the page reads the
 * `?p=` purchase, the visitor and the customer facts, and these functions decide what each of them may use. The one
 * rule that runs through all of them: a `?p=` reference shows THAT purchase and its own booking, never its customer,
 * because the customer of a purchase came from an e-mail somebody typed (SEC-C1). Nothing here imports the database.
 */
import type { BookingMode, BookingStatus, PurchaseStatus } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

import type { PublicVisitor, WalletOwner } from "./identity";
import type { PublicSeanceState } from "./planning-view";
import type { PurchaseReference } from "./purchase-reads";

/** What a ?p= reference lets a page show: THAT purchase and its own booking, never its customer (Decision 71). */
export type ReferenceView = {
  purchaseId: string;
  kind: "buybook" | "shop";
  status: PurchaseStatus;
  processing: boolean;
  livemode: boolean;
  resumeUrl: string | null;
  /** ISO */
  holdExpiresAt: string | null;
  booking: { occurrenceId: string; status: BookingStatus } | null;
};

/**
 * The reference as this page may use it, or null: null for no reference; on a séance page when its booking is not on
 * this occurrence; on an offer page when its offer is not this offer or it has a booking; and whenever an Owner is
 * signed in and the reference is not her customer's (OUT:74). The customerId is compared here and dropped.
 */
export function referenceForPage(
  ref: PurchaseReference | null,
  page: { kind: "seance"; occurrenceId: string } | { kind: "offer"; offerId: string },
  owner: WalletOwner | null,
): ReferenceView | null {
  if (ref === null) return null;
  if (owner !== null && ref.customerId !== owner.customerId) return null;
  if (page.kind === "seance") {
    if (ref.booking === null || ref.booking.occurrenceId !== page.occurrenceId) return null;
  } else if (ref.offerId !== page.offerId || ref.booking !== null) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    purchaseId: ref.purchaseId,
    kind: ref.booking === null ? "shop" : "buybook",
    status: ref.status,
    processing: ref.processing,
    livemode: ref.livemode,
    resumeUrl: ref.resumeUrl,
    holdExpiresAt: ref.booking?.holdExpiresAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    booking: ref.booking === null ? null : { occurrenceId: ref.booking.occurrenceId, status: ref.booking.status },
  };
}

export type SeanceViewer =
  | { kind: "customer"; customerId: string; source: "owner" | "guest" }
  | { kind: "reference"; reference: ReferenceView }
  | null;

/**
 * A purchase reference shows THAT purchase and its own booking, never its customer: the customer of a purchase came
 * from a typed e-mail (SEC-C1). Order: the Owner -> customer/owner; an impersonating or verified session without a
 * record -> the reference when set, else null (the cookie is ignored, L1370); the guest cookie customer ->
 * customer/guest; else the reference when set; else null. Never a typed e-mail.
 */
export function seanceViewerOf(a: { visitor: PublicVisitor; reference: ReferenceView | null }): SeanceViewer {
  const { visitor, reference } = a;
  const byReference: SeanceViewer = reference === null ? null : { kind: "reference", reference };
  if (visitor.owner !== null && visitor.state === "verified") {
    return { kind: "customer", customerId: visitor.owner.customerId, source: "owner" };
  }
  if (visitor.state === "impersonating" || visitor.state === "verified") return byReference;
  if (visitor.guestCustomerId !== null) return { kind: "customer", customerId: visitor.guestCustomerId, source: "guest" };
  return byReference;
}

/**
 * L1452: a private séance is shown to the page owner, to a customer viewer (Owner or guest) with an active booking on
 * it, or to a reference whose booking is on it (referenceForPage already checked the occurrence); else notFound().
 */
export function canSeePrivateSeance(a: {
  isPageOwner: boolean;
  viewer: SeanceViewer;
  customerHasActiveBooking: boolean;
}): boolean {
  if (a.isPageOwner) return true;
  if (a.viewer === null) return false;
  if (a.viewer.kind === "customer") return a.customerHasActiveBooking;
  return a.viewer.reference.booking !== null;
}

/**
 * The booking state the page may act on: the Owner's active booking (from seanceVisitorFacts), or the reference's own
 * booking (pending while the purchase is pending and its hold has not ended, confirmed when confirmed); NEVER the
 * guest cookie's (Decision 63).
 */
export type PageBooking = { status: "pending" | "confirmed"; via: "owner" | "reference" } | null;

export type SeancePageMode =
  | { kind: "state"; state: PublicSeanceState }
  | { kind: "booked"; status: "pending" | "confirmed"; via: "owner" | "reference" }
  | { kind: "free" }
  | { kind: "tickets"; canSpend: boolean; coveringOffers: number };

/**
 * Decision 9, precedence (exact): booked (PageBooking) -> booked; state cancelled -> state; archived -> state closed
 * (COV-M4b); private -> state closed (COV-M4a: a private séance is never bookable online); any other state than free /
 * open -> state; then the mode's form. A guest cookie's booking never hides the form: the page shows
 * COPY.GUEST_BOOKING_EXISTS above it instead.
 */
export function seancePageMode(a: {
  state: PublicSeanceState;
  archived: boolean;
  isPrivate: boolean;
  booked: PageBooking;
  mode: BookingMode;
  canSpend: boolean;
  coveringOffers: number;
}): SeancePageMode {
  if (a.booked !== null) return { kind: "booked", status: a.booked.status, via: a.booked.via };
  if (a.state.kind === "cancelled") return { kind: "state", state: a.state };
  if (a.archived || a.isPrivate) return { kind: "state", state: { kind: "closed" } };
  if (a.state.kind !== "free" && a.state.kind !== "open") return { kind: "state", state: a.state };
  if (a.mode === "free") return { kind: "free" };
  if (a.mode === "tickets") return { kind: "tickets", canSpend: a.canSpend, coveringOffers: a.coveringOffers };
  return { kind: "state", state: { kind: "onsite" } };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The offer page read (spec L1458-1459, E9). Testable core: takes `db`, imports neither server-only, next/* nor the db
 * index. The pro comes from the slug on the server; the offer id comes from the URL, so it is checked as an id and
 * against the pro before anything is returned.
 */
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { ticketOffer, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { idSchema, offerLabel, validityLabel } from "@/lib/tickets";

import { acceptedByTitles } from "./boutique-reads";

export type PublicOfferDetail =
  | {
      kind: "on_sale";
      offerId: string;
      ticketTypeId: string;
      ticketTypeName: string;
      typeDescription: string | null;
      color: string;
      label: string;
      quantity: number;
      priceCents: number;
      validityText: string | null;
      acceptedBy: string[];
    }
  | { kind: "unavailable" };

/**
 * L1458-1459: an active offer of a non-archived, non-rdv_free type -> on_sale; inactive, archived or of an archived
 * (or free) type -> unavailable, with nothing of the offer; another pro's, unknown or not an id -> null.
 */
export async function getPublicOffer(db: Db, professionalId: string, offerId: string): Promise<PublicOfferDetail | null> {
  if (!idSchema.safeParse(offerId).success) return null;
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      ticketTypeId: ticketType.id,
      ticketTypeName: ticketType.name,
      typeDescription: ticketType.description,
      color: ticketType.color,
      typeArchivedAt: ticketType.archivedAt,
      rdvFree: ticketType.rdvFree,
      label: ticketOffer.label,
      quantity: ticketOffer.quantity,
      priceCents: ticketOffer.priceCents,
      validityCount: ticketOffer.validityCount,
      validityUnit: ticketOffer.validityUnit,
      isActive: ticketOffer.isActive,
      archivedAt: ticketOffer.archivedAt,
    })
    .from(ticketOffer)
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, ticketOffer.ticketTypeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticketOffer.id, offerId),
        eq(ticketOffer.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId),
      ),
    );
  if (!row) return null;
  if (!row.isActive || row.archivedAt !== null || row.typeArchivedAt !== null || row.rdvFree) {
    return { kind: "unavailable" };
  }
  const accepted = await acceptedByTitles(db, professionalId, [row.ticketTypeId]);
  return {
    kind: "on_sale",
    offerId,
    ticketTypeId: row.ticketTypeId,
    ticketTypeName: row.ticketTypeName,
    typeDescription: row.typeDescription,
    color: row.color,
    label: offerLabel({ label: row.label, quantity: row.quantity }),
    quantity: row.quantity,
    priceCents: row.priceCents,
    validityText: validityLabel(row.validityCount, row.validityUnit),
    acceptedBy: accepted.get(row.ticketTypeId) ?? [],
  };
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { nanoid } from "nanoid";

import { cancelOccurrence } from "@/lib/booking/cancel";
import { setTicketTypeArchived } from "@/lib/booking/catalog";
import { attachCheckoutSession, bookWithHeldTicket, startBuyAndBook } from "@/lib/booking/claims";
import { releasePurchase } from "@/lib/booking/release";
import { instantAt } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { event, occurrence, question, ticketOffer, timeOff } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { addMinutes, createTestPro, dbTest, deleteTestUser, testEmail, type DbHarness, type TestPro } from "@/test/db";
import { dayIn, giveTickets, makeCustomer, makeEvent, makeOffer, makeType } from "@/test/fixtures";
import { rowBooking, rowCustomer, rowEvent, rowLink, rowOffer, rowPurchase, rowRdv, rowRdvType, rowSeance, rowType } from "@/test/rows";

import type { PublicVisitor } from "./identity";
import { purchaseByReference } from "./purchase-reads";
import { getPublicSeance, livePendingHoldsOf, seanceVisitorFacts } from "./seance-reads";
import { referenceForPage, seanceViewerOf } from "./visibility";

const WINDOW = { bookingHorizonDays: 60, minNoticeMinutes: 60, cancelDeadlineHours: 24 };
const proOf = (pro: TestPro) => ({ professionalId: pro.proId, timezone: pro.tz, window: WINDOW });

/** A tickets séance in 3 days at 10:00 with one linked type, one offer of 4 tickets and one customer (the victim of a typed address). */
async function world(h: DbHarness) {
  const typeId = await makeType(h.db, h.pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const offerId = await makeOffer(h.db, h.pro, typeId, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500 });
  const { eventId, occurrences } = await makeEvent(h.db, h.pro, { title: "Altinha débutants", ticketTypeIds: [typeId] });
  const customerId = await makeCustomer(h.db, h.pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida", email: testEmail("beatriz") });
  return { typeId, offerId, eventId, occ: occurrences[0], customerId };
}

async function buyAndBook(h: DbHarness, w: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof world>>, now: Date, over: { customerId?: string; occurrenceId?: string; startsAt?: Date } = {}) {
  const res = await startBuyAndBook(
    h.db,
    {
      professionalId: h.pro.proId,
      occurrenceId: over.occurrenceId ?? w.occ.id,
      customerId: over.customerId ?? w.customerId,
      seenStartsAt: over.startsAt ?? w.occ.startsAt,
      offerId: w.offerId,
    },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(res.ok, JSON.stringify(res));
  return res;
}

/** A pending booking (ticket coverage) backed by a pending purchase, as « buy + book » leaves it until the client pays. */
async function pendingHold(h: DbHarness, args: { occurrenceId: string; typeId: string; offerId: string; holdExpiresAt: Date }): Promise<void> {
  const customerId = await rowCustomer(h.db, h.pro);
  const purchaseId = await rowPurchase(h.db, h.pro, { customerId, offerId: args.offerId, ticketTypeId: args.typeId });
  await rowBooking(h.db, h.pro, {
    occurrenceId: args.occurrenceId,
    customerId,
    status: "pending",
    coverage: "ticket",
    purchaseId,
    holdExpiresAt: args.holdExpiresAt,
  });
}

const ANONYMOUS: PublicVisitor = { state: "anonymous", email: null, name: null, isPageOwner: false, owner: null, guestCustomerId: null };

/* ───────────────────────── getPublicSeance ───────────────────────── */

dbTest("getPublicSeance: the séance with its place, seats, types, questions and the offers that can pay for it", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const collectif = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif", color: "#22c55e" });
  const unite = await makeOffer(db, pro, collectif, { quantity: 1, priceCents: 2500 });
  const trimestre = await makeOffer(db, pro, collectif, { quantity: 4, priceCents: 8500, validityCount: 3, validityUnit: "month" });
  const court = await makeOffer(db, pro, collectif, { quantity: 2, priceCents: 4500, validityCount: 1, validityUnit: "day" });
  const inactive = await makeOffer(db, pro, collectif, { quantity: 10, priceCents: 19000, isActive: false });
  const archivedOffer = await makeOffer(db, pro, collectif, { quantity: 3, priceCents: 6500 });
  await db.update(ticketOffer).set({ archivedAt: now }).where(eq(ticketOffer.id, archivedOffer));
  const essai = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours d'essai" });
  const essaiOffer = await makeOffer(db, pro, essai, { quantity: 1, priceCents: 1500 });
  const ancien = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Ancien type" });
  await makeOffer(db, pro, ancien, { quantity: 1, priceCents: 2000 });
  const free = await rowType(db, pro, { name: "Cours gratuit", rdvEnabled: true, rdvFree: true, rdvDurationMin: 60 });
  await rowOffer(db, pro, free);

  // A séance in 10 days: a one-day offer cannot cover it.
  const { eventId, occurrences } = await makeEvent(
    db,
    pro,
    { title: "Altinha débutants", capacity: 12, ticketTypeIds: [collectif, essai, ancien], rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 10, now) } },
    now,
  );
  await rowLink(db, pro, eventId, free);
  const archivedType = await setTicketTypeArchived(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, ticketTypeId: ancien, archived: true });
  assert.ok(archivedType.ok, JSON.stringify(archivedType));
  await db.update(event).set({ description: "Séance d'initiation.", location: "Gymnase Jean Bouin" }).where(eq(event.id, eventId));
  await db.insert(question).values({ professionalId: pro.proId, eventId, label: "Votre niveau ?", type: "text", required: true, position: 0 });

  const got = await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(pro), occurrences[0].id, now);
  assert.ok(got && got.kind === "seance", JSON.stringify(got));
  assert.deepEqual(
    [got.occurrenceId, got.eventId, got.title, got.description, got.location, got.bookingMode, got.status, got.capacity, got.seatsLeft],
    [occurrences[0].id, eventId, "Altinha débutants", "Séance d'initiation.", "Gymnase Jean Bouin", "tickets", "scheduled", 12, 12],
  );
  assert.deepEqual([got.isPrivate, got.archived, got.underTimeOff], [false, false, false]);
  assert.deepEqual(got.startsAt, occurrences[0].startsAt);
  assert.deepEqual(got.endsAt, occurrences[0].endsAt);
  assert.deepEqual(got.window, WINDOW);
  assert.deepEqual(got.acceptedTypes.map((t) => t.name).sort(), ["Cours collectif", "Cours d'essai", "Cours gratuit"], "the archived type is dropped");
  assert.deepEqual(
    got.questions.map((q) => [q.label, q.type, q.required]),
    [["Votre niveau ?", "text", true]],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    got.offers.map((o) => [o.offerId, o.label, o.ticketTypeName, o.priceCents, o.validityText, o.covers]),
    [
      [unite, "À l'unité", "Cours collectif", 2500, null, true],
      [trimestre, "Carnet de 4", "Cours collectif", 8500, "3 mois", true],
      [court, "Carnet de 2", "Cours collectif", 4500, "1 jour", false],
      [essaiOffer, "À l'unité", "Cours d'essai", 1500, null, true],
    ],
    "inactive and archived offers, the archived type's and the free type's offers are left out; a one-day offer does not cover a séance in 10 days",
  );
  assert.equal(got.offers.some((o) => o.offerId === inactive), false);
  assert.deepEqual(got.offers[0].ticketTypeId, collectif);
});

dbTest("getPublicSeance: private, archived, cancelled, under a time off, a lapsed hold, free and onsite séances", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const typeId = await rowType(db, pro);
  const offerId = await rowOffer(db, pro, typeId);

  const priv = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Équipe compétition", isPrivate: true }, now);
  const archivedEvent = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Atelier archivé" }, now);
  await db.update(event).set({ archivedAt: now }).where(eq(event.id, archivedEvent.eventId));
  const struck = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha annulée" }, now);
  const cancelled = await cancelOccurrence(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, actorUserId: pro.userId, occurrenceId: struck.occurrences[0].id }, now);
  assert.ok(cancelled.ok, JSON.stringify(cancelled));
  const blocked = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha bloquée", rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 5, now) } }, now);
  await db.insert(timeOff).values({
    id: nanoid(),
    professionalId: pro.proId,
    startAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 5, now), 0, pro.tz),
    endAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 6, now), 0, pro.tz),
    allDay: true,
    reason: null,
  });
  const lapsed = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha abandonnée", capacity: 5, rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 4, now) } }, now);
  await db.update(occurrence).set({ seatsTaken: 1 }).where(eq(occurrence.id, lapsed.occurrences[0].id));
  await pendingHold(
    { db, pro },
    { occurrenceId: lapsed.occurrences[0].id, typeId, offerId, holdExpiresAt: addMinutes(now, -5) },
  );
  const roda = await rowEvent(db, pro, { bookingMode: "free" }, now);
  await rowLink(db, pro, roda, typeId);
  const rodaSeance = await rowSeance(db, pro, roda, { startsAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 7, now), 600, pro.tz), seriesDate: dayIn(pro, 7, now) }, now);
  const onsite = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Atelier sur place", bookingMode: "none", rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 8, now) } }, now);

  const read = async (id: string) => {
    const got = await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(pro), id, now);
    assert.ok(got && got.kind === "seance", id);
    return got;
  };
  const p = await read(priv.occurrences[0].id);
  assert.deepEqual([p.title, p.isPrivate, p.archived, p.status], ["Équipe compétition", true, false, "scheduled"]);
  const a = await read(archivedEvent.occurrences[0].id);
  assert.deepEqual([a.isPrivate, a.archived], [false, true]);
  const c = await read(struck.occurrences[0].id);
  assert.equal(c.status, "cancelled");
  const t = await read(blocked.occurrences[0].id);
  assert.equal(t.underTimeOff, true, "an empty séance under a time off is still readable by its URL: the page says « Réservations fermées »");
  const l = await read(lapsed.occurrences[0].id);
  assert.deepEqual([l.capacity, l.seatsLeft], [5, 5], "a lapsed hold is a free seat");
  const f = await read(rodaSeance);
  assert.deepEqual([f.bookingMode, f.acceptedTypes, f.offers], ["free", [], []], "a free séance has no accepted type and sells nothing, a stale link or not");
  const o = await read(onsite.occurrences[0].id);
  assert.deepEqual([o.bookingMode, o.acceptedTypes, o.offers], ["none", [], []]);
});

dbTest("getPublicSeance: an RDV is { kind: rdv }, another pro's séance, an unknown id and a malformed id are null", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const rdvType = await rowRdvType(db, pro, { name: "Cours particulier" });
  const rdv = await rowRdv(db, pro, rdvType, {}, now);
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: rdv, customerId: await rowCustomer(db, pro) }, now);
  const mine = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha débutants" }, now);
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const theirs = await makeEvent(db, other, { title: "Chez l'autre" }, now);
    assert.deepEqual(await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(pro), rdv, now), { kind: "rdv" });
    assert.equal(await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(pro), theirs.occurrences[0].id, now), null, "another pro's séance");
    assert.equal(await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(other), mine.occurrences[0].id, now), null, "and the other way round");
    assert.equal(await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(other), rdv, now), null, "another pro's RDV is not an RDV of this one");
    assert.equal((await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(other), theirs.occurrences[0].id, now))?.kind, "seance");
    for (const bad of ["inconnu", "", "x".repeat(65), "../etc", "a b"]) {
      assert.equal(await getPublicSeance(db, proOf(pro), bad, now), null, JSON.stringify(bad));
    }
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

dbTest("seanceVisitorFacts (owner): nothing, then the tickets that would pay, left after this séance", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const w = await world({ db, pro });
  const now = new Date();
  const viewer = { customerId: w.customerId, source: "owner" } as const;
  assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer, now), { booking: null, ended: null, usable: null });

  await giveTickets(db, pro, w.customerId, w.typeId, 3);
  assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer, now), {
    booking: null,
    ended: null,
    usable: { typeName: "Cours collectif", leftAfter: 2 },
  });
});

dbTest("seanceVisitorFacts (owner): the type spent first is the one that expires first; unfit tickets are not usable here", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const now = new Date();
  const soonest = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours d'essai" });
  const open = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Cours collectif" });
  const unlinked = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Stage d'été" });
  const archived = await makeType(db, pro, { name: "Ancien type" });
  const { occurrences } = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha débutants", ticketTypeIds: [soonest, open, archived] }, now);
  const occ = occurrences[0];
  const viewer = (customerId: string) => ({ customerId, source: "owner" as const });

  const beatriz = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Beatriz Almeida" });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, beatriz, open, 3);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, beatriz, soonest, 2, { expiresAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 20, now), 0, pro.tz) });
  assert.deepEqual((await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, occ.id, viewer(beatriz), now)).usable, { typeName: "Cours d'essai", leftAfter: 1 });

  // A ticket that expires before the séance, a ticket of a type the event does not accept and a ticket of an archived type.
  const rafael = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Rafael Souza" });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, rafael, open, 1, { expiresAt: instantAt(dayIn(pro, 2, now), 0, pro.tz) });
  await giveTickets(db, pro, rafael, unlinked, 1);
  await giveTickets(db, pro, rafael, archived, 1);
  const archivedType = await setTicketTypeArchived(db, { professionalId: pro.proId, ticketTypeId: archived, archived: true });
  assert.ok(archivedType.ok, JSON.stringify(archivedType));
  assert.equal((await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, occ.id, viewer(rafael), now)).usable, null);
});

dbTest("seanceVisitorFacts (owner): a pending booking carries its purchase and its resume URL while the session is open", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const h = { db, pro };
  const w = await world(h);
  const now = new Date();
  const started = await buyAndBook(h, w, now);
  const attached = await attachCheckoutSession(db, { purchaseId: started.purchaseId, checkoutSessionId: "cs_test_1", checkoutUrl: "https://checkout.test/p1" }, now);
  assert.ok(attached.ok);
  const viewer = { customerId: w.customerId, source: "owner" } as const;

  assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer, now), {
    booking: { bookingId: started.bookingId, status: "pending", coverage: "ticket", purchaseId: started.purchaseId, resumeUrl: "https://checkout.test/p1" },
    ended: null,
    usable: null,
  });
  // 35 minutes in: the Checkout session (31 minutes) is closed, the hold (45 minutes) is not: no URL, the purchase can still be released.
  const later = await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer, addMinutes(now, 35));
  assert.deepEqual(later.booking, { bookingId: started.bookingId, status: "pending", coverage: "ticket", purchaseId: started.purchaseId, resumeUrl: null });
  // 50 minutes in: the hold has lapsed, the seat is free and the sweep has not run: the booking is an ended one.
  assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer, addMinutes(now, 50)), { booking: null, ended: "expired", usable: null });
});

dbTest("seanceVisitorFacts (owner): a confirmed booking, with a ticket or not", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const w = await world({ db, pro });
  const now = new Date();
  await giveTickets(db, pro, w.customerId, w.typeId, 1);

    db,
    { professionalId: pro.proId, occurrenceId: w.occ.id, customerId: w.customerId, seenStartsAt: w.occ.startsAt, actorUserId: pro.userId },
    now,
  );
  assert.ok(booked.ok, JSON.stringify(booked));
  assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, { customerId: w.customerId, source: "owner" }, now), {
    booking: { bookingId: booked.bookingId, status: "confirmed", coverage: "ticket", purchaseId: null, resumeUrl: null },
    ended: null,
    usable: null,
  });

  const free = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Rafael Souza" });

  assert.deepEqual(facts.booking, { bookingId: guestBooking, status: "confirmed", coverage: "guest", purchaseId: null, resumeUrl: null });
});

dbTest("seanceVisitorFacts (owner): the latest ended booking says how it ended, an active one hides it", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const w = await world({ db, pro });
  const now = new Date();
  const viewer = (customerId: string) => ({ customerId, source: "owner" as const });
  const ended = (customerId: string, status: "cancelled" | "expired", at: Date) =>
    rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: w.occ.id, customerId, status }, at);

  await ended(w.customerId, "cancelled", addMinutes(now, -120));
  await ended(w.customerId, "expired", addMinutes(now, -60));
  assert.equal((await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer(w.customerId), now)).ended, "expired", "the expired one is the latest");

  const other = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Rafael Souza" });
  await ended(other, "expired", addMinutes(now, -120));
  await ended(other, "cancelled", addMinutes(now, -60));
  assert.equal((await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer(other), now)).ended, "cancelled", "the cancelled one is the latest");

  // An active booking after an ended one: no ended state.
  const third = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Marina Costa" });
  await ended(third, "cancelled", addMinutes(now, -60));
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: w.occ.id, customerId: third, status: "confirmed" }, now);
  await db.update(occurrence).set({ seatsTaken: 1 }).where(eq(occurrence.id, w.occ.id));
  const facts = await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, viewer(third), now);
  assert.equal(facts.ended, null);
  assert.equal(facts.booking?.status, "confirmed");
});

dbTest("seanceVisitorFacts (guest cookie): the status of the booking only, never a purchase, a URL, a wallet or an ended state (Decision 63)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const h = { db, pro };
  const w = await world(h);
  const now = new Date();
  const guest = { customerId: w.customerId, source: "guest" } as const;
  await giveTickets(db, pro, w.customerId, w.typeId, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, guest, now), { booking: null, ended: null, usable: null }, "tickets are not shown to a cookie");

  const started = await buyAndBook(h, w, now);
  const attached = await attachCheckoutSession(db, { purchaseId: started.purchaseId, checkoutSessionId: "cs_test_1", checkoutUrl: "https://checkout.test/p1" }, now);
  assert.ok(attached.ok);
  const facts = await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, guest, now);
  assert.deepEqual(facts, {
    booking: { bookingId: started.bookingId, status: "pending", coverage: "ticket", purchaseId: null, resumeUrl: null },
    ended: null,
    usable: null,
  });
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(facts).includes(started.purchaseId), false);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(facts).includes("checkout.test"), false);

  // The same state for the Owner carries both.
  const owner = await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, { customerId: w.customerId, source: "owner" }, now);
  assert.equal(owner.booking?.purchaseId, started.purchaseId);
  assert.equal(owner.booking?.resumeUrl, "https://checkout.test/p1");

  // Ended: nothing for a cookie.
  const released = await releasePurchase(db, started.purchaseId, addMinutes(now, 1));
  assert.ok(released.ok, JSON.stringify(released));
  assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, guest, addMinutes(now, 2)), { booking: null, ended: null, usable: null });
  assert.equal((await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, { customerId: w.customerId, source: "owner" }, addMinutes(now, 2))).ended, "expired");
});

dbTest("seanceVisitorFacts: a customer or a séance of another pro gives empty facts", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const w = await world({ db, pro });
  const now = new Date();
  await giveTickets(db, pro, w.customerId, w.typeId, 2);
  await rowBooking(db, pro, { occurrenceId: w.occ.id, customerId: w.customerId, status: "confirmed", coverage: "guest" }, now);
  await db.update(occurrence).set({ seatsTaken: 1 }).where(eq(occurrence.id, w.occ.id));
  const empty = { booking: null, ended: null, usable: null };
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    const theirCustomer = await makeCustomer(db, other, { name: "Chez l'autre" });
    const theirs = await makeEvent(db, other, { title: "Chez l'autre" }, now);
    for (const source of ["owner", "guest"] as const) {
      assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, other.proId, w.occ.id, { customerId: w.customerId, source }, now), empty, `${source}: my customer, my séance, their pro`);
      assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, theirs.occurrences[0].id, { customerId: w.customerId, source }, now), empty, `${source}: their séance`);
      assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, { customerId: theirCustomer, source }, now), empty, `${source}: their customer`);
      assert.deepEqual(await seanceVisitorFacts(db, other.proId, theirs.occurrences[0].id, { customerId: w.customerId, source }, now), empty, `${source}: my customer at their séance`);
    }
    assert.equal((await seanceVisitorFacts(db, pro.proId, w.occ.id, { customerId: w.customerId, source: "owner" }, now)).booking?.status, "confirmed");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

/* ───────────────────────── livePendingHoldsOf ───────────────────────── */

dbTest("livePendingHoldsOf: the holds anonymous requests started with her address, soonest end first, and nothing else (SEC-I6)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const h = { db, pro };
  const w = await world(h);
  const second = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha intermédiaires", ticketTypeIds: [w.typeId], rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 4) } });
  const now = new Date();
  const holdA = await buyAndBook(h, w, now);
  const holdB = await buyAndBook(h, w, addMinutes(now, 5), { occurrenceId: second.occurrences[0].id, startsAt: second.occurrences[0].startsAt });
  // Somebody else's hold on the same séance is not hers.
  const stranger = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Rafael Souza" });
  await buyAndBook(h, w, now, { customerId: stranger });

  const listed = await livePendingHoldsOf(db, pro.proId, w.customerId, addMinutes(now, 6));
  assert.deepEqual(
    listed.map((x) => [x.purchaseId, x.occurrenceId, x.title]),
    [
      [holdA.purchaseId, w.occ.id, "Altinha débutants"],
      [holdB.purchaseId, second.occurrences[0].id, "Altinha intermédiaires"],
    ],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(listed.map((x) => x.holdExpiresAt), [addMinutes(now, 45), addMinutes(now, 50)]);
  assert.deepEqual(listed.map((x) => x.startsAt), [w.occ.startsAt, second.occurrences[0].startsAt]);

  // The first hold has lapsed after 45 minutes, the second after 50.
  assert.deepEqual((await livePendingHoldsOf(db, pro.proId, w.customerId, addMinutes(now, 46))).map((x) => x.purchaseId), [holdB.purchaseId]);
  assert.deepEqual(await livePendingHoldsOf(db, pro.proId, w.customerId, addMinutes(now, 51)), []);

  // A released hold goes; the stranger's customer has its own list.
  const released = await releasePurchase(db, holdB.purchaseId, addMinutes(now, 10));
  assert.ok(released.ok, JSON.stringify(released));
  assert.deepEqual((await livePendingHoldsOf(db, pro.proId, w.customerId, addMinutes(now, 11))).map((x) => x.purchaseId), [holdA.purchaseId]);
  assert.equal((await livePendingHoldsOf(db, pro.proId, stranger, addMinutes(now, 11))).length, 1);
});

dbTest("livePendingHoldsOf: a confirmed booking is not a hold, another pro's id lists nothing", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const w = await world({ db, pro });
  const now = new Date();
  await giveTickets(db, pro, w.customerId, w.typeId, 1);
  const booked = await bookWithHeldTicket(
    db,

    now,
  );
  assert.ok(booked.ok, JSON.stringify(booked));
  assert.deepEqual(await livePendingHoldsOf(db, pro.proId, w.customerId, now), []);

  const h = { db, pro };
  const holder = await makeCustomer(db, pro, { name: "Rafael Souza" });
  await buyAndBook(h, w, now, { customerId: holder });
  const other = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    assert.equal((await livePendingHoldsOf(db, pro.proId, holder, now)).length, 1);
    assert.deepEqual(await livePendingHoldsOf(db, other.proId, holder, now), [], "another pro's id");
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, other.userId);
  }
});

/* ───────────────────────── SEC-C1 ───────────────────────── */

dbTest("a ?p= reference carries its own purchase and booking only: the victim's later hold on the same séance stays hidden (SEC-C1)", async ({ db, pro }) => {
  const h = { db, pro };
  const w = await world(h);
  const now = new Date();

  // The attacker types the victim's address, starts a purchase P, and lets it go.
  const attack = await buyAndBook(h, w, now);
  const attackSession = await attachCheckoutSession(db, { purchaseId: attack.purchaseId, checkoutSessionId: "cs_attacker", checkoutUrl: "https://checkout.test/attacker" }, now);
  assert.ok(attackSession.ok);
  const released = await releasePurchase(db, attack.purchaseId, addMinutes(now, 1));
  assert.ok(released.ok && released.released, JSON.stringify(released));

  // The victim then holds her own seat on the same séance.
  const mine = await buyAndBook(h, w, addMinutes(now, 2));
  const mineSession = await attachCheckoutSession(db, { purchaseId: mine.purchaseId, checkoutSessionId: "cs_victim", checkoutUrl: "https://checkout.test/victim" }, addMinutes(now, 2));
  assert.ok(mineSession.ok);
  const at = addMinutes(now, 3);
  const page = { kind: "seance", occurrenceId: w.occ.id } as const;

  const ref = await purchaseByReference(db, pro.proId, attack.purchaseId, at);
  assert.ok(ref);
  const view = referenceForPage(ref, page, null);
  assert.ok(view);
  assert.equal(view.purchaseId, attack.purchaseId);
  assert.deepEqual(view.booking, { occurrenceId: w.occ.id, status: "expired" }, "its own booking, which ended");
  assert.deepEqual([view.status, view.resumeUrl], ["expired", null]);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(view).sort(), ["booking", "holdExpiresAt", "kind", "livemode", "processing", "purchaseId", "resumeUrl", "status"], "no customerId, no balance");
  const text = JSON.stringify(view);
  for (const secret of [mine.purchaseId, mine.bookingId, "https://checkout.test/victim", w.customerId]) {
    assert.equal(text.includes(secret), false, `the view leaks ${secret}`);
  }

  // The viewer of that reference is the reference: the page never asks the facts of a customer for it.
  assert.deepEqual(seanceViewerOf({ visitor: ANONYMOUS, reference: view }), { kind: "reference", reference: view });

  // The victim's own reference shows her own purchase, and only hers.
  const ownRef = await purchaseByReference(db, pro.proId, mine.purchaseId, at);
  const own = referenceForPage(ownRef, page, null);
  assert.deepEqual([own?.purchaseId, own?.status, own?.resumeUrl], [mine.purchaseId, "pending", "https://checkout.test/victim"]);
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(own).includes(attack.purchaseId), false);

  // Another séance, another pro: the reference shows nothing.
  const other = await makeEvent(db, pro, { title: "Altinha intermédiaires", rule: { startDate: dayIn(pro, 4) } });
  assert.equal(referenceForPage(ref, { kind: "seance", occurrenceId: other.occurrences[0].id }, null), null);
  const stranger = await createTestPro(db);
  try {
    assert.equal(await purchaseByReference(db, stranger.proId, attack.purchaseId, at), null);
  } finally {
    await deleteTestUser(db, stranger.userId);
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 11: Create `src/lib/public/seance-reads.ts`**

```ts
/**
 * The séance page reads (spec L1445-1455, Decisions 9, 21, 31, 63, 71, SEC-I6). Testable core: takes `db`, imports
 * neither server-only, next/* nor the db index. The pro comes from the slug on the server and every statement filters
 * `professional_id`. A viewer here is ONE server-derived customer (an Owner or the guest cookie's customer), never the
 * customer of a typed e-mail nor of a `?p=` reference (Decision 71): activeBookingOf and usableTickets take no
 * professional, so this module checks the customer and the occurrence against the pro before it calls them.
 */
import { and, asc, desc, eq, inArray, isNull, lte, gt, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { elapsedHoldsOf } from "@/lib/back-office/planning-reads";
import { effectiveWindow, type BookingWindow } from "@/lib/booking-window";
import { loadQuestions, type QuestionRow } from "@/lib/booking/answers";
import { activeBookingOf } from "@/lib/booking/claims";
import { usableTickets } from "@/lib/booking/eligibility";
import { seatsShown } from "@/lib/booking/holds";
import { walletBalance } from "@/lib/booking/wallet";
import type { Db } from "@/lib/db/atomic";
import { booking, customer, event, eventTicketType, occurrence, ticketOffer, ticketPurchase, ticketType } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { offerCovers, validityOf } from "@/lib/ticket-expiry";
import { idSchema, offerLabel, validityLabel, type BookingCoverage } from "@/lib/tickets";

import type { BoutiqueOffer } from "./boutique-reads";
import { acceptedTypesOf, effectiveLocation, type PublicSeance } from "./planning-reads";

export type PublicOfferChoice = BoutiqueOffer & {
  ticketTypeId: string;
  ticketTypeName: string;
  /** offerCovers(now, validityOf(offer), tz, startsAt): the tickets it sells are still valid at the séance */
  covers: boolean;
};

export type PublicSeanceDetail = PublicSeance & {
  kind: "seance";
  description: string | null;
  isPrivate: boolean;
  archived: boolean;
  /** loadQuestions({ eventId }) */
  questions: QuestionRow[];
  /** active, non-archived offers of the linked non-archived, non-rdv_free types (tickets mode only) */
  offers: PublicOfferChoice[];
};

type SeancePro = { professionalId: string; timezone: string; window: BookingWindow };

async function offersOf(
  db: Db,
  pro: SeancePro,
  eventId: string,
  startsAt: Date,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicOfferChoice[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      offerId: ticketOffer.id,
      label: ticketOffer.label,
      quantity: ticketOffer.quantity,
      priceCents: ticketOffer.priceCents,
      validityCount: ticketOffer.validityCount,
      validityUnit: ticketOffer.validityUnit,
      ticketTypeId: ticketType.id,
      ticketTypeName: ticketType.name,
    })
    .from(ticketOffer)
    .innerJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, ticketOffer.ticketTypeId))
    .innerJoin(
      eventTicketType,
      and(eq(eventTicketType.ticketTypeId, ticketType.id), eq(eventTicketType.eventId, eventId)),
    )
    .where(
      and(
        eq(ticketOffer.professionalId, pro.professionalId),
        eq(ticketType.professionalId, pro.professionalId),
        eq(eventTicketType.professionalId, pro.professionalId),
        eq(ticketOffer.isActive, true),
        isNull(ticketOffer.archivedAt),
        isNull(ticketType.archivedAt),
        eq(ticketType.rdvFree, false),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(
      asc(ticketType.position),
      asc(ticketType.createdAt),
      asc(ticketType.id),
      asc(ticketOffer.position),
      asc(ticketOffer.createdAt),
      asc(ticketOffer.id),
    );
  return rows.map((r) => ({
    offerId: r.offerId,
    label: offerLabel({ label: r.label, quantity: r.quantity }),
    quantity: r.quantity,
    priceCents: r.priceCents,
    validityText: validityLabel(r.validityCount, r.validityUnit),
    ticketTypeId: r.ticketTypeId,
    ticketTypeName: r.ticketTypeName,
    covers: offerCovers(now, validityOf(r), pro.timezone, startsAt),
  }));
}

/**
 * One occurrence of this pro: an event séance (any status, private and archived included: the page decides),
 * { kind: "rdv" } for an RDV, null when not this pro's, unknown or not an id.
 */
export async function getPublicSeance(
  db: Db,
  pro: SeancePro,
  occurrenceId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<PublicSeanceDetail | { kind: "rdv" } | null> {
  if (!idSchema.safeParse(occurrenceId).success) return null;
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      occurrenceEventId: occurrence.eventId,
      eventId: event.id,
      title: event.title,
      description: event.description,
      color: event.color,
      eventLocation: event.location,
      bookingMode: event.bookingMode,
      isPrivate: event.isPrivate,
      archivedAt: event.archivedAt,
      eventHorizonDays: event.bookingHorizonDays,
      eventNoticeMinutes: event.minNoticeMinutes,
      eventCancelHours: event.cancelDeadlineHours,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      endsAt: occurrence.endsAt,
      locationOverride: occurrence.locationOverride,
      status: occurrence.status,
      capacity: occurrence.capacity,
      seatsTaken: occurrence.seatsTaken,
      underTimeOff: sql<boolean>`exists (select 1 from time_off t where t.professional_id = occurrence.professional_id
        and t.start_at < occurrence.ends_at and t.end_at > occurrence.starts_at)`,
    })
    .from(occurrence)
    .leftJoin(event, and(eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId), eq(event.professionalId, pro.professionalId)))
    .where(and(eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, pro.professionalId)));
  if (!row) return null;
  if (row.occurrenceEventId === null) return { kind: "rdv" };
  // The occurrence points at an event that is not this pro's (cannot happen): nothing to show.
  if (row.eventId === null || row.title === null || row.color === null || row.bookingMode === null) return null;

  const eventId = row.eventId;
  const bookingMode = row.bookingMode;
  const [elapsed, types, questions, offers] = await Promise.all([
    elapsedHoldsOf(db, pro.professionalId, [occurrenceId], now),
    bookingMode === "tickets" ? acceptedTypesOf(db, pro.professionalId, [eventId]) : Promise.resolve(new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; color: string }[]>()),
    loadQuestions(db, { eventId }),
    bookingMode === "tickets" ? offersOf(db, pro, eventId, row.startsAt, now) : Promise.resolve([]),
  ]);
  return {
    kind: "seance",
    occurrenceId,
    eventId,
    title: row.title,
    description: row.description,
    color: row.color,
    startsAt: row.startsAt,
    endsAt: row.endsAt,
    location: effectiveLocation(row.locationOverride, row.eventLocation),
    status: row.status,
    bookingMode,
    capacity: row.capacity,
    seatsLeft: seatsShown({ capacity: row.capacity, seatsTaken: row.seatsTaken, elapsedHolds: elapsed.get(occurrenceId) ?? 0 }),
    acceptedTypes: types.get(eventId) ?? [],
    window: effectiveWindow(pro.window, {
      bookingHorizonDays: row.eventHorizonDays,
      minNoticeMinutes: row.eventNoticeMinutes,
      cancelDeadlineHours: row.eventCancelHours,
    }),
    underTimeOff: row.underTimeOff,
    isPrivate: row.isPrivate ?? false,
    archived: row.archivedAt !== null,
    questions,
    offers,
  };
}

export type SeanceVisitorFacts = {
  /** activeBookingOf; purchaseId and resumeUrl only for source "owner" (a guest cookie never receives a Checkout URL, Decision 63) */
  booking: {
    bookingId: string;
    status: "pending" | "confirmed";
    coverage: BookingCoverage;
    purchaseId: string | null;
    resumeUrl: string | null;
  } | null;
  /** no active booking: the status of this customer's latest booking on the séance when it ended (COV-M4a); source "owner" only */
  ended: "cancelled" | "expired" | null;
  /** source "owner" only: usableTickets[0]'s type; walletBalance(type).usable - 1 */
  usable: { typeName: string; leftAfter: number } | null;
};

const noFacts = (): SeanceVisitorFacts => ({ booking: null, ended: null, usable: null });

/**
 * The state of ONE server-derived customer of this pro on this séance: an Owner or a guest cookie customer, never a
 * typed e-mail nor the customer of a ?p= reference (Decision 71); for "guest" only the booking is filled, and its
 * purchaseId and resumeUrl stay null (no wallet, no ended state); empty facts when the customer or the séance is not
 * this pro's. A pending booking whose hold has lapsed is an ended one (« expired »): the page never waits for the sweep.
 */
export async function seanceVisitorFacts(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  occurrenceId: string,
  viewer: { customerId: string; source: "owner" | "guest" },
  now: Date,
): Promise<SeanceVisitorFacts> {
  const { customerId } = viewer;
  const [[mine], [seance]] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ id: customer.id })
      .from(customer)
      .where(and(eq(customer.id, customerId), eq(customer.professionalId, professionalId))),
    db
      .select({ id: occurrence.id })
      .from(occurrence)
      .where(and(eq(occurrence.id, occurrenceId), eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId))),
  ]);
  if (!mine || !seance) return noFacts();

  const active = await activeBookingOf(db, { occurrenceId, customerId }, now);
  let activeFacts: SeanceVisitorFacts["booking"] = null;
  if (active) {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ coverage: booking.coverage })
      .from(booking)
      .where(and(eq(booking.id, active.bookingId), eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId)));
    if (row) {
      activeFacts = {
        bookingId: active.bookingId,
        status: active.status === "pending" ? "pending" : "confirmed",
        coverage: row.coverage,
        purchaseId: viewer.source === "owner" ? active.purchaseId : null,
        resumeUrl: viewer.source === "owner" ? active.checkoutUrl : null,
      };
    }
  }
  if (viewer.source === "guest") return { booking: activeFacts, ended: null, usable: null };

  const [ended, usable] = await Promise.all([
    activeFacts === null ? endedStatusOf(db, professionalId, occurrenceId, customerId, now) : Promise.resolve(null),
    usableFor(db, professionalId, occurrenceId, customerId, now),
  ]);
  return { booking: activeFacts, ended, usable };
}

/** The latest ended booking of this customer on the séance: cancelled, expired, or a hold that lapsed (« expired »). */
async function endedStatusOf(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  occurrenceId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<"cancelled" | "expired" | null> {
  const [last] = await db
    .select({ status: booking.status })
    .from(booking)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(booking.occurrenceId, occurrenceId),
        eq(booking.customerId, customerId),
        or(
          inArray(booking.status, ["cancelled", "expired"]),
          and(eq(booking.status, "pending"), lte(booking.holdExpiresAt, now)),
        ),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(desc(sql`coalesce(${booking.endedAt}, ${booking.holdExpiresAt})`), desc(booking.id))
    .limit(1);
  if (!last) return null;
  return last.status === "cancelled" ? "cancelled" : "expired";
}

/** The type a spend would use here (consumption order) and what the balance of that type leaves after it. */
async function usableFor(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  occurrenceId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<SeanceVisitorFacts["usable"]> {
  const [first] = await usableTickets(db, { customerId, occurrenceId });
  if (!first) return null;
  const [[type], balances] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ name: ticketType.name })
      .from(ticketType)
      .where(and(eq(ticketType.id, first.ticketTypeId), eq(ticketType.professionalId, professionalId))),
    walletBalance(db, { professionalId, customerId }, now),
  ]);
  if (!type) return null;
  const usable = balances.find((b) => b.ticketTypeId === first.ticketTypeId)?.usable ?? 0;
  return { typeName: type.name, leftAfter: Math.max(0, usable - 1) };
}

export type LivePendingHold = {
  purchaseId: string;
  occurrenceId: string;
  title: string;
  startsAt: Date;
  holdExpiresAt: Date;
};

/**
 * SEC-I6: the live pending holds (booking pending, hold_expires_at > now, purchase pending) of THIS Owner's customer at
 * this pro, soonest hold end first (at most MAX_PENDING_HOLDS by the engine's quota): holds typed by strangers with her
 * address land on her row, and she can always release them. Owner only.
 */
export async function livePendingHoldsOf(
  db: Db,
  professionalId: string,
  customerId: string,
  now: Date,
): Promise<LivePendingHold[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      purchaseId: ticketPurchase.id,
      occurrenceId: booking.occurrenceId,
      title: sql<string>`coalesce(${event.title}, ${ticketType.name})`,
      startsAt: occurrence.startsAt,
      holdExpiresAt: booking.holdExpiresAt,
    })
    .from(booking)
    .innerJoin(ticketPurchase, eq(ticketPurchase.id, booking.purchaseId))
    .innerJoin(occurrence, eq(occurrence.id, booking.occurrenceId))
    .leftJoin(event, eq(event.id, occurrence.eventId))
    .leftJoin(ticketType, eq(ticketType.id, occurrence.ticketTypeId))
    .where(
      and(
        eq(booking.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(booking.customerId, customerId),
        eq(booking.status, "pending"),
        gt(booking.holdExpiresAt, now),
        eq(ticketPurchase.status, "pending"),
        eq(ticketPurchase.professionalId, professionalId),
        eq(occurrence.professionalId, professionalId),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(asc(booking.holdExpiresAt), asc(booking.id));
  return rows.flatMap((r) =>
    r.holdExpiresAt === null
      ? []
      : [{ purchaseId: r.purchaseId, occurrenceId: r.occurrenceId, title: r.title, startsAt: r.startsAt, holdExpiresAt: r.holdExpiresAt }],
  );
}
```

**Design notes (read before coding):**
- Before writing the JSX of Steps 5 and 6, invoke the `design-taste-frontend` skill (user rule). Design read to declare: public booking page of a pro for their clients, trust-first product UI inside the existing Skedul system (violet card system, brand theme through `PublicShell`), dials 3 / 2 / 5 (variance, motion, density): no new component family, no motion, no decoration. Keep the system: `Card`, `Badge`, `Button`, `EmptyState`; brand text in `text-accent-foreground` (never `text-primary`), inline links `INLINE_LINK_CLASS`; the only colour dots are the ticket-type colours, which carry data; user text (titles, places, type names, descriptions) gets `wrap-anywhere`; no dash, no emoji; below 640 px the planning is a list per day, the week grid is hidden and each offer takes a row with a full-width « Acheter ».
- The page is dynamic (it reads `searchParams`), read-only and shows the same thing to everyone: wallet, banners and the visitor bar are Task 25b's. It keeps the pro's « Présentation » (`bio`) which the P2 page showed: `resolvePublicPro` does not return it, so the page reads the pro through the request-memoized `getPublicPageProfile` and builds its `PublicPro` with `publicProOfRow` (the same pattern as the espace page).
- `loading.tsx` makes the pages of this segment stream, and a streamed response has already sent its status: a `notFound()` in a page then answers 200 with `noindex`, and `permanentRedirect` inserts a meta refresh instead of a 308 (Next docs, `loading.md` « Status Codes », `permanentRedirect.md`). Two measures keep the real status codes: `layout.tsx` (a layout renders before the loading boundary, the ruling of the P3 espace layout, `1b743cc`) answers 404 for a slug with no pro page, a suspended pro still counting as existing so that the thank-you page keeps working for a client who paid just before a suspension; and the two old flows are redirected by `next.config.ts` `redirects()` (a routing-level 308), the pages keeping `permanentRedirect` as the contract states. A config redirect copies the matched segment into `Location` without encoding it, so its `:slug` only accepts the slug shape (`[a-z0-9-]{1,60}`, as `SLUG_PARAM_RE`): no encoded slash, backslash or host name can turn it into an open redirect (the pure test pins it); any other segment reaches the page, whose `permanentRedirect` encodes it, under the layout that answers 404. Accepted side effect, recorded for the outcome: the espace's own P3 layout now sits under this segment's loading boundary, so a SUSPENDED pro's espace, like its `/[slug]` page, answers the streamed not-found (status 200 with `noindex`, Next `loading.md`) instead of a 404 status; an unknown slug still gets a real 404 from the new layout, and nothing of the pro is shown either way.
- `headers()` (SEC-M11, `05-config/01-next-config-js/headers.md`): the frame-refusing headers go on `/:slug`, `/:slug/:path*` and `/mon-espace`, with a negative lookahead that leaves `/api` and `/_next` out. A route handler's response headers are appended (`appendHeader`) to the ones the config already set, so a mock checkout or personal-link page that sets its own `X-Frame-Options` would send it twice. The source patterns are the ones Next compiles with its own path-to-regexp; the pure test matches real paths with that same compiler.
- Nothing here writes during a render. The `ensureHorizon` call after a render is Task 25b's.

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { join } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

import nextConfig from "../../next.config";

// Next compiles every `source` with its own copy of path-to-regexp: the test matches paths the way the router does.
const requireFromRoot = createRequire(join(process.cwd(), "package.json"));
const { pathToRegexp } = requireFromRoot("next/dist/compiled/path-to-regexp") as { pathToRegexp: (source: string) => RegExp };

type Rule = { source: string };
const matches = (rules: readonly Rule[], path: string): boolean => rules.some((rule) => pathToRegexp(rule.source).test(path));

const FRAMED = [
  "/altinha-paris",
  "/altinha-paris/seance/abc123",
  "/altinha-paris/offre/o1",
  "/altinha-paris/merci",
  "/altinha-paris/espace",
  "/altinha-paris/book/x",
  "/mon-espace",
  "/apiary",
  "/apiary/seance/x",
];
const LEFT_ALONE = [
  "/api/stripe/webhook",
  "/api/mock-checkout",
  "/api/c/token",
  "/api/cron/daily",
  "/api",
  "/_next/static/chunks/a.js",
  "/_next/image",
  "/",
];

test("headers: the public pages refuse framing with both headers, the API and the assets are left to their own", async () => {
  const rules = (await nextConfig.headers?.()) ?? [];
  assert.ok(rules.length > 0);
  for (const rule of rules) {
    assert.deepEqual(rule.headers, [
      { key: "Content-Security-Policy", value: "frame-ancestors 'none'" },
      { key: "X-Frame-Options", value: "DENY" },
    ]);
  }
  for (const path of FRAMED) assert.equal(matches(rules, path), true, `${path} must refuse framing`);
  for (const path of LEFT_ALONE) assert.equal(matches(rules, path), false, `${path} must not get the headers twice`);
});

test("headers: /mon-espace has a rule of its own", async () => {
  const rules = (await nextConfig.headers?.()) ?? [];
  assert.equal(rules.some((rule) => rule.source === "/mon-espace"), true);
});

test("redirects: the old booking and pack URLs move for good to the public page", async () => {
  const rules = (await nextConfig.redirects?.()) ?? [];
  assert.deepEqual(
    rules.map((rule) => [rule.source, rule.destination, "permanent" in rule ? rule.permanent : null]),
    [
      ["/:slug([a-z0-9-]{1,60})/book/:path*", "/:slug", true],
      ["/:slug([a-z0-9-]{1,60})/pack/:path*", "/:slug", true],
    ],
  );
  for (const path of ["/altinha-paris/book/x", "/altinha-paris/book", "/altinha-paris/pack/y/z"]) {
    assert.equal(matches(rules, path), true, path);
  }
  for (const path of ["/altinha-paris", "/altinha-paris/seance/x", "/altinha-paris/espace", "/altinha-paris/offre/book"]) {
    assert.equal(matches(rules, path), false, path);
  }
});

test("redirects: only a slug-shaped segment is copied into the Location header (no open redirect)", async () => {
  const rules = (await nextConfig.redirects?.()) ?? [];
  // An encoded slash or backslash, a dot or a colon never reaches the destination: such a segment is not a slug, the
  // config leaves it to the page (which encodes it) and to the layout (which answers 404 for an unknown pro).
  for (const path of ["/%2F%2Fevil.com/book/x", "/%5Cevil.com/pack/y", "/evil.com/book/x", "/a:b/book/x", "/" + "a".repeat(61) + "/book/x"]) {
    assert.equal(matches(rules, path), false, path);
  }
});
```

Read the file, then replace its whole content (Write) with:

```ts
import type { NextConfig } from "next";

/**
 * Public pages refuse framing (SEC-M11, P4 contract § 5 Framing): a pro's page, a séance, an offer, the thank-you page, the espace
 * and /mon-espace must not be embeddable in another site (clickjacking on a form that books or pays). The two headers
 * say the same thing for every browser. The patterns leave out /api (the route handlers set their own headers, and a
 * header set twice would be sent twice) and /_next (static assets).
 */
const FRAME_HEADERS = [
  { key: "Content-Security-Policy", value: "frame-ancestors 'none'" },
  { key: "X-Frame-Options", value: "DENY" },
];
const NOT_API_OR_ASSETS = "(?!(?:api|_next)(?:/|$))[^/]+";
/**
 * A redirect copies the matched segment into its Location header as it came: only a slug-shaped segment (the
 * SLUG_PARAM_RE shape of src/lib/public/context.ts) is ever copied, so no encoded slash, backslash or host can become
 * an open redirect. Any other segment falls through to the page, which encodes it, under the layout that answers 404.
 */
const SLUG_SEGMENT = "[a-z0-9-]{1,60}";

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    // Vercel's request-body cap: support images are shrunk in the browser to
    // 1.3 MB or less each (src/lib/shrink-image.ts) before the Server Action.
    serverActions: { bodySizeLimit: "4.5mb" },
  },
  async headers() {
    return [
      { source: `/:slug(${NOT_API_OR_ASSETS})`, headers: FRAME_HEADERS },
      { source: `/:slug(${NOT_API_OR_ASSETS})/:path*`, headers: FRAME_HEADERS },
      // Covered by the first rule already (a reserved segment is a single segment); named so that narrowing the first
      // rule one day cannot silently unprotect the client space.
      { source: "/mon-espace", headers: FRAME_HEADERS },
    ];
  },
  async redirects() {
    // The old flows moved for good (308, OUT:96). The pages under src/app/[slug]/book and pack redirect too, but they
    // sit under the loading boundary of [slug], where a redirect streams as a meta refresh instead of a status code.
    return [
      { source: `/:slug(${SLUG_SEGMENT})/book/:path*`, destination: "/:slug", permanent: true },
      { source: `/:slug(${SLUG_SEGMENT})/pack/:path*`, destination: "/:slug", permanent: true },
    ];
  },
};

export default nextConfig;
```

The existing `serverActions` block is kept as it was.

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { CalendarDays, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, MapPin } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { INLINE_LINK_CLASS } from "@/components/ui/link-class";
import { COPY, PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import type { PlanningNav, PlanningView, PublicDay, PublicSeanceVM } from "@/lib/public/planning-view";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/** The state badge: cancelled stands out, « Inscription libre » is the one good news, everything else is neutral. */
function stateBadgeVariant(stateText: string): "destructive" | "success" | "neutral" {
  if (stateText === PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS.cancelled) return "destructive";
  if (stateText === PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS.free) return "success";
  return "neutral";
}

function ViewLink({ href, current, children }: { href: string; current: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      aria-current={current ? "page" : undefined}
      className={cn(
        "rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 font-medium focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring",
        current ? "bg-primary-muted text-accent-foreground" : "text-zinc-600 hover:bg-muted",
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </Link>
  );
}

/** One séance of the « Liste » view: a single link whose accessible name is the view model's `ariaLabel` (COV-M12). */
function SeanceRow({ vm }: { vm: PublicSeanceVM }) {
  const cancelled = vm.stateText === PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS.cancelled;
  return (
    <Link
      href={vm.href}
      aria-label={vm.ariaLabel}
      className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3 transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-ring"
    >
      <span className="flex min-w-0 gap-3">
        <span aria-hidden className="w-1 shrink-0 self-stretch rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: vm.color }} />
        <span className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
          <span className="block text-xs font-medium tabular-nums text-zinc-600">{vm.timeLabel}</span>
          <span className={cn("block font-medium wrap-anywhere", vm.muted && "text-zinc-600", cancelled && "line-through")}>
            {vm.title}
          </span>
          {vm.location && (
            <span className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-600">
              <MapPin className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
              <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{vm.location}</span>
            </span>
          )}
          {vm.badges.length > 0 && (
            <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
              {vm.badges.map((badge) => (
                <span key={badge.name} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-700">
                  <span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: badge.color }} />
                  <span className="wrap-anywhere">{badge.name}</span>
                </span>
              ))}
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
      </span>
      <span className="flex shrink-0 flex-col items-end gap-1 text-right">
        {vm.stateText && <Badge variant={stateBadgeVariant(vm.stateText)}>{vm.stateText}</Badge>}
        {vm.seatsText && <span className="text-xs text-zinc-600">{vm.seatsText}</span>}
      </span>
    </Link>
  );
}

/** One séance of the « Semaine » view: a chip in its day column, named by `ariaLabel`. */
function SeanceChip({ vm }: { vm: PublicSeanceVM }) {
  const cancelled = vm.stateText === PUBLIC_STATE_LABELS.cancelled;
  const tail = vm.stateText ?? vm.seatsText;
  return (
    <Link
      href={vm.href}
      aria-label={vm.ariaLabel}
      className="block rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-2 text-xs transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
      style={{ borderLeft: `4px solid ${vm.color}` }}
    >
      <span className="block tabular-nums text-zinc-600">{vm.timeLabel}</span>
      <span className={cn("mt-0.5 block text-sm font-medium wrap-anywhere", vm.muted && "text-zinc-600", cancelled && "line-through")}>
        {vm.title}
      </span>
      {tail && <span className="mt-1 block text-zinc-600">{tail}</span>}
    </Link>
  );
}

/**
 * The public planning of `/[slug]` (spec L1440-1443, Decisions 46, 47): a « Liste » view (a section per day with
 * séances) and a « Semaine » view (seven day columns of chips, from 640 px; below that the list always shows). A week
 * without séance says so and points to the next one; a pro with nothing ahead gets an empty state, with a link to the
 * Boutique when it has offers. Every label comes from the view model: nothing here reads the database.
 */
export function PublicPlanning({
  nav,
  view,
  days,
  empty,
  nextWeekHref,
  shopHref,
}: {
  nav: PlanningNav;
  view: PlanningView;
  days: PublicDay[];
  empty: "week" | "all" | null;
  nextWeekHref: string | null;
  shopHref: string | null;
}) {
  const withSeances = days.filter((day) => day.seances.length > 0);
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="planning-title" className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <h2 id="planning-title" className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">
          Planning
        </h2>
        {empty !== "all" && (
          <nav aria-label="Affichage du planning" className="inline-flex rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-0.5 text-sm">
            <ViewLink href={nav.listHref} current={view === "liste"}>
              Liste
            </ViewLink>
            <ViewLink href={nav.weekHref} current={view === "semaine"}>
              Semaine
            </ViewLink>
          </nav>
        )}
      </div>

      {empty === "all" ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={CalendarDays}
          title={COPY.NO_SEANCE}
          action={
            shopHref ? (
              <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
                <Link href={shopHref}>{COPY.SEE_SHOP}</Link>
              </Button>
            ) : undefined
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:flex-nowrap">
            {nav.prevHref ? (
              <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm" className="flex-1 sm:flex-none">
                <Link href={nav.prevHref}>
                  <ChevronLeft aria-hidden />
                  Semaine précédente
                </Link>
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled className="flex-1 sm:flex-none">
                <ChevronLeft aria-hidden />
                Semaine précédente
              </Button>
            )}
            <p className="order-first w-full text-center text-sm font-semibold sm:order-none sm:w-auto sm:flex-1">{nav.title}</p>
            {nav.nextHref ? (
              <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm" className="flex-1 sm:flex-none">
                <Link href={nav.nextHref}>
                  Semaine suivante
                  <ChevronRight aria-hidden />
                </Link>
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" disabled className="flex-1 sm:flex-none">
                Semaine suivante
                <ChevronRight aria-hidden />
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>

          {empty === "week" && (
            <Card className="space-y-2 px-5 py-6 text-center">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">{COPY.NO_SEANCE_WEEK}</p>
              {nextWeekHref && (
                <p className="text-sm">
                  <Link href={nextWeekHref} className={INLINE_LINK_CLASS}>
                    {COPY.NEXT_SEANCE_WEEK}
                  </Link>
                </p>
              )}
            </Card>
          )}

          {withSeances.length > 0 && (
            <div className={cn("space-y-6", view === "semaine" && "sm:hidden")}>
              {withSeances.map((day) => (
                <section key={day.dayKey} aria-labelledby={`jour-${day.dayKey}`} className="space-y-2">
                  <h3 id={`jour-${day.dayKey}`} className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-700 first-letter:uppercase">
                    {day.label}
                  </h3>
                  <ul className="divide-y divide-border overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card">
                    {day.seances.map((vm) => (
                      <li key={vm.occurrenceId}>
                        <SeanceRow vm={vm} />
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </section>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {view === "semaine" && withSeances.length > 0 && (
            <div className="hidden grid-cols-7 items-start gap-2 sm:grid">
              {days.map((day) => (
                <section key={day.dayKey} aria-labelledby={`colonne-${day.dayKey}`} className="min-w-0 space-y-2">
                  <h3
                    id={`colonne-${day.dayKey}`}
                    className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-1.5 py-1.5 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-zinc-700 first-letter:uppercase"
                  >
                    {day.label}
                  </h3>
                  {day.seances.length > 0 && (
                    <ul className="space-y-2">
                      {day.seances.map((vm) => (
                        <li key={vm.occurrenceId}>
                          <SeanceChip vm={vm} />
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  )}
                </section>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * The Boutique of `/[slug]` (spec L1443, E9): the offers on sale, by ticket type, each with its « Acheter » link to the
 * offer page. It carries the anchor every « Voir la boutique » link points to (BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR, FR:UI-14) and is not

 */
export function Boutique({ slug, currency, types }: { slug: string; currency: string; types: BoutiqueType[] }) {
  if (types.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section id={BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR} aria-labelledby="boutique-title" className="scroll-mt-6 space-y-4">
      <h2 id="boutique-title" className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">

      </h2>
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {types.map((type) => (
          <Card key={type.ticketTypeId}>

              <CardTitle className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <span aria-hidden className="mt-1.5 size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: type.color }} />
                <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{type.name}</span>
              </CardTitle>
              {type.description && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{type.description}</p>}
              {type.acceptedBy.length > 0 && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{acceptedByLine(type.acceptedBy)}</p>}
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
                {type.offers.map((offer) => (
                  <li
                    key={offer.offerId}
                    className="flex flex-col gap-3 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
                  >
                    <p className="min-w-0 text-sm wrap-anywhere">
                      <span className="font-medium">{offer.label}</span>
                      {` · ${formatMoney(offer.priceCents, currency)}`}
                      {offer.validityText !== null && ` · valable ${offer.validityText}`}
                    </p>
                    <Button asChild className="w-full shrink-0 sm:w-auto">
                      <Link href={`/${slug}/offre/${offer.offerId}`} aria-label={`Acheter : ${offer.label}, ${type.name}`}>
                        Acheter
                      </Link>
                    </Button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";

/**
 * The error state of the public pages of a pro (the espace keeps its own). Only the digest Next gives an error reaches
 * the console, never the error itself: a page error can carry what the page was reading.
 */
export default function PublicError({
  error,
  unstable_retry,
}: {
  error: Error & { digest?: string };
  unstable_retry: () => void;
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    console.error("[public] page error", error.digest ?? "no digest");
  }, [error]);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl px-5 py-8">
      <Card role="alert" className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col items-center gap-3 px-6 py-12 text-center">
        <TriangleAlert className="size-8 text-zinc-600" aria-hidden />
        <h2 className="text-base font-semibold">Une erreur est survenue</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">Cette page n&apos;a pas pu se charger. Réessayez dans un instant.</p>
        <Button onClick={() => unstable_retry()}>Réessayer</Button>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { publicPageExists } from "@/server/public-queries";

/**
 * Answers a real 404 for an unknown slug. The loading.tsx of this segment makes its pages stream, and a streamed
 * response has already sent its 200 status when a page calls notFound(); a layout renders before that boundary, so the
 * check here still sets the status code (the same ruling as the espace layout, P3 1b743cc). A suspended pro still
 * exists here: the thank-you page must keep working for a client who paid just before the suspension, and every other
 * page applies the suspension itself. Public data only (the pro's existence): nothing of a client is read.
 */
export default async function SlugLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
}) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  if (!(await publicPageExists(slug))) notFound();
  return children;
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";

import { Boutique } from "@/components/public/boutique";
import { PublicPlanning } from "@/components/public/public-planning";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { addDays, todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { paramForWeek, weekBounds, weekStartFromParam } from "@/lib/planning";
import { publicProOfRow } from "@/lib/public/context";
import {
  groupByDay,
  parsePlanningParams,
  planningEmptyState,
  planningNav,
  toPublicSeanceVM,
} from "@/lib/public/planning-view";
import { BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR } from "@/lib/public-anchors";
import { getBoutiquePage, getNextSeanceStart, getPlanningPage, getPublicPageProfile } from "@/server/public-queries";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ semaine?: string | string[]; vue?: string | string[] }>;
};

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const profile = await getPublicPageProfile(slug);
  if (!profile) return { title: "Page introuvable" };
  return { title: profile.pro.businessName, description: profile.pro.headline ?? undefined };
}

/**
 * The public page of a pro: its planning (« Liste » or « Semaine », one week at a time) and its Boutique. Dynamic by
 * construction (it reads the search parameters) and read-only: a render never writes. Anyone may open it; what is
 * personal to a visitor (wallet, banners) is added by the next task.
 */
export default async function PublicProfilePage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const profile = await getPublicPageProfile(slug);
  if (!profile) notFound();
  const pro = publicProOfRow(profile.pro);
  const { semaine, view } = parsePlanningParams(await searchParams);

  const now = new Date();
  const tz = pro.timezone;
  const weekStart = weekStartFromParam(semaine, tz, now);
  const range = weekBounds(weekStart, tz);
  const weekKey = paramForWeek(weekStart, tz);
  const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(weekKey, i));

  const [seances, boutique] = await Promise.all([getPlanningPage(pro, range), getBoutiquePage(pro.professionalId)]);
  // Only an empty week asks where the next séance is, and only a week with nothing after it asks if there is any at all.
  const nextStart = seances.length === 0 ? await getNextSeanceStart(pro, range.end) : null;
  const anyStart = seances.length === 0 && nextStart === null ? await getNextSeanceStart(pro, now) : null;
  const { empty, nextWeekHref } = planningEmptyState({ slug: pro.slug, view, tz, shown: seances.length, nextStart, anyStart });

  return (
    <PublicShell branding={profile.pro}>
      {profile.pro.bio && <p className="mb-8 whitespace-pre-line text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{profile.pro.bio}</p>}
      <div className="space-y-10">
        <PublicPlanning
          nav={planningNav({ slug: pro.slug, weekKey, view, todayKey: todayKey(now, tz) })}
          view={view}
          days={groupByDay(
            seances.map((s) => toPublicSeanceVM(s, pro.slug, now, tz)),
            days,
          )}
          empty={empty}
          nextWeekHref={nextWeekHref}
          shopHref={boutique.length > 0 ? `#${BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR}` : null}
        />
        <Boutique slug={pro.slug} currency={pro.currency} types={boutique} />
      </div>
    </PublicShell>
  );
}
```
