**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** none. The wiring that reviewers check first (contract § 9 rows 1, 2 and 4) is pinned by the source guards added here: the page reads the visitor through `currentPublicVisitor` (fresh session), never `getSession()`; no row, user id or customer id reaches a client prop; the wallet is the Owner's only; the horizon key is consumed inside `after()`.

Design notes (read before coding):
- Load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing the JSX (project rule). Everything here sits inside `PublicShell` and keeps the existing card system, `lucide-react` icons and `INLINE_LINK_CLASS` for links inside a sentence. Muted text is `text-zinc-600` (AA on cards), the brand never colours text (`text-accent-foreground` through `INLINE_LINK_CLASS` only), no `text-primary`.
- The sign-in-by-code form is offered to an anonymous visitor only (risk 7, Decision 70): `VisitorBar` mounts `OtpDialog` behind `canOfferCodeSignIn(state)`. A signed-in but unverified visitor gets the « Confirmez votre adresse » banner and nothing that signs in.
- Focus after a sign-in (G3a sweep, contract § 3.16): the « J'ai déjà des tickets » button goes away once the visitor is signed in, so the dialog could hand the focus back only to a control that is no longer there. The bar therefore renders ONE `h2` « Vos tickets » (`tabIndex={-1}`, a ref, `id` from `useId`) in both states it shows (the anonymous card and the verified link row), as the same element: one `section` root whose class changes, the heading always its first child. It passes the heading to the dialog as `returnFocusTo={headingTarget}`, `headingTarget = useCallback(() => heading.current, [])` (`Dialog` asks for a stable identity). When the visitor turns out to be an Owner, the page swaps the bar for `WalletPanel`, whose own `h2` « Vos tickets » sits in the same place: the bar's heading goes with the bar, and the browser carries on from that spot (the « Mon espace » button of the wallet card is the next stop). Step 10.3 checks both.
- A guest cookie (personal link) never gives a wallet on a public page (Decision 61): `hasGuestSpace` only adds the « Mon espace » link to the anonymous bar. The page passes `hasGuestSpace={visitor.guestCustomerId !== null}`, never the customer id.
- An Owner already gets « Mon espace » inside `WalletPanel`, so the page renders `WalletPanel` for her and `VisitorBar` for everybody else (one « Mon espace » control, not two).
- Task 25a wrote `src/app/[slug]/page.tsx` (the pro read through `getPublicPageProfile` and `publicProOfRow`, the « Présentation » `bio` paragraph, the week computation, `planningEmptyState`, `PublicPlanning` and `Boutique`). Step 7 below replaces the whole file with Task 25a's text plus this task's additions: the visitor read, the wallet read in the same `Promise.all`, the horizon need, `testMode`, the horizon `after()`, the two banners and the bar or the wallet. Everything of Task 25a is kept unchanged. If your Task 25a file differs from the text quoted here in a cosmetic detail (a helper name, the order of two reads), keep 25a's version of those lines and add only what concerns `visitor`, `space`, `testMode`, `needsHorizon` and the imports they need; this task removes nothing of 25a.
- Heading order on `/[slug]`: the shell's `h1` is the business name and `PublicPlanning` opens with the `h2` « Planning », so the full `WalletPanel`, which sits above the planning, titles its card with an `h2` (not `CardTitle`, which is an `h3`).

```tsx
import Link from "next/link";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { INLINE_LINK_CLASS } from "@/components/ui/link-class";
import type { CustomerSpace } from "@/lib/back-office/customer-space";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR } from "@/lib/public-anchors";

/**
 * The balance of the Owner by ticket type (contract § 3.23). Rendered for an Owner only: the page decides, the wallet
 * of a customer resolved from a typed e-mail, a purchase reference or a guest cookie is never shown here. `full`
 * is the card of /[slug]; `compact` is the one line above the booking block of the séance page (nothing when empty).
 */
export function WalletPanel({
  slug,
  businessName,
  wallet,
  variant,
}: {
  slug: string;
  businessName: string;
  wallet: CustomerSpace["wallet"];
  variant: "full" | "compact";
}) {
  const spaceHref = `/${slug}/espace`;

  if (variant === "compact") {
    if (wallet.length === 0) return null;
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card px-4 py-3 text-sm sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <p className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{`Vos tickets : ${wallet.map((w) => `${w.usable} × ${w.name}`).join(", ")}`}</p>
        <Link href={spaceHref} className={`${INLINE_LINK_CLASS} shrink-0`}>
          {COPY.MY_SPACE}
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
        {/* An h2: the card sits above the « Planning » h2 of the page, under the shell's h1. */}
        <h2 className="text-base leading-tight font-semibold">Vos tickets</h2>
        <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
          <Link href={spaceHref}>{COPY.MY_SPACE}</Link>
        </Button>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {wallet.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.NO_TICKET}</p>
            <Link href={`#${BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR}`} className={INLINE_LINK_CLASS}>
              {COPY.SEE_SHOP}
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
            {wallet.map((w) => (
              <li key={w.ticketTypeId} className="space-y-1 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
                <p className="flex items-start gap-2 font-medium">
                  <span className="mt-1.5 size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: w.color }} aria-hidden />
                  <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{`${w.usable} × ${w.name}`}</span>
                </p>
                {w.expiries.map((text) => (
                  <p key={text} className="text-sm text-zinc-600">
                    {text}
                  </p>
                ))}
                {w.archived && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{`Ce type n'est plus proposé par ${businessName}.`}</p>
                )}
                {w.typeClass === "orphan" && <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600">{COPY.ORPHAN_TYPE}</p>}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useCallback, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";

import { OtpDialog } from "@/components/auth/otp-dialog";
import { VerifyEmailBanner } from "@/components/dashboard/verify-email-banner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { INLINE_LINK_CLASS } from "@/components/ui/link-class";
import type { VisitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { canOfferCodeSignIn } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";

/**
 * What /[slug] offers a visitor who is not the Owner, by state (contract § 3.23, Decision 61):
 * unverified -> the « Confirmez votre adresse » banner; anonymous -> « J'ai déjà des tickets » (the sign-in dialog) and,
 * when a personal-link cookie is present, a « Mon espace » link (the cookie never gives a wallet here); verified -> a
 * « Mon espace » link; impersonating -> nothing (an admin has no client identity). The code form exists for an
 * anonymous visitor only (risk 7): it would purge the password of an unverified account.
 */
export function VisitorBar({
  state,
  email,
  slug,
  returnTo,
  googleEnabled,
  hasGuestSpace,
}: {
  state: VisitorState;
  email: string | null;
  slug: string;
  returnTo: string;
  googleEnabled: boolean;
  hasGuestSpace: boolean;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const headingId = useId();
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  // The sign-in dialog hands the focus to this heading when it closes: once the visitor is signed in the bar loses the
  // « J'ai déjà des tickets » button that opened the dialog, the heading stays (the same element, only the bar changes).
  const headingTarget = useCallback(() => heading.current, []);

  if (state === "impersonating") return null;
  if (state === "unverified") return email ? <VerifyEmailBanner email={email} verified={false} /> : null;

  const anonymous = state === "anonymous";
  return (
    <section
      aria-labelledby={headingId}
      className={
        anonymous
          ? "mb-6 flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
          : "mb-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm"
      }
    >
      <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
        <h2
          id={headingId}
          ref={heading}
          tabIndex={-1}
          className="rounded text-sm font-semibold focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
        >
          Vos tickets
        </h2>
        {anonymous && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.HAVE_TICKETS_HINT}</p>}
      </div>
      {anonymous ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:shrink-0">
          <Button type="button" variant="secondary" className="w-full sm:w-auto" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            {COPY.HAVE_TICKETS}
          </Button>
          {hasGuestSpace && (
            <Button asChild variant="ghost" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
              <Link href={`/${slug}/espace`}>{COPY.MY_SPACE}</Link>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Link href={`/${slug}/espace`} className={INLINE_LINK_CLASS}>
          {COPY.MY_SPACE}
        </Link>
      )}
      {canOfferCodeSignIn(state) && (
        <OtpDialog
          open={open}
          onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
          returnTo={returnTo}
          googleEnabled={googleEnabled}
          returnFocusTo={headingTarget}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Wiring guards for the public pages (P4 Tasks 25b, 26, 27). The pages import server-only modules and next/*, which
 * the node:test runner cannot load, so what they must keep is pinned on their source: the decisions themselves (who
 * the visitor is, what a page may show) have their own pure and DB tests. Run from the repository root.
 */
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import test from "node:test";

import { rawErrorLogs } from "@/test/source-guards";

const source = (path: string): string => readFileSync(path, "utf8");

const HOME = source("src/app/[slug]/page.tsx");

test("/[slug] reads the visitor through currentPublicVisitor (fresh session), never the cached session, and is never cached", () => {
  assert.match(HOME, /currentPublicVisitor\(pro\.professionalId, pro\.ownerUserId\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(HOME, /\bgetSession\(/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(HOME, /unstable_cache|"use cache"|export const revalidate/);
});

test("/[slug]: the wallet is the Owner's, everybody else gets the bar, and no row or id reaches a client prop", () => {
  const wallet = HOME.indexOf("<WalletPanel");
  assert.notEqual(wallet, -1, "the wallet panel is rendered");
  assert.match(HOME.slice(Math.max(0, wallet - 160), wallet), /visitor\.owner && space/, "only for an Owner with a space");
  assert.match(HOME, /<VisitorBar[\s\S]*?hasGuestSpace=\{visitor\.guestCustomerId !== null\}/);
  assert.match(HOME, /email=\{visitor\.state === "unverified" \? visitor\.email : null\}/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(HOME, /\b(ownerUserId|userId|customerId|stripeAccountId|owner)=\{/, "no identity or row in a prop");
});

test("/[slug] refreshes the horizon after the response, behind its per-pro key, only when a series needs it (SEC-M13)", () => {
  const need = HOME.indexOf("getHorizonNeed(");
  const afterAt = HOME.indexOf("after(async", need);
  const consumeAt = HOME.indexOf("consumeThrottle(", afterAt);
  const ensureAt = HOME.indexOf("ensureHorizon(db, pro.professionalId)", consumeAt);
  assert.ok(need !== -1 && afterAt > need && consumeAt > afterAt && ensureAt > consumeAt, "need, then after(), then the key, then the write");
  assert.match(HOME, /`t:horizon:p:\$\{pro\.professionalId\}`, \{ limit: 1, windowSec: 300 \}/);
  assert.equal(HOME.split("consumeThrottle(").length - 1, 1, "the key is consumed in one place only");
  assert.match(HOME, /logSafeMessage\(err\)/);
  assert.deepEqual(rawErrorLogs(HOME), [], "never a raw error in a console call (the shared guard of src/test/source-guards.ts)");
});

test("/[slug] shows the test-payments banner above the Boutique whenever the payment mode is not live", () => {
  assert.match(HOME, /const payment = paymentMode\(\);/);
  assert.match(HOME, /const testMode = payment === "live" \? null : payment;/);
  assert.match(HOME, /\{testMode && <TestPaymentsBanner mode=\{testMode\} \/>\}/);
});

test("/[slug] warns the owner of the page", () => {

});
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { after } from "next/server";

import { Boutique } from "@/components/public/boutique";
import { OwnerPreviewBanner } from "@/components/public/owner-preview-banner";
import { PublicPlanning } from "@/components/public/public-planning";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { TestPaymentsBanner } from "@/components/public/test-payments-banner";
import { VisitorBar } from "@/components/public/visitor-bar";
import { WalletPanel } from "@/components/public/wallet-panel";
import { ensureHorizon } from "@/lib/booking/occurrences";
import { addDays, todayKey } from "@/lib/civil-date";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { logSafeMessage } from "@/lib/log-safe";
import { paramForWeek, weekBounds, weekStartFromParam } from "@/lib/planning";
import { publicProOfRow } from "@/lib/public/context";
import {
  groupByDay,
  parsePlanningParams,
  planningEmptyState,
  planningNav,
  toPublicSeanceVM,
} from "@/lib/public/planning-view";
import { BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR } from "@/lib/public-anchors";
import { paymentMode } from "@/lib/stripe";
import { consumeThrottle } from "@/lib/throttle";
import { getCustomerSpacePage } from "@/server/client-queries";
import {
  getBoutiquePage,
  getHorizonNeed,
  getNextSeanceStart,
  getPlanningPage,
  getPublicPageProfile,
} from "@/server/public-queries";
import { currentPublicVisitor } from "@/server/visitor";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ semaine?: string | string[]; vue?: string | string[] }>;
};

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const profile = await getPublicPageProfile(slug);
  if (!profile) return { title: "Page introuvable" };
  return { title: profile.pro.businessName, description: profile.pro.headline ?? undefined };
}

/**
 * The public page of a pro: its planning (« Liste » or « Semaine », one week at a time), its Boutique, and what the
 * visitor is (the owner banner, the bar or the Owner's wallet, the test-payments note). Dynamic by construction: it
 * reads the search parameters, the fresh session and the personal-link cookie. A render never writes; the one write,
 * the horizon refresh, runs after the response (spec § 13.2, contract § 4 row 12 and § 5).
 */
export default async function PublicProfilePage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const profile = await getPublicPageProfile(slug);
  if (!profile) notFound();
  const pro = publicProOfRow(profile.pro);
  const { semaine, view } = parsePlanningParams(await searchParams);

  const now = new Date();
  const tz = pro.timezone;
  const weekStart = weekStartFromParam(semaine, tz, now);
  const range = weekBounds(weekStart, tz);
  const weekKey = paramForWeek(weekStart, tz);
  const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(weekKey, i));

  // Who the visitor is: the fresh session (a suspended user counts as none) and the personal-link cookie, read only.
  const visitor = await currentPublicVisitor(pro.professionalId, pro.ownerUserId);
  const [seances, boutique, needsHorizon, space] = await Promise.all([
    getPlanningPage(pro, range),
    getBoutiquePage(pro.professionalId),
    getHorizonNeed(pro),
    // The wallet is the Owner's only: never a typed address, a purchase reference or a personal-link cookie (Decision 61).
    visitor.owner ? getCustomerSpacePage(pro.professionalId, visitor.owner.customerId) : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);
  // Only an empty week asks where the next séance is, and only a week with nothing after it asks if there is any at all.
  const nextStart = seances.length === 0 ? await getNextSeanceStart(pro, range.end) : null;
  const anyStart = seances.length === 0 && nextStart === null ? await getNextSeanceStart(pro, now) : null;
  const { empty, nextWeekHref } = planningEmptyState({ slug: pro.slug, view, tz, shown: seances.length, nextStart, anyStart });
  const payment = paymentMode();
  const testMode = payment === "live" ? null : payment;

  // A render never writes: when a series is generated less than a few weeks ahead, the refresh runs after the response,
  // and its per-pro key (one run per 5 minutes) is consumed inside after(), never during the render (SEC-M13).
  if (needsHorizon) {
    after(async () => {
      try {
        if (await consumeThrottle(db, `t:horizon:p:${pro.professionalId}`, { limit: 1, windowSec: 300 }, new Date())) {
          const res = await ensureHorizon(db, pro.professionalId);
          if (!res.ok) console.error(`[public] ensureHorizon refused: ${res.code}`);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`[public] ensureHorizon failed: ${logSafeMessage(err)}`);
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <PublicShell branding={profile.pro}>
      {visitor.isPageOwner && <OwnerPreviewBanner />}
      {visitor.owner && space ? (
        <div className="mb-6">
          <WalletPanel slug={pro.slug} businessName={pro.businessName} wallet={space.wallet} variant="full" />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <VisitorBar
          state={visitor.state}
          email={visitor.state === "unverified" ? visitor.email : null}
          slug={pro.slug}
          returnTo={`/${pro.slug}`}
          googleEnabled={env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED}
          hasGuestSpace={visitor.guestCustomerId !== null}
        />
      )}
      {profile.pro.bio && <p className="mb-8 whitespace-pre-line text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{profile.pro.bio}</p>}
      <div className="space-y-10">
        <PublicPlanning
          nav={planningNav({ slug: pro.slug, weekKey, view, todayKey: todayKey(now, tz) })}
          view={view}
          days={groupByDay(
            seances.map((s) => toPublicSeanceVM(s, pro.slug, now, tz)),
            days,
          )}
          empty={empty}
          nextWeekHref={nextWeekHref}
          shopHref={boutique.length > 0 ? `#${BOUTIQUE_ANCHOR}` : null}
        />
        {boutique.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {testMode && <TestPaymentsBanner mode={testMode} />}
            <Boutique slug={pro.slug} currency={pro.currency} types={boutique} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </PublicShell>
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/public/occurrence-form.ts (pure, client-safe)
export type QuestionFieldDef = { id: string; label: string; type: QuestionType; options: string[] | null; required: boolean };
/** Field messages the server would refuse (keys `identity.name`, `identity.email`, `identity.phone`, as parseFr on the whole input). */
export function identityErrors(identity: IdentityInput): Record<string, string>;
/** The identity as the Server Action receives it: trimmed, the phone omitted when empty. */
export function identityToSend(identity: IdentityInput): { name: string; email: string; phone?: string };
/** Answers in question order, trimmed, blank ones skipped (the engine's rule); a value of an unknown question is ignored. */
export function answersFromValues(questions: readonly QuestionFieldDef[], values: Readonly<Record<string, string>>): AnswerInput[];
/** « Merci de répondre à : {label} » (the engine's sentence) per required question left blank, keyed by question id. */
export function requiredAnswerErrors(questions: readonly QuestionFieldDef[], values: Readonly<Record<string, string>>): Record<string, string>;
/** Server field errors `answers.<i>.…` mapped back to the question id of answer i. */
export function answerErrorsById(answers: readonly AnswerInput[], fieldErrors: Readonly<Record<string, string>>): Record<string, string>;

// src/lib/public/seance-copy.ts (pure)
export const SEANCE_STATE_LINES: Readonly<Record<Exclude<PublicStateKind, "free" | "open">, string>>;
export function stateLine(kind: PublicStateKind): string | null;
export const BOOKED_CONFIRMED: string; export const BOOKED_PENDING: string; export const SEE_MY_SPACE: string;
export const FREE_BOOKING_TITLE: string; export const TICKETS_BOOKING_TITLE: string;
export function ticketUsedLine(typeName: string): string;
/** "seance-title": the id of the séance heading (`tabIndex={-1}`), where the focus goes after a success that books the signed-in visitor. */
export const SEANCE_HEADING_ID: string;

// src/components/public/identity-fields.tsx (client, presentational)
export function IdentityFields(props: {
  idPrefix: string; value: IdentityInput; onChange: (v: IdentityInput) => void; emailLocked: boolean;
  errors: Record<string, string>; businessName: string; website: string; onWebsite: (v: string) => void;
}): React.JSX.Element;
// src/components/public/question-fields.tsx (client, presentational)
export function QuestionFields(props: {
  idPrefix: string; questions: QuestionFieldDef[]; value: Record<string, string>;
  onChange: (v: Record<string, string>) => void; errors: Record<string, string>;
}): React.JSX.Element | null;
// src/components/public/occurrence-booking.tsx (client): contract § 3.23 props, Task 26 renders the free and held parts
export type OccurrenceBookingProps = {
  slug: string; occurrenceId: string; seenStartsAt: string; businessName: string; currency: string;
  mode: "free" | "tickets"; questions: QuestionFieldDef[];
  offers: { offerId: string; label: string; priceCents: number; validityText: string | null; covers: boolean }[];
  visitor: { state: VisitorState; email: string | null; name: string | null; canSpend: boolean; leftAfter: number; typeName: string | null };
  googleEnabled: boolean; returnTo: string; testMode: "mock" | "test" | null;
};
export function OccurrenceBooking(props: OccurrenceBookingProps): React.JSX.Element | null;
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** none. The identity and capability rules (S1, S2, S24, S25, S35) are owned by Tasks 10 and 24, whose cores and reads this page only calls. What reviewers check first on this page (contract § 9 rows 1, 2, 4 and 6) is pinned by the source guards added here: the visitor comes from `currentPublicVisitor` (fresh session), the facts are read only for a customer viewer (Owner or guest cookie), a guest cookie never makes a booking `booked` and never hides the form, a private séance is `notFound()` unless `canSeePrivateSeance`, the metadata never reads the viewer, no row or identifier reaches a client prop, and the form posts only the slug, the séance, the typed identity, the answers and the honeypot.

Design notes (read before coding):
- Load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing the JSX (project rule). The page sits inside `PublicShell`; it keeps the card system, `lucide-react`, `text-zinc-600` for muted text, `INLINE_LINK_CLASS` for links in a sentence, `wrap-anywhere` on every user-supplied text (title, place, type names, question labels), brand colour never on text. Forms are full width below 640 px; no horizontal scroll.
- Page precedence is Decision 9: unknown or another pro's séance -> `notFound()`; an RDV -> `redirect(`/${slug}/espace`)` (no RDV occurrence exists before P5, so the branch is proven by `seance-reads.db.test.ts` and by reading it); a private séance -> `canSeePrivateSeance` else `notFound()`; then `seancePageMode`.
- A guest cookie is read-and-cancel only (Decision 63): `seanceViewerOf` can return it as a customer viewer, but its booking never becomes `booked`, never carries a purchase id or a Checkout URL (`seanceVisitorFacts` fills only `booking.status` for it), and the page shows `COPY.GUEST_BOOKING_EXISTS` above the normal form instead.
- A signed-in unverified visitor keeps the anonymous flows with a typed e-mail but never sees the code form (Decision 70): `OccurrenceBooking` shows `COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_TO_SPEND`, the page shows `VerifyEmailBanner`.
- A refused input costs the visitor a throttle hit (the keys are consumed before the engine reads the answers), so the form checks the identity and the required answers itself first (`occurrence-form.ts`) and calls the action only with an input that can pass.
- After a successful action the Server Action revalidates `/[slug]`: for an Owner the page re-renders as « booked » and this form unmounts, for a typed visitor the page keeps the form and its status line. `OccurrenceBooking` is keyed by visitor state and spend ability so that it remounts after a sign-in (`router.refresh()` in the dialog) with the right e-mail and no stale state.
- Buy + book, the offers, the test-payments note and the return link of a refused attempt are Task 27's. The page passes `offers={[]}` and `testMode={null}` until then, and a visitor who can neither spend nor sign in sees no card.
- Focus after a success (contract § 1 UI rules, WCAG 2.4.3): a held-ticket booking, and a free registration by a verified visitor, book the signed-in visitor, so the revalidated page renders the « booked » block and `OccurrenceBooking` unmounts with its status line (the P3 lesson of Task 22's `SpaceStatusProvider`). The form then moves the focus to the séance heading (`id="seance-title"` = `SEANCE_HEADING_ID`, `tabIndex={-1}`), which the page always renders. A typed visitor (anonymous, unverified, impersonating) keeps the form, and the focus goes to its status line. The sign-in dialog of `HaveTicketsPrompt` hands the focus back to the same heading (`returnFocusTo={seanceHeading}`, a module-level function, so its identity is stable): the prompt goes once the visitor is signed in (G3a).
- Task 28 rewrites this page whole (it adds the `?p=` reference, the Owner's own pending purchase, `CheckoutReturn` and `PendingHolds`), so the séance guards appended to `page-wiring.test.ts` pin invariants (fresh visitor, the 404 and RDV branches, the private gate, facts for a customer viewer only, no identifier in a prop, metadata that never reads the viewer), not identifiers: they must stay green on Task 28's file. `OccurrenceBooking` does not depend on the page's `key`: a verified visitor's locked e-mail is always the session's, whatever the form held before the session changed.
- The tab title is the contract's string followed by the root template's suffix: `title: "Altinha débutants · Altinha Paris"` renders `Altinha débutants · Altinha Paris · Skedul` (`src/app/layout.tsx` template `%s · Skedul`). The browser check reads the beginning of the title.

Create `src/lib/public/occurrence-form.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Pure helpers of the public booking forms (the séance page and, later, the offer page): what the browser sends and
 * the checks it runs before a Server Action call. The throttle keys of a public action are consumed before the engine
 * reads the answers, so a typo caught here costs no rate-limit hit. Client-safe: no server module. The server parses
 * the whole input again; nothing here authorises anything.
 */
import { z } from "zod";

import type { IdentityInput } from "@/lib/public/booking-actions";
import { plainNameSchema } from "@/lib/public/plain-name";
import { customerInputSchema, type AnswerInput, type QuestionType } from "@/lib/tickets";
import { parseFr } from "@/lib/zod-fr";

/** A registration question as the forms need it (the page picks these fields from the engine's question rows). */
export type QuestionFieldDef = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  type: QuestionType;
  options: string[] | null;
  required: boolean;
};

/** The server's identity rules (plain name, e-mail, phone) as one schema; the same building blocks as the action's. */
const identityCheck = z.object({
  name: plainNameSchema,
  email: z.string().trim().pipe(customerInputSchema.shape.email),
  phone: customerInputSchema.shape.phone,
});

/** Field messages the server would refuse (keys `identity.name`, `identity.email`, `identity.phone`, as parseFr on the whole input). */
export function identityErrors(identity: IdentityInput): Record<string, string> {
  const phone = (identity.phone ?? "").trim();
  const parsed = parseFr(identityCheck, {
    name: identity.name,
    email: identity.email,
    ...(phone === "" ? {} : { phone }),
  });
  if (parsed.ok) return {};
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(parsed.fieldErrors).map(([key, message]) => [`identity.${key}`, message]));
}

/** The identity as the Server Action receives it: trimmed, the phone omitted when empty. */
export function identityToSend(identity: IdentityInput): { name: string; email: string; phone?: string } {
  const phone = (identity.phone ?? "").trim();
  return { name: identity.name.trim(), email: identity.email.trim(), ...(phone === "" ? {} : { phone }) };
}

/** Answers in question order, trimmed, blank ones skipped (the engine's rule); a value of an unknown question is ignored. */
export function answersFromValues(
  questions: readonly QuestionFieldDef[],
  values: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): AnswerInput[] {
  const answers: AnswerInput[] = [];
  for (const q of questions) {
    const value = (values[q.id] ?? "").trim();
    if (value !== "") answers.push({ questionId: q.id, value });
  }
  return answers;
}

/** « Merci de répondre à : {label} » (the engine's sentence) per required question left blank, keyed by question id. */
export function requiredAnswerErrors(
  questions: readonly QuestionFieldDef[],
  values: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const q of questions) {
    if (q.required && (values[q.id] ?? "").trim() === "") errors[q.id] = `Merci de répondre à : ${q.label}`;
  }
  return errors;
}

/** Server field errors `answers.<i>.…` mapped back to the question id of answer i; the first message of a question wins. */
export function answerErrorsById(
  answers: readonly AnswerInput[],
  fieldErrors: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
): Record<string, string> {
  const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [key, message] of Object.entries(fieldErrors)) {
    const match = /^answers\.(\d+)(?:\.|$)/.exec(key);
    if (!match) continue;
    const answer = answers[Number(match[1])];
    if (answer && errors[answer.questionId] === undefined) errors[answer.questionId] = message;
  }
  return errors;
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Fixed sentences of the séance page that the shared client copy (messages.ts) does not hold (contract § 3.23, « Séance
 * page copy »). Pure and client-safe; no em dash and no en dash (ui-copy.test.ts).
 */
import type { PublicStateKind } from "@/lib/public/messages";

/** The sentence under the title of a séance that cannot be booked online, per state. */
export const SEANCE_STATE_LINES: Readonly<Record<Exclude<PublicStateKind, "free" | "open">, string>> = {
  cancelled: "Cette séance est annulée.",
  past: "Cette séance est terminée.",
  ongoing: "Cette séance a commencé.",
  onsite: "Pas de réservation en ligne : présentez-vous sur place.",
  notYet: "Les réservations ne sont pas encore ouvertes pour cette séance.",
  closed: "Les réservations en ligne sont fermées pour cette séance.",
  full: "Cette séance est complète.",
};

/** The sentence of a state, or null for free and open (the booking form is shown instead). */
export function stateLine(kind: PublicStateKind): string | null {
  return kind === "free" || kind === "open" ? null : SEANCE_STATE_LINES[kind];
}

/** The Owner's or the reference's confirmed booking on this séance. */
export const BOOKED_CONFIRMED = "Vous êtes inscrit(e) à cette séance.";
/** A pending booking: the payment is not done yet. */
export const BOOKED_PENDING = "Un paiement est en attente pour cette séance.";
export const SEE_MY_SPACE = "Voir mon espace";

/** Titles of the booking card: free registration, and the card that holds the tickets and the purchase. */
export const FREE_BOOKING_TITLE = "S'inscrire à cette séance";
export const TICKETS_BOOKING_TITLE = "Réserver cette séance";

/** Which ticket the « Réserver avec 1 ticket » button spends (the first in consumption order). */
export function ticketUsedLine(typeName: string): string {
  return `Ticket utilisé : ${typeName}.`;
}

/**
 * The id of the séance heading (`tabIndex={-1}` on the page). A success that books the signed-in visitor re-renders the
 * page as « booked » and removes the form that held the focus: the form then gives the focus to this heading, which
 * stays (WCAG 2.4.3).
 */
export const SEANCE_HEADING_ID = "seance-title";
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { createElement, type ComponentProps } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";

import { IdentityFields } from "./identity-fields";

const noop = () => {};
type Props = ComponentProps<typeof IdentityFields>;

const render = (over: Partial<Props> = {}): string =>
  renderToStaticMarkup(
    createElement(IdentityFields, {
      idPrefix: "t",
      value: { name: "Ana Souza", email: "ana@example.com", phone: "" },
      onChange: noop,
      emailLocked: false,
      errors: {},
      businessName: "Altinha Paris",
      website: "",
      onWebsite: noop,
      ...over,
    }),
  );

/** The visible text of a markup string: tags dropped, the entities of apostrophes and ampersands decoded. */
function textOf(markup: string): string {
  return markup.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/&#x27;/g, "'").replace(/&amp;/g, "&").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

/** The opening tag of the control with this id. */
function tagOf(markup: string, id: string): string {
  const found = new RegExp(`<(?:input|textarea|select)[^>]*\\bid="${id}"[^>]*>`).exec(markup);
  assert.ok(found, `no control with the id ${id}`);
  return found[0];
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { createElement, type ComponentProps } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof QuestionFields>;

const QUESTIONS: QuestionFieldDef[] = [
  { id: "q1", label: "Niveau", type: "text", options: null, required: true },
  { id: "q2", label: "Pied fort", type: "choice", options: ["Droit", "Gauche"], required: false },
  { id: "q3", label: "Première fois", type: "boolean", options: null, required: true },
];

const render = (over: Partial<Props> = {}): string =>
  renderToStaticMarkup(
    createElement(QuestionFields, { idPrefix: "t", questions: QUESTIONS, value: {}, onChange: noop, errors: {}, ...over }),
  );

/** The opening tag of the control with this id. */
function tagOf(markup: string, id: string): string {
  const found = new RegExp(`<(?:input|textarea|select)[^>]*\\bid="${id}"[^>]*>`).exec(markup);
  assert.ok(found, `no control with the id ${id}`);
  return found[0];
}

test("no question renders nothing", () => {
  assert.equal(render({ questions: [] }), "");
});

test("a text question is a labelled textarea bounded by the answer length, « (obligatoire) » when required", () => {
  const markup = render({ value: { q1: "Débutant" } });
  assert.match(markup, /<label[^>]*for="t-q-q1"[^>]*>Niveau \(obligatoire\)<\/label>/);
  const tag = tagOf(markup, "t-q-q1");
  assert.match(tag, /^<textarea/);
  assert.match(tag, /maxlength="2000"/i);
  assert.match(markup, /<textarea[^>]*>Débutant<\/textarea>/);
  assert.match(markup, /<label[^>]*for="t-q-q2"[^>]*>Pied fort<\/label>/, "an optional question has no suffix");
});

test("a choice question is a select that starts on « Choisir » and lists its options", () => {
  const markup = render({ value: { q2: "Gauche" } });
  assert.match(tagOf(markup, "t-q-q2"), /^<select/);
  const options = markup.match(/<option[^>]*>[^<]*<\/option>/g) ?? [];
  assert.equal(options.length, 3);
  assert.match(options[0], /value=""/);
  assert.match(options[0], />Choisir</);
  assert.equal(options.filter((option) => option.includes("selected")).length, 1);
  assert.ok(options[2].includes("selected") && options[2].includes(">Gauche<"));

});
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import type { IdentityInput } from "@/lib/public/booking-actions";
import { dataUseLine } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

/**
 * Name, e-mail and phone of a public form (Decision 12: the minimum the engine needs, one data-use line, no consent
 * box). `emailLocked` is true only for a VERIFIED session, whose e-mail then comes from the session (a personal-link
 * cookie never fills or locks a field, Decision 7). Errors are read from the keys of the whole-input parse
 * (`identity.name`, `identity.email`, `identity.phone`). The honeypot is an empty field a person never sees: a
 * filled one is refused by the server before anything is read.
 */
export function IdentityFields({
  idPrefix,
  value,
  onChange,
  emailLocked,
  errors,
  businessName,
  website,
  onWebsite,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  value: IdentityInput;
  onChange: (v: IdentityInput) => void;
  emailLocked: boolean;
  errors: Record<string, string>;
  businessName: string;
  website: string;
  onWebsite: (v: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <FormField label="Prénom et nom" htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-name`} error={errors["identity.name"]}>
        <Input
          id={`${idPrefix}-name`}
          name="name"
          autoComplete="name"
          maxLength={BOUNDS.name}
          value={value.name}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...value, name: e.target.value })}
        />
      </FormField>
      <FormField
        label="Email"
        htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-email`}
        help={emailLocked ? "Adresse de votre compte." : undefined}
        error={errors["identity.email"]}
      >
        <Input
          id={`${idPrefix}-email`}
          name="email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          inputMode="email"
          value={value.email}
          readOnly={emailLocked}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...value, email: e.target.value })}
        />
      </FormField>
      <FormField label="Téléphone" optional htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-phone`} error={errors["identity.phone"]}>
        <Input
          id={`${idPrefix}-phone`}
          name="phone"
          type="tel"
          autoComplete="tel"
          maxLength={BOUNDS.phone}
          value={value.phone ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...value, phone: e.target.value })}
        />
      </FormField>
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{dataUseLine(businessName)}</p>
      <div aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -left-[9999px] top-auto h-px w-px overflow-hidden">
        <label htmlFor={`${idPrefix}-website`}>Laissez ce champ vide</label>
        <input
          id={`${idPrefix}-website`}
          name="website"
          type="text"
          tabIndex={-1}
          autoComplete="off"
          value={website}
          onChange={(e) => onWebsite(e.target.value)}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { FormField } from "@/components/dashboard/form-field";
import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import type { QuestionFieldDef } from "@/lib/public/occurrence-form";
import { BOOLEAN_ANSWERS, BOUNDS } from "@/lib/tickets-vocab";

/**
 * The questions of an event (contract § 3.23): text -> textarea, choice -> select (first option « Choisir »), boolean ->
 * two radios « Oui » / « Non ». A required question says « (obligatoire) ». `errors` is keyed by question id. The
 * labels are the pro's text and can be long and unbroken, hence `wrap-anywhere`.
 */
export function QuestionFields({
  idPrefix,
  questions,
  value,
  onChange,
  errors,
}: {
  idPrefix: string;
  questions: QuestionFieldDef[];
  value: Record<string, string>;
  onChange: (v: Record<string, string>) => void;
  errors: Record<string, string>;
}) {
  if (questions.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {questions.map((q) => {
        const id = `${idPrefix}-q-${q.id}`;
        const label = q.required ? `${q.label} (obligatoire)` : q.label;
        const current = value[q.id] ?? "";
        const error = errors[q.id] ?? null;
        const set = (next: string) => onChange({ ...value, [q.id]: next });

        if (q.type === "boolean") {
          return (
            <fieldset key={q.id} className="wrap-anywhere">
              <legend className="text-sm font-medium">{label}</legend>
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-2">
                {BOOLEAN_ANSWERS.map((answer, index) => (
                  <label key={answer} htmlFor={`${id}-${index}`} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    <input
                      id={`${id}-${index}`}
                      type="radio"
                      name={id}
                      value={answer}
                      checked={current === answer}
                      onChange={() => set(answer)}
                      aria-invalid={error && index === 0 ? true : undefined}
                      aria-describedby={error ? `${id}-error` : undefined}
                      className="size-4 accent-primary"
                    />
                    {answer}
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
              {error && (
                <p id={`${id}-error`} role="alert" className="mt-1 text-xs text-rose-700">
                  {error}
                </p>
              )}
            </fieldset>
          );
        }

        if (q.type === "choice") {
          return (
            <div key={q.id} className="wrap-anywhere">
              <FormField label={label} htmlFor={id} error={error}>
                <Select id={id} value={current} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value)}>
                  <option value="">Choisir</option>
                  {(q.options ?? []).map((option) => (
                    <option key={option} value={option}>
                      {option}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </Select>
              </FormField>
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <div key={q.id} className="wrap-anywhere">
            <FormField label={label} htmlFor={id} error={error}>
              <Textarea id={id} rows={3} maxLength={BOUNDS.answer} value={current} onChange={(e) => set(e.target.value)} />
            </FormField>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type Ref } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { OtpDialog } from "@/components/auth/otp-dialog";
import { useRefusalFocus } from "@/components/dashboard/use-refusal-focus";
import { IdentityFields } from "@/components/public/identity-fields";
import { QuestionFields } from "@/components/public/question-fields";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { IdentityInput } from "@/lib/public/booking-actions";
import type { VisitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY, heldTicketButtonLabel } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import {
  answerErrorsById,
  answersFromValues,
  identityErrors,
  identityToSend,
  requiredAnswerErrors,
  type QuestionFieldDef,
} from "@/lib/public/occurrence-form";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED, type PublicFail } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { FREE_BOOKING_TITLE, SEANCE_HEADING_ID, TICKETS_BOOKING_TITLE, ticketUsedLine } from "@/lib/public/seance-copy";
import { canOfferCodeSignIn } from "@/lib/public/sign-in-flow";
import { bookWithHeldTicketAction, registerFreeAction } from "@/server/public";

export type OccurrenceBookingProps = {
  slug: string;
  occurrenceId: string;
  /** The ISO start the page rendered: posted back so the engine can tell that the séance moved. */
  seenStartsAt: string;
  businessName: string;
  currency: string;
  mode: "free" | "tickets";
  questions: QuestionFieldDef[];
  offers: { offerId: string; label: string; priceCents: number; validityText: string | null; covers: boolean }[];
  visitor: {
    state: VisitorState;
    /** The session e-mail of a VERIFIED visitor only; never the e-mail of a cookie or of a typed address. */
    email: string | null;
    name: string | null;
    canSpend: boolean;
    leftAfter: number;
    typeName: string | null;
  };
  googleEnabled: boolean;
  returnTo: string;
  testMode: "mock" | "test" | null;
};

/** A Server Action call that never throws: a network failure or a deploy in between becomes a failure the form shows. */
async function call<R extends { ok: boolean }>(run: () => Promise<R>): Promise<R | PublicFail> {
  try {
    return await run();
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, error: PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED };
  }
}

/** The success line of a form: `succeed(true)` shows it and puts the focus on it once it is rendered (WCAG 2.4.3). */
function useStatusFocus() {
  const box = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  const [focusTick, setFocusTick] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusTick > 0) box.current?.focus();
  }, [focusTick]);
  return {
    box,
    shown,
    succeed: (focus: boolean) => {
      setShown(true);
      if (focus) setFocusTick((n) => n + 1);
    },
    reset: () => setShown(false),
  };
}

/**
 * A success that books the signed-in visitor (a held ticket, or a free registration with the session's address): the
 * action revalidates the page, which renders the « booked » block, so this form and its status line go. The focus moves
 * to the séance heading, which the page always renders (WCAG 2.4.3, contract § 1). The sign-in dialog of
 * `HaveTicketsPrompt` hands the focus back to the same heading: its prompt goes once the visitor is signed in (G3a).
 */
function seanceHeading(): HTMLElement | null {
  return document.getElementById(SEANCE_HEADING_ID);
}

function focusSeanceHeading() {
  seanceHeading()?.focus();
}

/** The always-mounted status and alert regions of a form: the text is inserted into a region that already exists. */
function Feedback({
  status,
  statusBox,
  error,
  errorBox,
}: {
  status: string | null;
  statusBox: Ref<HTMLParagraphElement>;
  error: string | null;
  errorBox: Ref<HTMLParagraphElement>;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      <div role="status">
        {status && (
          <p
            ref={statusBox}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg bg-green-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-green-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
            <span className="min-w-0">{status}</span>
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      <div role="alert">
        {error && (
          <p
            ref={errorBox}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-rose-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

/** Free registration (E3): identity, questions, « S'inscrire ». The e-mail is locked for a verified session only. */
function FreeForm({ p }: { p: OccurrenceBookingProps }) {
  const { visitor } = p;
  const uid = useId();
  const emailLocked = visitor.state === "verified" && visitor.email !== null;
  const [identity, setIdentity] = useState<IdentityInput>({ name: visitor.name ?? "", email: visitor.email ?? "", phone: "" });
  // A verified visitor's e-mail is the session's, whatever was typed before the session changed under this form.
  const effective: IdentityInput = emailLocked && visitor.email !== null ? { ...identity, email: visitor.email } : identity;
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState("");
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const { root, errorBox, refused } = useRefusalFocus();
  const registered = useStatusFocus();

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    registered.reset();
    setError(null);
    const local = { ...identityErrors(effective), ...requiredAnswerErrors(p.questions, values) };
    if (Object.keys(local).length > 0) {
      setErrors(local);
      refused();
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    setPending(true);
    const answers = answersFromValues(p.questions, values);
    const res = await call(() =>
      registerFreeAction({ slug: p.slug, occurrenceId: p.occurrenceId, seenStartsAt: p.seenStartsAt, identity: identityToSend(effective), answers, website }),
    );
    setPending(false);
    if (res.ok) {
      // A verified visitor is booked now and the page re-renders as « booked » (this form goes); a typed visitor keeps
      // the form, and the focus goes to its status line.
      if (emailLocked) focusSeanceHeading();
      registered.succeed(!emailLocked);
      return;
    }
    setError(res.error);
    setErrors({ ...(res.fieldErrors ?? {}), ...answerErrorsById(answers, res.fieldErrors ?? {}) });
    refused();
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{FREE_BOOKING_TITLE}</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <form ref={root} onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
          <IdentityFields
            idPrefix={uid}
            value={effective}
            onChange={setIdentity}
            emailLocked={emailLocked}
            errors={errors}
            businessName={p.businessName}
            website={website}
            onWebsite={setWebsite}
          />
          <QuestionFields idPrefix={uid} questions={p.questions} value={values} onChange={setValues} errors={errors} />
          <Feedback
            status={registered.shown ? COPY.REGISTERED : null}
            statusBox={registered.box}
            error={error}
            errorBox={errorBox}
          />
          <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="w-full sm:w-auto">
            {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
            {pending ? COPY.PENDING_REGISTER : "S'inscrire"}
          </Button>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** Booking with a held ticket (E2): the Owner's one-click spend; only the event's questions are asked. */
function HeldForm({ p }: { p: OccurrenceBookingProps }) {
  const { visitor } = p;
  const uid = useId();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const { root, errorBox, refused } = useRefusalFocus();
  const booked = useStatusFocus();

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending) return;
    booked.reset();
    setError(null);
    const local = requiredAnswerErrors(p.questions, values);
    if (Object.keys(local).length > 0) {
      setErrors(local);
      refused();
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    setPending(true);
    const answers = answersFromValues(p.questions, values);
    const res = await call(() =>
      bookWithHeldTicketAction({ slug: p.slug, occurrenceId: p.occurrenceId, seenStartsAt: p.seenStartsAt, answers }),
    );
    setPending(false);
    if (res.ok) {
      // The Owner is booked now: the page re-renders as « booked » and this form goes.
      focusSeanceHeading();
      booked.succeed(false);
      return;
    }
    setError(res.error);
    setErrors({ ...(res.fieldErrors ?? {}), ...answerErrorsById(answers, res.fieldErrors ?? {}) });
    refused();
  }

  return (
    <form ref={root} onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
      {visitor.typeName && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{ticketUsedLine(visitor.typeName)}</p>}
      <QuestionFields idPrefix={uid} questions={p.questions} value={values} onChange={setValues} errors={errors} />
      <Feedback
        status={booked.shown ? COPY.BOOKED_WITH_TICKET : null}
        statusBox={booked.box}
        error={error}
        errorBox={errorBox}
      />
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="w-full sm:w-auto">
        {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
        {pending ? COPY.PENDING_BOOK : heldTicketButtonLabel(visitor.leftAfter)}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

/** « J'ai déjà des tickets »: the sign-in dialog of an anonymous visitor (never prefilled with an address, Decision 7). */
function HaveTicketsPrompt({ p }: { p: OccurrenceBookingProps }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl bg-muted p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
      <p className="min-w-0 text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.HAVE_TICKETS_HINT}</p>
      <Button type="button" variant="secondary" className="w-full sm:w-auto sm:shrink-0" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        {COPY.HAVE_TICKETS}
      </Button>
      <OtpDialog open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} returnTo={p.returnTo} googleEnabled={p.googleEnabled} returnFocusTo={seanceHeading} />
    </div>
  );
}

/** Tickets mode: spend a held ticket (Owner), sign in (anonymous), or confirm the address first (unverified). */
function TicketsBooking({ p }: { p: OccurrenceBookingProps }) {
  const { visitor } = p;
  const canSignIn = canOfferCodeSignIn(visitor.state);
  const unverified = visitor.state === "unverified";
  // A visitor who can neither spend a ticket nor sign in has nothing to do in this card.
  if (!visitor.canSpend && !canSignIn && !unverified) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{TICKETS_BOOKING_TITLE}</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-6">
        {visitor.canSpend && <HeldForm p={p} />}
        {!visitor.canSpend && canSignIn && <HaveTicketsPrompt p={p} />}
        {!visitor.canSpend && unverified && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.CONFIRM_EMAIL_TO_SPEND}</p>}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** The booking block of the séance page, by booking mode (contract § 3.23). */
export function OccurrenceBooking(props: OccurrenceBookingProps) {
  return props.mode === "free" ? <FreeForm p={props} /> : <TicketsBooking p={props} />;
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { cache } from "react";
import { MapPin } from "lucide-react";

import { VerifyEmailBanner } from "@/components/dashboard/verify-email-banner";
import { OccurrenceBooking } from "@/components/public/occurrence-booking";
import { OwnerPreviewBanner } from "@/components/public/owner-preview-banner";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { WalletPanel } from "@/components/public/wallet-panel";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { formatWhen } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { COPY, seatsLeftLabel } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { seanceState, stateLabel } from "@/lib/public/planning-view";
import { BOOKED_CONFIRMED, BOOKED_PENDING, SEE_MY_SPACE, stateLine } from "@/lib/public/seance-copy";
import { canSeePrivateSeance, seancePageMode, seanceViewerOf, type PageBooking } from "@/lib/public/visibility";
import { getCustomerSpacePage } from "@/server/client-queries";
import { resolvePublicPro } from "@/server/public-context";
import { getSeancePage, getSeanceVisitorFacts } from "@/server/public-queries";
import { currentPublicVisitor } from "@/server/visitor";

type Props = { params: Promise<{ slug: string; occurrenceId: string }> };

/** One read of the pro and of the séance per request, shared by generateMetadata and the page. */
const loadSeance = cache(async (slug: string, occurrenceId: string) => {
  const resolved = await resolvePublicPro(slug);
  if (!resolved) return null;
  const detail = await getSeancePage(resolved.pro, occurrenceId);
  return { ...resolved, detail };
});

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug, occurrenceId } = await params;
  const loaded = await loadSeance(slug, occurrenceId);
  if (!loaded) return { title: "Page introuvable", referrer: "no-referrer", robots: { index: false } };
  const { pro, detail } = loaded;
  // The metadata never depends on the viewer: a private, archived, RDV, unknown or foreign séance carries the business name only.
  if (!detail || detail.kind === "rdv" || detail.isPrivate || detail.archived) {
    return { title: pro.businessName, referrer: "no-referrer", robots: { index: false } };
  }
  return { title: `${detail.title} · ${pro.businessName}`, referrer: "no-referrer" };
}

/** A sentence above the booking form (a guest cookie's booking, an ended booking). */
function Notice({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <p className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted px-4 py-3 text-sm text-zinc-700">{children}</p>;
}

/**
 * One séance of a pro (spec § 13.2, contract § 3.21 and § 5). Precedence (Decision 9): unknown or another pro's ->
 * 404; RDV -> the espace; private and not visible to this viewer -> 404; then the state, the booked block or the
 * booking form of the mode. Dynamic: it reads the fresh session and the personal-link cookie. Nothing is written.
 */
export default async function SeancePage({ params }: Props) {
  const { slug, occurrenceId } = await params;
  const loaded = await loadSeance(slug, occurrenceId);
  if (!loaded) notFound();
  const { pro, branding, detail } = loaded;
  if (!detail) notFound();
  if (detail.kind === "rdv") redirect(`/${pro.slug}/espace`);

  const now = new Date();
  const visitor = await currentPublicVisitor(pro.professionalId, pro.ownerUserId);
  const viewer = seanceViewerOf({ visitor, reference: null });
  const customerViewer = viewer?.kind === "customer" ? viewer : null;
  const [facts, space] = await Promise.all([
    customerViewer ? getSeanceVisitorFacts(pro.professionalId, detail.occurrenceId, customerViewer) : Promise.resolve(null),
    visitor.owner ? getCustomerSpacePage(pro.professionalId, visitor.owner.customerId) : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);

  if (detail.isPrivate && !canSeePrivateSeance({ isPageOwner: visitor.isPageOwner, viewer, customerHasActiveBooking: facts?.booking != null })) notFound();

  const state = seanceState(detail, now, pro.timezone);
  const usable = customerViewer?.source === "owner" ? (facts?.usable ?? null) : null;
  // Only the Owner's own booking decides « booked »; a guest cookie's booking never hides the form (Decision 63).
  const booked: PageBooking =
    customerViewer?.source === "owner" && facts?.booking ? { status: facts.booking.status, via: "owner" } : null;
  const guestBooked = customerViewer?.source === "guest" && facts?.booking != null;
  const ended = customerViewer?.source === "owner" ? (facts?.ended ?? null) : null;
  const mode = seancePageMode({
    state,
    archived: detail.archived,
    isPrivate: detail.isPrivate,
    booked,
    mode: detail.bookingMode,
    canSpend: usable !== null,
    coveringOffers: detail.offers.filter((o) => o.covers).length,
  });

  const label = stateLabel(state);
  const when = formatWhen(detail.startsAt, detail.endsAt, pro.timezone);
  const showSeats = state.kind === "open" || state.kind === "free";

  return (
    <PublicShell branding={branding} backHref={`/${pro.slug}`}>
      {visitor.isPageOwner && <OwnerPreviewBanner />}
      {visitor.state === "unverified" && visitor.email && <VerifyEmailBanner email={visitor.email} verified={false} />}

      <section aria-labelledby="seance-title" className="mb-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* id = SEANCE_HEADING_ID: the booking form gives it the focus after a success that books the visitor. */}
          <h2
            id="seance-title"
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="min-w-0 rounded text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight wrap-anywhere focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            {detail.title}
          </h2>
          {label && <Badge variant={state.kind === "cancelled" ? "destructive" : state.kind === "free" ? "default" : "neutral"}>{label}</Badge>}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">{when}</p>
        {detail.location && (
          <p className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-600">
            <MapPin className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
            <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{detail.location}</span>
          </p>
        )}
        {showSeats && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">{seatsLeftLabel(detail.seatsLeft)}</p>}
        {detail.acceptedTypes.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2" aria-label="Types de ticket acceptés">
            {detail.acceptedTypes.map((t) => (
              <li
                key={t.id}
                className="inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium"
              >
                <span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: t.color }} />
                <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{t.name}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {detail.description && (
          <p className="mt-4 text-sm whitespace-pre-line text-zinc-700 wrap-anywhere">{detail.description}</p>
        )}
      </section>

      {space && space.wallet.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-6">
          <WalletPanel slug={pro.slug} businessName={pro.businessName} wallet={space.wallet} variant="compact" />
        </div>
      )}

      {mode.kind === "booked" ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 py-6">
            <p className="font-medium">{mode.status === "confirmed" ? BOOKED_CONFIRMED : BOOKED_PENDING}</p>
            {mode.status === "confirmed" && (
              <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
                <Link href={`/${pro.slug}/espace`}>{SEE_MY_SPACE}</Link>
              </Button>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : mode.kind === "state" ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="py-6">
            <p className="text-sm">{stateLine(mode.state.kind)}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          {guestBooked && <Notice>{COPY.GUEST_BOOKING_EXISTS}</Notice>}
          {ended === "cancelled" && <Notice>{COPY.ENDED_CANCELLED}</Notice>}
          {ended === "expired" && <Notice>{COPY.ENDED_EXPIRED}</Notice>}
          <OccurrenceBooking
            key={`${visitor.state}:${usable !== null ? "spend" : "buy"}`}
            slug={pro.slug}
            occurrenceId={detail.occurrenceId}
            seenStartsAt={detail.startsAt.toISOString()}
            businessName={pro.businessName}
            currency={pro.currency}
            mode={mode.kind}
            questions={detail.questions.map((q) => ({
              id: q.id,
              label: q.label,
              type: q.type,
              options: q.options,
              required: q.required,
            }))}
            offers={[]}
            visitor={{
              state: visitor.state,
              email: visitor.state === "verified" ? visitor.email : null,
              name: visitor.state === "verified" ? visitor.name : null,
              canSpend: usable !== null,
              leftAfter: usable?.leftAfter ?? 0,
              typeName: usable?.typeName ?? null,
            }}
            googleEnabled={env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED}
            returnTo={`/${pro.slug}/seance/${detail.occurrenceId}`}
            testMode={null}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </PublicShell>
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/public/buy-and-book-form.ts (pure, client-safe)
export type OfferChoice = { offerId: string; label: string; priceCents: number; validityText: string | null; covers: boolean };
export const BUY_TITLE: string;       // « Acheter et réserver »
export const OFFERS_LEGEND: string;   // « Choisissez une offre »
export const OFFER_TOO_SHORT: string; // « Validité trop courte pour cette séance »
/** « {label} · {price} » plus « · valable {validityText} » when the offer has a validity (price through formatMoney). */
export function offerOptionLabel(offer: OfferChoice, currency: string): string;
/** The id of the first offer that covers the séance, null when none does. */
export function firstCoveringOfferId(offers: readonly OfferChoice[]): string | null;
/** « Payer {price} ». */
export function payLabel(offer: OfferChoice, currency: string): string;
export const HOLD_KEY_PREFIX: string; // "skedul:hold:"
export const HOLD_ID_RE: RegExp;      // /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/
export function holdStorageKey(occurrenceId: string): string;
/** The session storage of the tab, null when the browser refuses it (private window, blocked data) or on the server. */
export function browserSessionStorage(): Storage | null;
export function storeHoldId(storage: Pick<Storage, "setItem"> | null, occurrenceId: string, purchaseId: string): void;
export function readHoldId(storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem"> | null, occurrenceId: string): string | null;
/** /{slug}/seance/{occurrenceId}?paiement=annule&p={holdId}: the return page of a payment the buyer left (COV-M6). */
export function returnHref(slug: string, occurrenceId: string, holdId: string): string;
/** The URL to leave for, or null: an https URL without credentials, or a same-origin http URL (the dev mock checkout). */
export function safeCheckoutUrl(url: string, origin: string): string | null;
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** none. S24 (a refused buy + book carries no URL), S33 and S34 (the throttle keys, the hold ceiling, the one sentence of Decision 64) are owned by Task 9, whose core this form calls; the wiring pinned here is that the action receives only the slug, the séance, the chosen offer id, the typed identity, the answers and the honeypot (never a price, an amount or a customer), that the browser leaves only for a URL `safeCheckoutUrl` accepts, and that the return link is built from the buyer's own `sessionStorage` entry (no server identity involved, COV-M6).

Design notes (read before coding):
- Load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing the JSX (project rule): same card system as Task 26, radio rows as bordered labels, brand colour only through `accent-primary` on the native radio and `has-checked` borders, muted text `text-zinc-600`, one pay button full width below 640 px.
- The offers come from the server with the `covers` flag; the form never decides validity. A non-covering offer is a disabled radio tied by `aria-describedby` to « Validité trop courte pour cette séance » (COV-M12). When no offer covers the séance and the visitor cannot spend, the block says `COPY.NO_COVERING_OFFER` and has no form.
- The buy block is for a visitor who cannot spend a held ticket (`!visitor.canSpend`): anonymous, unverified, or verified without a usable ticket. An unverified visitor keeps this flow with a typed e-mail (Decision 8). A verified visitor's e-mail is locked to the session's (the server also replaces the typed one for an Owner).
- On success the browser keeps the purchase id in `sessionStorage["skedul:hold:" + occurrenceId]` (try/catch: it can be unavailable) and leaves with `window.location.assign(checkoutUrl)`; the button keeps its « Redirection vers le paiement… » label until the page is gone, and a page restored from the back/forward cache (`pageshow` with `persisted`) leaves the pending state. After a refusal such as « Cette réservation ne peut pas être payée en ligne avec cette adresse. … », a buyer who started a payment in this tab gets the link « Reprendre ou libérer ma réservation » to `?paiement=annule&p=<id>`: the id is the buyer's own reference (the page re-reads it through the slug's pro, Task 28), never derived from the typed address.
- Until Task 30 the page `/{slug}/merci?p=` is the P3 stub « Merci ! »: the browser check only reads the URL.

- [ ] **Step 3: Create the pure helpers**

Create `src/lib/public/buy-and-book-form.ts` with exactly this content:

```ts
/**
 * Pure helpers of the buy + book block of the séance page (contract § 3.23 `OccurrenceBooking`, COV-M6, COV-M12):
 * the offer rows, the id of the seat the buyer holds (kept in the tab's sessionStorage so that a refused second
 * attempt can offer a way back to « Libérer ma place »), and the check of the URL the browser leaves for. Client-safe:
 * no server module. Nothing here identifies a customer: the held id is the buyer's own reference of THEIR purchase,
 * which the séance page re-reads through the slug's pro.
 */
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";

/** An offer of the séance as the form needs it (the page picks these fields). */
export type OfferChoice = {
  offerId: string;
  label: string;
  priceCents: number;
  validityText: string | null;
  covers: boolean;
};

export const BUY_TITLE = "Acheter et réserver";
export const OFFERS_LEGEND = "Choisissez une offre";
/** Why an offer cannot be picked: its validity ends before this séance. */
export const OFFER_TOO_SHORT = "Validité trop courte pour cette séance";

/** « {label} · {price} » plus « · valable {validityText} » when the offer has a validity (the price through formatMoney). */
export function offerOptionLabel(offer: OfferChoice, currency: string): string {
  const base = `${offer.label} · ${formatMoney(offer.priceCents, currency)}`;
  return offer.validityText ? `${base} · valable ${offer.validityText}` : base;
}

/** The id of the first offer that covers the séance, null when none does. */
export function firstCoveringOfferId(offers: readonly OfferChoice[]): string | null {
  return offers.find((o) => o.covers)?.offerId ?? null;
}

/** « Payer {price} » of the chosen offer. */
export function payLabel(offer: OfferChoice, currency: string): string {
  return `Payer ${formatMoney(offer.priceCents, currency)}`;
}

export const HOLD_KEY_PREFIX = "skedul:hold:";
/** What one of our purchase ids looks like (a nanoid): anything else read from a storage is ignored. */
export const HOLD_ID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/;

export function holdStorageKey(occurrenceId: string): string {
  return `${HOLD_KEY_PREFIX}${occurrenceId}`;
}

/** The session storage of the tab, null when the browser refuses it (private window, blocked data) or on the server. */
export function browserSessionStorage(): Storage | null {
  try {
    return typeof window === "undefined" ? null : window.sessionStorage;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Keeps the purchase id of a started payment for this séance; never throws, stores only a plausible id. */
export function storeHoldId(storage: Pick<Storage, "setItem"> | null, occurrenceId: string, purchaseId: string): void {
  if (storage === null || !HOLD_ID_RE.test(purchaseId)) return;
  try {
    storage.setItem(holdStorageKey(occurrenceId), purchaseId);
  } catch {
    // The storage is full or blocked: the return link is a convenience, the purchase itself is safe on the server.
  }
}

/** The purchase id kept for this séance, or null (absent, unreadable, or not shaped like one of our ids). */
export function readHoldId(storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem"> | null, occurrenceId: string): string | null {
  if (storage === null) return null;
  try {
    const value = storage.getItem(holdStorageKey(occurrenceId));
    return value !== null && HOLD_ID_RE.test(value) ? value : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** /{slug}/seance/{occurrenceId}?paiement=annule&p={holdId}: the return page of a payment the buyer left (COV-M6). */
export function returnHref(slug: string, occurrenceId: string, holdId: string): string {
  return `/${slug}/seance/${occurrenceId}?paiement=annule&p=${encodeURIComponent(holdId)}`;
}

/** The URL to leave for, or null: an https URL without credentials, or a same-origin http URL (the dev mock checkout). */
export function safeCheckoutUrl(url: string, origin: string): string | null {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url);
    if (parsed.username !== "" || parsed.password !== "") return null;
    if (parsed.protocol === "https:") return parsed.toString();
    if (parsed.protocol === "http:" && parsed.origin === origin) return parsed.toString();
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}
```
