```tsx
/** Buy + book (E1): choose an offer, give an identity, pay on the payment page; the seat is held while the buyer pays. */
function BuyForm({ p }: { p: OccurrenceBookingProps }) {
  const { visitor } = p;
  const uid = useId();
  const emailLocked = visitor.state === "verified" && visitor.email !== null;
  const [identity, setIdentity] = useState<IdentityInput>({ name: visitor.name ?? "", email: visitor.email ?? "", phone: "" });
  // A verified visitor's e-mail is the session's, whatever was typed before the session changed under this form.
  const effective: IdentityInput = emailLocked && visitor.email !== null ? { ...identity, email: visitor.email } : identity;
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState("");
  const [values, setValues] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [offerId, setOfferId] = useState<string | null>(() => firstCoveringOfferId(p.offers));
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [heldId, setHeldId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { root, errorBox, refused } = useRefusalFocus();

  // Back from the payment page through the history: the page comes back from the cache with the form still pending.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onShow = (event: PageTransitionEvent) => {
      if (event.persisted) setPending(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", onShow);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pageshow", onShow);
  }, []);

  const offer = p.offers.find((o) => o.offerId === offerId && o.covers) ?? p.offers.find((o) => o.covers) ?? null;

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (pending || offer === null) return;
    setError(null);
    setHeldId(null);
    const local = { ...identityErrors(effective), ...requiredAnswerErrors(p.questions, values) };
    if (Object.keys(local).length > 0) {
      setErrors(local);
      refused();
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    setPending(true);
    const answers = answersFromValues(p.questions, values);
    const res = await call(() =>
      startBuyAndBookAction({ slug: p.slug, occurrenceId: p.occurrenceId, offerId: offer.offerId, seenStartsAt: p.seenStartsAt, identity: identityToSend(effective), answers, website }),
    );
    if (res.ok) {
      const storage = browserSessionStorage();
      storeHoldId(storage, p.occurrenceId, res.purchaseId);
      const target = safeCheckoutUrl(res.checkoutUrl, window.location.origin);
      if (target !== null) {
        // The page leaves: the button keeps its « Redirection vers le paiement… » label until it is gone.
        window.location.assign(target);
        return;
      }
      setPending(false);
      setError(COPY.CHECKOUT_FAILED);
      setHeldId(readHoldId(storage, p.occurrenceId));
      refused();
      return;
    }
    setPending(false);
    setError(res.error);
    setErrors({ ...(res.fieldErrors ?? {}), ...answerErrorsById(answers, res.fieldErrors ?? {}) });
    setHeldId(readHoldId(browserSessionStorage(), p.occurrenceId));
    refused();
  }

  if (offer === null) return <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.NO_COVERING_OFFER}</p>;

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${uid}-buy`} className="space-y-4">
      <h4 id={`${uid}-buy`} className="text-base font-semibold">
        {BUY_TITLE}
      </h4>
      {p.testMode && <TestPaymentsBanner mode={p.testMode} />}
      <form ref={root} onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="space-y-4">
        <fieldset className="space-y-2">
          <legend className="text-sm font-medium">{OFFERS_LEGEND}</legend>
          {p.offers.map((o) => {
            const id = `${uid}-offer-${o.offerId}`;
            const shortId = `${id}-short`;
            return (
              <div key={o.offerId}>
                <label
                  htmlFor={id}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-3 text-sm",
                    o.covers ? "cursor-pointer has-checked:border-ring has-checked:bg-accent" : "cursor-not-allowed opacity-60",
                  )}
                >
                  <input
                    id={id}
                    type="radio"
                    name={`${uid}-offer`}
                    value={o.offerId}
                    checked={offer.offerId === o.offerId}
                    disabled={!o.covers}
                    aria-describedby={o.covers ? undefined : shortId}
                    onChange={() => setOfferId(o.offerId)}
                    className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 accent-primary"
                  />
                  <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{offerOptionLabel(o, p.currency)}</span>
                </label>
                {!o.covers && (
                  <p id={shortId} className="mt-1 pl-3 text-xs text-zinc-600">
                    {OFFER_TOO_SHORT}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </fieldset>
        <IdentityFields
          idPrefix={uid}
          value={effective}
          onChange={setIdentity}
          emailLocked={emailLocked}
          errors={errors}
          businessName={p.businessName}
          website={website}
          onWebsite={setWebsite}
        />
        <QuestionFields idPrefix={uid} questions={p.questions} value={values} onChange={setValues} errors={errors} />
        <Feedback status={null} statusBox={null} error={error} errorBox={errorBox} />
        {heldId !== null && (
          <p className="text-sm">
            <Link href={returnHref(p.slug, p.occurrenceId, heldId)} className={INLINE_LINK_CLASS}>
              {COPY.RETURN_LINK}
            </Link>
          </p>
        )}
        <Button type="submit" disabled={pending} className="w-full sm:w-auto">
          {pending && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
          {pending ? COPY.PENDING_PAY : payLabel(offer, p.currency)}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** S36 (browser part): strangers typing an address cannot lock out its verified holder, proven by Step 9.8 (a hold started anonymously with `beatriz@example.com` is listed for Beatriz once signed in, and she releases it). The DB half of S36 and the reference rules S32 and S35 belong to Task 24; this task pins the wiring (Step 1) and re-proves S32 and S35 in the browser (Steps 9.7 and 9.9: a tampered or foreign `p` shows nothing, a personal-link cookie never gets the Checkout block).

Design notes (read before coding):
- Load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing the JSX (project rule). Everything sits inside `PublicShell` and keeps the card system: `Card`, `Badge`, `Button`, `INLINE_LINK_CLASS` only for a link inside a sentence, no `text-primary` (brand text is `text-accent-foreground`), user-supplied text with `wrap-anywhere`.
- A `?p=` reference shows THAT purchase and its own booking and never its customer (Decision 71, SEC-C1). The page reads it only on `?paiement=annule`, through `getPurchaseReference(pro.professionalId, …)` (the slug's pro) and `referenceForPage` (an Owner and a reference of another customer: null). It never reads `ref.customerId`, never passes an id of a customer to a component, and `CheckoutReturn` gets only the purchase id the reference itself carries. A guest cookie never receives a Checkout URL or a purchase id (Decision 63): `seanceVisitorFacts` fills the status only for it, and the page builds the block from the reference or from the Owner's own pending booking, never from a guest fact.
- The Owner's own pending booking: `facts.booking` carries her `purchaseId` and `resumeUrl`, but not the hold end nor whether the payment is processing. The page therefore reads her own purchase once more through `getPurchaseReference` + `referenceForPage(…, owner)` (the id comes from her own booking, never from the URL), which gives the hold end and the `processing` flag. One shape (`ReferenceView`) then feeds `CheckoutReturn` for both paths.
- A pending reference whose hold has ended (`holdExpiresAt <= now`) and that is not processing is shown as `expired`: the seat counts as free (`hold_expires_at < now`, Decision 31) even if the nightly sweep has not run yet, so the block never promises a seat that is gone.
- Focus (WCAG 2.4.3): a successful release removes the buttons that held the focus. `ConfirmDialog` gets `returnFocusTo` and the component points it at the block heading (`tabIndex={-1}`) on success and at the button that opened the dialog on a cancel (`opener` ref, written in event handlers only). `PendingHolds` is rendered by the page for every Owner, even with no hold, so that its state (the « Votre place est libérée. » line, its heading) survives the revalidation that follows the action; the component itself renders nothing while it has no hold and no line to show. Known corner: an Owner who releases her OWN pending booking from the block of this same séance sees the block unmount when the page revalidates (the booking is gone), so the dialog's focus restore finds no heading; the focus then rests on the document and the line `COPY.ENDED_EXPIRED` appears above the form. The reference path and `PendingHolds` keep their heading; the corner is listed in the Task 31 outcome.
- No `router.refresh()` after the action (the action's own `revalidatePath` refreshes the page, § 1). The failure of a release is shown by the `ConfirmDialog` (`error`), the dialog staying open; the outcome lines live in an always-mounted `role="status"` region.
- Task 26 created `src/app/[slug]/seance/[occurrenceId]/page.tsx` and wrote in its notes that this task rewrites it whole; Task 27 changed four lines of it (the `paymentMode` import, `payment` and `testMode`, `offers`, `testMode`). Step 6 replaces the file by its final content: everything Tasks 26 and 27 own is reproduced unchanged (the `loadSeance` cache, the metadata, `Notice`, the header, the compact wallet, the `OccurrenceBooking` call), so their guards in `page-wiring.test.ts` stay green; the additions of this task are the `reference` / `refView` / `returnView` / `checkout` / `holdRows` reads, the reference-aware viewer, `booked` and `ended`, and the `CheckoutReturn` and `PendingHolds` blocks. If your file differs from this one in a cosmetic detail (a helper name, the order of two reads), keep this version; if it holds a behaviour that this one lacks, carry it over and report it.

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `src/components/public/checkout-return.tsx`**

```tsx
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useCallback, useId, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import type { ConfirmCopy } from "@/lib/back-office/confirm-copy";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import type { AbandonOutcome } from "@/lib/public/release-actions";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { abandonCheckoutAction } from "@/server/public";

/** The confirmation of « Libérer ma place » (spec L1166-1168, Decision 50): it says what the gesture costs. Shared with PendingHolds. */
export const RELEASE_CONFIRM: ConfirmCopy = {
  title: "Libérer votre place ?",
  body: "La place est rendue aux autres clients et le paiement en cours est annulé.",
  confirm: "Libérer ma place",
};

const RELEASED_TEXT = "Votre place est libérée.";
const ENDED_TEXT = "Cette réservation n'est plus en attente de paiement.";

/** The line a release outcome leaves on the page (the action never fulfils: « Paiement reçu » only points to merci, Decision 33). */
export function releaseOutcomeText(outcome: AbandonOutcome): string {
  switch (outcome) {
    case "released":
      return RELEASED_TEXT;
    case "paid":
      return COPY.PAYMENT_RECEIVED;
    case "processing":
      return COPY.PROCESSING;
    case "already_ended":
      return ENDED_TEXT;
  }
}

type View = "pending" | "paid" | "processing" | "expired" | "released" | "ended";

/** What the block says now: the outcome of a release made here wins over the props, which the revalidation then catches up with. */
function viewOf(a: { status: "pending" | "paid" | "expired"; processing: boolean; outcome: AbandonOutcome | null }): View {
  if (a.outcome === "released") return "released";
  if (a.outcome === "already_ended") return "ended";
  if (a.outcome === "paid" || a.status === "paid") return "paid";
  if (a.outcome === "processing") return "processing";
  if (a.status === "expired") return "expired";
  return a.processing ? "processing" : "pending";
}

/** The sentence under the heading (null: nothing to say, e.g. a pending hold whose end the page could not read). */
function textOf(a: { view: View; kind: "buybook" | "shop"; resumeUrl: string | null; holdUntilLabel: string | null }): string | null {
  switch (a.view) {
    case "paid":
      return COPY.PAYMENT_RECEIVED;
    case "processing":
      return COPY.PROCESSING;
    case "released":
      return RELEASED_TEXT;
    case "ended":
      return ENDED_TEXT;
    case "expired":
      return a.kind === "buybook" ? "Votre place a été libérée. Vous pouvez réserver à nouveau." : "Ce paiement n'a pas abouti.";
    case "pending":
      if (a.kind === "shop") return "Votre achat n'est pas payé.";
      if (a.resumeUrl === null) return "La page de paiement a expiré. Vous pouvez libérer votre place maintenant.";
      return a.holdUntilLabel === null ? null : `Votre place est gardée jusqu'à ${a.holdUntilLabel}.`;
  }
}

/**
 * The return from a Checkout page (spec L1099-1104, L1163-1168, Decisions 13, 31, 32, 33): shown for the `?p=` reference's
 * own purchase or the Owner's own pending booking, never for a guest cookie nor any other purchase id (Decisions 63, 71).
 * « Reprendre le paiement » only while the Checkout session is open (`resumeUrl`); « Libérer ma place » (buy + book only)
 * asks first, then lets the server decide: it never releases a paid, processing or unverifiable purchase.
 */
export function CheckoutReturn({
  slug,
  purchaseId,
  kind,
  status,
  processing,
  resumeUrl,
  holdUntilLabel,
  merciHref,
}: {
  slug: string;
  purchaseId: string;
  kind: "buybook" | "shop";
  status: "pending" | "paid" | "expired";
  processing: boolean;
  resumeUrl: string | null;
  holdUntilLabel: string | null;
  merciHref: string;
}) {
  const headingId = useId();
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  /** Where the dialog gives the focus back: the button that opened it, then the heading once a release removed the buttons. */
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const returnFocus = useCallback(() => opener.current, []);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = useState<AbandonOutcome | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const view = viewOf({ status, processing, outcome });
  const text = textOf({ view, kind, resumeUrl, holdUntilLabel });
  const canRelease = kind === "buybook";

  function ask(e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) {
    opener.current = e.currentTarget;
    setError(null);
    setOpen(true);
  }

  function close() {
    if (pending) return;
    setOpen(false);
    setError(null);
  }

  function release() {
    if (pending) return;
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await abandonCheckoutAction({ slug, purchaseId });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        // The buttons are gone with an outcome: the focus goes to the block heading, not to <body> (WCAG 2.4.3).
        opener.current = heading.current;
        setOutcome(res.outcome);
        setOpen(false);
      } catch {
        setError(PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED);
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="p-5">
      <section aria-labelledby={headingId} className="space-y-3">
        <h2
          id={headingId}
          ref={heading}
          tabIndex={-1}
          className="rounded text-lg font-semibold focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
        >
          Paiement interrompu
        </h2>
        {/* Always mounted, so that a screen reader announces the outcome when it appears. */}
        <div role="status" className="space-y-1 text-sm">
          {text !== null && <p>{text}</p>}
        </div>
        {view === "paid" && (
          <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
            <Link href={merciHref}>Voir la confirmation</Link>
          </Button>
        )}
        {view === "pending" && (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
            {resumeUrl !== null && (
              <Button asChild className="w-full sm:w-auto">
                <a href={resumeUrl}>Reprendre le paiement</a>
              </Button>
            )}
            {canRelease && (
              <Button type="button" variant="secondary" className="w-full sm:w-auto" onClick={ask} disabled={pending}>
                Libérer ma place
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        <ConfirmDialog
          open={open}
          copy={RELEASE_CONFIRM}
          pending={pending}
          error={error}
          onConfirm={release}
          onClose={close}
          returnFocusTo={returnFocus}
        />
      </section>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useCallback, useId, useRef, useState, useTransition } from "react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "@/components/dashboard/confirm-dialog";
import { RELEASE_CONFIRM, releaseOutcomeText } from "@/components/public/checkout-return";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { abandonCheckoutAction } from "@/server/public";

type PendingHold = { purchaseId: string; title: string; whenLabel: string; holdUntilLabel: string };

/**
 * « Paiements en attente » (SEC-I6, Decision 67): the live holds of the signed-in Owner at this pro. A stranger can start
 * a buy + book with her address, which parks a seat on her customer row for 45 minutes; here she sees it and releases it.
 * The page renders this for every Owner, even with no hold, so that the line left by a release survives the revalidation
 * that follows the action; the component renders nothing while it has no hold and no line to show.
 */
export function PendingHolds({ slug, holds }: { slug: string; holds: PendingHold[] }) {
  const headingId = useId();
  const heading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  /** Where the dialog gives the focus back: the row button that opened it, then the heading once the row is gone. */
  const opener = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const returnFocus = useCallback(() => opener.current, []);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<PendingHold | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  /** Purchases released from this page, hidden at once while the revalidated list catches up. */
  const [gone, setGone] = useState<readonly string[]>([]);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const rows = holds.filter((h) => !gone.includes(h.purchaseId));
  if (rows.length === 0 && notice === "") return null;

  function ask(hold: PendingHold, button: HTMLButtonElement) {
    opener.current = button;
    setError(null);
    setTarget(hold);
  }

  function close() {
    if (pending) return;
    setTarget(null);
    setError(null);
  }

  function release() {
    if (target === null || pending) return;
    const hold = target;
    setError(null);
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await abandonCheckoutAction({ slug, purchaseId: hold.purchaseId });
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError(res.error);
          return;
        }
        // The row goes with its button: the focus is handed to the section heading (WCAG 2.4.3).
        opener.current = heading.current;
        setNotice(releaseOutcomeText(res.outcome));
        if (res.outcome !== "processing") setGone((ids) => [...ids, hold.purchaseId]);
        setTarget(null);
      } catch {
        setError(PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED);
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <Card className="p-5">
      <section aria-labelledby={headingId} className="space-y-3">
        <h2
          id={headingId}
          ref={heading}
          tabIndex={-1}
          className="rounded text-lg font-semibold focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
        >
          {COPY.PENDING_HOLDS_TITLE}
        </h2>
        {/* Always mounted, so that a screen reader announces the line when it appears. */}
        <p role="status" className={notice ? "text-sm" : "sr-only"}>
          {notice}
        </p>
        {rows.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="divide-y divide-border">
            {rows.map((h) => (
              <li key={h.purchaseId} className="flex flex-col gap-2 py-3 first:pt-0 last:pb-0 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="font-medium wrap-anywhere">{`${h.title} · ${h.whenLabel}`}</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{`Place gardée jusqu'à ${h.holdUntilLabel}.`}</p>
                </div>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="secondary"
                  size="sm"
                  className="w-full sm:w-auto"
                  disabled={pending}
                  aria-label={`Libérer ma place pour ${h.title}, ${h.whenLabel}`}
                  onClick={(e) => ask(h, e.currentTarget)}
                >
                  Libérer ma place
                </Button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        <ConfirmDialog
          open={target !== null}
          copy={RELEASE_CONFIRM}
          pending={pending}
          error={error}
          onConfirm={release}
          onClose={close}
          returnFocusTo={returnFocus}
        />
      </section>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

Replace the whole content of `src/app/[slug]/seance/[occurrenceId]/page.tsx` (Write) with the file below. It is Task 26's file with Task 27's four edits applied, plus the additions of this task: the `searchParams` type and the `one` helper, the `reference` / `refView` / `returnView` reads, the reference-aware `seanceViewerOf`, `booked` and `ended` from the reference, `checkout` and `holdRows`, and the `CheckoutReturn` and `PendingHolds` blocks.

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { cache, type ComponentProps } from "react";
import { MapPin } from "lucide-react";

import { VerifyEmailBanner } from "@/components/dashboard/verify-email-banner";
import { CheckoutReturn } from "@/components/public/checkout-return";
import { OccurrenceBooking } from "@/components/public/occurrence-booking";
import { OwnerPreviewBanner } from "@/components/public/owner-preview-banner";
import { PendingHolds } from "@/components/public/pending-holds";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { WalletPanel } from "@/components/public/wallet-panel";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { formatWhen, formatWhenShort } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { formatTime } from "@/lib/datetime";
import { env } from "@/lib/env";
import { COPY, seatsLeftLabel } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { seanceState, stateLabel } from "@/lib/public/planning-view";
import { BOOKED_CONFIRMED, BOOKED_PENDING, SEE_MY_SPACE, stateLine } from "@/lib/public/seance-copy";
import { canSeePrivateSeance, referenceForPage, seancePageMode, seanceViewerOf, type PageBooking } from "@/lib/public/visibility";
import { paymentMode } from "@/lib/stripe";
import { getCustomerSpacePage } from "@/server/client-queries";
import { resolvePublicPro } from "@/server/public-context";
import { getLivePendingHolds, getPurchaseReference, getSeancePage, getSeanceVisitorFacts } from "@/server/public-queries";
import { currentPublicVisitor } from "@/server/visitor";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string; occurrenceId: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ paiement?: string | string[]; p?: string | string[] }>;
};

/** A query value that is one string, else undefined. */
const one = (value: string | string[] | undefined): string | undefined => (typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined);

/** One read of the pro and of the séance per request, shared by generateMetadata and the page. */
const loadSeance = cache(async (slug: string, occurrenceId: string) => {
  const resolved = await resolvePublicPro(slug);
  if (!resolved) return null;
  const detail = await getSeancePage(resolved.pro, occurrenceId);
  return { ...resolved, detail };
});

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug, occurrenceId } = await params;
  const loaded = await loadSeance(slug, occurrenceId);
  if (!loaded) return { title: "Page introuvable", referrer: "no-referrer", robots: { index: false } };
  const { pro, detail } = loaded;
  // The metadata never depends on the viewer: a private, archived, RDV, unknown or foreign séance carries the business name only.
  if (!detail || detail.kind === "rdv" || detail.isPrivate || detail.archived) {
    return { title: pro.businessName, referrer: "no-referrer", robots: { index: false } };
  }
  return { title: `${detail.title} · ${pro.businessName}`, referrer: "no-referrer" };
}

/** A sentence above the booking form (a guest cookie's booking, an ended booking). */
function Notice({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <p className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted px-4 py-3 text-sm text-zinc-700">{children}</p>;
}

/**
 * One séance of a pro (spec § 13.2, contract § 3.21 and § 5). Precedence (Decision 9): unknown or another pro's ->
 * 404; RDV -> the espace; private and not visible to this viewer -> 404; then the state, the booked block or the
 * booking form of the mode. Dynamic: it reads the fresh session, the personal-link cookie and the `?p=` reference.
 * Nothing is written.
 */
export default async function SeancePage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { slug, occurrenceId } = await params;
  const query = await searchParams;
  const loaded = await loadSeance(slug, occurrenceId);
  if (!loaded) notFound();
  const { pro, branding, detail } = loaded;
  if (!detail) notFound();
  if (detail.kind === "rdv") redirect(`/${pro.slug}/espace`);

  const now = new Date();
  const visitor = await currentPublicVisitor(pro.professionalId, pro.ownerUserId);
  const owner = visitor.owner;
  const seancePage = { kind: "seance", occurrenceId: detail.occurrenceId } as const;

  // The `?p=` reference describes THAT purchase and its own booking, never its customer (Decision 71). It is read only on
  // the cancel URL of a Checkout, through the slug's pro, and an Owner ignores a reference of another customer (OUT:74).
  const referenceId = one(query.paiement) === "annule" ? one(query.p) : undefined;
  const reference = referenceId ? await getPurchaseReference(pro.professionalId, referenceId) : null;
  const refView = referenceForPage(reference, seancePage, owner);

  const viewer = seanceViewerOf({ visitor, reference: refView });
  const customerViewer = viewer?.kind === "customer" ? viewer : null;
  const [facts, space, liveHolds] = await Promise.all([
    customerViewer ? getSeanceVisitorFacts(pro.professionalId, detail.occurrenceId, customerViewer) : Promise.resolve(null),
    owner ? getCustomerSpacePage(pro.professionalId, owner.customerId) : Promise.resolve(null),
    // SEC-I6: the live holds of the Owner at this pro (strangers typing her address park seats on her row).
    owner ? getLivePendingHolds(pro.professionalId, owner.customerId) : Promise.resolve([]),
  ]);

  if (detail.isPrivate && !canSeePrivateSeance({ isPageOwner: visitor.isPageOwner, viewer, customerHasActiveBooking: facts?.booking != null })) notFound();

  const state = seanceState(detail, now, pro.timezone);
  // Only the Owner's facts carry a purchase, a Checkout URL, a wallet or an ended state; a guest cookie's booking never
  // becomes « booked » and never hides the form (Decision 63).
  const ownerFacts = customerViewer?.source === "owner" ? facts : null;
  const usable = ownerFacts?.usable ?? null;
  const guestBooked = customerViewer?.source === "guest" && facts?.booking != null;

  // The purchase the payment block describes: the reference of the URL, else the Owner's own pending purchase (its id
  // comes from her own booking, never from the URL).
  const ownerPurchaseId = ownerFacts?.booking?.status === "pending" ? ownerFacts.booking.purchaseId : null;
  const returnView =
    refView ??
    (ownerPurchaseId !== null
      ? referenceForPage(await getPurchaseReference(pro.professionalId, ownerPurchaseId), seancePage, owner)
      : null);

  const holdLive = (iso: string | null): boolean => iso !== null && new Date(iso).getTime() > now.getTime();
  let booked: PageBooking = null;
  if (ownerFacts?.booking) booked = { status: ownerFacts.booking.status, via: "owner" };
  else if (refView?.booking) {
    if (refView.booking.status === "confirmed") booked = { status: "confirmed", via: "reference" };
    else if (refView.booking.status === "pending" && refView.status === "pending" && holdLive(refView.holdExpiresAt)) {
      booked = { status: "pending", via: "reference" };
    }
  }
  const refEnded: "cancelled" | "expired" | null =
    refView?.booking == null
      ? null
      : refView.booking.status === "cancelled"
        ? "cancelled"
        : refView.booking.status === "expired" ||
            (refView.booking.status === "pending" && !refView.processing && !holdLive(refView.holdExpiresAt))
          ? "expired"
          : null;
  const ended = booked === null ? (ownerFacts?.ended ?? refEnded) : null;

  let checkout: ComponentProps<typeof CheckoutReturn> | null = null;
  if (returnView !== null) {
    const holdEnd = returnView.holdExpiresAt === null ? null : new Date(returnView.holdExpiresAt);
    const live = holdLive(returnView.holdExpiresAt);
    // A pending purchase whose hold has ended frees its seat (Decision 31) even before the nightly sweep: say so.
    const lapsed = returnView.status === "pending" && !returnView.processing && returnView.booking !== null && !live;
    const status = lapsed ? "expired" : returnView.status;
    checkout = {
      slug: pro.slug,
      purchaseId: returnView.purchaseId,
      kind: returnView.kind,
      status,
      processing: returnView.processing,
      resumeUrl: status === "pending" ? returnView.resumeUrl : null,
      holdUntilLabel: status === "pending" && live && holdEnd !== null ? formatTime(holdEnd, pro.timezone) : null,
      merciHref: `/${pro.slug}/merci?p=${encodeURIComponent(returnView.purchaseId)}`,
    };
  }
  // The purchase the payment block already shows is not listed twice.
  const holdRows = liveHolds
    .filter((h) => h.purchaseId !== returnView?.purchaseId)
    .map((h) => ({
      purchaseId: h.purchaseId,
      title: h.title,
      whenLabel: formatWhenShort(h.startsAt, pro.timezone, now),
      holdUntilLabel: formatTime(h.holdExpiresAt, pro.timezone),
    }));

  const mode = seancePageMode({
    state,
    archived: detail.archived,
    isPrivate: detail.isPrivate,
    booked,
    mode: detail.bookingMode,
    canSpend: usable !== null,
    coveringOffers: detail.offers.filter((o) => o.covers).length,
  });

  const label = stateLabel(state);
  const when = formatWhen(detail.startsAt, detail.endsAt, pro.timezone);
  const showSeats = state.kind === "open" || state.kind === "free";
  const payment = paymentMode();
  const testMode = payment === "live" ? null : payment;

  return (
    <PublicShell branding={branding} backHref={`/${pro.slug}`}>
      {visitor.isPageOwner && <OwnerPreviewBanner />}
      {visitor.state === "unverified" && visitor.email && <VerifyEmailBanner email={visitor.email} verified={false} />}

      <section aria-labelledby="seance-title" className="mb-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* id = SEANCE_HEADING_ID: the booking form gives it the focus after a success that books the visitor. */}
          <h2
            id="seance-title"
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="min-w-0 rounded text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight wrap-anywhere focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            {detail.title}
          </h2>
          {label && <Badge variant={state.kind === "cancelled" ? "destructive" : state.kind === "free" ? "default" : "neutral"}>{label}</Badge>}
        </div>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">{when}</p>
        {detail.location && (
          <p className="mt-1 flex items-start gap-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-600">
            <MapPin className="mt-0.5 size-3.5 shrink-0" aria-hidden />
            <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{detail.location}</span>
          </p>
        )}
        {showSeats && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600">{seatsLeftLabel(detail.seatsLeft)}</p>}
        {detail.acceptedTypes.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2" aria-label="Types de ticket acceptés">
            {detail.acceptedTypes.map((t) => (
              <li
                key={t.id}
                className="inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-card px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium"
              >
                <span aria-hidden className="size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: t.color }} />
                <span className="min-w-0 wrap-anywhere">{t.name}</span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {detail.description && (
          <p className="mt-4 text-sm whitespace-pre-line text-zinc-700 wrap-anywhere">{detail.description}</p>
        )}
      </section>

      {space && space.wallet.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-6">
          <WalletPanel slug={pro.slug} businessName={pro.businessName} wallet={space.wallet} variant="compact" />
        </div>
      )}

      {checkout && (
        <div className="mb-6">
          <CheckoutReturn key={checkout.purchaseId} {...checkout} />
        </div>
      )}
      {visitor.owner && (
        <div className="mb-6 empty:hidden">
          <PendingHolds slug={pro.slug} holds={holdRows} />
        </div>
      )}

      {mode.kind === "booked" ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 py-6">
            <p className="font-medium">{mode.status === "confirmed" ? BOOKED_CONFIRMED : BOOKED_PENDING}</p>
            {mode.status === "confirmed" && (
              <Button asChild variant="secondary" size="sm">
                <Link href={`/${pro.slug}/espace`}>{SEE_MY_SPACE}</Link>
              </Button>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : mode.kind === "state" ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="py-6">
            <p className="text-sm">{stateLine(mode.state.kind)}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          {guestBooked && <Notice>{COPY.GUEST_BOOKING_EXISTS}</Notice>}
          {checkout === null && ended === "cancelled" && <Notice>{COPY.ENDED_CANCELLED}</Notice>}
          {checkout === null && ended === "expired" && <Notice>{COPY.ENDED_EXPIRED}</Notice>}
          <OccurrenceBooking
            key={`${visitor.state}:${usable !== null ? "spend" : "buy"}`}
            slug={pro.slug}
            occurrenceId={detail.occurrenceId}
            seenStartsAt={detail.startsAt.toISOString()}
            businessName={pro.businessName}
            currency={pro.currency}
            mode={mode.kind}
            questions={detail.questions.map((q) => ({
              id: q.id,
              label: q.label,
              type: q.type,
              options: q.options,
              required: q.required,
            }))}
            offers={detail.offers.map((o) => ({
              offerId: o.offerId,
              label: o.label,
              priceCents: o.priceCents,
              validityText: o.validityText,
              covers: o.covers,
            }))}
            visitor={{
              state: visitor.state,
              email: visitor.state === "verified" ? visitor.email : null,
              name: visitor.state === "verified" ? visitor.name : null,
              canSpend: usable !== null,
              leftAfter: usable?.leftAfter ?? 0,
              typeName: usable?.typeName ?? null,
            }}
            googleEnabled={env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ENABLED}
            returnTo={`/${pro.slug}/seance/${detail.occurrenceId}`}
            testMode={testMode}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </PublicShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/public/offer-checkout-form.tsx (client)
export function OfferCheckoutForm(props: {
  slug: string; offerId: string; businessName: string; priceLabel: string;
  visitor: { state: VisitorState; email: string | null; name: string | null };
  testMode: "mock" | "test" | null;
}): React.JSX.Element;
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** none. The identity, throttle and honeypot rules of the shop action are Task 11's (S6, S19, S20, S34, S43, S44); the reference rules (S7, S32) are Tasks 12 and 24's. This task pins the wiring of the page and of the form (Step 1) and re-proves in the browser that a reference of another offer shows nothing (Step 9.5).

Design notes (read before coding):
- Load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing the JSX (project rule). Everything sits inside `PublicShell` and keeps the card system; the type's colour is a dot (never text colour), user-supplied text (offer label, type name and description, business name) gets `wrap-anywhere`, money goes through `formatMoney(cents, currency)`.
- Every purchase starts from a page with its own URL (Decision 11): the Boutique links here, the identity form lives here (the buy + book form lives on the séance page). An offer that is inactive, archived, of an archived type or of an `rdv_free` type reads `unavailable`: « Cette offre n'est plus proposée » and « Voir la boutique » (spec L1458-1459); another pro's or an unknown id is a 404.
- The cancel URL of a shop Checkout is `/{slug}/offre/{offerId}?paiement=annule&p={purchaseId}` (Decision 13). The page reads that reference only on `?paiement=annule`, only through the slug's pro, and shows it only when it is a shop purchase of THIS offer (`referenceForPage`); it never reads the customer of a purchase. No seat is held for a shop purchase, so the block offers « Reprendre le paiement » only (the nightly job expires an unpaid purchase), never « Libérer ma place » (`CheckoutReturn` with `kind: "shop"`).
- An e-mail typed into the form never prefills from a cookie and is locked only for a VERIFIED session (the page passes the session e-mail for `verified` only); the Owner's session e-mail replaces the typed one server-side anyway (`identityOf`). The form sends `{ slug, offerId, identity, website }` and nothing else: no price, no customer, no user id.
- After a success the browser leaves for the Checkout URL with `window.location.assign` (an external URL, or `/api/mock-checkout?purchase=…` in mock mode); there is no `router.refresh()` and no `router.push`. The submit stays disabled through the navigation (`redirecting`); a page restored from the back/forward cache (`pageshow` with `persisted`, the browser Back button from the Checkout page) leaves that state, else the button would stay disabled for good (the same rule as Task 27's buy form).
- The form checks the identity itself first (`identityErrors`, the server's own rules) and sends `identityToSend(identity)`, as Tasks 26 and 27 do: an empty or malformed field is said at once under that field. A server failure goes to an always-mounted `role="alert"` line unless the refusal belongs to an identity field, whose own line `IdentityFields` shows. After any refusal `useRefusalFocus` moves the focus to the first invalid field, else to the alert line (the submit was disabled while the call ran, which dropped the focus).
- The mock and Stripe test banner « Paiements en mode test » sits above the identity fields whenever `paymentMode()` is not `live` (Decision 15).

```ts
/**
 * Wiring guard for src/components/public/offer-checkout-form.tsx (P4 Task 29). The form is a client component that imports
 * a Server Action (which imports server-only modules), and the node:test runner cannot load those, so the rules it must
 * keep are pinned on its source: what the action accepts has its own DB tests (shop-actions.db.test.ts). Run from the
 * repository root.
 */
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import test from "node:test";

const SOURCE = readFileSync("src/components/public/offer-checkout-form.tsx", "utf8");

const DASH = new RegExp("[" + String.fromCharCode(0x2013, 0x2014) + "]");

test("the form posts the slug, the offer id, the typed identity and the honeypot, and nothing else", () => {
  assert.match(SOURCE, /^"use client";/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /startShopPurchaseAction\(\{ slug, offerId, identity: identityToSend\(identity\), website \}\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(SOURCE, /customerId|ownerUserId|userId|priceCents|amountCents/, "no identity, no price from the browser");
  assert.doesNotMatch(SOURCE, /^import (?!type)[^;]*(?:-actions|-reads)";/m, "no core and no read is imported at run time");
});

test("an identity the server would refuse is said under its field before any call", () => {
  const check = SOURCE.indexOf("const local = identityErrors(identity);");
  assert.notEqual(check, -1);
  assert.ok(check < SOURCE.indexOf("startShopPurchaseAction({"), "the local check comes first");
  assert.match(SOURCE, /if \(Object\.keys\(local\)\.length > 0\) \{\s*refused\(\);\s*return;\s*\}/);
});

test("a success leaves for the Checkout URL with a full navigation and keeps the button disabled", () => {
  assert.match(SOURCE, /setRedirecting\(true\);\s*window\.location\.assign\(res\.checkoutUrl\);/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(SOURCE, /useRouter|router\.(refresh|push|replace)/, "navigation after a Server Action is window.location.assign alone");
  assert.match(SOURCE, /const busy = pending \|\| redirecting;/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /disabled=\{busy\}/);
});

test("a page restored from the back/forward cache leaves the redirecting state", () => {
  assert.match(SOURCE, /window\.addEventListener\("pageshow", onShow\)/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /if \(event\.persisted\) setRedirecting\(false\);/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /window\.removeEventListener\("pageshow", onShow\)/);
});

test("the submit shows the price, then the pending label", () => {
  assert.match(SOURCE, /\{busy \? COPY\.PENDING_PAY : `Payer \$\{priceLabel\}`\}/);
});

test("only a verified session locks the e-mail field and only the session e-mail fills it", () => {
  assert.match(SOURCE, /const emailLocked = visitor\.state === "verified" && visitor\.email !== null;/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /email: emailLocked \? \(visitor\.email \?\? ""\) : ""/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /emailLocked=\{emailLocked\}/);
});

test("the test-payments banner shows above the fields whenever a test mode runs, and the form lets the server speak French", () => {
  assert.match(SOURCE, /\{testMode && <TestPaymentsBanner mode=\{testMode\} \/>\}/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /<form ref=\{root\} onSubmit=\{onSubmit\} noValidate /);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /<IdentityFields[\s\S]*?website=\{website\}[\s\S]*?onWebsite=\{setWebsite\}/);
});

test("a failure goes to an always-mounted alert line, unless an identity field owns the refusal, and the focus follows", () => {
  assert.match(SOURCE, /const \{ root, errorBox, refused \} = useRefusalFocus\(\);/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /<p role="alert" ref=\{errorBox\} tabIndex=\{-1\} className=\{formError \? ERROR_CLASS : "sr-only"\}>/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /Object\.keys\(fields\)\.some\(\(key\) => key\.startsWith\("identity\."\)\)/);
  assert.match(SOURCE, /setFormError\(PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED\);\s*refused\(\);/);
  assert.equal(SOURCE.split("refused();").length - 1, 3, "the local check, a server refusal and a failed call");
});

test("no dash, no brand-coloured text and no address in the logs", () => {
  assert.doesNotMatch(SOURCE, DASH);
  assert.doesNotMatch(SOURCE, /text-primary([^-a-zA-Z]|$)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(SOURCE, /console\./);
});
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { useRefusalFocus } from "@/components/dashboard/use-refusal-focus";
import { IdentityFields } from "@/components/public/identity-fields";
import { TestPaymentsBanner } from "@/components/public/test-payments-banner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { IdentityInput } from "@/lib/public/booking-actions";
import type { VisitorState } from "@/lib/public/identity";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { identityErrors, identityToSend } from "@/lib/public/occurrence-form";
import { PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED } from "@/lib/public/result";
import { startShopPurchaseAction } from "@/server/public";

const ERROR_CLASS =
  "rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-rose-700 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring";

/**
 * The identity form of a shop purchase (E9, spec L1099-1104, contract § 3.23): « Prénom et nom », « Email », « Téléphone »,
 * then « Payer {prix} ». It posts the slug, the offer id, the typed identity and the honeypot, and leaves for the Checkout
 * URL the server answers with. The e-mail is read-only for a VERIFIED session only (the session address, never a cookie's);
 * everybody else types an address, which identifies a client row and authorises nothing (Decision 38).
 */
export function OfferCheckoutForm({
  slug,
  offerId,
  businessName,
  priceLabel,
  visitor,
  testMode,
}: {
  slug: string;
  offerId: string;
  businessName: string;
  priceLabel: string;
  visitor: { state: VisitorState; email: string | null; name: string | null };
  testMode: "mock" | "test" | null;
}) {
  const emailLocked = visitor.state === "verified" && visitor.email !== null;
  const [identity, setIdentity] = useState<IdentityInput>({
    name: visitor.name ?? "",
    email: emailLocked ? (visitor.email ?? "") : "",
    phone: "",
  });
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState("");
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  /** The navigation to the Checkout page has started: the button stays disabled until the page unloads. */
  const [redirecting, setRedirecting] = useState(false);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  /** After a refusal: the focus goes to the first invalid field, else to the alert line (WCAG 3.3.1). */
  const { root, errorBox, refused } = useRefusalFocus();
  const busy = pending || redirecting;

  // Back from the Checkout page, the browser may restore this page from its back/forward cache with the button still
  // « Redirection vers le paiement… » and disabled: a restored page leaves that state.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onShow = (event: PageTransitionEvent) => {
      if (event.persisted) setRedirecting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener("pageshow", onShow);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pageshow", onShow);
  }, []);

  function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    setFormError(null);
    // What the server's parse would refuse is said at once, under its field, without a call.
    const local = identityErrors(identity);
    setErrors(local);
    if (Object.keys(local).length > 0) {
      refused();
      return;
    }
    startTransition(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await startShopPurchaseAction({ slug, offerId, identity: identityToSend(identity), website });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const fields = res.fieldErrors ?? {};
          setErrors(fields);
          // A refusal that belongs to an identity field is shown under that field; any other one is the form's own line.
          if (!Object.keys(fields).some((key) => key.startsWith("identity."))) setFormError(res.error);
          refused();
          return;
        }
        setRedirecting(true);
        window.location.assign(res.checkoutUrl);
      } catch {
        setFormError(PUBLIC_UNEXPECTED);
        refused();
      }
    });
  }

  return (
    <form ref={root} onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="space-y-5">
      {testMode && <TestPaymentsBanner mode={testMode} />}
      <IdentityFields
        idPrefix="offer"
        value={identity}
        onChange={setIdentity}
        emailLocked={emailLocked}
        errors={errors}
        businessName={businessName}
        website={website}
        onWebsite={setWebsite}
      />
      {/* Always mounted, so that a screen reader announces a failure when it appears. */}
      <p role="alert" ref={errorBox} tabIndex={-1} className={formError ? ERROR_CLASS : "sr-only"}>
        {formError}
      </p>
      <Button type="submit" size="lg" className="w-full sm:w-auto" disabled={busy}>
        {busy && <Loader2 className="animate-spin" aria-hidden />}
        {busy ? COPY.PENDING_PAY : `Payer ${priceLabel}`}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { cache, type ComponentProps } from "react";
import { Ticket } from "lucide-react";

import { EmptyState } from "@/components/dashboard/empty-state";
import { CheckoutReturn } from "@/components/public/checkout-return";
import { OfferCheckoutForm } from "@/components/public/offer-checkout-form";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { plural } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { COPY, acceptedByLine } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { referenceForPage } from "@/lib/public/visibility";
import { boutiqueHref } from "@/lib/public-anchors";
import { paymentMode } from "@/lib/stripe";
import { formatMoney } from "@/lib/utils";
import { resolvePublicPro } from "@/server/public-context";
import { getOfferPage, getPurchaseReference } from "@/server/public-queries";
import { currentPublicVisitor } from "@/server/visitor";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string; offerId: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ paiement?: string | string[]; p?: string | string[] }>;
};

/** A query value that is one string, else undefined. */
const one = (value: string | string[] | undefined): string | undefined => (typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined);

/** One read of the pro and of the offer per request, shared by generateMetadata and the page. */
const loadOffer = cache(async (slug: string, offerId: string) => {
  const resolved = await resolvePublicPro(slug);
  if (!resolved) return null;
  const offer = await getOfferPage(resolved.pro.professionalId, offerId);
  return { ...resolved, offer };
});

/**
 * « {label} · {business} » for an offer on sale, the business name when it is no longer sold. The URL may carry `p`
 * (the cancel URL of a Checkout), so the referrer is not sent.
 */
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug, offerId } = await params;
  const loaded = await loadOffer(slug, offerId);
  if (!loaded) return { title: "Page introuvable", referrer: "no-referrer", robots: { index: false } };
  const { pro, offer } = loaded;
  const title = offer?.kind === "on_sale" ? `${offer.label} · ${pro.businessName}` : pro.businessName;
  return { title, referrer: "no-referrer" };
}

/**
 * One offer of the Boutique and its checkout (spec § 13.4, E9, contract § 3.23 and § 5). Dynamic by construction: it reads
 * the fresh session. A render never writes. Another pro's or an unknown offer is a 404; an offer that is no longer sold
 * says so and leads back to the Boutique.
 */
export default async function OfferPage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { slug, offerId } = await params;
  const query = await searchParams;
  const loaded = await loadOffer(slug, offerId);
  if (!loaded) notFound();
  const { pro, branding, offer } = loaded;
  if (!offer) notFound();
  if (offer.kind === "unavailable") {
    return (
      <PublicShell branding={branding} backHref={`/${slug}`}>
        <EmptyState
          icon={Ticket}
          title={COPY.OFFER_GONE}
          action={
            <Button asChild>
              <Link href={boutiqueHref(slug)}>{COPY.SEE_SHOP}</Link>
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </PublicShell>
    );
  }

  const visitor = await currentPublicVisitor(pro.professionalId, pro.ownerUserId);

  // The `?p=` reference describes THAT purchase, never its customer (Decision 71): read only on the cancel URL of a shop
  // Checkout, through the slug's pro, and shown only when it is a shop purchase of this very offer.
  const referenceId = one(query.paiement) === "annule" ? one(query.p) : undefined;
  const reference = referenceId ? await getPurchaseReference(pro.professionalId, referenceId) : null;
  const refView = referenceForPage(reference, { kind: "offer", offerId }, visitor.owner);
  let checkout: ComponentProps<typeof CheckoutReturn> | null = null;
  if (refView !== null) {
    checkout = {
      slug,
      purchaseId: refView.purchaseId,
      kind: refView.kind,
      status: refView.status,
      processing: refView.processing,
      resumeUrl: refView.status === "pending" ? refView.resumeUrl : null,
      holdUntilLabel: null,
      merciHref: `/${slug}/merci?p=${encodeURIComponent(refView.purchaseId)}`,
    };
  }

  const priceLabel = formatMoney(offer.priceCents, pro.currency);
  const accepted = offer.acceptedBy.length > 0 ? acceptedByLine(offer.acceptedBy) : null;
  const payment = paymentMode();
  const testMode = payment === "live" ? null : payment;

  return (
    <PublicShell branding={branding} backHref={`/${slug}`}>
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {checkout && <CheckoutReturn key={checkout.purchaseId} {...checkout} />}
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4 p-6">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight wrap-anywhere">{offer.label}</h1>
            <span className="inline-flex max-w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border px-3 py-1 text-sm">
              <span className="size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: offer.color }} aria-hidden />
              <span className="min-w-0 font-medium wrap-anywhere">{offer.ticketTypeName}</span>
            </span>
            {offer.typeDescription && (
              <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere whitespace-pre-line">{offer.typeDescription}</p>
            )}
            <p className="text-lg font-semibold">
              {offer.validityText ? `${priceLabel} · valable ${offer.validityText}` : priceLabel}
            </p>
            {accepted !== null && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600 wrap-anywhere">{accepted}</p>}
            <p className="text-sm wrap-anywhere">
              {`Vous recevez ${plural(offer.quantity, "ticket", "tickets")} « ${offer.ticketTypeName} » après le paiement.`}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <OfferCheckoutForm
              slug={slug}
              offerId={offerId}
              businessName={pro.businessName}
              priceLabel={priceLabel}
              visitor={{ state: visitor.state, email: visitor.state === "verified" ? visitor.email : null, name: visitor.name }}
              testMode={testMode}
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </PublicShell>
  );
}
```

The fields this task reads: `status: PurchaseStatus`, `processing: boolean`, `livemode: boolean`, `quantity: number`, `ticketTypeName: string`, `ticketCount: number` (tickets issued, 0 until paid) and `booking: { bookingId; occurrenceId; status: BookingStatus; holdExpiresAt: Date | null; title: string; startsAt: Date; endsAt: Date; location: string | null } | null` (the booking of THIS purchase, whatever its status). It never reads `customerId`.

```ts
// src/lib/public/merci-view.ts (pure)
export type MerciState =
  | { kind: "booked"; title: string; whenLabel: string }
  | { kind: "paid_shop"; count: number; typeName: string }
  | { kind: "paid_late"; count: number }
  | { kind: "processing" } | { kind: "pending" }
  | { kind: "expired"; withBooking: boolean };
/** paid + confirmed booking → booked; paid + ended booking → paid_late; paid without booking → paid_shop; pending + processing → processing; pending → pending; expired → expired (L1460-1461). */
export function merciStateOf(ref: PurchaseReference, tz: string): MerciState;
/** Title and body (exact copy in § 3.23). */
export function merciCopy(state: MerciState): { title: string; body: string };
```

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** none. S26 (a `?p=` of another pro gives 404 on `merci`) is proven by `purchase-reads.db.test.ts` (Task 12: `purchaseByReference` returns null) and by the page branch pinned in Step 1; the browser proves the visible 404 (Step 9.6).

Design notes (read before coding):
- Load the `design-taste-frontend` skill before writing the JSX (project rule). The page sits inside `PublicShell` and keeps the card system; the state icon is decorative, the state title is the page's heading.
- `merci` shows THAT purchase and nothing about its customer (Decision 71, SEC-C1): the page reads no session and no cookie, only the purchase the `p` reference names at the slug's pro; a missing, malformed or foreign `p` is `notFound()` (Decision 14). The title carries no personal data (« Confirmation · {businessName} »), the page is `noindex` and sends no referrer.
- Six states (spec L1460-1461, contract § 3.22): `booked` (paid, booking confirmed), `paid_shop` (paid, no booking), `paid_late` (paid, the booking ended: the place was released before the payment landed, L1136-1137), `processing` (pending with a delayed payment on its way), `pending` (pending, the confirmation is about to arrive), `expired`. A paid purchase whose booking is still `pending` is not in the contract's table: it can only be a transient moment (fulfilment confirms the purchase and its booking in one batch), so it reads `pending` and the refresher keeps looking.
- Only `pending` refreshes (`MerciRefresher active`): every 3 s, 20 times at most, with `router.refresh()` (a periodic read after no Server Action, the one allowed use besides `EmailCodeForm`), then the text « La confirmation vous sera envoyée par email. ». `processing` (a bank confirmation that can take days) does not refresh: its own body says an e-mail follows. The state title and body live in an `aria-live="polite"` region, so the change from « Paiement en attente de confirmation » to « Paiement reçu » is announced (COV-M12).
- `COPY.TEST_PAYMENT_LINE` is shown for a paid purchase with `livemode = false` (mock and Stripe test payments), the same string as the receipt (Decision 53).
- The `whenLabel` is built with the pro's time zone (`formatWhen(…, tz)`), never the host's: `merci-view.test.ts` runs both `Europe/Paris` and `America/Los_Angeles`, one DST day each.

```ts
/**
 * What the thank-you page says about a purchase (spec L1460-1461, contract § 3.22). Pure: it maps the purchase reference
 * to one of six states and a state to its copy; the page adds the test-payment line and the buttons. A state carries only
 * what the sentence needs (a title, a date, a count, a type name): never the purchase, the customer or an address
 * (Decision 71).
 */
import { formatCount, formatWhen } from "@/lib/back-office/format";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import type { PurchaseReference } from "@/lib/public/purchase-reads";

export type MerciState =
  | { kind: "booked"; title: string; whenLabel: string }
  | { kind: "paid_shop"; count: number; typeName: string }
  | { kind: "paid_late"; count: number }
  | { kind: "processing" }
  | { kind: "pending" }
  | { kind: "expired"; withBooking: boolean };

/**
 * paid + confirmed booking → booked; paid + ended booking → paid_late; paid without booking → paid_shop; pending +
 * processing → processing; pending → pending; expired → expired (L1460-1461). A paid purchase whose booking is still
 * pending is a transient moment (fulfilment confirms both in one batch): it reads pending, and the page keeps looking.
 */
export function merciStateOf(ref: PurchaseReference, tz: string): MerciState {
  if (ref.status === "paid") {
    const count = ref.ticketCount > 0 ? ref.ticketCount : ref.quantity;
    const booking = ref.booking;
    if (booking === null) return { kind: "paid_shop", count, typeName: ref.ticketTypeName };
    if (booking.status === "confirmed") {
      return { kind: "booked", title: booking.title, whenLabel: formatWhen(booking.startsAt, booking.endsAt, tz) };
    }
    if (booking.status === "pending") return { kind: "pending" };
    return { kind: "paid_late", count };
  }
  if (ref.status === "pending") return ref.processing ? { kind: "processing" } : { kind: "pending" };
  return { kind: "expired", withBooking: ref.booking !== null };
}

/** Title and body of a state (exact copy, contract § 3.23). */
export function merciCopy(state: MerciState): { title: string; body: string } {
  switch (state.kind) {
    case "booked":
      return {
        title: "Inscription confirmée",
        body: `Paiement reçu. Vous êtes inscrit(e) à « ${state.title} » (${state.whenLabel}). Vous recevez par email la confirmation et le reçu.`,
      };
    case "paid_shop":
      return {
        title: COPY.PAYMENT_RECEIVED,
        body:
          state.count === 1
            ? `Votre ticket « ${state.typeName} » est dans votre portefeuille.`
            : `Vos ${formatCount(state.count)} tickets « ${state.typeName} » sont dans votre portefeuille.`,
      };
    case "paid_late":
      return {
        title: COPY.PAYMENT_RECEIVED,
        body:
          state.count === 1
            ? "Paiement reçu, votre place n'était plus réservée : votre ticket est dans votre portefeuille."
            : `Paiement reçu, votre place n'était plus réservée : vos ${formatCount(state.count)} tickets sont dans votre portefeuille.`,
      };
    case "processing":
      return {
        title: COPY.PROCESSING,
        body: "Votre banque confirme le paiement. Vous recevrez un email dès qu'il sera validé.",
      };
    case "pending":
      return {
        title: "Paiement en attente de confirmation",
        body: "La confirmation arrive dans quelques secondes. Cette page se met à jour toute seule.",
      };
    case "expired":
      return state.withBooking
        ? { title: "Place expirée", body: "Le paiement n'a pas abouti et votre réservation a expiré." }
        : { title: "Paiement non abouti", body: "Le paiement n'a pas abouti." };
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Create `src/components/public/merci-refresher.tsx`**

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

/** The cadence of the periodic read while a payment waits for its confirmation (Decision 14, spec L1460-1461). */
const REFRESH_EVERY_MS = 3000;
const REFRESH_MAX = 20;
const GIVE_UP_TEXT = "La confirmation vous sera envoyée par email.";

/**
 * Re-reads the page every 3 seconds while `active` (a purchase pending its confirmation: the webhook or the mock
 * checkout is about to mark it paid), 20 times at most, then says that the confirmation comes by e-mail. A periodic read
 * after no Server Action, so refreshing the router is safe here (the hang of the pinned Next version is a refresh queued
 * right after an action). The page renders it with `key={state.kind}`: a state change starts a fresh counter. The status
 * line is always mounted, so a screen reader announces the sentence when it appears.
 */
export function MerciRefresher({ active }: { active: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [spent, setSpent] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!active) return;
    let count = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      count += 1;
      router.refresh();
      if (count >= REFRESH_MAX) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        setSpent(true);
      }
    }, REFRESH_EVERY_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [active, router]);

  return (
    <p role="status" className={active && spent ? "text-sm text-zinc-600" : "sr-only"}>
      {active && spent ? GIVE_UP_TEXT : ""}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { CheckCircle2, Clock, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

import { MerciRefresher } from "@/components/public/merci-refresher";
import { PublicShell } from "@/components/public/public-shell";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { merciCopy, merciStateOf } from "@/lib/public/merci-view";
import { COPY } from "@/lib/public/messages";
import { resolvePublicPro } from "@/server/public-context";
import { getPurchaseReference } from "@/server/public-queries";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ p?: string | string[] }>;
};

/**
 * The title carries no personal data (« Confirmation · {business} »), the page is never indexed and sends no referrer:
 * the URL carries the purchase reference `p`.
 */
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const resolved = await resolvePublicPro(slug, { includeSuspended: true });
  if (!resolved) return { title: "Page introuvable" };
  return { title: `Confirmation · ${resolved.pro.businessName}`, robots: { index: false }, referrer: "no-referrer" };
}

/**
 * The page a Checkout returns to (spec § 13.5, L1460-1461, contract § 3.22): the real state of THAT purchase and nothing
 * about its customer. A client who paid just before a suspension still sees it. It reads no session and no cookie: the
 * `p` reference, checked against this pro, is the capability. A missing, malformed or foreign `p` is a 404.
 */
export default async function MerciPage({ params, searchParams }: Props) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  const { p } = await searchParams;
  const resolved = await resolvePublicPro(slug, { includeSuspended: true });
  if (!resolved) notFound();
  const { pro, branding } = resolved;

  const reference = typeof p === "string" && p !== "" ? await getPurchaseReference(pro.professionalId, p) : null;
  if (reference === null) notFound();

  const state = merciStateOf(reference, pro.timezone);
  const { title, body } = merciCopy(state);
  const paid = state.kind === "booked" || state.kind === "paid_shop" || state.kind === "paid_late";
  const waiting = state.kind === "pending" || state.kind === "processing";
  const testLine = paid && !reference.livemode;
  const Icon = paid ? CheckCircle2 : waiting ? Clock : TriangleAlert;

  return (
    <PublicShell branding={branding} backHref={`/${slug}`}>
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-12 text-center">
          <Icon className={paid ? "size-14 text-success" : "size-14 text-zinc-600"} aria-hidden />
          <div aria-live="polite" className="space-y-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight wrap-anywhere">{title}</h1>
            <p className="mx-auto max-w-sm text-muted-foreground wrap-anywhere">{body}</p>
          </div>
          {testLine && <p className="text-sm text-zinc-600">{COPY.TEST_PAYMENT_LINE}</p>}
          <MerciRefresher key={state.kind} active={state.kind === "pending"} />
          <div className="mt-4 flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:w-auto sm:flex-row">
            <Button asChild>
              <Link href={`/${slug}/espace`}>Voir mon espace</Link>
            </Button>
            <Button asChild variant="secondary">
              <Link href={`/${slug}`}>Retour à la page</Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </PublicShell>
  );
}
```

**Interfaces:**

**Security tests owned here (contract § 8.4):** S31 (logs never print an e-mail, a token or a session id: the `console.*` greps of Step 2, one allowed line, the orphan-payment warning); S47 (public pages and HTML route responses refuse framing: the `curl` header checks of Step 6); S48 (a pro never learns from « Compte client lié » that a typed address belongs to a Skedul user: the grep of the writers of `customer.user_id`, Decision 72); S49 (client-initiated and fulfilment mails never spend a pro's budget: the `runEffects(…, "pro")` grep, Decision 74); S50 (no client name or e-mail typed by the pro reaches a URL: the `q=` grep, Decision 73). Their positive tests belong to Tasks 3 to 20a.

Design notes (read before running anything):
- This task adds no feature. It proves the whole of P4 against the contract's Global Constraints, fixes what the proof finds, and writes down what P5 and P6 must know. Every check below states its expected result; a check that does not give it is a defect of an earlier task: fix it at the site the output names, with the rule stated next to the check, then re-run the check (and every check after it). A failure that cannot be fixed without a migration, a new dependency or a change to a decision stops the sweep and is reported.
- Run order: the greps first (they find code to change), then typecheck, lint and the pure suite, then the build, the `curl` checks, the browser tour, the conditional Stripe step, and last the full DB suite, so that every gate number written into the outcome comes from the final code.

````markdown
# P4 (public, payments, identity): outcome

Plan: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-21-p4-public.md` · Contract: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-21-p4-public-contract.md` · Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-tickets-evenements-design.md`

What shipped: the public side of the tickets and events model on top of the P2 engine and the P3 back-office. Final gates (at <<HEAD>>): DB <<DB_GATE>>; pure <<PURE_GATE>>; tsc 0; eslint 0 errors and 0 warnings on every file changed since the base (the 3 diagnostics inherited from P3 are outside them); build green with every P4 route dynamic (`ƒ`); the zone-sensitive pure files (`planning-view`, `merci-view`, `public-emails`, `checkout`) pass under host zones `America/Los_Angeles` and `Europe/Paris`; the sweep greps are clean; browser tour of every route at 1280 and 375 px with a clean console, no horizontal scroll and every dialog Tab-trapped. This file keeps what the execution ledger, the contract and the final sweep decided, so that P5 (RDV libre) and P6 (rollout) can build on it after the ledger is deleted. The contract is committed with the plan at `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-21-p4-public-contract.md` (Task 1 checks that it is tracked). `LED:<n>` cites a line of the archived P3 ledger, `OUT:<n>` a line of the P2 outcome, `FR:<id>` a finding of the P3 final review.

## For the owner

- **Changes to the spec you are asked to approve.** Until you approve each one, the spec text stays as written and the contract wins for P4 only. Security won every trade-off.
  - Decision 4 (L827, L1322, L1341, L1483): `requireWalletOwner(proId)` is not built, in `client.ts` or anywhere: every export of a `"use server"` file is a public endpoint (an identity helper that returns a customer id must not be one), and a separate writer would let a wrapper link the account before its core has parsed and throttled the call. The Owner is the `owner` of the visitor `resolveVisitor` returns (read-only, `src/server/visitor.ts` `currentPublicVisitor`), and `bookWithHeldTicketCore` makes the one write itself; a pure guard fails if any source file names `requireWalletOwner`.
  - Decision 5 (L1344): the Owner is the customer whose e-mail is the session e-mail AND whose `user_id` is null or the session user (the spec names the e-mail only): the same predicate as `getMySpace` (L1377-1378), so a row already linked to another account is never treated as yours.
  - Decision 6 (L791): `upsertCustomer` enforces in SQL, on insert and on conflict, that `user_id` is set only for a verified user with the same e-mail, and that a missing phone is filled only by that user (the spec left it to the caller): anonymous input can no longer link an account or fill a stranger's phone.
  - Decision 7 (L1369): « Réserver avec 1 ticket » for a visitor who holds only a personal-link cookie opens the code dialog with an EMPTY address field (the spec prefills it): the cookie can be planted by a cross-site navigation, and a prefilled or locked address would steer the victim onto the attacker's identity.
  - Decision 9 (L1445-1455): two states are added to the séance page: « En cours » (started, not ended) and « Réservations pas encore ouvertes » (beyond the effective horizon, reachable by URL only).
  - Decision 27 (L1145, L1870): the mock checkout is reachable only when Stripe is off AND outside production, by `APP_ENV` and by `VERCEL_ENV` (the spec cuts it once Stripe is active), and a Vercel production deployment refuses to boot when `APP_ENV` is not `production`: `APP_ENV` defaults to `development`, so a keyless production would hand out free tickets (SEC-I5).
  - Decision 28 (L1146-1147): the mock checkout GET shows a simulated page and writes nothing; its same-origin POST pays and answers 303 to `merci` (the spec redirects on the first call): no side effect on a GET (prefetchers, L1847), and the abandon flow is testable in mock mode.
  - Decision 32 (L1167-1168): « Libérer ma place » releases nothing when Stripe cannot be reached, nor when Stripe says paid or processing, nor when the booking is confirmed (the spec releases otherwise): releasing a session that may still be paid would turn a payment into a late payment.
  - Decision 40 (L1228-1235): the code dialog uses the sign-in code for signed-out visitors only, and verification codes are sent only for a session of the same address (the spec counts and sends them for any existing account): closes OUT:129 (enumeration by timing, confirmation mails pushed to strangers).
  - Decision 64 (L709, L822): for a visitor who is not a verified identity, no answer depends on another customer's state: a free registration that hits `already_booked` answers as a new address would on this séance (a fresh success, or the same « Complet » answer when no seat is left) and re-sends the confirmation of the existing booking to its address only; a buy + book that hits `already_booked` or `too_many_holds` answers one neutral sentence. A verified identity keeps the engine sentences.
  - Decision 65 (L1268-1273): seat holds and free registrations are bounded per séance, per pro and per IPv6 /48, and buy + book refuses a new hold on a séance that already carries `holdCeiling(capacity)` live holds.
  - Decision 66 (L1268-1273): booking with a held ticket, client cancellation and « Libérer ma place » are throttled (`held`, `cancel`, `release`); the spec lists `free`, `buybook`, `rdv` and `shop` only.
  - Decision 67 (L1268-1273): e-mail keys are per pro (the spec's 6 per hour) plus a global mailbox bound (20 per hour), and a verified identity is throttled on its user key only: strangers typing an address can neither lock its verified holder out nor pin her holds.
  - Decision 68 (L1365-1366): a personal link sets the cookie only through a same-origin confirmation page (the spec sets it on the GET): a cross-site navigation or a mail scanner can no longer plant an identity.
  - Decision 69 (L1115-1117): every Checkout session carries `metadata { purchaseId, app: "skedul-tickets", env }`, and the webhook handles only its own app and environment (the spec records any paid session without a purchase as an orphan payment): the account also receives other billing, Payment Links and the events of other deployments, none of which is ever an orphan to refund.
  - Decision 72 (L1345-1346): the cross-pro link of `customer.user_id` at sign-in is removed (the spec links every pro's rows of a verified user): that link made the « Compte client lié » badge an oracle for typed addresses (FR:SEC-5). The link now comes only from the user's own act at that pro. This answers the SEC-5 question the P3 outcome left to you (« show it only when the link came from that client's own action at this pro »); it was applied without waiting because security comes first.
  - Decision 73 (a change to the P3 contract, not to the spec): the pro's client search goes through a Server Action and keeps the term in component state; `?filter=` stays in the URL (FR:UI-13). Cost: a search result has no shareable URL.
- **Product calls to confirm (no security reason behind them).** Decision 44 (L1353): the held-ticket button reads « Réserver avec 1 ticket (il vous en restera N) » for N of 1 or more and « Réserver avec mon dernier ticket » for 0. Decision 46 (L1521): the public « Semaine » view is seven day columns of chips (no hour grid, no lanes), and below 640 px only the list per day shows. Decision 48 (L1441-1442, L1699): no RDV libre cards in P4, because a card would link to a route that does not exist until P5; say whether you want link-less cards earlier (COV-I10).
- **Before P6, on your side:** the Stripe webhook endpoint of the production account enabled for `checkout.session.completed`, `checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded`, `checkout.session.async_payment_failed` and `checkout.session.expired`, with its secret in the production environment; `CRON_SECRET` of 32 characters at least set in production (the cron is `0 3 * * *` in `vercel.ts`; the route answers 401 without it); `APP_ENV=production` on the production Vercel project (the boot check refuses a production deployment otherwise); a `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` of 32 characters at least in production (the boot check refuses a production build with a shorter one); a real `RESEND_API_KEY` and a verified sending domain (the production build refuses to load the mailer without a key); your existing admin and pro accounts confirmed (a verified address); the Google consent screen out of Testing; rotate the Neon `neondb_owner` password (open since the P2 outcome). If the Stripe step above did not run, check once on the Stripe Checkout page whether Apple Pay and Google Pay appear (risk 10, spec L1819).

## Residuals accepted

- Decision 64: a buy + book refusal for a typed address (« Cette réservation ne peut pas être payée en ligne avec cette adresse. ») still differs from a Checkout redirect, and on a FULL séance from « Complet » (the engine tests `already_booked` before the seat); it is bounded by the e-mail keys and says nothing else about who holds the address. The free registration has no such residual: a registered address gets « Complet » on a full séance too.
- The personal-link token travels in the request path of `/api/c/<token>` (the e-mail link), so the platform request log keeps it; no log drain exports request paths, `logSafeMessage` masks `/api/c/…` in application logs, and the link is revocable (« Déconnecter mes liens »).
- The all-or-nothing `sweepHolds` batch (OUT:118): one drifted occurrence blocks the nightly sweep; the cron reports it (`errors`) and answers 500.
- `redactSubject` hard-codes 6 digits (OUT:128, COV-M7 part): a different code length needs the constant shared with `CODE_LENGTH`.
- The redacted subject of the production mock mail line (Decision 59, the P3 FR:SEC-3 ruling): the subject is logged without the code, and no P4 subject carries a client name or address.
- An Owner who releases her OWN pending booking from the payment block of that very séance sees the block unmount when the page revalidates (the booking is gone), so the dialog's focus restore finds no heading and the focus rests on the document; the line « Votre réservation a expiré. » then shows above the form. The reference path and `PendingHolds` keep their heading (Task 28).
- The 404 pages of the séance, offer and `merci` routes may answer HTTP status `<<NOTFOUND_STATUS>>` (see the curl check) because their `loading.tsx` has already streamed the shell when `notFound()` runs; the visible page is the 404 and the response carries the noindex meta. P3 added a layout only for the espace.
- SEC-M9 (`isPlainName`, Task 2 fix round 1): the rule refuses links, domain names, addresses and phone numbers however they are spaced or written (full-width forms, other digit scripts, invisible characters, the blank Hangul fillers included). A number or an address spelled out in words (« zéro six douze … », « arobase »), letters swapped for digits often enough to break every run of 5 (« O6 I2 34 S6 78 ») or any other sentence typed as a name are still relayed as plain text in the mails: a pure rule cannot tell them from a name, and the mail never turns them into a link. Two rare false positives are accepted: a dot glued to a word (« St.Pierre ») and a slash (« Anne/Paul »); the client reads « Prénom et nom : n'indiquez que votre nom. » and retypes.
- A paid purchase whose booking ended (« Paiement reçu, votre place n'était plus réservée … ») is also what `merci` says when a client cancelled their own paid booking and reopens the link later: the spec's mapping (paid + ended booking) does not tell the two apart.
````
